title: Java Product Architect
description:
Job description:
  
  
**Job Description**

We are looking for engineers for our Technology team, to work as Java Product Architect.

In this role, you will be part of the department in charge of developing the Denodo Platform. You will join one of the teams that develop and maintain some of the Denodo Platform modules and its associated tooling and extensions, with the possibility of moving to another team in the future based on your interests and skills, and even being able to become a team leader. As part of the product development, you could work in many different areas, such as connectors to integrate sources, execution engine, query optimization, cache engine, monitoring and resource management, management of the environments where the servers and tools of the platform are installed, automatic deployments (including cloud environments), task scheduling and parallel execution, self-service data discovery, client tools, etc.

The technologies and external tools with which you will work or interact are also very diverse. For example, different types of databases (relational, multidimensional, parallel, document-oriented, etc.), Big Data sources, SaaS sources, Web Services, message queues, technologies related to authentication and authorization (Identity Providers, SAML, OAuth, Kerberos, Vaults, etc.), cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), web technologies (both backend and frontend), indexing and search engines (Lucene, Elasticsearch), business intelligence tools, workflow management tools, version control systems, and many others.

Good remuneration in line with the candidate’s experience and knowledge, plus variable remuneration.

**Job Responsibilities & Duties**

* Initially, you will receive training on the Denodo Platform at the user level to understand the product that Denodo develops.
* You will also receive training on the development process used in Denodo and the tools involved in it (Redmine, Git, Jenkins, Sonar, automated test frameworks, etc.).
* After the initial training, you will join a team in charge of developing and maintaining one of the modules of the Denodo Platform and its ecosystem. You will receive training specific to the development of that module.
* Your main task will be the development of new features and the maintenance of existing ones. An important part of our development process is the design and implementation of automated tests.
* Creation and maintenance of the product documentation.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

We need people meeting the following requirements:

* BS or higher degree in Computer Science.
* At least 10+ years of experience in Software Development.
* Experience leading technical teams; or strong experience in designing and developing complex features affecting the architecture of software products.
* Programming experience with Java SE and Java/Jakarta EE.
* Knowledge of Design Patterns.
* Knowledge and experience in development Lifecycle and Version Control (pref. Maven and git).
* Knowledge of SQL and relational database design.
* Good written communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Team worker with a positive attitude.

We value knowledge and/or experience in the following (these are not required):

* Experience in Agile software development Methodologies.
* Experience developing in distributed application environments.
* Software security techniques and technologies.
* Spring Framework, Spring Boot and/or related technologies.
* Java Web Applications and related technologies, esp. server-side.
* Client-side Web technologies.
* Cloud data warehouses, cloud data lake engines, NoSQL databases.

description:

Join a leading global organization driving enterprise Data, Analytics & AI Transformation using Palantir Foundry, AIP and modern data & cloud technologies.

**Location:**
Chennai (Hybrid)

**Experience:**
10+ Years

We are looking for a
**hands-on Palantir Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise data, AI, and operational solutions using Palantir Foundry, Ontology, and AIP.**

You will connect
**enterprise data to business decisions and governed actions, while designing secure integrations and writeback workflows with systems such as SAP, Salesforce, TrakSYS, Workday, and comparable enterprise applications.**

* **Deep knowledge of Foundry data integration, transformations, Ontology, actions, functions, and operational applications.**

* **Experience architecting solutions across Foundry, Snowflake, and enterprise applications.**

**Good to Have:-**

* SAP, Salesforce, Workday, or TrakSYS integration experience.
* Atlan or comparable metadata/catalog and lineage experience.

* SAP BW on HANA, TypeScript, manufacturing/supply-chain, or enterprise middleware experience.
* Palantir Foundry or AIP certification.

**What You Can Expect:-**

* Opportunity to shape enterprise-scale Palantir Foundry, Ontology, and AIP architecture.
* Work on high-impact data, AI, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate across business, data, application, security, governance, and platform teams.
* A hands-on architecture role with responsibility for standards, delivery quality, and business outcomes.

title: Design Team Lead
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – DESIGN TEAM LEAD (ARCHITECTURAL / Interior Design / JOINERY)**

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are looking for an experienced Design Team Lead with strong expertise in architectural design, interior design , and joinery design, preferably in the interior fit-out or construction industry. The candidate will be responsible for leading the design team, reviewing architectural and interior drawings, ensuring technical accuracy, coordinating joinery detailing, and delivering design documents within project timelines. The role also involves coordinating with project execution, estimation, procurement, and other departments, resolving design-related issues, maintaining design quality, and guiding team members to ensure efficient and accurate design delivery.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*Responsibilities include but are not limited to:*

* Lead and manage the architectural, interior design, and joinery design team to ensure quality and timely completion of design deliverables.
* Review architectural drawings, interior layouts, design concepts, detailed drawings, and joinery drawings to ensure technical accuracy and compliance with project requirements.
* Develop and review space planning, interior layouts, material selections, finishes, and design details based on client requirements and project specifications.
* Prepare, review, and approve technical drawings, working drawings, shop drawings, and joinery detailing before submission or execution.
* Ensure design drawings are practical, technically feasible, and suitable for site execution, fabrication, and installation.
* Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, estimation, procurement, and execution teams to resolve design discrepancies and technical issues.
* Review joinery drawings, furniture details, cabinetry layouts, material specifications, hardware requirements, and fabrication details.
* Identify design clashes, dimensional errors, and coordination issues before construction or manufacturing begins.
* Coordinate with clients, architects, consultants, and vendors regarding design approvals, technical clarifications, and drawing revisions.
* Monitor design schedules, allocate tasks, and ensure drawings and design documents are submitted within project deadlines.
* Review project specifications, material requirements, and finishing details to ensure compliance with approved designs and quality standards.
* Coordinate with the estimation and procurement teams to support BOQ preparation, material selection, cost evaluation, and value engineering.
* Review design changes and assess their impact on project timelines, material requirements, fabrication, and execution.
* Ensure timely incorporation of client comments, consultant feedback, and site-related design changes.
* Maintain proper documentation of drawings, revisions, approvals, technical details, and design records.
* Establish and maintain design standards, drawing procedures, quality control practices, and documentation protocols.
* Guide, mentor, and support design team members to improve technical knowledge, productivity, and design quality.
* Monitor team performance, distribute workloads, and ensure consistency and accuracy across all design submissions.
* Coordinate with site teams to resolve execution-related design queries and provide technical support wherever required.
* Ensure the latest approved drawings are shared with the relevant departments to avoid errors, rework, and delays.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Strong knowledge of architectural design, interior design, and joinery detailing.
* Experience in preparing and reviewing architectural drawings, working drawings, shop drawings, and joinery drawings.
* Good understanding of interior fit-out processes, construction detailing, furniture design, and fabrication methods.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, technical specifications, and project requirements.
* Knowledge of materials, finishes, hardware, joinery components, and installation methods.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and other relevant design software.
* Knowledge of SketchUp, Revit, 3ds Max, or other 3D modelling and BIM tools will be an advantage.
* Understanding of design coordination, drawing revisions, technical documentation, and quality control.
* Ability to identify design clashes, resolve technical issues, and provide practical design solutions.
* Strong team leadership, task allocation, and team management skills.
* Good communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet strict deadlines.
* Attention to detail and a strong focus on design accuracy and execution quality.

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in architectural design, interior design, or joinery design, preferably in the interior fit-out or construction industry.
* Hands-on experience in preparing, reviewing, and coordinating architectural drawings, interior working drawings, and joinery shop drawings.
* Experience in commercial interior fit-out projects, including offices, retail spaces, hospitality, or other commercial establishments.
* Proven experience in leading or supervising a design team and managing design deliverables.
* Experience coordinating with project execution, estimation, procurement, and site teams.
* Knowledge of joinery fabrication, furniture detailing, material specifications, and installation requirements.
* Experience in client coordination, design approvals, drawing revisions, and technical issue resolution.
* Strong understanding of design quality standards, project timelines, and construction requirements.
* Experience in managing multiple projects and ensuring timely delivery of design documentation will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Architect | Strategic Enterprise Architecture
description:
**Company Description**

**About NIQ:** NIQ is a leading global consumer intelligence company, helping clients understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what they should do next. Our data, technology, AI, and analytics capabilities power decision-making for some of the world’s most important consumer, retail, and technology businesses.

AI is central to NIQ’s next stage of growth. We are building trusted, scalable, and high-impact AI capabilities that transform how insights are created, delivered, and adopted across the business. This role will help shape the platforms, operating model, and leadership system needed to make that ambition real.

 **Job Description**

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are building and evolving Connect, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by AI, cloud and on-premises technologies. Clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will define architecture for key components and capabilities across NIQ platforms, ensuring alignment with business strategy, product objectives, technology standards, and the long-term platform vision. You will partner with architecture peers, Product and Operations leaders, engineering leaders, and development teams to take solutions from initial requirements through design, delivery, and production operation. A key focus of this role is shaping the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and agentic AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine broad enterprise architecture experience with practical knowledge of AI-enabled systems and will grow into an end-to-end platform architect as their knowledge of NIQ's platforms expands.

**Role Mandate:** Act as the strategic Enterprise Architecture partner and single point of architecture accountability for an assigned NIQ product portfolio. The role connects business and product strategy to target-state architecture, capability ownership, technology roadmaps, governed standards, and delivery feedback. It is intentionally strategic while remaining close enough to Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Architecture Practice teams to ensure that direction is actionable and produces measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

* Own and maintain the portfolio target-state architecture and rolling three-year technology roadmap, aligned with business priorities, product strategy, engineering plans, and enterprise transformation goals.
* Serve as the named strategic architecture partner and single point of EA accountability for the assigned portfolio, building trusted working relationships with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data Science, Security, and business leadership.
* Create and maintain business-capability, domain, application, data, and platform maps that expose ownership, dependencies, duplication, maturity gaps, lifecycle risk, and opportunities for simplification or growth.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear architecture outcomes, transition states, investment options, sequencing recommendations, and measurable decision criteria.
* Guide platform-placement and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing enterprise reuse and standards with appropriate portfolio autonomy, speed, cost, resilience, and client commitments.
* Define and contribute reusable reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and decision trees, including patterns for AI, Generative AI, agentic AI, data, integration, cloud, security, and observability.
* Drive adoption of approved architecture standards and bring standards, reference architectures, major exceptions, and cross-functional decisions through the lightweight EA governance process for ratification.
* Own visibility of portfolio architecture risks, strategic exceptions, technical debt, capability gaps, and cross portfolio dependencies; ensure actions, owners, and escalation paths are clear.
* Partner with the Solution Architecture pillar to triage architecturally significant demand, shape initiatives early, and ensure delivery-level learning feeds back into portfolio strategy, standards, and roadmaps.
* Assess emerging technologies and market shifts, especially AI and agentic commerce, and convert relevant signals into adoption guidance, controlled experiments, investment recommendations, and roadmap implications.
* Enable self-service architecture by creating high-quality, reusable content for NIQ architecture knowledge repositories and supporting AI-enabled access to standards, patterns, decisions, and portfolio views.
* Establish and run an effective operating cadence, including strategic portfolio reviews, intake alignment with Solution Architecture, reference artifact alignment with the Architecture Practice, and architect-only sessions to drive capability and domain consistency.
* Define outcome-oriented measures for the portfolio, such as roadmap adoption, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, decision cycle time, standards adoption, and value realized from technology investments.
* Support M&A due diligence and integration planning by assessing capability fit, architecture compatibility, technology risk, redundancy, security considerations, and potential integration paths.
* Mentor architects and engineering leaders, communicate complex decisions clearly, and influence across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, solution architecture, platform architecture, or enterprise architecture, including significant experience with enterprise-scale products and data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to define target-state architectures and multi-year technology roadmaps, and to connect them to business capabilities, product objectives, investment decisions, and executable transition plans.
* Experience operating as a strategic advisor to senior Product, Engineering, Technology, Operations, or business leaders, with evidence of influencing decisions across multiple organizations and geographies.
* Strong knowledge of capability-based planning, domain and platform mapping, application rationalization, technology lifecycle management, technical debt, and architecture risk management.
* Experience creating and driving adoption of enterprise standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, architecture decision records, and governance processes that are pragmatic and lightweight.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud, data, integration, API, security, resilience, observability, and distributed system architecture, preferably in Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI architectures, including model and tool integration, retrieval augmented generation, orchestration, context and memory, evaluation, guardrails, observability, human oversight, and Responsible AI controls.
* Ability to assess emerging technologies and develop clear build-versus-buy, adoption, migration, and total-cost of-ownership recommendations.
* Experience partnering with Solution Architecture and delivery teams on architecturally significant initiatives while preserving a strategic, portfolio-wide perspective.
* Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to express complex architecture choices as concise options, trade-offs, decisions, roadmaps, and executive-level narratives.
* Proven facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to establish accountability and progress in a matrixed organization.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in data, analytics, measurement, consumer intelligence, retail, media, or other information intensive product environments.
* Knowledge of ArchiMate, capability-based planning methods, and enterprise architecture repositories such as ADOIT.
* Experience with product operating models, agile delivery, portfolio planning, FinOps, and outcome-based technology investment governance.
* Experience supporting technology due diligence, post-merger integration, platform consolidation, or large-scale modernization and simplification programs.
* Hands-on engineering or architecture experience with APIs, Python, databases, data pipelines, cloud-native platforms, MLOps or LLMOps, or enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI.
* Thinks in business capabilities, portfolios, platforms, and multi-year outcomes rather than isolated projects.

**Successful Profile:**

* Balances enterprise consistency with purposeful autonomy and avoids governance for its own sake.
* Creates clarity from complexity, makes decision ownership explicit, and converts strategy into reusable architecture assets.
* Builds trust through early engagement, pragmatic recommendations, transparent trade-offs, and reliable follow-through.
* Uses delivery feedback to continuously improve target states, standards, patterns, and investment guidance.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

title: Senior Engineer, IAM with designing and architecturing AI/ML systems
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.

title: Enterprise Architect

Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Job Summary**
---------------

**About the role**
------------------

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you operate at the front line of delivery ; embedded with the client, turning ambiguous business problems into working software, fast. You own the outcome end to end: conceptualize the solution, prototype it, integrate it into the client's real environment, harden it, and lead a small team to ship and sustain it. You are part builder, part consultant, and an engineer who uses AI/GenAI as a force multiplier for delivery and operational efficiency. You bring HCLTech's AI/GenAI capabilities to life inside the client's world, with Responsible AI and security as non-negotiables

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Conceptualize fast:** embed with stakeholders, rapidly frame a solution to a business problem, and stand up a working prototype in days, not weeks.
* **Own efficiency as the scorecard:** drive measurable delivery efficiency and operational efficiency ; shorter cycle times, less manual effort, lower defect leakage, clear ROI.
* **Engineer with AI leverage:** use AI coding assistants / toolset across the SDLC to lift your own and the pod's productivity and quality.
* **Apply agents and automation:** work with coding agents, custom agents and reusable skills to automate delivery and operations workflows; build them where the problem warrants it.
* **Get reliable AI output:** apply prompt engineering and sound context practices (context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context-graph patterns) so AI output is accurate, cost-aware and production-grade.
* **Integrate to standards:** design standards-based integrations using proven integration patterns that plug into client ecosystems predictably and securely.
* **Make reusability and predictability the default:** build assets, templates and patterns the pod and account can re-apply, so outcomes are consistent and repeatable.
* **Prototype and iterate quickly:** favor fast, testable prototypes over big up-front design; learn from each loop.
* **Own DevOps and DevSecOps:** CI/CD, shift-left security, infrastructure-as-code, and automated testing built in from day one.
* **Run a continuous, adaptable feedback loop:** use telemetry, quality signals, evals and client feedback to iterate both the solution and the AI behind it.
* **Stay ahead of the curve:** adopt emerging AI and engineering concepts quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
* **Lead and mentor:** set technical direction for a lean team of 3 or 4, raise the engineering bar, and grow the pod's overall capability and AI fluency.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* **Strong software engineering fundamentals -** design, clean code, version control, testing, sound architecture; with hands-on full-stack delivery.
* **Proven experience** with standards-based integrations, integration patterns, DevOps/DevSecOps and test automation.
* **Conceptual fluency in AI/GenAI** and a working habit of using AI coding assistants for productivity; understands what agents, prompting, RAG and context graphs are and where they add value.
* **Ability to conceptualize solutions** to business problems quickly and operate effectively in ambiguous, customer-embedded settings.
* **Client-facing maturity:** translates fluidly between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and owns outcomes.
* **Experience mentoring or leading** small teams.
* **A genuine appetite** to deepen AI/GenAI skills fast.

**What great looks like (strongly preferred)**
----------------------------------------------

* **Hands-on experience building custom agents and reusable skills,** not just consuming AI tools.
* **Practical command of prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching and RAG / context-graph design,** including cost and latency optimization.
* **Experience designing agentic / GenAI solutions** on platforms such as GHCP, Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor or comparable (multi-LLM, Responsible AI, governance-aware).
* **A track record of turning field patterns into reusable accelerators** adopted beyond a single engagement.

----------------------

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. As part of Caterpillar’s digital strategy, the MineStar suite delivers an integrated platform that connects machines and enterprise systems to enable real-time monitoring, control, and optimisation of mining operations.

To support this vision, we are evolving our software delivery model through a **DevSecOps approach**, embedding security, automation, and operational excellence across the software lifecycle.

We are seeking an experienced **Product Owner – DevSecOps** to lead prioritisation and delivery within a DevSecOps enablement team. This role focuses on enabling engineering teams to deliver software **faster, more securely, and with greater reliability** through platform capabilities, standardised pipelines, and integrated security practices.

**Role Overview**

The Product Owner – DevSecOps is responsible for defining and prioritising the backlog for DevSecOps capabilities, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, security controls, and developer enablement services.

The role acts as the bridge between **engineering, security, platform, and business stakeholders**, ensuring that DevSecOps investments deliver measurable improvements in delivery velocity, quality, security, and compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **DevSecOps Backlog Ownership**
  + Own and prioritise the DevSecOps backlog, aligning with platform strategy, security requirements, and engineering needs.
  + Define and sequence features such as CI/CD pipelines, IaC capabilities, environment provisioning, and security tooling.

* **Program Increment (PI) Planning & Delivery**
  + Lead backlog refinement and planning activities for Program Increments, ensuring clear, prioritised, and outcome-driven deliverables.
  + Ensure features deliver measurable improvements in automation, standardisation, and developer experience.

* **Security & Compliance Integration**
  + Drive the inclusion of security controls (e.g., scanning, secrets management, policy-as-code) into delivery pipelines.
  + Ensure alignment with enterprise compliance frameworks and audit requirements (e.g., ISO, governance standards).

* **Platform & Enablement Focus**
  + Prioritise initiatives that enable self-service, reusable “golden paths,” and standardised DevSecOps patterns across teams.
  + Balance platform standardisation with product team flexibility and adoption.

* **Technical Alignment & Architecture Enablement**
  + Collaborate with architects and technical leads to support architectural runway, including infrastructure modernisation, pipeline standardisation, and reduction of technical debt.
  + Ensure adequate backlog allocation for platform capabilities and engineering enablement.

* **Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**
  + Act as the primary interface between DevSecOps teams and stakeholders across engineering, security, and leadership.
  + Provide clear visibility into priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes.

* **Value Delivery & Continuous Improvement**
  + Define success metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time, security posture, incident reduction).
  + Continuously refine priorities based on feedback, adoption, and performance data.

**Experience Required**

* 4+ years’ experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role in software delivery environments.
* Experience working with **DevOps or DevSecOps practices**, including CI/CD, cloud platforms, or infrastructure automation.
* Proven experience working within Agile frameworks (SAFe, Scrum, etc.).
* Experience delivering platform or enablement capabilities (preferred).

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of **DevSecOps principles**, including automation, security integration, and continuous delivery.
* Ability to translate technical platform capabilities into **business value outcomes**.
* Strong stakeholder management across engineering, security, and leadership domains.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to prioritise high-impact initiatives.
* Strong communication and influencing skills in complex, cross-functional environments.
* Familiarity with modern engineering ecosystems (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub, cloud platforms, IaC tools).

Competitive salary based on degree and professional industry working experience. The Total Rewards package includes:

* Competitive remuneration package

* Career development with global prospects
* A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing

* A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity, and equal outcome

* The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Architect to own the technical direction of our platform across web and backend systems. **Backend & Services**

**Data & Streaming**

  — event streaming, producers/consumers, partitioning, and stream processing at scale.
* **Clickstream**
  data pipelines — capturing, processing, and analyzing high-volume user-event data.
* **MySQL**
  (and relational data modeling, query optimization, indexing, replication) — plus exposure to NoSQL stores (Redis, MongoDB, Cassandra/DynamoDB).
* Data warehousing and analytics pipelines (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalents).

**Frontend**

* Modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React / Angular / Vue) and responsive, performant UI architecture.

**Cloud, Infra & DevOps**

* Cloud platforms (AWS / GCP ), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Caching, CDN, load balancing, and high-availability design for high-traffic consumer systems.
* Observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).

**AI-Native Tooling**

* Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tooling across the SDLC, and a clear view on applying AI within the product.

**Qualifications**

**What You Bring**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong full-stack foundation across modern web frameworks, backend services, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Proven track record architecting and delivering large-scale, high-traffic systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams of 10–20 engineers and running multiple projects simultaneously without compromising timelines.
* Strong prioritization instincts — able to align technical decisions with business outcomes and defend trade-offs.
* Hands-on fluency with AI-native development tooling and a clear point of view on applying AI across the engineering lifecycle.
* Excellent leadership, mentorship, and stakeholder-communication skills.
* Solid project management capability (Agile/Scrum or equivalent).

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in travel-tech, e-commerce, or high-scale consumer platforms.

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly experienced Compiler / Software Architect to join our NPU Hardware Architecture team and play a key role in the hardware-software co-design of next-generation AI inference accelerators.
  
  
This is a unique role at the intersection of NPU hardware architecture, AI compilers, performance modeling, and software development. The position will work directly with hardware architects to define, evaluate, and prototype the software stack required to program current and future NPU architectures.
  
  
Our NPU architecture is closely coupled with the compiler stack. Efficient utilization of the accelerator requires deep understanding of the hardware compute architecture, memory hierarchy, dataflow, scheduling, quantization, instruction set and execution model. The successful candidate will use this understanding to develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts, evaluate architectural proposals against real AI workloads, and influence the design of future NPU hardware.
  
  
You will work closely with hardware architects, micro-architects, compiler engineers and AI software teams to answer a fundamental question:
  
  
**How should the NPU hardware and software be co-designed to deliver the best performance, power efficiency, programmability and scalability for real-world AI workloads?**
What You Will Be Responsible For
  
  
Compiler & Software Architecture for NPU
  
  

* Develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts for current and next-generation NPU architectures.
* Define software abstractions and compiler flows that efficiently expose NPU hardware capabilities to AI workloads.
* Develop and evaluate compiler concepts including graph lowering, intermediate representations, operator mapping, scheduling, tiling, fusion, memory planning and code generation.
* Translate NPU architectural concepts into executable software models and demonstrate their feasibility using representative AI workloads.
* Develop lightweight compiler/runtime infrastructure to validate new hardware features before production software implementation.
* Analyze existing compiler limitations and identify architectural changes required to improve programmability and accelerator utilization.

Hardware–Software Co-Design
  
  

* Work as an integral member of the hardware architecture team to co-design NPU hardware and software.
* Analyze how proposed hardware features can be effectively exposed through the compiler and software stack.
* Provide software-driven feedback on compute architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, dataflow, scheduling, instruction set and accelerator programmability.
* Identify hardware features that provide meaningful benefits to real AI workloads and challenge features that add hardware complexity without sufficient software value.
* Define compiler requirements and software abstractions for new NPU capabilities.
* Participate in architecture and micro-architecture reviews and influence hardware decisions from a software and workload perspective.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs considering performance, power, area, compiler complexity and software scalability.

AI Workload & Performance Analysis
  
  

* Analyze representative AI models and workloads to identify compute, memory, bandwidth, scheduling and data-movement bottlenecks.
* Build software-based performance models and workload prototypes to evaluate architectural concepts.
* Develop experiments to quantify the impact of proposed hardware features on model performance and accelerator utilization.
* Investigate issues such as quantization, sparsity, operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, data reuse, memory bandwidth and scheduling efficiency.
* Correlate software/model-level performance with architectural and micro-architectural behavior.
* Use workload analysis to guide both current-generation optimizations and next-generation NPU architecture.

Architecture Prototyping
  
  

* Rapidly prototype software solutions for architectural concepts that may be months or years away from production silicon.
* Develop functional models, compiler prototypes, simulators, emulators, reference implementations or runtime abstractions as needed to validate architectural ideas.
* Demonstrate end-to-end execution of representative AI workloads on proposed NPU architectures.
* Build proof-of-concepts that allow hardware architects to make informed architectural decisions before RTL implementation.
* Help establish software models and interfaces that can later evolve into production compiler components.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with NPU hardware architects, micro-architects, RTL designers and the production compiler/software organization.
* Bridge the communication gap between hardware and software teams and translate requirements in both directions.
* Participate in architecture definition from early concept through implementation and silicon bring-up.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction for compiler-driven hardware/software co-design.
* Influence the roadmap of future NPU architectures through workload and software-driven insights.

**Necessary Qualifications**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  
  
8+ years of experience in compiler development, systems software, computer architecture, AI accelerators, or a closely related area.
  
  
Strong understanding of compiler architecture and compiler optimization techniques.
  
  
Strong C++ programming skills and proficiency in Python.
  
  
Strong understanding of computer architecture and familiarity with accelerator architectures, memory hierarchies and data movement.
  
  
Experience analyzing AI/ML workloads and understanding performance bottlenecks.
  
  
Ability to work across hardware and software boundaries and communicate effectively with hardware architects.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate architectural ideas.
  
  
Good to have
  
  

* Experience developing compilers or software stacks for NPUs, GPUs, DSPs, TPUs or other AI accelerators.
* Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TOSA, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR or similar compiler infrastructure.
* Experience with accelerator-specific scheduling, tiling, memory management or code generation.
* Understanding of NPU architecture concepts such as dataflow, tensor engines, systolic/array-based compute, local SRAMs, DMA/data movement and accelerator instruction sets.

title: Embedded Software Technical Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.

title: Firmware Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Firmware Lead**, you will lead implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for Kandou's Randa 1.6T Active Electrical Cable platform. This is a coding-heavy technical leadership role: you will spend the majority of your time writing and reviewing C/C++, debugging firmware and hardware interactions, and supporting pre-silicon and post-silicon bring-up. You will turn the Firmware Architect's system design into production code, own implementation quality and delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining active in the codebase.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for AEC retimer silicon across 224G/lane, 448G/lane and forward-looking 896G/lane configurations; remain a hands-on C/C++ contributor.
* Implement and maintain boot, configuration, calibration, link-training, fault-recovery and run-time supervision state machines on resource-constrained RISC-V or ARM platforms.
* Translate approved firmware architecture into module designs, APIs, task and interrupt models, memory budgets and hardware/software contracts; surface implementation tradeoffs early.
* Code, debug and optimize firmware for SerDes equalization and adaptation, FEC-aware monitoring and re-adaptation, telemetry capture, thermal behavior and power management.
* Own low-level drivers and management interfaces including SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C, MCTP and JTAG, and integrate firmware services with the CMIS management layer.
* Drive pre-silicon development and first-silicon bring-up; isolate issues across firmware, RTL, boards and lab setups using JTAG, register traces and targeted instrumentation.
* Set coding and review standards; build unit, integration and hardware-in-loop tests; enforce CI, static analysis and release evidence; improve Python-based build, debug and test tools.
* Break the roadmap into deliverable work packages, estimate and track execution, mentor firmware engineers and coordinate with architecture, ASIC, DV, validation, SI and applications teams.

**Essential Experience**

* 8+ years developing and debugging production real-time firmware in C/C++, including 2+ years leading firmware modules, projects or a small team.
* Expert hands-on C/C++ in resource-constrained systems, with recent evidence of personal code delivery, code review and complex defect resolution.
* Firmware experience on a retimer, gearbox, PHY, AEC, AOC, optical module, networking ASIC or comparable high-speed mixed hardware/software product.
* RISC-V and/or ARM bare-metal or RTOS firmware, including interrupts, traps, CSR or register access, concurrency and tight RAM/flash budgets.
* RTOS development with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent; ownership of scheduling, synchronization, timing and failure recovery.
* At least one silicon or board bring-up cycle using JTAG and related debug mechanisms, with root-cause analysis across firmware, drivers, RTL and hardware.
* Python, Git/GitLab, Make/CMake, CI, unit and integration testing, and static analysis, with disciplined reproducible development workflows.

BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience; strong communication, planning, mentoring and cross-functional leadership.

**Useful experience**

* IEEE 802.3ck or 802.3dj link training and equalization, SerDes adaptation algorithms, channel-quality monitoring and register-level PHY tuning.
* FEC exposure including KP4 or RS-544, pre-FEC and post-FEC telemetry, symbol-error analysis and FEC-aware recovery behavior.
* CMIS 5.x firmware integration, module or datapath state machines, VDM telemetry, and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C and MCTP.
* Bootloaders, secure boot, root of trust, authenticated A/B firmware updates, rollback protection and field-recovery mechanisms.
* Pre-silicon firmware development using QEMU, SystemC, FPGA, simulation or emulation; heterogeneous multicore or vector-processing systems.

PCIe or CXL, hyperscaler qualification, interoperability debugging, and production support for field or manufacturing issues.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

title: Senior Siemens Opcenter MES System Developer
description:
Job Description: **Senior Siemens Opcenter MES System Developer**

Experience: **8+ Years**

Location: **Hyderabad**

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Opcenter MES system developer to design, develop, configure, integrate, and support Siemens Opcenter MES solutions across manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience translating manufacturing requirements into scalable MES applications and will be responsible for both system design and software development.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop Siemens Opcenter MES solutions based on manufacturing and business requirements.
* Configure and customize Opcenter MES modules, workflows, screens, business rules, and reports.
* Develop integrations between Opcenter MES and ERP, PLM, automation, equipment, warehouse, quality, and other enterprise systems.
* Design application architecture, data models, interfaces, and technical specifications.
* Develop and maintain APIs, web services, database procedures, and integration components.
* Analyze existing manufacturing processes and recommend opportunities for standardization and automation.
* Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Troubleshoot system issues and perform root-cause analysis.
* Develop technical documentation, configuration guides, test plans, and support procedures.
* Collaborate with global manufacturing sites to implement consistent MES processes.
* Support data migration, system upgrades, validation, and release management.
* Follow software development, cybersecurity, change management, and IT governance standards.
* Provide technical guidance to project teams, business users, and other developers.

Required Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience designing and developing manufacturing execution systems.
* Hands-on experience with Siemens Opcenter MES or a comparable MES platform.
* Strong understanding of MES concepts, including:
* Workflows and production operations
* Dispatching and scheduling
* Material and lot traceability
* Electronic work instructions
* Quality and nonconformance management
* Equipment and labour tracking
* Genealogy and reporting
* Experience with software design, application development, system configuration, and integration.
* Strong SQL and relational database development experience.
* Experience developing or consuming APIs, web services, and system interfaces.
* Knowledge of application development using technologies such as .NET, Java, JavaScript, or similar.
* Experience with the software development lifecycle, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience integrating Opcenter MES with ERP systems
* Experience with REST APIs, message brokers, middleware, and event-driven architectures.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, and automated testing.
* Experience supporting semiconductor, optical, electronics, or discrete manufacturing.
* Experience with digital twin, Industry 4.0, or smart factory initiatives.
* Siemens Opcenter certification or relevant professional certification.

Key Competencies

* MES solution design and architecture
* Opcenter configuration and development
* Manufacturing process analysis
* System integration
* Database and API development
* Problem solving and root-cause analysis
* Stakeholder management
* Technical documentation
* Agile project delivery

Scope of Work

1. Business Requirements Gathering

* Engage with business stakeholders, production teams, quality, maintenance, warehouse, and IT teams to understand current manufacturing processes.
* Conduct workshops, interviews, and site visits to gather functional and non-functional requirements.
* Document business requirements and obtain stakeholder approval.

2. Process Analysis and Documentation

* Analyse existing ("As-Is") manufacturing processes and identify pain points and improvement opportunities.
* **Design future-state ("To-Be") processes aligned with MES capabilities and business objectives.**
* Develop process maps, workflow diagrams, and business process documentation.3. Requirements Management
* Create and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritise requirements based on business value, regulatory compliance, and project scope.
* Manage requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

4. Gap Analysis

* Compare current business processes with standard MES functionality.
* Identify functional gaps and recommend process changes, system configuration, or customisations where necessary.
* Evaluate impacts on manufacturing operations and business processes.

5. Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary liaison between business users, implementation partners, solution architects, developers, and project management.
* Facilitate discussions to resolve business and functional issues.
* Ensure stakeholder expectations are aligned throughout the implementation.

6. Functional Solution Design

* Collaborate with solution architects to translate business requirements into functional solutions.
* Review system configurations to ensure alignment with approved business requirements.
* Support the definition of workflows, business rules, and exception handling.

7. Integration Requirements

* Define business requirements for integrations between MES and enterprise systems such as ERP, SCADA, PLCs, LIMS, WMS, and quality systems.
* Work with integration teams to validate end-to-end business processes.
* Ensure data consistency and process continuity across integrated systems.

8. Master Data Management

* Identify manufacturing master data requirements, including products, materials, equipment, routing, work centers, recipes, and resources.
* Support data mapping, validation, and migration activities.
* Ensure data quality and governance standards are followed.

9. Testing Support

* Develop test scenarios and business test cases.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production validation.
* Coordinate defect triage with business users and technical teams.
* Validate that implemented functionality meets business requirements.

10. Change Management and Training

* Assess business impacts resulting from new MES processes.
* Prepare training materials, user guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Conduct user training sessions and support organisational change management initiatives.

11. Deployment and Go-Live Support

* Assist in deployment planning and production readiness assessments.
* Support cutover activities and business validation during go-live.
* Monitor user adoption and provide functional support during hypercare.

12. Risk and Issue Management

* Identify business risks associated with MES implementation.
* Escalate issues affecting project scope, timeline, or operational readiness.
* Recommend mitigation strategies and participate in issue resolution.

13. Compliance and Quality Assurance

* Ensure MES processes comply with industry regulations, company standards, and quality requirements.
* Support audit readiness by maintaining complete and accurate business documentation.
* Verify that electronic records and manufacturing workflows meet applicable compliance requirements.

14. Continuous Improvement

* Collect user feedback after implementation.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization and system enhancements.
* Support future MES releases, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Deliverables

* Business Requirements Document (MD50)
* Technical Requirements Specification (MD70)
* As-Is and To-Be Process Maps
* Gap Analysis Report
* Data Mapping Documents
* Test Scenarios and UAT Scripts
* Training Materials and SOPs
* Business Process Documentation
* Go-Live Readiness Checklist

Pay: ₹200,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have hands-on experience in Siemens Opcenter MES application development, or has your role primarily involved configuration ?
* Have you developed APIs, web services, SQL stored procedures, or custom system integration components?
* Have you independently designed and developed MES functionalities based on manufacturing business requirements?

**Site Reliability Engineer**
=============================

Location: Hyderabad

Working Hours: Pacific Time (PST/PDT), aligned with US West Coast

**About the Role**
==================

We are growing our Site Reliability Engineering team with a Senior Officer, Site Reliability Engineer who will help make the cloud platforms behind our products measurably more reliable. Our SRE team brings together engineers who care about instrumentation, incident response and the health of production systems, all working toward a common mission: giving product and engineering teams the observability, guardrails and operational practices they need to run their services with confidence.

This role is for an SRE who comes from a cloud and platform engineering background. You will spend your time where reliability meets infrastructure: operating Kubernetes clusters (EKS and AKS) and the workloads on them, managing cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure through Terraform, and building the observability and automation that keep it all healthy. Expect to work on autoscaling and capacity, cluster and cloud networking, resilience and failover, cost and performance tuning, and the automation that removes repetitive operational work, then prove the results with SLOs rather than assertions.

Our platform runs around the clock and so does the team behind it. On-call coverage moves naturally across time zones as the day progresses. This position anchors the US West Coast (PST/PDT) window of that follow-the-sun rotation, and as part of it you should expect to step in on weekends from time to time.

This is a strong fit for an experienced individual contributor who enjoys hands-on infrastructure work, both building and running it, and wants to deepen their expertise in site reliability engineering within a regulated financial services environment.

**On-Call & Coverage Expectations**
===================================

On-call is a core, ongoing part of this role and not an occasional add-on. Please read this section carefully before applying.

* Your standard working hours align with Pacific Time (PST/PDT) and cover the US West Coast business day from our Hyderabad office.
* You will take part in a shared on-call rotation with the wider SRE team, following a follow-the-sun model in which coverage hands over between regions as each working day ends.
* While on rotation you are expected to be reachable, to acknowledge and respond to pages within the agreed response targets, and to drive or support incidents through to resolution and handover.
* Weekend and public holiday coverage is part of the rotation and comes around periodically; you should expect to step in from time to time.
* Escalation and paging run through PagerDuty. You will help keep escalation policies, schedules and alert routing accurate and low-noise.
* After significant incidents you will take part in blameless postmortems and follow through on the resulting action items.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Build: Observability, Automation & Reliability Tooling**

* Build and maintain the observability stack that the organization relies on: OpenTelemetry collectors and pipelines, Prometheus-based metrics, and Grafana dashboards for platform and workload health.
* Define and implement SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for platform services, and make burn-rate alerting the basis of paging where it fits.
* Improve alert quality: remove duplicate and low-value alerts, tighten thresholds, add runbook links and make sure every page is actionable.
* Build and maintain PagerDuty integrations, services, escalation policies and schedules so that alerts reach the right people with the right context.
* Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) so that reliability controls, monitoring and environments are provisioned consistently and repeatably.
* Maintain GitOps-based deployment workflows using tools such as Helm, Flux or ArgoCD, and keep reliability configuration versioned alongside the platform it describes.
* Write code and automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) to reduce toil, automate recurring operational tasks and remove manual steps from routine platform work.
* Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., coding assistants, infrastructure and incident copilots) in your own day-to-day work and help other engineers adopt AI tooling effectively.

**Operate: Incident Response & Production Ownership**

* Monitor platform health, respond to incidents and take part in our on-call rotation, including occasional weekend coverage.
* Act as incident responder and, where needed, incident commander: triage, coordinate responders, communicate status and drive to mitigation.
* Debug production issues across the platform, including node and pod-level failures, scheduling and eviction problems, resource saturation, ingress and DNS issues, certificate expiry, and degraded cloud services.
* Operate and tune our EKS and AKS clusters, including autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler, KEDA/HPA) and cluster networking (CNI, ingress, workload identity).
* Run blameless postmortems, identify contributing causes and track corrective actions to completion.
* Support disaster recovery efforts, including backup and restore testing and failover exercises, to validate platform resilience.
* Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization and performance tuning across cloud environments.
* Help maintain security and compliance controls across the platform (access management, network security, audit evidence, policy-as-code) in line with financial services requirements.

**Engineering: Resilience & Platform Hardening**

* Design for failure: multi-AZ and multi-region posture, pod disruption budgets, graceful degradation, safe rollout and rollback patterns.
* Review infrastructure and deployment changes from a reliability standpoint, and raise the bar on defaults, quotas, limits and guardrails.
* Identify recurring sources of instability and toil, and drive systemic fixes rather than repeated manual intervention.
* Make platform reliability visible: capacity headroom, saturation, error budgets and cost per workload.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with product engineering teams to understand their services, their failure modes and their reliability goals, and translate those into SLOs and operational practice.
* Partner with the Cloud Platform and DevEx teams so that observability and reliability tooling is available as a self-service golden path rather than a bespoke effort per team.
* Help engineers across the organization onboard to our reliability tooling, troubleshoot issues, get support when needed and review their infrastructure and observability-related PRs.
* Contribute to internal documentation, runbooks and best practices for reliability and incident response.

**What You Bring**
==================

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, or a closely related technical domain, including hands-on production ownership.
* Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes, ideally EKS and/or AKS.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, ideally AWS and/or Azure, across compute, storage, networking and identity.
* Practical experience with infrastructure-as-code tools, particularly Terraform.
* Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry (collectors, pipelines, instrumentation) in a production environment.
* Practical experience with Grafana and Prometheus (PromQL, dashboards, recording and alerting rules).
* Experience with PagerDuty or an equivalent incident and on-call platform, including escalation policies and schedules.
* Solid grasp of core SRE concepts: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, blameless postmortems, change and release safety.
* Experience with cluster autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler) and workload autoscaling (KEDA or HPA).
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes networking (CNI plugins, ingress controllers) and workload identity (IRSA on EKS, Workload Identity on AKS).
* Experience with GitOps workflows and tools such as Helm, Flux, or ArgoCD for Kubernetes deployments.
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go), and comfort with Linux fundamentals and networking troubleshooting.
* Comfort operating in a regulated environment, with an understanding of security and compliance fundamentals (access control, least privilege, audit logging).
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and the ability to stay calm and structured during incidents.
* Willingness and ability to work Pacific Time (PST/PDT) hours from Hyderabad and to take part in the on-call rotation described above, including occasional weekend coverage.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with distributed tracing and log backends such as Grafana Tempo, Loki, Jaeger, Elastic or Splunk.
* Experience with policy-as-code tools such as Kyverno or OPA.

description:
