The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering is a hands-on engineering leader accountable for the strategy, design, delivery, and operational maturity of secure cloud platforms and software delivery capabilities supporting Claims Global Claims Operations (GCO). This leader will manage and develop a team of DevOps, platform, and site reliability engineers while partnering with application, data, AI/ML, architecture, security, and product teams.

The role will establish standardized CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, cloud governance, observability, reliability, and DevSecOps practices that accelerate delivery while maintaining the controls required for healthcare and other regulated workloads. The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with deep technical judgment, measurable operational ownership, and the ability to influence across a complex enterprise.

Leadership mandate: Build a reliable, secure, reusable engineering platform that improves developer velocity, production resilience, and governance by design.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* People Leadership & Engineering Management
  + Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary DevOps/platform engineering team; establish clear goals, operating rhythms, career development plans, and accountability for outcomes
  + Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and skills development aligned to the platform roadmap
  + Create an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and blameless improvement
  + Translate business priorities into an executable roadmap, capacity plan, delivery milestones, and measurable engineering outcomes
* DevOps Platform Strategy & Delivery
  + Define and execute the DevOps and platform engineering strategy for cloud-native applications, data products, and AI-enabled solutions
  + Build and govern reusable "paved-road" capabilities including source control standards, build automation, artifact management, deployment pipelines, environment provisioning, configuration management, and release orchestration
  + Establish standardized CI/CD patterns for application, infrastructure, data, and AI/ML workloads, with automated quality gates and promotion controls
  + Drive platform adoption through strong documentation, self-service workflows, developer enablement, office hours, and actionable product telemetry
* Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
  + Lead the design and operation of secure, scalable, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code and policy-as-code practices
  + Establish reusable Terraform modules and cloud deployment patterns covering networking, compute, containers, serverless, storage, databases, identity, secrets, logging, and monitoring
  + Guide container orchestration and runtime engineering using Kubernetes/EKS and related cloud-native technologies where appropriate
  + Partner with architecture, cloud, security, and FinOps teams to improve cloud governance, capacity management, resilience, and cost transparency
* DevSecOps, Risk & Compliance
  + Embed security across the software delivery lifecycle, including code scanning, dependency and container scanning, secrets management, infrastructure scanning, image provenance, and release approvals
  + Implement role-based access, segregation of duties, audit evidence, traceability, and policy enforcement consistent with enterprise and regulated-environment requirements
  + Partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and audit teams to remediate findings and maintain production-readiness controls
  + Ensure platform capabilities protect sensitive healthcare data and support applicable privacy, retention, and access-control expectations
* Site Reliability & Operational Excellence
  + Define service-level objectives, reliability indicators, error budgets, operational dashboards, and production health standards for critical services
  + Advance end-to-end observability through metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring, alerting, and service health telemetry
  + Lead incident response and problem management practices, including command structure, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and learning reviews
  + Drive resilience engineering through high availability, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, capacity planning, performance engineering, and game-day exercises
* AI/ML and Data Delivery Enablement
  + Enable secure delivery patterns for AI/ML and generative AI workloads, including model and prompt configuration promotion, evaluation gates, lineage, observability, rollback, and controlled release
  + Partner with data and AI engineering teams to establish MLOps, LLMOps, and DataOps integration points without duplicating domain-team ownership
  + Provide platform controls for agentic and AI-enabled solutions, including environment isolation, secrets, auditability, monitoring, kill-switch or containment mechanisms, and production support readiness

  + Lead architecture and operational-readiness reviews; communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and progress to senior leadership
  + Manage vendor and strategic partner delivery, including scope, technical quality, capacity, performance, and knowledge transfer
  + Drive continuous improvement using engineering metrics, delivery analytics, operational trends, and stakeholder feedback

  + Improved deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore, measured using agreed delivery and reliability baselines
  + Increased adoption and reuse of standardized pipelines, infrastructure modules, security controls, and observability patterns
  + Reduced manual provisioning, deployment effort, configuration drift, production incidents, and repeat operational defects
  + Measurable improvement in service availability, recovery readiness, cloud cost efficiency, audit readiness, and developer experience
  + Predictable roadmap execution, effective talent development, and strong stakeholder confidence in platform delivery
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

title: Software Engineer III - Data Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help modernize cloud data engineering by delivering trusted lakehouse products and shaping responsible AI-assisted engineering practices that improve engineering throughput and quality.

**Job summary**

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Cloud Data Engineering team, you design, build, and operate scalable data engineering products on AWS using Databricks and lakehouse architecture. You use AI-assisted delivery practices (for example, GitHub Copilot and Claude) to accelerate delivery across development, testing, documentation, and production support, while we maintain human accountability for architecture, approvals, security, and production decisions.

**Job responsibilities**

* Design scalable extract-transform-load (ETL) and extract-load-transform (ELT) pipelines on AWS using Databricks, PySpark, Spark, Delta Lake, AWS Glue, SQL, and lakehouse patterns for batch and streaming workloads.
* Build ingestion, transformation, enrichment, calculation, allocation, reporting, and publishing pipelines that produce maintainable, well-modeled data products.
* Develop production-grade Python, PySpark, and SQL with disciplined engineering practices including testing, peer review, performance tuning, resiliency, and secure coding.
* Operate orchestration and scheduling workflows using Airflow (or equivalent), including dependency management, retries, backfills, service level agreement monitoring, and operational runbooks.
* Implement continuous integration and continuous delivery practices with automated quality gates (linting, unit and integration tests, security scans, data-quality checks, schema validation, and release controls).
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, and create architecture, design, lineage, and operational artifacts that meet scalability, performance, cost, resiliency, governance, and security requirements.
* Lead adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the ETL lifecycle (Copilot-assisted development, Claude-enabled refactoring and troubleshooting, and reusable AI skills and task-oriented agents) and integrate approved developer tools with Jira, source control, documentation, observability, incident triage, and release readiness—ensuring controls for human review, secrets protection, and safeguards for personally identifiable information and payment card information.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 8 years of hands-on data engineering or software engineering experience delivering production data platforms and pipelines.
* Hands-on experience building data products using Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, and lakehouse architectures on AWS.
* Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL, with demonstrated ability to write clean, testable, maintainable, production-grade code.
* Hands-on experience with AWS Glue and cloud-native ETL patterns, including jobs, cataloging, identity and access management security, monitoring, and operational support.
* Experience with Airflow (or equivalent orchestration), including workflow design, scheduling, backfills, dependency management, monitoring, and recovery.
* Hands-on Apache NiFi experience for ingestion design, flow operationalization, source onboarding, and reliability practices.
* Demonstrated experience with disciplined delivery practices, including infrastructure as code (Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation), automated testing and quality gates, release controls, agile delivery, DevOps practices, data governance, resiliency engineering, secure-by-design implementation, AI-assisted workflows (including GitHub Copilot and Claude) with human review, reusable AI skills/prompts/agents, and controls for sensitive data (personally identifiable information and payment card information), secrets management, access control, auditability, and secure logging.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience implementing agentic automation patterns for incident triage, deployment validation, data-quality checks, lineage generation, developer enablement, or operational workflows.
* Experience integrating AI agents with Jira, source control systems, documentation platforms, Databricks, observability platforms, or internal developer tooling.
* Familiarity with data mesh concepts, Unity Catalog, data contracts, metadata management, and modern analytics and business intelligence ecosystems (for example, ThoughtSpot), including streaming and event-driven ingestion (for example, Kafka) and enterprise observability tooling.
* AWS and/or Databricks certifications (for example, AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Developer Associate, AWS Data Analytics Specialty, or Databricks Data Engineer certification) and experience mentoring engineers and leading standards for AI-assisted data engineering delivery.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description: Lead Agentic AI Engineer — Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)**
===============================================================================

  
  

**1.Role Overview & Mission**
=============================

  
  

As a Lead Agentic AI Engineer (Forward Deployed), you will operate at the intersection of applied GenAI engineering, autonomous multi-agent systems, and business domain problem-solving. Unlike traditional back-office research roles, a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is embedded directly with business stakeholders, product leads, and operations teams to translate complex, unstructured institutional workflows into high-impact, enterprise-grade Autonomous Agent solutions.

You will spearhead the design, prototyping, evaluation, and end-to-end production deployment of multi-agent architectures, agentic tool orchestration (e.g., Model Context Protocol / MCP, tool-calling pipelines), dynamic RAG retrieval engines, and human-in-the-loop autonomous decision workflows across institutional platforms (e.g., KYC Intelligence, Funds Lifecycle, Document Processing, and Regulatory Compliance).

  
  

**2. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

  
  

**Architecture & Agentic Engineering**
--------------------------------------

  
  

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **AI Solutioning & Translation:** Formulate and define systems scope and objectives for complex AI/GenAI projects, fostering seamless communication and translating business requirements into technical specifications for Data Scientists and ML Engineers.
* **Implementation & Integration:** Support the end-to-end AI implementation and system change processes—from translating Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) to functional specifications, through model deployment, testing, and integration with existing systems.
* **Customization & Scripting:** Consult with business clients to determine functional specifications for AI applications, developing custom scripts, integrations, or workflows to tailor AI/GenAI products to the unique needs of the business.
* **Advanced Troubleshooting:** Consult with users and clients to solve complex system and model integration issues through in-depth evaluation of business processes, AI/ML systems, and industry standards, recommending tailored technical solutions.
* **Feedback Loop & Product Advocacy:** Act as a critical bridge between front-line business users and core AI research/engineering teams. Gather direct feedback, identify model performance pain points, and relay insights from the field to help guide the AI product roadmap.
* **Enablement & Training:** Educate business and technical teams on how to leverage deployed AI solutions effectively, promoting best practices in prompt engineering, model interaction, and operational maintenance.
* **Risk & Impact Management:** Identify and communicate risks and impacts (including AI model limitations, data privacy, bias, and ethical considerations), evaluating the business implications of applying GenAI/ML technologies to the current business environment.
* **Leadership & Collaboration:** Act as advisor or coach to new or lower-level analysts and work as a team to achieve business objectives, performing other duties and functions as assigned.
* **Autonomy:** Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision, exercising independence of judgment and autonomy while acting as an SME to senior stakeholders and/or other team members.
* **Compliance & Safeguarding:** Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

  

**Forward Deployed Leadership & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

  
  

* High-Velocity Prototyping to Production: Rapidly convert ambiguous business problems into functional, production-ready Proof of Concepts (PoCs) in 2–4 week cycles, followed by hardened enterprise deployment.
* Client & Stakeholder Partnership: Sit alongside business heads, compliance officers, and operations leads to uncover automation bottlenecks and architect tailored AI agent interventions.
* End-to-End System Integration: Partner with Java/Python backend, UI, and DevOps engineers to integrate agent services into core transactional systems, client lifecycle management (CLM) platforms, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Governance & Model Risk Management (MRM): Lead the technical defense and documentation of agentic workflows through enterprise Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI, and InfoSec approval gates.
  

  

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**
===========================================

  
  

**Technical Expertise**
-----------------------

* Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years dedicated to applied NLP, GenAI, LLM application development, and autonomous agent orchestration.
* Programming Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Asyncio, Pydantic, LangChain/LangGraph) and strong working knowledge of Java / Spring Boot or modern TypeScript/Node environments.
* Agent Frameworks & Patterns: Proven experience building multi-agent systems, ReAct loops, Plan-and-Solve patterns, stateful workflows, memory management, and structured JSON output parsing.
* Vector & Relational Databases: Hands-on experience with vector search engines (PostgreSQL with pgvector, Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone) and relational/NoSQL datastores.
* LLM APIs & Gateways: Deep familiarity with leading foundational models (Claude, GPT-4, Gemini) and enterprise gateways (e.g., R2D2, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) including token optimization, rate-limiting, and cost modeling.
* Cloud & DevOps: Solid experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift), CI/CD pipelines, AWS/GCP cloud services (S3, IAM, Lambda/ECS), and enterprise observability (distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry).
* Soft Skills & Forward-Deployed Competencies
* Problem Solving Under Ambiguity: Ability to frame, scope, and deliver complex AI projects with minimal upfront requirements.
* Executive Communication: Outstanding ability to articulate AI architectural trade-offs, confidence intervals, and ROI to technical and non-technical executive stakeholders.
* Bias for Action: High-ownership mindset with the agility to shift from strategic architectural design to hands-on debugging in the same day.
  

  
  

**4. Preferred / Bonus Qualifications**
=======================================

* Prior experience in Institutional Banking, FinTech, Wealth Management, KYC/AML, or Fund Operations.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom enterprise tool-calling frameworks.
* Experience with Model Risk Governance (MRM), Fair Lending, or Regulatory AI Compliance frameworks.

You will maintain our service catalog, design architectural blueprints, establish the observability standard, and — most distinctively — bring hands-on LLM-driven tooling skills to a team actively shaping what the next generation of cloud operations looks like.

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the **Cloud Architect Manager (who reports to the CIO)**, with direct CIO-adjacent visibility. You will sit at the intersection of platform engineering and technology strategy, contributing to platform roadmap decisions — not just executing them. The team is small, ownership is total, and iteration cycles are short. You will be expected to resolve ambiguity, align expectations, and establish technical clarity across a diverse group of stakeholders.

**Time allocation (approximate):**
  
~40% LLM-driven tooling & workflow design | ~30% architecture & catalog governance | ~20%
  
observability | ~10% collaboration & documentation

**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Service Catalog & Platform Governance**

* Build and maintain a minimalistic, opinionated service catalog of approved cloud components across Google Cloud and Azure
* Apply a serverless-first, PaaS-first philosophy — challenge complexity and push back on
    
  unnecessary infrastructure sprawl
* For every approved catalog entry, deliver production-ready configuration: IaC, security baseline,observability hooks, and runbook
* Scrutinise every new component request and justify its addition in terms of cost, operational overhead, and platform alignment

**Cloud Architecture**

* Define, document, and govern cloud architectural blueprints across networking, compute, storage and data layers
* Design event-driven pipelines that trigger AI-assisted validation, drift detection, and deployment gates
* Serve as the technical authority on platform design decisions within your domain

**LLM-Driven Operations**

* Implement LLM-based automated deployment capabilities using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent frameworks
* Design and operate infrastructure workflows augmented by AI agents — from deployment validation to configuration drift detection
* Stay ahead of the market in AI-assisted tooling and bring relevant innovations into the platform

**Observability**

* Define the observability standard: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLO/SLA frameworks
* Establish platform-level KPIs and ensure consistent adoption across engineering teams

**Collaboration**

* Partner with DevOps and Engineering teams to embed platform standards into delivery pipelines
* Partner with SecOps to integrate all controls and security requirements
* Document everything: blueprints, ADRs, runbooks, onboarding guides

**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
You have operated multi-cloud Kubernetes environments in production, built IaC pipelines with Terraform and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven tooling in real engineering workflows. Specifically:

* Proven cloud networking experience: firewalls, gateways, VPCs, VPNs, private service connect, and network security groups
* Strong, current proficiency across **Google Cloud Platform** (GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Armor, Pub/Sub, Artifact Registry) and **Microsoft Azure**
* Proven IaC experience with **Terraform** (required); Ansible a strong plus
* **Proven hands-on LLM tooling experience**: must have used **OpenCode, Claude Code,** or equivalent AI-assisted coding/deployment agents in real engineering workflows
* **Kubernetes at scale:** demonstrated experience operating **AKS** (Azure Kubernetes Service) and **GKE** (Google Kubernetes Engine) — cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, and workload management
* Experience with **Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, or similar cloud** model gardens
* Ability to proactively coordinate with stakeholders to remove ambiguity and build clarity in migration designs
* Experience in Agile/fast-iteration environments with high individual ownership

**Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Knowledge of C5, SecNumCloud, ISO 27001, or equivalent cloud security frameworks
* FinOps — cost attribution, rightsizing, commitment strategies
* Prior experience in a SaaS product company at scale
* Platform engineering / SRE background

**Soft Skills**

* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and form opinions before they become mainstream
* Strong problem-solving discipline: you reach for first principles, not familiarity
* Ownership mindset — you build it, you run it, you improve it
* Clear written and verbal communication: able to document decisions and explain them to non specialists
* Operates well under pressure and tight constraints — energised by hard problems
* Strong negotiation skills — fact-driven and data-driven: you argue with evidence, not opinion
* Highly collaborative: you build alignment across engineering, SecOps, and leadership

**What success looks like**

We target a mature and highly automated cloud foundation designed for modern enterprise SaaS. The long-term success of this role is defined by:

* **Robust Service Catalog & Governance:** An established service catalog baseline featuring approved, standardized cloud components with built-in compliance, IaC automation, and production-ready monitoring.
* **Enterprise-Wide Observability Adoption:** Broad deployment of unified platform-level observability standards across engineering teams, incorporating logging, distributed tracing, and clear SLA frameworks.
* **AI-Accelerated Workflows:** Active, production-ready LLM-driven deployment, validation, and configuration drift-detection pipelines to streamline system management.
* **Sustainable Architecture Blueprints:** Completed architectural blueprints and ADR documents defining the multi-cloud framework, paired with scalable FinOps cost tracking principles.

**You're probably NOT a fit if**

* You need a large team to delegate to before making decisions
* You prefer deep specialisation in a single cloud over breadth across two
* You're not actively following the LLM/AI tooling space

title: Senior Engineering Manager- NKP
description:
**About the Team**

The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi-cloud environment.

NKP offers Container Attached Storage using Kubernetes pods to run AOS distributed storage fabric (Cloud Native AOS), enabling seamless integration with cloud native stateful workloads. The platform offers scale out, resilient and tiered storage. Supports storage features such as dynamic provisioning, thin provisioning, data efficiency, and application-centric snapshots. Cloud Native AOS can be used in both hyperconverged and disaggregated storage environments in a hybrid cloud environment. The stateful application Pods use the Nutanix CSI driver to consume storage entities that the AOS Pods present as Persistent Volumes. Much Like an on-premise HCI setup, Cloud Native AOS too provides all core Nutanix data management and copy data management functionalities.

**The Role**  
We are seeking a **Senior Engineering Manager** who is a “builder” at heart—someone who can architect complex storage software and, more importantly, architect the careers of the engineers who write it.

In this role, you will lead a team of talented junior and mid-level engineers. You will serve as the technical anchor and mentor, guiding the team through the challenges of containerizing our services while ensuring our storage control path remains the gold standard for performance and reliability.

You will design secure-by-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.

**Key Responsibilities**.

* Cloud-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads
* Architect, design and develop storage software for a computing+storage platform, Storage for AI - for cloud native environment.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Improve data path performance, scale-out and resiliency of our distributed control plane.
* Work closely with other development teams, testers, documentation writers and product management to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.
* Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: 12-18 years of software engineering experience and 2+ years of team management, with a proven track record of building large-scale distributed systems, cloud native platforms, or cloud infrastructure.
* **Storage Fundamentals**: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability. Understanding of the storage access protocols and features viz. SCSI/iSCSI/NFS/CIFS/S3/Cloud. Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization and/or storage management.
* **Kubernetes Expertise**: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Container Storage Interface (CSI), CNI, SCCs, MCS preferred
* **Systems Engineering:** Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), file systems, database back-ends, distributed storage systems and cloud based storage technologies. Experience with Hadoop, MapReduce, Cassandra, Zookeeper and other large-scale distributed systems preferred

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Arrangement**  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. This role is based out of **Pune,** where employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of **3 days per week** to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager

description:

**Title and Summary**

Senior Technical Program ManagerOverview:  
  
The AI Platform Engineering team is responsible for enabling the enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence by building, operating, and evolving shared AI platforms, services, governance capabilities, and operational practices. Our mission is to provide scalable, secure, reliable, and compliant AI infrastructure that empowers teams across Mastercard to accelerate the development and deployment of AI-powered solutions.  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional initiatives that support the evolution of Mastercard's AI platform ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders to drive alignment, manage dependencies, reduce execution risk, and ensure successful delivery of strategic programs.  
  
This team functions as an enterprise AI Platform Engineering organization, delivering and operating shared capabilities that enable application teams to build and scale AI-powered products across public and private cloud environments.  
  
This role provides the opportunity to help shape and execute the roadmap for Mastercard's next generation AI platform capabilities. Rather than focusing on a single product or application, you will drive programs that span platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement, governance, operational excellence, and enterprise adoption.  
  
You will work on challenging problems involving large-scale technology delivery, platform adoption, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, operational readiness, governance, and organizational transformation while helping shape Mastercard's long-term AI platform strategy.  
  
About the Role:  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, AI Platform Engineering, you will be responsible for leading large-scale technology initiatives from concept through implementation and operationalization. You will coordinate work across multiple engineering and business organizations, ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into executable plans and delivered successfully.  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with sufficient technical depth to engage effectively with engineers, architects, and technology leaders. You are passionate about execution, organizational effectiveness, continuous improvement, and enabling teams to deliver complex technology solutions at enterprise scale.  
  
Responsibilities:  
  

* Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs from initiation through deployment and operational readiness.

  

* Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans that account for dependencies, risks, resource requirements, milestones, and evolving business priorities.

  

* Drive alignment across engineering, product, architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, operations, and business stakeholders.

  

* Establish clear program objectives, success metrics, execution strategies, and delivery mechanisms.

  

* Proactively identify, manage, and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, and organizational blockers.

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for program status, ensuring stakeholders have timely, accurate, and actionable information.

  

* Drive effective decision-making by facilitating discussions, evaluating tradeoffs, and escalating issues when necessary.

  

* Coordinate delivery across multiple teams, ensuring dependencies are understood, managed, and communicated effectively.

  

* Develop executive-ready communications, dashboards, status updates, presentations, and program reviews.

  

* Lead planning sessions, steering committees, roadmap reviews, operational reviews, and stakeholder meetings.

  

* Establish governance, reporting, and operational mechanisms that improve transparency, predictability, and execution effectiveness.

  

* Partner with engineering teams to improve delivery processes, operating models, planning practices, and cross-functional collaboration.

  

* Ensure programs meet organizational standards for security, compliance, risk management, operational readiness, and business continuity.

  

* Utilize metrics and data-driven insights to assess program health, communicate outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.

  

* Support strategic planning, portfolio management, roadmap development, prioritization, and organizational scaling initiatives.

  

* Contribute to a culture of accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and customer focus.

  
All About You:  
Required Qualifications  
  

* Experience leading large-scale technical programs involving multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders.

  

* Strong experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives within software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, data, or technology organizations.

  

* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated plans, coordinate dependencies, mitigate risks, and drive successful delivery outcomes.

  

* Experience communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

  

* Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  

* Experience managing competing priorities and delivering results in fast-paced, evolving environments.

  

* Ability to influence across organizations without direct authority.

  

* Experience working with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation and reporting.

  

* Experience working within highly collaborative, cross-functional technology organizations.

  
Preferred Qualifications  
  

* Experience supporting cloud platforms, developer platforms, AI/ML platforms, data platforms, infrastructure platforms, or enterprise software systems.

  

* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, system architecture, cloud computing, and modern technology delivery practices.

  

* Experience supporting platform adoption, developer enablement, operational excellence, and organizational transformation initiatives.

  

* Experience establishing delivery governance, operational reviews, portfolio management, or enterprise planning practices.

  

* Experience working within regulated environments requiring strong security, governance, compliance, and risk management controls.

  

* PMP, PgMP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable program management certifications.

  

* Experience supporting large-scale platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Principal Architect | Strategic Enterprise Architecture
description:
**Company Description**

**About NIQ:** NIQ is a leading global consumer intelligence company, helping clients understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what they should do next. Our data, technology, AI, and analytics capabilities power decision-making for some of the world’s most important consumer, retail, and technology businesses.

AI is central to NIQ’s next stage of growth. We are building trusted, scalable, and high-impact AI capabilities that transform how insights are created, delivered, and adopted across the business. This role will help shape the platforms, operating model, and leadership system needed to make that ambition real.

 **Job Description**

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are building and evolving Connect, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by AI, cloud and on-premises technologies. Clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ data and insights to innovate and grow. As a Principal Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team, you will define architecture for key components and capabilities across NIQ platforms, ensuring alignment with business strategy, product objectives, technology standards, and the long-term platform vision. You will partner with architecture peers, Product and Operations leaders, engineering leaders, and development teams to take solutions from initial requirements through design, delivery, and production operation. A key focus of this role is shaping the responsible adoption of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and agentic AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will combine broad enterprise architecture experience with practical knowledge of AI-enabled systems and will grow into an end-to-end platform architect as their knowledge of NIQ's platforms expands.

**Role Mandate:** Act as the strategic Enterprise Architecture partner and single point of architecture accountability for an assigned NIQ product portfolio. The role connects business and product strategy to target-state architecture, capability ownership, technology roadmaps, governed standards, and delivery feedback. It is intentionally strategic while remaining close enough to Product, Engineering, Solution Architecture, and Architecture Practice teams to ensure that direction is actionable and produces measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

* Own and maintain the portfolio target-state architecture and rolling three-year technology roadmap, aligned with business priorities, product strategy, engineering plans, and enterprise transformation goals.
* Serve as the named strategic architecture partner and single point of EA accountability for the assigned portfolio, building trusted working relationships with Product, Engineering, Operations, Data Science, Security, and business leadership.
* Create and maintain business-capability, domain, application, data, and platform maps that expose ownership, dependencies, duplication, maturity gaps, lifecycle risk, and opportunities for simplification or growth.
* Translate strategic priorities into clear architecture outcomes, transition states, investment options, sequencing recommendations, and measurable decision criteria.
* Guide platform-placement and build-versus-buy decisions, balancing enterprise reuse and standards with appropriate portfolio autonomy, speed, cost, resilience, and client commitments.
* Define and contribute reusable reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and decision trees, including patterns for AI, Generative AI, agentic AI, data, integration, cloud, security, and observability.
* Drive adoption of approved architecture standards and bring standards, reference architectures, major exceptions, and cross-functional decisions through the lightweight EA governance process for ratification.
* Own visibility of portfolio architecture risks, strategic exceptions, technical debt, capability gaps, and cross portfolio dependencies; ensure actions, owners, and escalation paths are clear.
* Partner with the Solution Architecture pillar to triage architecturally significant demand, shape initiatives early, and ensure delivery-level learning feeds back into portfolio strategy, standards, and roadmaps.
* Assess emerging technologies and market shifts, especially AI and agentic commerce, and convert relevant signals into adoption guidance, controlled experiments, investment recommendations, and roadmap implications.
* Enable self-service architecture by creating high-quality, reusable content for NIQ architecture knowledge repositories and supporting AI-enabled access to standards, patterns, decisions, and portfolio views.
* Establish and run an effective operating cadence, including strategic portfolio reviews, intake alignment with Solution Architecture, reference artifact alignment with the Architecture Practice, and architect-only sessions to drive capability and domain consistency.
* Define outcome-oriented measures for the portfolio, such as roadmap adoption, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, decision cycle time, standards adoption, and value realized from technology investments.
* Support M&A due diligence and integration planning by assessing capability fit, architecture compatibility, technology risk, redundancy, security considerations, and potential integration paths.
* Mentor architects and engineering leaders, communicate complex decisions clearly, and influence across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, solution architecture, platform architecture, or enterprise architecture, including significant experience with enterprise-scale products and data platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to define target-state architectures and multi-year technology roadmaps, and to connect them to business capabilities, product objectives, investment decisions, and executable transition plans.
* Experience operating as a strategic advisor to senior Product, Engineering, Technology, Operations, or business leaders, with evidence of influencing decisions across multiple organizations and geographies.
* Strong knowledge of capability-based planning, domain and platform mapping, application rationalization, technology lifecycle management, technical debt, and architecture risk management.
* Experience creating and driving adoption of enterprise standards, reference architectures, reusable patterns, architecture decision records, and governance processes that are pragmatic and lightweight.
* Strong understanding of modern cloud, data, integration, API, security, resilience, observability, and distributed system architecture, preferably in Microsoft Azure and hybrid environments.
* Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, and agentic AI architectures, including model and tool integration, retrieval augmented generation, orchestration, context and memory, evaluation, guardrails, observability, human oversight, and Responsible AI controls.
* Ability to assess emerging technologies and develop clear build-versus-buy, adoption, migration, and total-cost of-ownership recommendations.
* Experience partnering with Solution Architecture and delivery teams on architecturally significant initiatives while preserving a strategic, portfolio-wide perspective.
* Excellent written, visual, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to express complex architecture choices as concise options, trade-offs, decisions, roadmaps, and executive-level narratives.
* Proven facilitation, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to establish accountability and progress in a matrixed organization.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in data, analytics, measurement, consumer intelligence, retail, media, or other information intensive product environments.
* Knowledge of ArchiMate, capability-based planning methods, and enterprise architecture repositories such as ADOIT.
* Experience with product operating models, agile delivery, portfolio planning, FinOps, and outcome-based technology investment governance.
* Experience supporting technology due diligence, post-merger integration, platform consolidation, or large-scale modernization and simplification programs.
* Hands-on engineering or architecture experience with APIs, Python, databases, data pipelines, cloud-native platforms, MLOps or LLMOps, or enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI.
* Thinks in business capabilities, portfolios, platforms, and multi-year outcomes rather than isolated projects.

**Successful Profile:**

* Balances enterprise consistency with purposeful autonomy and avoids governance for its own sake.
* Creates clarity from complexity, makes decision ownership explicit, and converts strategy into reusable architecture assets.
* Builds trust through early engagement, pragmatic recommendations, transparent trade-offs, and reliable follow-through.
* Uses delivery feedback to continuously improve target states, standards, patterns, and investment guidance.

  
**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: AI Harness Engineer
description:
We're hiring an experienced AI-native engineer to build the core systems behind Diligent's AI agents. This is not a prompt-writing role. This is a software engineering role for someone who can design reliable AI systems: prompts, context, tools, evals, orchestration, memory, observability, and production workflows.

**About Us**

Diligent is the new venture from the founding team of Leverage Edu, a Series D edtech company. There, our founders built and scaled multiple businesses from zero, including student mobility, cross-border payments and student housing.

Diligent is building the AI growth team every business deserves. Instead of hiring an agency or a five-person marketing team, our clients get a squad of AI agents that research competitors, plan budgets, generate creatives, and run and optimise campaigns on Meta and Google, with senior marketers guiding every move. A campaign that takes an agency weeks to set up goes live in under 30 minutes.

We're a small team building fast. Everyone here uses AI every day, and you will too.

**The Role**

You'll work on the core agent architecture behind Diligent.

Your job will be to build the harness around frontier models: prompt engineering, context engineering, tool design, agent orchestration, evals, memory, model routing, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop systems.

You should be equally comfortable thinking about system design and writing production code.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and build AI agent workflows for marketing, growth, reporting, creative analysis, SEO/AEO, lead intelligence, and reputation monitoring.
* Build production-grade harnesses around LLMs using prompts, context, tools, memory, structured outputs, evals, guardrails, and human review loops.
* Work on prompt engineering, context engineering, tool calling, workflow decomposition, and agent orchestration.
* Build backend systems that connect with databases, APIs, CRMs, ad platforms, Slack, WhatsApp, dashboards, and internal tools.
* Design systems for ingesting, cleaning, storing, and retrieving business context for AI agents.
* Build evaluation pipelines to test prompt changes, model changes, agent quality, regressions, and edge cases.
* Implement model routing strategies to balance quality, latency, and cost. Improve observability: logs, traces, prompt versions, model outputs, failure analysis, and feedback loops.
* Work closely with product and growth teams to convert messy business workflows into reliable AI systems. Own engineering quality across architecture, code, testing, debugging, deployment, and maintenance.

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong backend engineering and system design fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, tool calling, or agent frameworks.
* Strong software development fundamentals: clean code, APIs, databases, queues, testing, debugging, version control, and deployment.
* Experience with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar backend stacks.
* Comfort working with Postgres, Redis, vector databases, queues, schedulers, and production services.
* Understanding of structured outputs, JSON schemas, retries, validation, error handling, and deterministic workflows.
* Ability to break ambiguous business workflows into clear technical systems.
* High ownership and comfort working in an early-stage startup environment.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, or similar tools.
* Experience building evals for AI systems.
* Experience with tool servers, workflow engines, agent infrastructure, or automation platforms.
* Experience with marketing/adtech/growth tools such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, Zoho, Shopify, Slack, WhatsApp, or CRMs.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar cloud platforms.
* Experience with observability, tracing, logging, and production monitoring

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Us**

Trevolution is a global leader in air ticketing and travel services, serving retail and corporate clients across 50+ markets. With over 20 years of expertise and a strong entrepreneurial mindset, we combine modern technology with a customer-first approach to simplify travel.

Through partnerships with 70+ airlines, we deliver a full booking experience supported by expert service — focused on value, convenience, and reliability. Our portfolio spans online sales, call bookings, and semi-OTAs, and continues to evolve with market trends.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Tech Lead**
to take ownership of a mission-critical backend platform within the Trevolution travel division at Dyninno Group.

You will lead the technical direction of a high-traffic, distributed backend system that sits at the core of our daily business operations. This is a true end-to-end technical ownership role requiring strong engineering judgment, hands-on expertise, and the ability to guide a team through complex, ambiguous problem spaces.

The ideal candidate combines strong Go engineering skills with experience in scalable distributed systems, a pragmatic engineering mindset, and proven leadership capabilities in growing engineering teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of complex backend systems and integrations with downstream services.
* Own the architecture of core backend components, driving decisions around scalability, performance, and maintainability.
* Define and govern integration patterns across multiple services in a distributed microservices environment.
* Ensure performance, reliability, and scalability of high-volume, low-latency systems.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, business analysts, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Mentor and guide engineers; establish best practices in code quality, testing, observability, and security.
* Lead technical decision-making, trade-off analysis, and architectural governance.
* Own production stability, including troubleshooting incidents, performance issues, and system bottlenecks.
* Partner with peer platform teams to align architecture and share engineering standards.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Experience:**

* 6–12 years of software engineering experience.
* At least 2+ years in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* Proven experience leading high-traffic, production-scale backend platforms.
* Experience in the travel domain is a plus.

**Technical Skills:**

* Go (Golang)/ Node.js: Strong proficiency required, including concurrency, memory management, and idiomatic patterns.
* Databases: Strong experience with at least one at scale (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).
* Redis: caching strategies, streams, and key/value design patterns.
* Elasticsearch: search and analytics use cases.
* Microservices & APIs: REST, JSON, service design, and integration contracts.
* Security: OAuth, JWT, API security best practices.
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, Sentry, distributed tracing.
* Containers & CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI (or similar).
* Cloud: AWS, GCP, or Azure experience.
* Event-driven architecture: Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging systems.
* Testing: strong discipline in unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools) and using AI agents to improve engineering productivity.

There is no one-size-fits-all here; we are quite flexible and use an individual approach with every candidate we meet. While getting familiar during our interview, we try to understand where your working experience, professional skills, and future contribution to the company can be applied within our multiple business projects.

**With us, you will**

* Be part of a top-tier team of professionals working on global products used by millions of customers worldwide.
* Build and scale complex, in-house solutions that power real business impact.
* Learn and grow through internal lectures, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions led by colleagues and team leads.
* Benefit from comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Enjoy convenient parking options.

Senior Manager - AI & IT

ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.  
  
**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.

* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.

apps.

and data migration.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer with expertise in both machine learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI) to join our Emerging Technology Practice. In this role, you will drive the development of cutting-edge AI models and solutions—from statistical modeling and predictive analytics to advanced generative and agentic applications.

* Design and develop AI-powered systems using both traditional ML and Generative AI techniques, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
* Build intelligent applications and agentic systems that can perform tasks autonomously or interactively, using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar
* Architect and implement end-to-end RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector indexing, hybrid search, and contextual response generation
* Develop modular, well-documented APIs and service components (e.g., using FastAPI or Flask) to enable model integration and consumption
* Design, build, and manage end-to-end AI pipelines, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, model training, inference, deployment, and knowledge retrieval workflows
* Leverage AWS and Azure AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Document Intelligence, vector databases, etc.) to accelerate development and deployment
* Implement observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms to track model accuracy, drift, retrieval quality, grounding fidelity, reliability, and task-level reasoning
* Optimize RAG systems for latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and response quality in production environments
* Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, solution architects, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless solution design and transition to production
* Support both rapid experimentation (POCs, pilots) and robust, scalable deployments, depending on the maturity of each use case
* Stay up to date with emerging trends in Generative AI, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG evaluation techniques, and continuous improvement methodologies

* 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development or intelligent application engineering
* Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML/AI libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI APIs)
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying RAG-based systems, including embeddings, vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search), and retrieval optimization techniques
* Experience building APIs or backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or equivalent frameworks
* Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen) and multi-agent orchestration patterns
* Experience with orchestration standards or tools such as MCP or agent routing protocols is a plus
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and containerization tools (Docker)
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based ML platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, AWS SageMaker, or Google AI/ML services
* Experience with MLOps pipelines, CI/CD for model delivery, RAG evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS), or model monitoring is a plus
* Knowledge of AI system evaluation, observability, prompt performance testing, and grounding validation is a plus
* Ability to work on cross-functional teams, balance multiple projects, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences
* Cloud certifications in AI/ML services (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) are a plus

description:
**Company Description**

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

You will be responsible for all aspects of development and help develop best practices for future development. You will work closely with Tech, Design and Quality teams to build and launch the product.

* You will work directly with developers and product managers to conceptualize, build, test and release products.
* You will take responsibility for performance and stability for all server functions.
* You will continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximize development efficiency.

* 5-6 years of experience.
* You should have at least an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, preferably from IITs/Top RECs.
* You should have expertise in Java/J2EE technology.
* You should have proficiency in the implementation of algorithms and the use of advanced data structures to solve problems in computing.
* You should have experience with e-business/e-commerce applications and business environments.
* Any experience with internet companies or the travel industry will be a plus.
* You should have a good understanding of Java/J2EE and design patterns.
* You should have strong knowledge of data structures and designing for performance, scalability and availability.

Responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

Visible links
