Job Description – API Test Architect Test Solution Lead
  
  
API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain.
  
  
The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering.
  
  
The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
API Test Architecture Solutioning
  

* Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs.
* Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios.
* Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting.
* Define framework architecture with clear separation of:
* Test data
* Test logic
* Configuration
* Validation utilities
* Reporting
* Environment management
* Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects.
* Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results.

API Modernization Microservices Validation
  

* Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture.
* Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization.
* Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses.
* Design automated comparison capabilities for:
* Request/response validation
* JSON/XML payload comparison
* Schema validation
* Field-level comparison
* Business-rule validation
* Data transformation validation
* Database/backend validation
* Error and exception handling
* Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices.
* Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations.
* Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration.

API Functional Integration Testing
  

* Define comprehensive API testing coverage including:
* Functional testing
* Integration testing
* Contract testing
* Schema validation
* Positive and negative testing
* Boundary testing
* Authentication and authorization validation
* Error handling
* Data integrity validation
* Regression testing
* End-to-end service validation
* Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation.
* Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples.
* Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation.

Healthcare Domain Validation
  

* Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as:
* Member and eligibility
* Provider
* Claims
* Benefits
* Enrollment
* Accumulators
* Authorization
* Payments
* Clinical and administrative integrations
* Ensure modernization testing validates critical healthcare business rules and cross-system data integrity.
* Support testing of healthcare interoperability and data exchange services where applicable, including FHIR/HL7-based APIs and healthcare integration patterns.
* Ensure appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare test data and alignment with organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

Automation Framework Engineering
  

* Architect and enhance BDD-based API automation frameworks using:
* Cucumber
* TestNG
* REST Assured
* Java
* Gradle
* Define reusable feature files, step definitions, API clients, assertion libraries, data utilities, and comparison utilities.
* Develop configurable validation mechanisms capable of supporting different APIs without extensive custom coding.
* Establish coding standards, framework governance, peer reviews, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Optimize automation suites for parallel execution, maintainability, stability, and faster regression cycles.

CI/CD DevOps Integration
  

* Integrate API automation into Jenkins/Udeploy CI/CD pipelines.
* Define automated quality gates for builds and deployments.
* Enable API regression suites to execute across development, QA, integration, staging, and release environments.
* Establish mechanisms for:
* Pipeline-triggered execution
* Environment configuration
* Test-data management
* Parallel execution
* Failure diagnostics
* Automated reporting
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to enable continuous testing and shift-left quality engineering.

Reporting Quality Metrics
  

* Define enterprise-level API Quality Engineering reporting using:
* Cucumber Reports
* JSON Reports
* HTML Reports
* Execution Logs
* CI/CD dashboards
* Establish metrics for:
* API automation coverage
* Functional coverage
* Regression coverage
* Pass/fail trends
* Defect leakage
* Modernization parity
* Execution stability
* Release readiness
* Provide technical insights and quality recommendations to engineering leadership and customer stakeholders.

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
  

* Drive adoption of GitHub Copilot and GenAI-assisted engineering across the API testing lifecycle.
* Use AI assistance for:
* Requirement and API specification analysis
* Test scenario generation
* Test case generation
* Gherkin/feature-file generation
* REST Assured automation development
* Code refactoring
* Test-data generation
* Coverage-gap identification
* Failure analysis
* Leverage OpenAPI specifications, GraphQL schemas, legacy documentation, and existing test assets as inputs for AI-assisted test design.
* Define appropriate human review and governance practices for AI-generated test assets.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation and reusable accelerators.

Technical Leadership Customer Engagement
  

* Act as the technical solution lead and architecture point of contact for API Quality Engineering.
* Engage with customer stakeholders to understand modernization objectives, current-state architecture, quality risks, and target-state requirements.
* Translate business and technical requirements into testing architecture, solution approach, implementation roadmap, effort estimates, and delivery plans.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical solution presentations with customers and engineering leadership.
* Lead technical discussions across development, architecture, DevOps, business, and QA teams.
* Mentor automation engineers and QA leads and provide technical direction across distributed teams.
* Identify testing risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and mitigation strategies early in the modernization lifecycle.

Required Technical Skills
  
  
**API Microservices:** REST APIs, RESTful services, Microservices Architecture, JSON, XML, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL, API contracts, service integration patterns
  
  
**API Automation:** REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle
  
  
**Framework Architecture:** Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management
  
  
**DevOps:** Jenkins, Udeploy, Git, Bitbucket, CI/CD integration, continuous testing
  
  
**Testing:** API functional testing, integration testing, contract testing, regression testing, legacy-to-modern API parity testing, data validation, negative testing
  
  
**Reporting:** Cucumber Reports, JSON/HTML reporting, execution logs and CI/CD quality reporting
  
  
**AI-Assisted Engineering:** GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted test analysis, scenario generation, Gherkin generation, automation development and coverage analysis
  
  
**Healthcare:** Strong understanding of healthcare enterprise systems and preferably experience with claims, member, provider, eligibility, benefits, authorization, payments, or healthcare interoperability services.
  
  
Preferred Skills
  

* Experience leading enterprise API modernization or monolith-to-microservices transformation programs.
* Experience architecting API automation frameworks used across multiple applications or programs.
* Experience with legacy-to-modern service comparison/parity validation.
* Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, API gateways, and service discovery is desirable.
* Exposure to service virtualization, mocking, contract testing, and API performance testing.
* Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7 is advantageous.
* Experience implementing AI/GenAI-assisted Quality Engineering practices.
* Strong customer-facing solutioning, architecture presentation, estimation, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

* 13+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering, testing, software engineering, or related disciplines.
* 7+ years of strong API testing and automation experience.
* 5+ years in a Test Architect, Solution Architect, QE Architect, Technical Lead, or equivalent technical leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex API modernization, microservices, integration, or digital transformation programs.
* Prior experience in healthcare or health insurance programs is strongly preferred.

Expected Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to take an enterprise modernization requirement such as:
  
  
Legacy Enterprise Services → Modern APIs → Microservices
  
  
**and independently define the corresponding:**  
Current-State Assessment → Test Strategy → API Test Architecture → Legacy Baseline → Modern API Validation → Automated Parity Testing → CI/CD Integration → Regression Strategy → Quality Gates → Production Readiness
  
  
The candidate should combine hands-on API automation architecture expertise with solutioning and customer-facing leadership, rather than functioning only as a test manager or delivery manager.

* Build and deploy datacenter infrastructure, including server installation, storage and RAID configuration, and OS deployment.
* Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell and Ansible, and support application containerization using Docker.
* Manage the firmware and driver lifecycle for datacenter hardware (e.g., Dell EMC servers).
* Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and status reports, and coordinate with customer and internal teams.

  + Hands-on experience with Hyper-V, Proxmox VE, Docker, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
  + Exposure to cybersecurity fundamentals and network traffic analysis.
  + Experience in large-scale datacenter or government/public-sector projects.
  + Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and under pressure.

**Base Location:** Noida, but flexible to travel (as per project and customer requirements).

title: Manager III, Software Development, Nexus Gateway
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you a software development leader who thrives on building high-performing teams and delivering technology that makes a real difference for customers? At Amazon, you will lead a team of talented engineers through the full software lifecycle—from design and architecture through deployment and operations. In this role, you will own the strategic direction for your team's software systems, define a compelling vision, and translate that vision into a roadmap that balances near-term delivery with long-term innovation. You will tackle ambiguous problems, make critical technical and resourcing decisions, and partner across organizations to deliver results at scale. If you are passionate about growing engineering talent, simplifying complex systems, and building software that customers love, we want to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and grow a software development team, owning the team's charter, vision, and roadmap while ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals and delivering high-quality, maintainable software systems.
* Define and prioritize the team's product and architectural direction over a one-to-two year horizon, partnering with stakeholders and peer teams to sequence deliverables and resolve competing priorities.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers across multiple levels through collaborative development planning, actionable feedback, and strategic project assignments that accelerate career growth.
* Drive system design decisions that account for scalability, performance, security, and operational excellence, and create mechanisms to inspect service quality and customer experience through meaningful metrics.
* Manage program execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives by identifying risks early, removing roadblocks, and communicating progress clearly through written narratives and planning documents.

  
A day in the life  
You might start your morning reviewing operational metrics and customer feedback to identify areas for improvement, then shift into a design review where you challenge assumptions and guide your engineers toward a scalable solution. After a one-on-one coaching session with a direct report, you collaborate with partner teams to align on a shared roadmap. Later, you draft a planning document that outlines your team's strategy for the coming year, weaving together customer needs, technical opportunities, and resource plans.

title: AI Native Software Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** AI Native Software Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Build and ship production-ready software using AI as a core part of the engineering lifecycle. Apply AI-native practices to develop and validate solutions, maintain quality and compliance, and continuously improve how software is built and operated.
  
**Must have skills :** Digital Full Stack Development  
**Good to have skills :** Python (Programming Language), TypeScript, Software Development  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As an AI Native Software Engineer, your day revolves around creating and delivering software solutions where artificial intelligence is deeply integrated into every stage of development. You will engage in designing, building, and deploying applications that leverage AI capabilities, ensuring that these solutions meet high standards of quality and compliance. Your role involves continuous refinement of software processes to enhance efficiency and reliability, collaborating with various teams to innovate and improve the overall software lifecycle. This position offers an opportunity to work at the forefront of technology, blending software engineering with AI-driven methodologies to produce impactful products.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Design and implement multi-agent orchestration pipelines using LangGraph state machines with conditional routing, self-healing loops, and sub-agent

hierarchies
  

* Build and maintain a hybrid retrieval system combining Neo4j knowledge graphs (Cypher) with Qdrant vector search and sentence-transformer

embeddings  

* Develop FastAPI backend services with async I/O (asyncpg, Motor), Pydantic v2 models, and JWT/RBAC security
* Build React 18 / TypeScript frontend features including visual graph editors (ReactFlow), real-time SSE streaming, and observability dashboards (Recharts)
* Integrate enterprise protocols: A2A (JSON-RPC), MCP (Model Context Protocol), AG-UI (Server-Sent Events)
* Connect to ALM/PLM tools via REST and GraphQL APIs with OAuth2/SSO authentication (SAML, OIDC)

- Implement dual-tier agent memory (Redis L1 + mem0 L2) with semantic recall and context consolidation - Build DAG-based workflow compilation with topological sorting, cycle detection, and Ray-based parallel execution - Deploy and operate containerized services using Docker, Azure Bicep IaC, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure Pipelines / Jenkins) - Serve and manage on-prem LLM models via vLLM alongside cloud-hosted models (OpenAI-compatible APIs)
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Backend & AI  

* Python 3.10+ — production-grade FastAPI, Pydantic v2, async/await patterns
* LangGraph / LangChain — state machines, tool calling, agent orchestration
* LLM engineering — prompt design, token budgeting, multi-model routing, self-healing retry loops
* PostgreSQL (JSONB, asyncpg) or MongoDB (Motor) — async data persistence

  
Knowledge & Retrieval  

* Neo4j — Cypher queries, entity-relationship graph modeling, traversal algorithm
* Vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, or Weaviate) — embedding pipelines, semantic search, hybrid retrieval
* RAG architecture — chunking strategies, re-ranking, token budget management
* Sentence-transformers or equivalent embedding models

  
Frontend  

* React 18 + TypeScript + Vite — component architecture, hooks, lazy loading
* Server-Sent Events (SSE) or WebSocket — real-time streaming UIs
* ReactFlow / XYFlow — interactive node-based graph editors
* State management (Zustand or Redux) + server-state (TanStack Query)

  
Additional Skills  

* vLLM or TGI — on-prem LLM model serving and optimization
* mem0 or similar — persistent agent memory systems
* A2A / MCP / AG-UI — emerging agentic interoperability protocols
* GraphQL — schema design, client integration
* OAuth2 / SAML / OIDC — enterprise SSO integration
* Ontology modeling — entity taxonomies, relationship schemas for engineering domains
* Pytest — async test patterns, fixture-based testing

  
Qualifications  

* 4+ years professional software engineering experience
* 2+ years working with LLMs, agent frameworks, or ML systems in production
* Strong async Python and modern React/TypeScript skills
* Experience with graph databases or knowledge graph systems
* Comfortable owning features across the full stack — API to UI to deployment

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Digital Full Stack Development.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Validation Test Developer
description:
Job ID

72284

Category

Enterprise Technology

Location

Bengaluru, India

Work Type

On-site

As a **Validation Test Developer**, you will contribute to Ford’s internal Design Validation (DV) test systems for next-generation vehicle components. You’ll work with test engineers and cross-functional teams to develop and maintain automated test scripts, integrate test bench hardware, perform electrical measurements, and investigate test issues.

This role is suited to an early-career engineer with practical experience in electrical systems, measurement techniques, or test development who is ready to take ownership of defined test activities while continuing to build expertise in automotive validation. You’ll gain hands-on experience with tools such as Python, LabVIEW, NI TestStand, and NI VeriStand, along with laboratory instrumentation and vehicle communication protocols.

* **Test Automation & Scripting:** Develop, execute, debug, and maintain test sequences and automated scripts using Python, LabVIEW, NI TestStand, and/or NI VeriStand.
* **Test Bench Setup & Integration:** Assemble and integrate sensors, actuators, power supplies, and instrumentation into validation benches; support wiring and verify system readiness.
* **Electrical Measurement & Testing:** Perform and document measurements such as voltage, current, resistance, signal integrity, and timing using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and data loggers.
* **Troubleshooting & Anomaly Logging:** Investigate test bench and hardware-in-the-loop issues, document test anomalies, and collaborate with senior engineers to identify root causes and corrective actions.
* **Network & Bus Communication:** Configure or monitor CAN, LIN, and Ethernet interfaces during component validation, as required.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with product design, validation, and manufacturing test teams to clarify test requirements and execute test cases against design targets.
* **Documentation & Version Control:** Maintain test procedures, bench configurations, wiring diagrams, and execution reports; use Git or similar tools to manage scripts and changes.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Participate in design reviews, team meetings, and technical training; identify opportunities to improve test coverage, repeatability, and efficiency.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **1–2 years of relevant experience** in electrical systems, measurement, test development, or automation, including applicable internship or co-op experience.
* Foundational understanding of electrical engineering principles, circuit theory, signal conditioning, and data acquisition (DAQ).
* Practical familiarity with Python or LabVIEW for scripting, test execution, or automation.
* Hands-on experience using common laboratory equipment, such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, and DC power supplies.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to National Instruments hardware platforms such as PXI, cRIO, or cDAQ and software such as LabVIEW, TestStand, or VeriStand.
* Basic understanding or practical exposure to automotive communication protocols, including CAN, LIN, or Automotive Ethernet.
* Experience using Git or similar version control tools.
* Ability to work collaboratively across engineering teams and manage assigned tasks with appropriate guidance.
* Interest in automotive validation, test automation, and continuous learning.

title: Systems Engineer II, SRE
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience programming in one or more programming languages.
* Experience working with administration (e.g., filesystems, inodes, system calls) or networking (e.g., TCP/IP, routing, network topologies and hardware, SDN).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
* Experience in Unix/Linux systems, IP networking, performance, and application issues.
* Experience with problem solving and analyzing enterprise systems.
* Experience navigating enterprise software, deployment, and management of workloads on Cloud.
* Experience in an engineering or operations role within enterprise applications or other enterprise spaces.

**About the job**
-----------------

*Hope is not a strategy. Engineering solutions to design, build, and maintain efficient large-scale systems is a true strategy, and a good one.*  
  
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is an engineering discipline that combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability and uptime appropriate to users' needs and a fast rate of improvement while keeping an ever-watchful eye on capacity and performance.  
  
SRE is also a mindset and a set of engineering approaches to running better production systems—we build our own creative engineering solutions to operations problems. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. As SREs are responsible for the big picture of how our systems relate to each other, we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad spectrum of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems and proactive identification of potential outages factor into iterative improvement that is key to both product quality and interesting and dynamic day-to-day work.  
  
SRE's culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

  
To learn more:  

* Check out *Site Reliability Engineering*, written by Google SREs.
  
* Watch a recorded Hangout on Air to meet some of our SREs.
  
* Read a career profile about why a software engineer chose to join SRE.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate to support Corp Engineering services, and build relationships with business partners.
* Drive technical interactions with business partners to come up with innovative ideas for improving reliability for enterprise applications.
* Leverage Google SRE reliability strategies to span GCP and the Google stack, and reduce the operational work.
* Work with other engineering teams to ensure that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure, and participate in the team's on-call rotation.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: SRE Tools Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer – Azure, Automation, Splunk & Dynatrace

  

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer with strong experience in CI/CD, Azure infrastructure, automation, and containerized environments, complemented by administrative knowledge of Splunk and Dynatrace.
  
The role will focus on automating deployments, infrastructure, and observability setup — ensuring applications and services can be quickly onboarded, validated, and ready for production monitoring.
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
1. CI/CD & Release Automation
  
Design and maintain pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools. Automate builds, testing, deployments, and post-deployment validation, incorporating approval controls, rollback mechanisms, and secure release practices.
  
2. Azure Infrastructure & Infrastructure as Code
  
Provision and manage Azure services, including AKS, App Services, Azure Functions, networking, and storage. Use Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent tools to automate provisioning, standardize configurations, and improve scalability and cost efficiency.
  
3. Containerization & Kubernetes
  
Build and maintain Docker images and Kubernetes deployment configurations. Manage AKS workloads, scaling, resource allocation, and health checks; troubleshoot container, connectivity, and deployment issues.
  
4. Automation & Security
  
Develop reusable scripts using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to reduce manual effort across infrastructure, deployments, and operational workflows. Automate configuration management and integrate security scanning, secrets management, and access controls into delivery processes.
  
5. Splunk & Dynatrace Administration, Automation & Production Readiness
  
Automate platform setup, agent/forwarder deployment, configuration, and application onboarding to accelerate production-monitoring readiness. Support access management, platform health, and troubleshooting. Integrate reusable automation and readiness checks into CI/CD pipelines to validate log ingestion, telemetry collection, and monitoring coverage before go-live.
  
6. SRE & Production Reliability
  
Apply SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and post-incident reviews. Partner with SRE L2/L3 teams to resolve production issues, reduce MTTR, and automate recurring operational and recovery activities.
  
7. Collaboration & Enablement
  
Provide reusable automation templates, operational runbooks, and engineering standards. Enable self-service provisioning and monitoring onboarding, integrate workflows with ServiceNow or Jira, and guide teams on deployment and operational readiness.
  
**Required Qualifications**  
5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering experience, including CI/CD ownership, infrastructure automation, and production troubleshooting.
  
Strong experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools, along with Git-based workflows.
  
Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Linux.
  
Strong scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, including API-based automation and tool integration.
  
Working administrative knowledge of both Splunk and Dynatrace, including access management, forwarder/agent configuration, data onboarding, platform health, and troubleshooting.
  
Ability to automate monitoring setup, streamline application onboarding, and validate production-monitoring readiness.
  
Understanding of SRE fundamentals, with strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Experience supporting retail/e-commerce platforms, microservices, and distributed systems. Familiarity with Helm, GitOps/Argo CD, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  
Certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Splunk, or Dynatrace are good to have, but not mandatory.
  
**Success Measures**  
Reduced time to onboard applications into production monitoring; increased automation and self-service adoption; validated monitoring coverage before go-live; fewer manual configuration errors; and improved deployment reliability and incident resolution time.

description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

  
A day in the life  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.  
  
Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.  
  
Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times  
  
About the team  
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams

# Job Description: Kafka & Kubernetes Developer

\*\*Job ID:\*\* To be confirmed

\*\*Number of Openings:\*\* 3

\*\*Experience:\*\* 5–6+ Years

\*\*Work Locations:\*\* Hyderabad / Bangalore / Chennai / Pune

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Hybrid

\*\*Working Hours:\*\* 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM

\*\*Budget:\*\* 22 LPA

\*\*Interview Process:\*\* 2 Internal Rounds + 1 Client Round

\*\*Interview Mode:\*\* Virtual

## Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Kafka & Kubernetes Developer for a Data Platform Engineering role. The ideal candidate should have strong engineering and architectural knowledge of the Kafka ecosystem, along with experience in platform configuration, monitoring, infrastructure provisioning, and troubleshooting Kafka components deployed in Kubernetes environments.

## Key Responsibilities

\* Configure and support Kafka ecosystem components, including Kafka brokers, ZooKeeper, KRaft, Schema Registry, and Kafka Connect.

\* Understand Kafka architecture and platform operations.

\* Monitor Kafka platform health, performance, and observability using Confluent Control Center.

\* Deploy Kafka components using Terraform modules and resources for standardized and scalable infrastructure provisioning.

\* Build and support CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions to automate Kafka deployments.

\* Troubleshoot Kafka components deployed in Kubernetes environments.

\* Investigate Kubernetes pod errors to identify deployment and runtime issues.

\* Analyze pod logs to diagnose failures and resolve technical issues.

\* Apply knowledge of core Kubernetes components to support application deployment and operations.

\* Support platform reliability, performance, and operational stability.

## Mandatory Skills

\* Strong experience in Kafka and Data Platform Engineering.

\* Good understanding of Kafka architecture and engineering principles.

\* Hands-on experience configuring and supporting Kafka components.

\* Knowledge of Kafka brokers, ZooKeeper, KRaft, Schema Registry, and Kafka Connect.

\* Experience with Confluent Control Center for monitoring and troubleshooting.

\* Experience using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.

\* Knowledge of Kubernetes troubleshooting, pod errors, and log analysis.

\* Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD workflows.

## Good-to-Have Skills

\* Good verbal and written communication skills.

\* Client-facing experience.

\* Ability to communicate technical issues and solutions effectively.

## Candidate Requirements

\* 5–6+ years of relevant experience.

\* Strong engineering and architectural understanding.

\* Ability to troubleshoot platform-level issues independently.

\* Comfortable working in a hybrid environment and participating in client interviews.

Pay: Up to ₹2,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu

title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer – SPM & Industrial Automation
description:
**Job Title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer – SPM & Industrial Automation**

**Company:** Ecopmin Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Ambattur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 7–15 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Department:** Electrical Design

**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Electrical Design Engineer** to lead electrical design activities for Special Purpose Machines (**SPMs**), industrial automation equipment, and customized machinery. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in electrical schematics, control panel design, component selection, machine wiring, and coordination with **PLC**, mechanical design, and production teams.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead electrical design and development for SPMs, industrial automation systems, and customized machinery.
* Prepare electrical schematics, power and control circuit diagrams, panel layout drawings, and machine wiring diagrams.
* Develop electrical designs using **AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN**, or **equivalent electrical CAD software.**
* Select and size electrical components, including **MCBs**, **MCCBs**, **contactors**, **relays**, **SMPS, VFDs, servo drives, motors**, and **safety devices.**
* Design PLC I/O interfaces, sensor connections, actuator wiring, and industrial control circuits.
* Prepare **BOMs**, **cable schedules, terminal plans**, and complete **electrical documentation**.
* Review electrical designs for safety, reliability, cost-effectiveness, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Coordinate with mechanical design, PLC programming, manufacturing, and assembly teams throughout project execution.
* Guide electrical technicians and engineers during panel building, machine wiring, testing, and commissioning.
* Troubleshoot electrical design issues and implement engineering modifications.
* Support **FAT**, **SAT**, **Machine commissioning**, and customer technical discussions when required.
* Manage multiple projects, ensure timely drawing release, and maintain design documentation.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design tools.
* Strong expertise in industrial electrical design and control panel engineering.
* In-depth knowledge of PLC systems, I/O wiring, VFDs, servo drives, sensors, motors, and industrial safety circuits.
* Experience in electrical component selection, load calculations, cable sizing, and circuit protection.
* Strong understanding of machine wiring, panel layouts, grounding, and electrical safety.
* Knowledge of BOM preparation, terminal plans, cable schedules, and engineering documentation.
* Experience in SPM design, machine automation, robotics, or customized industrial equipment.
* Familiarity with IEC standards and applicable industrial electrical safety requirements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) or a related discipline.
* 7–15 years of relevant experience in electrical design, control panel engineering, SPMs, or industrial automation.
* Proven experience in designing electrical systems for machines or automation projects.
* Ability to independently handle electrical design activities from concept to commissioning.
* Experience in design reviews, technical problem-solving, and cross-functional coordination.
* Strong leadership, communication, and project execution skills.

**Benefits**

* **Permanent employment.**
* **PF, ESI, and insurance as per company policy.**
* **Opportunity to work on customized machinery and industrial automation projects.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with an updated resume highlighting their electrical design, control panel engineering, and industrial automation experience.  
**Contact Person:** HR Joesan  
**Contact Number:** 9789839956 / 9789839926  
**Email:** hr@ecopmin.com

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
### **About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?

### 

### **About the role**

As a **ServiceNow Developer**, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will ensure the end-to-end quality of solutions implemented across ServiceNow capabilities, including Security Operations, Vulnerability Response, Integrated Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, and Third-Party Risk Management.

You will collaborate with development teams, business teams, customers, and stakeholders to translate business needs into functional requirements, improve workflows, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality ServiceNow solutions.

### 

### **In this role, you will:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute quality test plans and test cases covering unit, functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing.
* Execute quality-testing activities for new solutions, enhancements, and defects. Manage identified defects and work closely with development teams to validate fixes.
* Map business needs to functional requirements and ensure that ServiceNow solutions meet applicable quality standards.
* Guide stakeholders through user acceptance testing, including test-case execution and documentation. Analyze test results and produce appropriate testing metrics.
* Review designs, testing scenarios, and test cases for usability and application quality. Troubleshoot functional and technical issues, support releases and upgrades, and contribute to ServiceNow configuration and platform customization.

Embrace Cognizant’s culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build productive relationships.

### 

### **What you must have to be considered**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* Minimum of **6 years of IT experience**, including at least **4 years of ServiceNow experience**.
* Strong GRC domain knowledge and functional knowledge of ServiceNow Security Operations, Vulnerability Response, Integrated Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, and Third-Party Risk Management.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Security Operations and Vulnerability Response, including integrations with scanning tools such as Prisma Cloud and Qualys.
* Experience with defect-tracking and test-case management tools.
* Experience developing automation scripts for regression test suites.
* Experience with SDLC and STLC processes, including client-requirement analysis, system design, and test-case design.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Knowledge of relational databases, including MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Oracle.
* Proficiency in GRC concepts, policies, and compliance areas.
* Strong understanding of defect-management processes, software-testing techniques, and testing strategies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, time-management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
* Experience collaborating with geographically distributed customers, stakeholders, and onshore and offshore teams.
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to lead assignments or teams, mentor others, and support team development.
* Strong presentation skills, with the ability to lead discussions with business leaders and stakeholders.
* A strong sense of ownership and a commitment to creating meaningful outcomes.
* Embodiment of Cognizant’s values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

### 

### **These will help you succeed**

* ServiceNow module certifications.
* Knowledge of security domains.
* Experience researching and assessing emerging ServiceNow platform resources and technologies.
* Excellent customer-service, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate cross-functional activities and share information effectively across teams.

### 

### **Work model**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a **hybrid position based in Bangalore, India**.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on the project as well as business and client requirements.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Software Engineering Advisor - HIH - Evernorth
description:

As well as work closely with subject matter experts to understand business logic you will be engineering. As a software engineer, you will help develop an integrated architectural strategy to support next-generation reporting and analytical capabilities on an enterprise-wide scale. You will work in an agile environment, delivering user-oriented products which will be available both internally and externally by our customers, clients, and providers.
  
  
Candidates will be provided the opportunity to work on a range of technologies and data manipulation concepts. Specifically, this may include developing healthcare data structures and data transformation logic to allow for analytics and reporting for customer journeys, personalization opportunities, pre-active actions, text mining, action prediction, fraud detection, text/sentiment classification, collaborative filtering/recommendation, and/or signal detection. This position will involve taking these skills and applying them to some of the most exciting and massive health data opportunities that exist here at Evernorth.
  
  
The ideal candidate will work in a team environment that demands technical excellence, whose members are expected to hold each other accountable for the overall success of the product. Focus for this team is on the delivery of innovative solutions to complex problems, but also with a mind to drive simplicity in refining and supporting of the solution by others.

* Automate data workflows, validation, and monitoring to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
* Conduct peer code reviews, manage merge requests, and oversee production releases.
* Apply Agile principles in design, development, and delivery.
* Collaborate effectively in a high-performing team environment.
* Demonstrate ownership, innovation, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Qualifications
  
  
**Required Skills:**  

* Knowledge and/or experience with healthcare information domains.
* Working knowledge of the following: Python, Databricks, Teradata, SQL, UNIX, Tableau, GIT, Jenkins, RESTful GraphQL APIs.
* Should have extensive hands-on experience in AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudTrail, CloudWatch, SNS, SQS, S3, VPC, EC2, RDS, IAM.
* Experience working with SPARK and real time analytic frameworks.
* Documented experience in a business intelligence or analytic development role on a variety of large-scale projects.
* Documented experience working with databases larger than 5TB and excellent data analysis skills.
* Ability to rapidly prototype and storyboard/wireframe development as part of application design.
* Write referenceable and modular code.
* Willingness to continuously learn share learnings with others.
* Ability to communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions clearly and effectively to teams and clients.
* Ability to manipulate and transform large datasets efficiently.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills to root cause complex issues.
* Experience with TDD/BDD.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline with 5 to 7 years of experience in application program development, or the equivalent in education and work experience.
  
  
**Desired Experience:**  
  
  

* AWS certification preferred

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. title: Sr. Snowflake Developer
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Snowflake Developer / Data Engineer (IC3) to take self-directed ownership of features and small epics within our Snowflake data platform — including Bronze/Silver/Gold data layer architecture, ELT pipelines, and the data models that power analytics and reporting across Keyloop. Beyond hands-on delivery, you will lead design discussions for your own work, coach more junior developers, and work with stakeholders across Finance, Sales, and Operations to deliver reliable, scalable, and well-governed data products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead complete delivery of features and small epics on the Snowflake platform, from design through to production, without senior oversight
* Design and implement Snowflake database objects: tables, views, streams, tasks, stored procedures, and dynamic tables
* Build and maintain ELT pipelines using Boomi, dbt, or SQL-based transformations into Snowflake
* Architect and manage Bronze / Silver / Gold data layers in line with Keyloop's data platform standards
* Develop and optimise complex SQL for data transformation, aggregation, and reporting use cases
* Implement Snowflake performance best practices: clustering keys, result caching, query profiling, and warehouse right-sizing
* Own testing strategy for pipeline and model changes, ensuring comprehensive coverage beyond unit-level checks
* Coach and support IC1/IC2 developers on Snowflake, SQL, and data engineering best practices
* Lead technical design discussions for your features and represent the team in cross-functional planning meetings
* Coordinate cross-functional data requirements with adjacent teams (Finance, Sales, Operations)
* Support data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and lineage documentation
* Manage Snowflake environment configuration across dev, QA, and production
* Contribute to data governance: access control, data masking, row-level security, and tagging
* Monitor pipeline health, proactively identify failures, and provide production support — including occasional out-of-hours incident response
* Support UAT cycles with technical recommendations and sign-off
* Produce clear technical documentation: data dictionaries, ERDs, pipeline runbooks

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–7 years of Snowflake development experience in a production data environment
* Strong SQL skills — window functions, CTEs, recursive queries, and advanced aggregations
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake-specific features: streams, tasks, dynamic tables, time travel, zero-copy cloning
* Experience building ELT/ETL pipelines from source systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, or ERP platforms
* Understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing concepts (star schema, slowly changing dimensions)
* Familiarity with Snowflake access controls: roles, grants, and row/column-level security
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD for data pipeline deployment
* Ability to translate business data requirements into technical data models
* Demonstrated ability to coach or mentor junior developers, and to lead technical discussions within a team

**Desirable Skills**

* SnowPro Core or Advanced Data Engineer certification
* Experience with dbt (data build tool) for transformation orchestration
* Exposure to Boomi as an integration tool feeding Snowflake
* Familiarity with Salesforce data structures and Salesforce reporting requirements
* Experience with NetSuite financial data extraction and modelling
* Knowledge of data observability tooling (Monte Carlo, Great Expectations, or similar)
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams and Jira-based project management
* Background in automotive, SaaS, or financial systems data

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

Are you ready to architect highly available, large-scale enterprise software platforms that solve complex, ambiguous problems? We're seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join Amazon's Finance Automation Payroll Technology team, where you'll define the technical vision for core product areas and transform how we enable accurate, timely payroll processing across multiple countries at scale.

Our mission is to enable our business to pay every team member accurately, on time, and at scale, with zero defects. As Amazon's workforce grows in size and geography, payroll operations become increasingly complex, and we're solving this through technology rather than process alone. If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Payroll Technology team.  
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. title: Sr Developer
description:

UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer or equivalent UiPath professional certification

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our India Operations and play a crucial role in our mission to establish a world-class data engineering team within the Center for Data and Insights (CDI). In this role, you’ll play a key part in building a cutting-edge, real-time data platform, designed to deliver insights at scale and power data-driven decision-making across our organization. Responsibilities will include collaborating with the data team and working on both backend microservices & frontend interfaces, crafting solutions that ensure data is processed, analyzed, and visualized in real time.

The ideal candidate will bring strong full-stack engineering expertise across modern frontend and backend technologies, with hands-on experience building scalable, secure, and cloud-native applications. You will leverage Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices to deliver high-quality solutions that enable data-driven decision making for our business partners. This role requires a proactive, self-driven engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes ownership from design through production, and balances technical excellence with business impact. By joining the CDI team, you will play a key role in shaping the data product application, building intuitive user experiences, scalable APIs, and robust platform capabilities that empower teams worldwide with timely, actionable insights. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, delivering exceptional user experiences, and driving continuous improvement across the full technology stack, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Core Areas of Responsibility**

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across the product, spanning React/Next.js frontend applications and Java Spring Boot backend services.
* Build secure, scalable REST APIs using OpenAPI-first design principles and implement robust authentication and authorization using Okta OIDC, OAuth2, and JWT-based security.
* Develop intuitive, accessible, and localized user experiences, including dashboards, analytics, data tables, and visualizations, ensuring WCAG-compliant implementations.
* Collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, UX designers, and stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and platform enhancements.
* Manage integrations with Databricks and other data platforms, optimizing API performance, database connectivity, and concurrent processing for large-scale analytics workloads.
* Implement comprehensive testing strategies across the stack, including unit, integration, API, and component testing, to ensure reliability and maintainability.
* Support cloud-native deployments using Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, and GitOps practices, while maintaining observability through Datadog and production monitoring tools.
* Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, architectural discussions, performance optimization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**About You**
-------------

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

* 8+ years of experience building and delivering modern full-stack applications using Java and React-based technologies.
* Strong expertise in Java 21, Spring Boot, REST API design, and secure application development using OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT authentication.
* Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks, including state management, API integration, and component-driven development.
* Solid understanding of SQL-based data platforms and API-driven integrations, with experience optimizing application performance and scalability.
* Experience working with containerized and cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms such as GCP and/or AWS.
* Proven ability to write high-quality, maintainable code supported by automated testing frameworks and engineering best practices.
* Strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Databricks, GitOps/Flux CD, observability platforms (Datadog), internationalization, or analytics applications is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**About the Team**
------------------

Center for Data and Insights (CDI) is a service oriented horizontal organization that is uniquely positioned within the company to be the trusted and unbiased source of timely data-based insights for Crunchyroll. Our vision is to inspire, support and guide our stakeholders to be data-aware and build the systems of intelligence to discover insights and act on them. We have built a highly functional organization that truly believes in being a responsive partner, with the utmost curiosity, unwavering accountability and the courage to lead with actions.

title: Senior Software Engineer - C# .net
description:
**Senior Software Engineer – C# .net**

**Location: Hyderabad / Noida**

  

**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values – caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

Join the Standard Configuration Framework area to develop XMGR, SimCorp’s configuration-management platform for SimCorp Dimension. You will help make configuration changes reliable, repeatable and traceable across development, test and production environments, supporting both cloud-hosted and on-premises deployments.

This is a hands-on, C#/.NET-focused senior engineering role with opportunities to contribute across the stack. XMGR combines ASP.NET Core APIs, an Angular/TypeScript UI, Entity Framework Core and relational databases, with asynchronous messaging and workflow processing. You will evolve an established platform and turn complex configuration requirements into maintainable software.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Build and evolve C#/.NET services and ASP.NET Core APIs
* Design reliable asynchronous workflows with clear failure handling, safe retries and useful diagnostics, protecting configuration integrity when operations fail or are interrupted.
* Improve security, authorization, auditability, performance and observability; diagnose issues across application and integration boundaries.
* Improve automated unit and integration testing, code review and CI/CD; refactor existing code incrementally while preserving compatibility and behaviour
Provide technical leadership through design discussions, mentoring and knowledge sharing; collaborate across engineering, configuration and platform teams to deliver the team’s definition of done.  

  

**WHAT WE VALUE**

* Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience ranging from 3 to 5 years developing production software in C#/.NET, with evidence of owning complex features and making sound technical decisions
* Experience building ASP.NET Core services and REST APIs, including API contracts, asynchronous programming, dependency injection and robust error handling.
* Practical application of object-oriented design, SOLID principles and appropriate design patterns; ability to navigate, debug and safely improve an established codebase.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL, using Entity Framework Core or a comparable ORM; understand data modelling, validation, serialization and schema compatibility.
* Understanding of reliable distributed or long-running operations: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures, with the ability to diagnose problems using logs and telemetry.
* Strong automated unit and integration testing skills; experience with peer reviews, Git and CI/CD, and a commitment to maintainability, security and release quality.
Ability to clarify requirements with domain stakeholders and collaborate in an Agile team; willingness to work across backend APIs and web UI when a feature requires it.  

  

**DESIRABLE**

* Experience with configuration-management or deployment-automation systems: versioned artifacts, dependency resolution, environment promotion, baseline comparison or audit trails.
* Angular and TypeScript experience, particularly reactive programming with RxJS and state management such as NgRx.
* Asynchronous messaging (for example NATS), OData APIs, Oracle or SQL Server, and application telemetry such as OpenTelemetry.
* Azure, enterprise authentication/authorization, Docker or Kubernetes, and automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience modernizing .NET applications while preserving integration compatibility; familiarity with NUnit, NSubstitute or equivalent testing tools.
* Experience in enterprise or financial software; familiarity with SimCorp Dimension is welcome but not required.

Prior experience with XMGR or the Standard Configuration Framework is not required; you should be willing to learn the product and configuration domain.

  

**PERSONAL COMPETENCIES**

* Take responsibility for, apply sound judgement and balance delivery with long-term quality
* Work constructively across cultures and disciplines; share knowledge, mentor colleagues and contribute to an inclusive team environment.
Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including technical decisions and documentation.  

  

**BENEFITS**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Viswanath Tangella (viswanath.tangella@simcorp.com), Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

  

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

  

**WHO WE ARE?**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with large and global investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 2,500+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not optional. It is essential.

* 1+ year building or operating real-time voice systems (VoIP, SIP/RTP, WebRTC, or STT/TTS integration).

- Akira AI - Reasoning and agent orchestration.

- ElixirData - Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes.

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI + Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise-ready.

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

We are building a Managed Services team to support a large-scale enterprise data platform. The platform spans Cloudera on AWS, an on-premises Oracle data warehouse, Oracle GoldenGate replication, Apache Spark for ETL and data processing, and Alation for data governance. L1 support is handled by our existing team; this role is part of L2/L3 operations.

**ROLE MISSION**

Support and automate the AWS-based infrastructure and deployment processes of the data platform, improving reliability, observability and release quality.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage and support AWS infrastructure for the data platform in production.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and manage deployments and releases.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational tasks.
* Set up and maintain monitoring, alerting and observability for platform components.
* Provide production support, troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues, and contribute to RCA.
* Manage configuration, environments and access in line with client security policies.
* Work with DataOps and Security teams to support the Cloudera environment and Spark workloads.
* Maintain documentation for pipelines, automation and runbooks.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Managed Services delivery lead; works with the DataOps and Data Security teams.

**HOW WE WORK WITH AI**

AI is part of the daily workflow at XenonStack, not an add-on.

* Within XenonStack's own systems, AI tools are open for use: log and incident analysis, runbook and RCA drafting, scripting and documentation.
* At the client site in Mumbai, you follow the client's compliance and information security policy: use only client-approved tools, and never put client data, logs, credentials, queries or configurations into any tool the client has not approved.
* Every AI-assisted output is verified by you before it is relied on or shared.
* Come ready to talk about what is in your AI stack, how you verify its output, and how you keep it compliant in a regulated environment.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Releases go out through the pipeline with a tested rollback, not by hand.
* Alerts catch platform issues before users report them.
* Repetitive manual tasks replaced by automation each month.
* No secrets or access outside client security policy.

**MUST-HAVE SKILLS**

* Hands-on AWS (EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch)
* CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI or equivalent) and Git
* Scripting in Python and/or Shell
* Linux administration

**About the Role**
  
We are looking for a **Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect (f/m/d)** to own the technical foundation of our cloud platform. You will maintain our service catalog, design architectural blueprints, establish the observability standard, and — most distinctively — bring hands-on LLM-driven tooling skills to a team actively shaping what the next generation of cloud operations looks like.

This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the **Cloud Architect Manager (who reports to the CIO)**, with direct CIO-adjacent visibility.
