The team is small, ownership is total, and iteration cycles are short. You will be expected to resolve ambiguity, align expectations, and establish technical clarity across a diverse group of stakeholders.

**Time allocation (approximate):**
  
~40% LLM-driven tooling & workflow design | ~30% architecture & catalog governance | ~20%
  
observability | ~10% collaboration & documentation

**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Service Catalog & Platform Governance**

* Build and maintain a minimalistic, opinionated service catalog of approved cloud components across Google Cloud and Azure
* Apply a serverless-first, PaaS-first philosophy — challenge complexity and push back on
    
  unnecessary infrastructure sprawl
* For every approved catalog entry, deliver production-ready configuration: IaC, security baseline,observability hooks, and runbook
* Scrutinise every new component request and justify its addition in terms of cost, operational overhead, and platform alignment

**Cloud Architecture**

* Define, document, and govern cloud architectural blueprints across networking, compute, storage and data layers
* Design event-driven pipelines that trigger AI-assisted validation, drift detection, and deployment gates
* Serve as the technical authority on platform design decisions within your domain

**LLM-Driven Operations**

* Implement LLM-based automated deployment capabilities using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, or equivalent frameworks
* Design and operate infrastructure workflows augmented by AI agents — from deployment validation to configuration drift detection

**Observability**

* Define the observability standard: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLO/SLA frameworks

**Collaboration**

* Partner with SecOps to integrate all controls and security requirements
* Document everything: blueprints, ADRs, runbooks, onboarding guides

**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
  
You have operated multi-cloud Kubernetes environments in production, built IaC pipelines with Terraform and have hands-on experience with LLM-driven tooling in real engineering workflows. Specifically:

* Proven cloud networking experience: firewalls, gateways, VPCs, VPNs, private service connect, and network security groups

* FinOps — cost attribution, rightsizing, commitment strategies
* Prior experience in a SaaS product company at scale
* Platform engineering / SRE background

**Soft Skills**

* Intense technical curiosity — you follow the market, test new tools, and form opinions before they become mainstream
* Strong problem-solving discipline: you reach for first principles, not familiarity
* Ownership mindset — you build it, you run it, you improve it
* Clear written and verbal communication: able to document decisions and explain them to non specialists
* Operates well under pressure and tight constraints — energised by hard problems
* Strong negotiation skills — fact-driven and data-driven: you argue with evidence, not opinion
* Highly collaborative: you build alignment across engineering, SecOps, and leadership

**What success looks like**

We target a mature and highly automated cloud foundation designed for modern enterprise SaaS. The long-term success of this role is defined by:

* **Robust Service Catalog & Governance:** An established service catalog baseline featuring approved, standardized cloud components with built-in compliance, IaC automation, and production-ready monitoring.

title: Senior NetSuite Developer (Hybrid Work Schedule)
description:
**Senior NetSuite Developer**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Model of Work: Hybrid**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international, and dynamic environment which contributes to drive the energy transition? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing technology & professional services solutions company and industry leader in energy transformation.

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the energy industry. Throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior NetSuite Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the development, customization, and maintenance of our NetSuite ERP system. This role requires a deep understanding of NetSuite's architecture, extensive experience with SuiteScript, and the ability to lead technical projects from conception to implementation. The ideal candidate will also bring a forward-thinking mindset, leveraging AI tools and technologies to drive efficiency and innovation.

**Responsibilities**

**NetSuite Development:**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy customizations, scripts (SuiteScript 1.0, 2.0, and 2.1), workflows, and new functionality based on evolving business needs.
* Optimize NetSuite performance and scalability to ensure efficient operation of the ERP system.
* Implement integrations with other business systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and other integration tools.
* Leverage AI/ML APIs (such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar) to extend NetSuite functionality and build intelligent, data-driven features.

**System Customization & Maintenance:**

* Customize and maintain NetSuite's forms, fields, records, and workflows to meet organizational requirements.
* Provide ongoing support and system administration to ensure NetSuite functionality aligns with business processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve any system issues in a timely manner.

**Project Management:**

* Lead and manage technical projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and budget.

**Team Collaboration:**

* Work closely with business analysts, system administrators, and other IT professionals to deliver comprehensive solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and IT staff, including adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
* Conduct training sessions and create documentation for end-users and technical teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Stay up-to-date with NetSuite updates and industry best practices to continuously enhance system functionality.
* Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and system optimization, including the application of AI-powered automation and agent-based workflows.

*And other duties as assigned.*

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience working with NetSuite, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead developer role.
* Expertise in SuiteScript (1.0, 2.0, and 2.1) and SuiteFlow.
* Strong experience with SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and other integration methods.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, SQL, and web technologies (HTML, CSS).
* Familiarity with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF).
* **Experience integrating AI/ML APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, or equivalent) into business applications or ERP workflows.**
* **Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor to accelerate development and improve code quality.**
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal

**Preferred Skills**

* NetSuite certification(s) such as SuiteFoundation, SuiteCloud Developer, or ERP Consultant.
* Experience with other ERP systems and integration platforms.
* Knowledge of accounting and finance principles.
* Experience with the ARM module within NetSuite.
* **Experience designing or deploying AI-powered automation solutions or agentic workflows within enterprise environments.**
* **Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen) or AI agent platforms.**

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position. The successful candidate will be required to ensure they maintain and renew any visas or permits that grant employment eligibility where applicable.

**About Quorum Software**  
Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com.

**Quorum Diversity Statement:** At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

*Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.*

description:

**Location:** Pune HO, India (In Campus) • **Experience:** 3–5 years • **Team:** Validation

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a QA engineer who thinks in frameworks, not test cases. You’ll own and grow the automated testing that gives us confidence to ship changes across a distributed, hardware-in-the-loop system — from API and integration layers up through operator-facing UIs — and wire that testing into CI so regressions get caught before they reach a warehouse floor.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, integration, UI, and end-to-end) for our control and fulfilment systems.
* Own test automation frameworks — choosing the right tools, keeping them fast and non-flaky, and making them easy for engineers to extend.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) so quality gates run on every merge, with clear signal on failures.
* Build test coverage for services that talk over message queues (RabbitMQ) and persist to PostgreSQL, including data-integrity and state-transition checks.
* Design and run performance, load, and reliability tests against critical paths, and help define pass/fail thresholds.
* Partner with developers to shift testing left — reviewing testability of new features, defining acceptance criteria, and contributing to test strategy early in the cycle.
* Triage, reproduce, and root-cause defects; write clear, reproducible reports and track them to closure.
* Contribute to release readiness — go/no-go assessments, regression sign-off, and release validation across projects.

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* 3–5 years in software QA / test automation, with a strong track record building automated suites (not just running manual cases).
* Solid programming ability in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for writing maintainable test code.
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks — e.g. Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI, and pytest / REST-assured / Postman-Newman for API testing.
* Practical experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and reasoning about flaky-test mitigation, parallelisation, and test data management.
* Comfort with API testing (REST), reading logs, and querying databases (SQL) to validate behaviour end-to-end.
* Strong debugging instincts and the ability to isolate whether a failure is in the test, the code, the data, or the environment.
* Clear written communication for defect reports, test plans, and release notes.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience testing distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or message-queue-based services (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter).
* Familiarity with containerised environments (Docker/Podman) and setting up reproducible test environments.
* Experience with hardware-in-the-loop, IoT, robotics, or other systems where software meets the physical world.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) to validate system behaviour under test.
* Prior work in warehousing, logistics, or industrial automation domains.

description:
**Job Summary:**

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

**Competencies:**

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

**Experience:**

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Job Overview**

We are looking for a **Senior** **SDET** to test the resilience and correctness of distributed backend systems supporting a high-stakes account provisioning and onboarding workflow. This role is focused on the execution of pre-approved, benign tracer/replay scenarios against staging endpoints, analysis of request/response behaviour, and documentation of observable account/CID lifecycle and downstream state behaviour.

The ideal candidate has strong distributed-systems and API-testing experience and maintains disciplined technical evidence capture and traceability.

This role is not intended to perform unrestricted adversarial testing. Testing activities will be limited to approved staging environments and pre-approved benign scenarios.

**Project Details**  
  
**Title:** Senior SDET  
**Rate:** $13.5/hr
  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 5 Weeks  
**Commitment**: 33 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Freelance

### **Responsibilities**

* Analyze distributed system APIs to validate correctness, consistency, and failure handling across services involved in account creation, data persistence, and related record-linking
* Execute pre-approved request variations and boundary-validation scenarios using sanitized tracer payloads against designated staging endpoints.
* Investigate system behavior under malformed, malicious, or unexpected inputs and document findings clearly
* Capture complete request/response evidence, including HTTP status codes, latency, headers, and payload bodies, subject to approved data-handling requirements.
* Validate behavior of near-real-time inline checks (evaluated within milliseconds at the gateway) as distinct from longer-running background verification/risk pipelines (evaluated over minutes to hours), confirming each layer of defense behaves as expected
* Verify data persistence, referential integrity, and correct linkage of related records/relationships written by backend services during processing
* Execute controlled replay suites and compare expected versus observed API behavior.
* Correlate replay results with the API schemas and network evidence produced by the Middleware SDET.
* Document observable account/CID lifecycle behavior and downstream state changes for handoff
* Capture and archive test logs and evidence in a structured, retrievable format to support audits and post-incident reviews
* Collaborate with backend engineering teams to reproduce, isolate, and validate fixes for distributed-system defects
* Contribute to test strategy for backend/middleware reliability, including failure-mode and chaos-style testing
* Maintain traceability between test evidence, defects, and system requirements
* Reconcile backend observations with the frontend FSM and middleware/API evidence produced by earlier workstreams.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience of **5-8+ years** in testing distributed systems and analyzing inter-service API behavior
* Hands-on experience with request payload tampering, fuzzing, or adversarial API testing techniques
* Understanding of layered defense architectures, including the distinction between synchronous/inline validation and asynchronous/background verification processes
* Familiarity with testing data persistence and relational/hierarchical integrity in backend data stores
* Demonstrated discipline in test log archival, evidence capture, and structured documentation practices
* Solid understanding of backend/middleware architecture, failure modes, and system boundaries
* Familiarity with API testing tools and scripting for building custom fuzzing/tampering test cases
* Strong analytical and investigative skills for root-causing complex, systemic defects
* Experience executing controlled API replay or staging validation is strongly preferred.
* Experience correlating API responses with observable application/account lifecycle states is preferred.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, or evidence-based reporting requirements is a plus

* Strong track record of technical delivery governance, including setting standards and quality gates

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Embedded Linux Engineer to join our Robotics engineering team. You will be responsible for bringing up custom-designed processor boards, developing Linux device drivers, optimizing kernel performance, and ensuring a stable platform for application development. The ideal candidate has a strong "hacker" mindset, loves working close to the metal, and thrives on solving complex hardware-software integration problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Board Bring-Up: Perform initial board bring-up on new, custom-designed processor boards (custom ARM/RISC-V).
* Linux Kernel/BSP Development: Customize, configure, and maintain the Linux kernel, bootloader (U-Boot), and Board Support Package (BSP) for custom hardware.
* Driver Development: Write, debug, and optimize low-level Linux device drivers for on-chip and off-chip peripherals (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, Ethernet, GPIO).
* Device Tree: Develop and maintain Device Tree Source (DTS/DTB) files to map hardware peripherals to Linux drivers.
* System Optimization: Optimize system boot time, memory usage, and performance on constrained custom hardware.
* Debugging: Troubleshoot complex system crashes, kernel panics, and hardware-software interaction issues using JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Build Systems: Create and maintain custom embedded Linux distributions using Yocto Project or Buildroot.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 3-7+ years of professional experience in embedded Linux software development.
* Languages: Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming for embedded systems; scripting experience in Python or Bash.
* Kernel Knowledge: Deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, including memory management, interrupts, and concurrency management.
* Hardware Familiarity: Ability to read hardware schematics and component datasheets to derive software solutions.
* Tools: Proficient with Git, GDB, and JTAG debugging tools.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with ARM Cortex-A/M or RISC-V architectures.

Experience contributing to the mainline Linux kernel or open-source community.

Knowledge of secure boot and hardware security modules (HSM).

Experience with real-time Linux patches (PREEMPT\_RT).

description:
**Who we are**

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

**Why Worldwide**

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

\*SUMMARY: To perform the lead programming role, lead continuous improvement in the programming function’s operating systems and provide consultancy across the function\* \*RESPONSIBILITIES:\* \_Some team members may focus on a limited number of these responsibilities depending on requirements. \_\_Tasks may include but are not limited to:\_ Develop, test and execute SAS programs to produce and validate CDISC SDTM and ADaM datasets, tables, figures and listings (TFL). Perform review and provide guidance on the development of the clinical database specification, data transfer agreement/specification, specification of tables, figures and listings (TFL) shells. Develop and review specification for SDTM datasets and ADaM datasets for safety data, TFL shells and other specifications, e.g. patient profiles, OPS reports. Develop and review electronic data submission package (SDTM annotated CRF, define.xml, Study/Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide) for high complexity studies. Apply advanced knowledge of CDISC standards and electronic data submission (SDTM annotated CRF, define.xml, Study/Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide, Analysis Results Metadata). Provide expertise and consultancy on FDA, PMDA and other regulatory agencies submission requirements. Serve as a programming project lead on multiple complex studies (e.g. adaptive design, integrated safety/efficacy study) to distribute and oversee tasks for the programming team, communicate with internal and external clients, plan and execute delivery, and manage resources and competing project priorities effectively. Ensure budget and scope of project work remain aligned. Manage the study documentation flow as per Worldwide SOP and other procedural documentation including timely document submission to eTMF. Be able to describe and explain Worldwide documentation and eTMF requirements. Actively seek, propose and lead process improvement initiatives including development of standard SAS Macros, in-house programming standards. Participate in development of department SOPs, guidelines, templates and other quality management documentation. Provide training and consultancy to Clinical Data Managers, Statistical Programmers and Biostatisticians on programming, clinical and analysis data standards (CDISC) and electronic data submission requirements. Develop and provide Statistical Programmers, Biostatisticians and representatives of other departments and groups with training and coaching on the Biostatistical Operations department process, infrastructure and tools, collaboration with other internal and external parties and the role of the statistical programmer. Develop knowledge of SAS (including BASE, GRAPH, MACRO, ODS, SQL) and other software applications (e.g. Excel, Visual Basic, Word). Develop regulatory standards knowledge in computer systems, systems validation, Good Clinical Practice, clinical data management, clinical/statistical reporting and regulatory submission requirements etc. Act as subject matter expert for internal and external quality audits and inspections. Perform review of study proposals and budgets. Assist at bid defense and other sponsor meeting. Ensure all activities are performed by the study team are in compliance with Worldwide and sponsor quality requirements, relevant ICH and regulatory authority standards, e.g. FDA 21 CFR Part 11, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Provide training on the standards and requirements. Act as a mentor for the members of Biostatistical Operations department. Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. \*OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: \* The job holder must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems. Hands-on expert level project statistical programmer experienced in providing programming leadership to projects. Statistical programming skills and knowledge across a broad range of applications together with key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change. It is essential that the job holder to possess strong analytical skills and attentiveness to detail. To have the ability to train new staff. \*REQUIREMENTS:\* Educated to degree level or equivalent. The jobholder has advanced SAS programming skills with expert knowledge in SAS/Macro, Proc Report and ODS. Good working knowledge in SAS/Graph, Proc SQL, SAS/STAT. Minimum 6 years of previous related experience. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement.

description:

Company and benefits

Role

Lead Enterprise Solutions Applied AI Engineer

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Core Mission
  
The Lead Applied AI Engineer is a hands-on, forward-deployed technical leader responsible for designing, building, and deploying production-grade agentic AI solutions across the enterprise. The role involves working directly with business units to create autonomous systems that deliver measurable impact. This individual will not only build solutions but also establish standards, reference architectures, and safety guardrails for how agentic AI is developed and scaled responsibly throughout the organization.
  
  
The position is for a "builder" who can translate complex business workflows into automated, agent-driven processes while navigating the realities of an enterprise environment, including security, governance, and user trust.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
This is a hybrid role-blending hands-on solution delivery with platform-level strategy.
  
  
1. Forward-Deployed Solution Delivery (60% of time)
  
Lead Agentic AI Initiatives: Serve as the embedded technical leader within business units to translate needs into robust, enterprise-integrated agentic AI solutions, overseeing the full lifecycle from idea to implementation and monitoring.
  
Enterprise System Integration: Connect AI agents to diverse enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, legacy databases, APIs), ensuring seamless integration and production-ready performance through rapid iteration and troubleshooting.
  
Pilot Management & Knowledge Transfer: Oversee pilot launches, provide user training, and develop thorough documentation to support smooth adoption and transition of AI solutions to business stakeholders.
  
  
2. Agentic System Architecture & Engineering (25% of time)
  
Design and build multi-agent AI systems that automate complex business processes, emphasizing agent orchestration and human in the loop concepts.
  
Transform human workflows into agent-first processes, ensuring effective automation while identifying necessary human oversight points.
  
Develop evaluation tools and optimize solutions for performance and cost, maintaining high quality throughout deployment and operation.
  
  
3. Platform Contributions & Standardization (15% of time)
  
Create Reusable Assets: Extract successful patterns from fieldwork to create libraries, templates, and reference implementations for other teams to use.
  
Set Enterprise Standards: Define production-ready reference architectures and official checklists for security, reliability, and operability.
  
Enable Governance & Safety: Partner with Security and Governance teams to embed safety guardrails, audit logging, and compliance checks into core agent architectures.
  
Mentorship and Enablement: Author best practices, lead technical reviews, and mentor other engineers to help them ship agentic solutions independently.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Over 10 years of experience in software engineering. More than 5 years building AI and machine learning systems. 3+ years delivering AI solutions that create real business results in production.
  
Leadership experience guiding technical direction and aligning teams.
  
Skilled with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and agent frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
  
Hands-on with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and using tools or functions within AI agents.
  
Proficient in Python, with strong knowledge of frontend development for agent UIs-React, TypeScript, APIs, authentication, and building reliable production systems.
  
Experience integrating with business systems (CRMs, ERPs, HR platforms).
  
Strong understanding of enterprise security, compliance, and data governance.
  
Deep understanding of OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI, and agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and Semantic Kernel.
  
Knowledge of vector databases like MongoDB, Pinecone, Weaviate, and Qdrant, Graph databased for knowledge representation.
  
Experienced with cloud services (Azure, GCP), container tools (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  
Skilled with logging, tracing, and monitoring tools for AI applications.
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Technology or Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).  
  
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate Profile: Who Thrives in This Role
  
  
Builders Over Theorists: You love shipping working software more than debating architecture. You have debugged authentication issues at 2am and resolved production incidents.
  
  
Field-Focused Problem Solvers: You get energized by sitting with users, understanding their pain, and building something that makes their day better. You are comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete requirements.
  
  
Pragmatic Technologists: You choose boring, reliable solutions over shiny new frameworks. You know when to use an agent and when a simple script is better. You balance innovation with delivery.
  
  
Translators: You can explain technical tradeoffs to executives and business requirements to engineers. You bridge worlds.
  
  
Standard Setters: You turn one-off successes into repeatable systems—templates, guardrails, evaluation suites, and reference architectures that scale across teams.
  
  
Entrepreneurial Mindset: You treat each business unit like a customer. You understand ROI, adoption, and change management matter as much as code quality.
  
  
Comfortable with Constraints: You know how to work within enterprise reality—security reviews, compliance requirements, budget constraints—without letting them kill momentum.
  
  
Generous Collaborators: You mentor others, share your learnings, and make the team better. You default to clear documentation and proactive communication.

Company Overview:

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.

UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.

description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Data Science Innovation team is the R&D engine of the Data Science organisation — a team dedicated to exploring, prototyping, and engineering the next generation of AI-powered intelligent systems. We are a team that invents, experiments, and builds things that do not yet exist within the organisation. Our work spans a wide spectrum of problem domains — from intelligent search and autonomous planning systems to knowledge engineering, decision support, and agentic automation — reflecting the deliberate breadth of challenges we take on.
  
The team operates at the intersection of classical AI research, applied engineering, machine learning, and enterprise platform delivery.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

* **Design and build AI-powered intelligent systems:** applying classical AI concepts — search, planning, ranking, retrieval, reasoning, constraint satisfaction, and knowledge representation — to solve real enterprise business problems.

* **Develop scalable backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and orchestration layers:** for AI-driven applications that are production-ready from day one.

* **Build and maintain search, ranking, recommendation, and knowledge management systems:** that support intelligent automation and enterprise knowledge use cases.

* **Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications:** including APIs, databases, document repositories, and workflow platforms, ensuring reliability, security, and observability.

* **Apply understanding of context management, memory systems, and human-in-the-loop patterns:** to design AI systems that behave correctly and safely in production environments.

* **Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders:** to understand ambiguous problem areas and translate them into well-scoped, measurable technical solutions.

* **Evaluate AI techniques, architectures, and tools:** based on practical value, reliability, scalability, and business impact — reasoning from first principles rather than relying solely on frameworks or pre-built tools.

* **Participate in design reviews and code reviews:** and contribute to the team's engineering standards and technical culture.

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* **Classical AI and Intelligent Systems:** Solid understanding of core classical AI concepts: state-space search, heuristic search (A\*, beam search), forward and backward planning, partial-order planning, constraint satisfaction, and optimization. Hands-on experience in one or more applied AI domains — search and ranking, planning and scheduling, recommendation engines, rule engines, expert systems, or knowledge-based systems. Understanding of knowledge representation, context management, memory systems, and intelligent automation patterns.

* **AI Application Development:** Experience building AI applications in areas such as semantic search, document intelligence, information extraction, recommendation systems, conversational AI, or enterprise decision support. Ability to evaluate AI techniques based on reliability, scalability, and business impact.

* **Software Engineering:** Strong programming skills in Python; working knowledge of Java or a similar language. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, object-oriented design, and design patterns. Experience building production-grade APIs, microservices, data pipelines, or event-driven systems. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, logging, and monitoring.

* **Systems and Platform:** Good understanding of distributed systems, databases, concurrency, and scalable backend architecture. Awareness of security, reliability, observability, and maintainability requirements for enterprise-scale systems.

**Required Technical Skills**

* **Programming:** Python (strong); Java or equivalent general-purpose language (working knowledge).

* **Classical AI and Search:** Search algorithms (A\*, BFS, beam search), heuristic planning, constraint satisfaction, ranking and optimization systems.

* **AI Systems:** Knowledge representation, rule-based systems, semantic systems, planning and scheduling frameworks, recommendation and retrieval systems.

* **Data Engineering and Storage:** SQL and relational databases; NoSQL databases; Vector databases, Graph databases (e.g. Neo4j, Ontop); data pipeline design and ETL/ELT patterns.

* **Cloud and Infrastructure:** Azure, AWS, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; Kafka, message queues; cloud-native application design.

* **Engineering Practices:** REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, logging, monitoring, and observability tooling.

**Preferred Skills (Good to Have)**

* Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embedding-based retrieval,

* Familiarity on Ontology & Knowledge graph integration.

* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen.

* Exposure to agentic workflows, tool calling, multi-agent system patterns, or AI evaluation and monitoring.

* Understanding of LLM-based agent architectures as a complement to classical AI planning approaches.

* Experience with NLP (Natural Language Processing), document intelligence, or conversational AI platforms.

title: Design Verification Engineer, Silicon Engineering
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience verifying digital logic at RTL using System Verilog for FPGAs and ASICs.
* Experience with UVM Testbenches/environments.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
* Expertise in creating/using verification components and environments in UVM methodology at IP or Subsystem level.
* Experience with image processing, computer vision or machine learning IPs.
* Experience with AMBA(APB/AXI/ACE) or other standard protocols.
* Familiarity with CPU, GPU or other compute/ML architectures.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As an ASIC Design Verification Engineer on the Silicon team, you will verify next-generation custom silicon accelerators and SoCs, build advanced Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) test environments, and collaborate across design, architecture, and emulation teams to deliver production-quality silicon.

  
The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create and improve constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM. Use SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and formal tools for formal verification.
* Perform power-aware simulations and formal verification to validate power management features like clock gating, power gating, and Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS). Develop and implement power-aware test cases, including stress and corner-case scenarios, for robust power integrity.
* Develop and execute coverage-driven verification plans to ensure comprehensive coverage of ASIC designs. Collaborate with design engineers to resolve coverage issues and improve design quality.
* Plan the verification of complex digital design blocks by understanding design specifications and collaborating with design engineers to identify key verification scenarios.

description:

-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products, you'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a physical design engineer in the CPU implementation team, you will own block or subsystem implementation of complex logic blocks with special focus on optimizing power, performance and area. The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

--------------------

* Develop all aspects of ASIC RTL2GDS implementation for the central processing unit (CPU) for the Tensor SOC.
* Signoff convergence including static timing analysis (STA), physical design verification (PDV), IR and Electo-Migration (EM).
* Manage block and subsystem level physical implementation and QoR (power, timing, area).
* Optimize power, performance and area (PPA) to achieve exceptional performance and cost.
* Reduce time to market and improve PPA through deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) physical design tools and workflows.

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of physical design, where a misplaced power ring or a routing bottleneck can turn a promising memory macro into a timing nightmare. Layout is not just drawing rectangles to you, it is solving a puzzle where every micron counts and every decision ripples through verification, performance, and yield. You know that the difference between a memory compiler that ships and one that gets stuck in debug is usually a floor plan decision made two weeks earlier, and you are the kind of engineer who sees that coming.

You are comfortable moving between Calibre or ICV verification runs, XARA power analysis, and sitting with circuit designers to understand why a bitcell is behaving the way it is. When a DRC violation shows up at tape-out minus two days, you do not panic, you methodically trace it back, fix it, and document it so it does not happen again. You have strong opinions about power grid design and you can back them up with IR drop numbers.

At Synopsys, you will work on memory IP that goes into chips powering everything from AI accelerators to automotive systems. The layouts you own will be used by customers worldwide, and the quality bar is exactly as high as you would expect.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and own full custom layouts for embedded memory blocks, including SRAM, register files, and ROM compilers across advanced process nodes
* Develop floor plans, place memory cells and periphery blocks, route power grids and signal interconnects to meet area, performance, and power targets
* Run IR drop and electromigration analysis using tools like XARA, back-annotate layout parasitics, and iterate with circuit teams to close timing and power
* Execute physical verification using DRC and LVS tools such as ICV or Calibre, debug violations, and drive layouts to clean signoff
* Collaborate with memory compiler architects and circuit designers to translate specifications into manufacturable, verified layout deliverables
* Script layout automation flows using TCL, Perl, or C-shell to improve productivity and ensure consistency across memory variants
* Support formal release cycles, including documentation, design rule checks, and handoff to product engineering and customers

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable Synopsys memory IP to meet aggressive PPA targets that directly affect customer chip performance and power efficiency
* Reduce layout development cycle time through automation and reusable design practices, accelerating time to market for new memory products
* Ensure memory macros pass physical verification and reliability checks on the first pass, minimizing costly respins and customer escalations
* Contribute to the quality and competitiveness of Synopsys memory compiler offerings used in high-volume production across automotive, mobile, and AI markets
* Influence layout methodology and best practices that shape how the team approaches next-generation process nodes

We're one of the world's largest food and beverage companies and a trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods, earning us a spot on 97% of American household tables. You can look forward to high-impact, no bureaucracy, entrepreneurial work – done in small teams – and a unique opportunity to create something bold, something awesome, something inventive - and something globally impactful.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As a Data Scientist you will be a core member of one of our nimble, cross-functional teams – disrupting from inside of a global powerhouse. You will help build our next generation of advanced analytics products using AI, Data Science, and Machine Learning. Examples of problems you will solve include helping R&D determine the next generation of household products, revolutionizing consumer engagement with personally relevant content, and reinventing our supply chain to eliminate food waste. Furthermore, you will:

* Deliver systematic approaches and integrating work into products and tools with a trailblazing team of data engineers, analysts, developers, and sometimes chefs.
* Create repeatable, interpretable, dynamic, scalable models as the heart of new statistical products.
* Engineer new features by using your business acumen to improve analytical models.
* Collaborate to refine best practices and deploy best-in-class solutions.
* Evangelize the value of data-driven decision-making

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You have a Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or Statistics with 2-5 years of experience.
* You have expertise in Python and/or R as well as SQL and are eager to learn other languages.
* You are proficient in machine learning to deliver clustering, time series, classification, regression, anomaly detection, simulation, and optimization queries.
* You have experience in marketing analytics or root cause analysis
* You have worked in retail or CPG analytics teams
* You have an aptitude in Big Data technologies like Hadoop, Spark, or distributed databases like Redshift and Snowflake.

**WHY US?**

  

**We're accelerating our ambition to become a best-in-class Digital leader by making data-driven investments that drive smarter business decisions. As the guardians of 200 beloved brands and the creators of innovative products, we're dedicated To Sustainably Grow by Delighting More Consumers Globally. What we build today helps bring joy to customers, consumers, and communities around the world tomorrow. Here at Kraft Heinz, we're not afraid to challenge the status quo. We are bold. We embrace new ideas. We value diverse perspectives. And we dare to do better every single day. We reward courage in the face of uncertainty. And every day, we are transforming our industry. We are creating the future of food, and we invite you to join us.**

title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova’s Power Conversion & Storage business is at the forefront of the energy transition. We are seeking several highly skilled Senior AI Engineers to join our teams to design, develop, and deliver AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making across our business.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams to apply artificial intelligence, generative AI, and machine learning to real-world industrial challenges, helping accelerate innovation, productivity, and operational excellence.
  
  
A defining part of the role is technical judgment; choosing the right tool for each problem: classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, or pure software development when needed.
  
  
**Job Description**
**AI & ML Solution Development & Integration**

* Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning models, neural networks, and optimization algorithms, to improve business process efficiency and effectiveness.
* Select the appropriate modelling approach for each problem and articulate the trade-offs behind that choice.
* Own the machine learning lifecycle: dataset construction, metrics definition, acceptance criteria in accordance with the stakeholders needs, evaluation strategies.
* Translate business and operational needs into scalable AI-enabled tools, applications, and workflows.
* Support the deployment and integration of AI/ML models into existing business and technical systems, software environments, and products where applicable, including monitoring for drift, performance degradation, and running cost.

**Technical Implementation & Architecture**

* Collaborate with domain experts to identify high-value use cases and define technical requirements for AI solutions.
* Define and document the solution architecture end to end: from data sources to the integration with the existing enterprise and technical IT landscape.
* Design cloud-ready and on-premises solutions aligned with company IT, cybersecurity and data-governance standards.
* Integrate AI/ML capabilities into hardware, software, and business process ecosystems in a way that supports reliability, usability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the development of robust, production-ready AI solutions suitable for industrial environments.

**Solution Delivery, Partner & Contractor Management**

* Write clear technical specifications, statements of work, and acceptance criteria for work delivered by external contractors, software vendors, or internal digital teams.
* Contribute to supplier, platform, and tool selection through structured technical evaluation, benchmarking, and proof-of-concept comparison.
* Steer and review the work of internal & external partners: technical follow-up, design reviews, code and model reviews, quality gates, and acceptance testing; remaining the technical owner and guardian of the delivered solution.
* Ensure solutions remain maintainable after handover through documentation, knowledge transfer, and clearly assigned ownership, so that delivered tools do not become orphaned.

**Data Strategy & Analytics**

* Lead or support the collection, processing, structuring, and analysis of large-scale operational and business data.
* Assess data readiness ahead of any development (availability, quality, labelling needs, access rights, confidentiality) and define strategies to close the gaps.
* Identify patterns, trends, and performance improvement opportunities using advanced analytics and AI methods.
* Develop data-driven solutions such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality and performance prediction, forecasting, cost analysis, document and requirement analysis, and knowledge support tools.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with technical, operational, business and IT teams to ensure AI solutions meet business and industry requirements for safety, reliability, performance, and scalability.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Help align AI initiatives with business priorities, operational goals, and constraints.
* Support end-user adoption: training, onboarding, feedback loops and measurement of the benefits realized once the solution is live.

**Continuous Innovation**

* Evaluate emerging technologies such as edge AI, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and large language models for industrial and business applicability.
* Stay current with developments in AI, machine learning, and digital tools, and recommend practical adoption opportunities.
* Maintain an active technology watch on the AI tooling landscape and filter it, distinguishing capability gains from hype before proposing adoption.
* Contribute to building an innovation-oriented culture through knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

**Your Profile**
**Education**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Overall 8+ Years Experience.
* Several years (2 to 4) of professional experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or a comparable technical role.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or similar languages, and proficiency with modern development environments such as VS Code.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**

You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. **Responsibilities:**

title: Senior NPU Compiler Engineer
description:
Role:
**Senior NPU Compiler Engineer**

Years:
**7-10 years | Chennai**

**Build the compiler that brings Processing-in-Memory AI to life.**

InCommon is hiring on behalf of a California based company that is building ultra-low-power neural processing technology for edge AI — chips that run advanced AI workloads within tight power and memory budgets. The Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architecture computes directly inside memory, breaking the traditional bottleneck of shuttling data back and forth.

We're looking for a
**Senior NPU Compiler Engineer**
to build the compiler stack — largely from the ground up — that takes models from TFLite, ONNX, and PyTorch and turns them into instructions our NPU can execute.

**What you'll do:**

🔹 Design and build the full compilation pipeline — graph import, operator lowering, scheduling, memory planning, and instruction generation

🔹 Map neural network graphs onto a novel dataflow / Processing-in-Memory architecture

🔹 Optimize for execution efficiency, memory bandwidth, and power

🔹 Build validation tools to compare compiler output against simulator and RTL results

🔹 Work directly with architecture, RTL, firmware, and ML teams to shape the hardware/software interface

**What you bring:**

✅ Strong experience building compilers, graph compilers, or backend toolchains

✅ Solid C++ and Python

✅ Deep understanding of compiler fundamentals — IRs, graph transforms, lowering, scheduling, codegen

✅ Experience with ML model formats (ONNX, TFLite, PyTorch) and neural network operators/tensors

✅ Background building software for NPUs, DSPs, GPUs, or other specialized accelerators

**Nice to have:**

⭐ Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TVM, XLA, Glow, or IREE

⭐ Familiarity with dataflow or Processing-in-Memory architectures

⭐ Experience with binary instruction streams, DMA engines, or on-chip SRAM

**Why join us:**

This is a rare chance to build a compiler stack from scratch for genuinely novel silicon — with real architectural influence, not just downstream implementation work. You'll shape decisions that affect the hardware itself, not just work around it.

Caterpillar’s Autonomy and Automation Group is building the autonomous planning platform that moves machines and manipulates terrain across construction sites.
  
  
As a Path Planning Engineer, you will design the navigation and terrain planning that lets autonomous machines drive, dig, and dump safely and efficiently — from stationary digging to high-speed machine navigation. * Create reusable planning libraries and common data objects such as path geometry and zones

* Develop production quality code and own your algorithms from design to production

title: Senior Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert II
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert II**
**Do you enjoy being part of a global team that works with a diverse range of products and technology?**
**Do you enjoy mentoring other engineers, and helping them grow their careers?**
**About Our Team**
Knowledge Innovation & Taxonomy Engineering (KITE) is the team within Elsevier Operations responsible for the taxonomies, vocabularies and knowledge graphs that sit beneath many of Elsevier’s products. In plain terms, a taxonomy is a structured, standardized, vocabulary of concepts, - such as diseases, drugs, materials or research topics — and the relationships between them. This shared structure is what lets our products tag content consistently, return relevant search results, connect related information, and feed reliable, well-grounded answers to AI features.
  
  
Main areas of work
  
  

* Taxonomy automation development — pipelines, scripts and tools that speed up taxonomy creation and editorial work.
* Platform development and support for CENtree, the shared taxonomy-management system used across all teams.
* Automated Curation and enrichment of taxonomies with semantic structure and relationships and their operationalization as reusable services.

**About The Role**
We are looking for an individual to support our team in linking our existing taxonomies and ontologies in a meaningful way, applying linked data standards and best practices. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills in semantic web technologies with a solid understanding of data modelling for knowledge organization systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement methods for linking and aligning existing taxonomies and ontologies
* Model and maintain controlled vocabularies, taxonomies and ontologies using SKOS, SKOS-XL, and OWL
* Query and manipulate semantic data using SPARQL
* Integrate taxonomy/ontology data with other systems via REST APIs
* Write and maintain Python scripts/tools to support data modeling and integration workflows
* Collaborate with the team to understand data needs and translate them into semantic data models

**Requirements**

* Extensive hands-on experience with SPARQL
* Advanced Python programming skills
* Experience working with REST APIs
* Good data modelling experience
* Experience with at least one taxonomy/ontology management tool (e.g., Centre, Synaptica, Top Braid, Protégé, or equivalent)
* Understanding of linked data standards and principles
* Familiarity with semantic web standards (RDF, RDFS, JSON-LD)
* Ability to understand and translate business/data needs into semantic modeling solutions

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience linking or aligning multiple taxonomies/ontologies at scale
* Experience using Git/GitHub
* Understanding of AWS (specifically Batch, Lambda, Athena, S3, ECR, RDS, SNS/SQS)
* Hands-on knowledge of automation, CI/CD a plus
* Background in Life Sciences or similar
* Experience with SHACL

**Work in a way that works for you: -**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
  
  
**Working for you: -**
**Benefits**
At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India-Chennai)

**About Us:**

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. We are looking for an
**AI/ML Engineer – Agentic AI**
with strong experience in
**Python, LLMs, LangGraph/LangChain, RAG, multi-agent systems, and prompt engineering**
.

The role focuses on building and deploying
**autonomous AI agents, enterprise copilots, and intelligent workflows**
using Azure/AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps/AgentOps, with an emphasis on scalability, security, observability, and responsible AI.

**Key Technical Skills**

**1. Core Programming & Systems**

* Expert-level Python for ML, orchestration, and agent logic
* Strong understanding of async programming, concurrency, and task scheduling

**2. Agentic AI**

* Autonomous AI agents for multi-step reasoning, planning, task orchestration, and decision-making
* ReAct, Plan & Execute, Reflexive agents
* Hierarchical and multi-agent systems
* Tool-augmented and function-calling agents
* Stateful/stateless agents and memory management

* Hands-on experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source LLMs
* Prompt engineering, reasoning, planning, critique, and tool-use techniques

* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar frameworks
* Custom agent orchestration

* RAG implementation
* Vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search, etc.
* Embeddings, chunking, and context management
* Knowledge graph/hybrid memory is a plus

**6. Planning, Reasoning & Control**

* Task planning and re-planning
* Constraint-based execution
* Feedback and self-correction loops
* Guardrails, action validation, failure detection, and recovery

* Production deployment of AI agents
* Agent observability, tracing, logging, and monitoring
* Model and prompt versioning
* CI/CD for AI/agent systems
* Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure/AWS deployments

**8. Evaluation & Testing**

* Agent evaluation frameworks
* Task success, cost, latency, reliability, and safety evaluation
* Hallucination detection
* A/B testing of prompts, tools, and agent strategies

**9. Security & Responsible AI**

* Secure tool execution and privilege control
* Prompt injection and jailbreak mitigation
* Data privacy and memory isolation
* Human-in-the-loop escalation
* Explainability and responsible AI practices

**10. Data & Integration**

* Enterprise system, API, CRM, ERP, database, and SaaS integrations
* SQL / NoSQL
* Event-driven systems and message queues are a plus

**11. Cloud & Platform**

* Strong experience in at least one cloud platform:
  **Azure, AWS, or GCP**
* Managed AI services
* IAM, secrets management, and security
* LLM cost optimization

**12. Nice to Have**

* Multi-agent collaboration
* Enterprise copilots and autonomous workflows
* Human-AI collaboration patterns
* Reinforcement learning for agent optimization

title: Senior Project Associate
description: Job title: Senior Project AssociateProject and job description:Applications are invited for the position of Senior Project Associate under ISRO RESPOND project titled “Large and small-scale ionospheric plasma irregularities using airglow imaging and GNSS TEC measurements“.This is a two-year project involving collaboration between Krea University and Physical Research Laboratory (PRL).The primary work location would be Krea University campus in Sri City.The aim of the project is to develop low-cost imagers to capable of observing ionospheric irregularity structures in the faint oxygen airglow lines emanating from the thermosphere-ionosphere region. In addition, machine learning based automatic sequestration and data analysis algorithms should be developed to process the images. These datasets will be invaluable to study the large-scale ionospheric plasma irregularities and they will be co-studied using existing GNSS TEC measurements from Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) and Krea University.The candidate should possess knowledge of machine learning and deep learning methods, fundamental physics, be passionate about research, assist in gathering and analyzing datasets, and support overall administrative and research activities of the project whereverrequired.Essential Qualifications:M.Sc./BS-MS/Four-year B.Sc. (Honours)/B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, DataScience, Physics, Atmospheric Science, Meteorology, Space Physics, Geophysics, or arelated discipline and four years of research and development experience in industrial oracademic institutions or science and technology organizations.(OR)M.E./ MTech./Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science,Data Science, Space Science and Technology, Instrumentation and two years ofexperience in industrial or academic institutions or science and technology organizations.(OR)Ph.D. in Computer Science, Space Physics, Atmospheric Sciences, Geosciences, or arelated discipline.Desirable Skills: Knowledge on Machine learning methods, Space Plasma Physics,Atmospheric Science, Proficiency in Python and MATLAB programming.Job Location: Sri CitySalary: Rs. 42000/- per month + 10% HRA.Duration: The initial offer will be for six months and renewable subject to satisfactory performance. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project with a maximum duration of 2 years.Application Process:Interested candidates may apply by sending a single PDF file containing their cover letter, detailed curriculum vitae, and scanned copies of marksheets and certificates to research.hiring@krea.edu.in with the subject line ‘Application for Senior Project Associate in ISRO RESPOND project’.For any inquiries regarding the project and nature of research, please email lakshmi.narayanan@krea.edu.in (kindly do not send applications to this email id)Deadline: 20 October 2026Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding further examination and interview.
