title: Staff AI Engineer
description:
GE Vernova’s Power Conversion & Storage business is at the forefront of the energy transition. We are seeking several highly skilled Senior
  
AI Engineers to join our teams to design, develop, and deliver AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making across our
  
business.
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams to apply artificial intelligence, generative AI, and
  
machine learning to real-world industrial challenges, helping accelerate innovation, productivity, and operational excellence.
  
A defining part of the role is technical judgment; choosing the right tool for each problem: classical machine learning, deep learning, GenAI, or
  
pure software development when needed

**Job Description**
===================

**AI & ML Solution Development & Integration**

* Design, develop, and implement AI solutions, including generative AI, machine learning models, neural networks, and optimization algorithms, to improve business process efficiency and effectiveness.
* Select the appropriate modelling approach for each problem and articulate the trade-offs behind that choice.
* Own the machine learning lifecycle: dataset construction, metrics definition, acceptance criteria in accordance with the stakeholders needs, evaluation strategies.
* Translate business and operational needs into scalable AI-enabled tools, applications, and workflows.
* Support the deployment and integration of AI/ML models into existing business and technical systems, software environments, and products where applicable, including monitoring for drift, performance degradation, and running cost.

**Technical Implementation & Architecture**

* Collaborate with domain experts to identify high-value use cases and define technical requirements for AI solutions.
* Define and document the solution architecture end to end: from data sources to the integration with the existing enterprise and technical IT landscape.
* Design cloud-ready and on-premises solutions aligned with company IT, cybersecurity and data-governance standards.
* Integrate AI/ML capabilities into hardware, software, and business process ecosystems in a way that supports reliability, usability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the development of robust, production-ready AI solutions suitable for industrial environments.

**Solution Delivery, Partner & Contractor Management**

* Write clear technical specifications, statements of work, and acceptance criteria for work delivered by external contractors, software vendors, or internal digital teams.
* Contribute to supplier, platform, and tool selection through structured technical evaluation, benchmarking, and proof-of-concept comparison.
* Steer and review the work of internal & external partners: technical follow-up, design reviews, code and model reviews, quality gates, and acceptance testing; remaining the technical owner and guardian of the delivered solution.
* Ensure solutions remain maintainable after handover through documentation, knowledge transfer, and clearly assigned ownership, so that delivered tools do not become orphaned.

**Data Strategy & Analytics**

* Lead or support the collection, processing, structuring, and analysis of large-scale operational and business data.
* Assess data readiness ahead of any development (availability, quality, labelling needs, access rights, confidentiality) and define strategies to close the gaps.
* Identify patterns, trends, and performance improvement opportunities using advanced analytics and AI methods.
* Develop data-driven solutions such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, quality and performance prediction, forecasting, cost analysis, document and requirement analysis, and knowledge support tools.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with technical, operational, business and IT teams to ensure AI solutions meet business and industry requirements for safety, reliability, performance, and scalability.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Help align AI initiatives with business priorities, operational goals, and constraints.
* Support end-user adoption: training, onboarding, feedback loops and measurement of the benefits realized once the solution is live.

**Continuous Innovation**

* Evaluate emerging technologies such as edge AI, synthetic data, reinforcement learning, and large language models for industrial and business applicability.
* Stay current with developments in AI, machine learning, and digital tools, and recommend practical adoption opportunities.
* Maintain an active technology watch on the AI tooling landscape and filter it, distinguishing capability gains from hype before proposing adoption.
* Contribute to building an innovation-oriented culture through knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

**Your Profile**

**Education**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Overall 8+ Years of experience.
* Several years (2 to 4) of professional experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or a comparable technical role.
* Experience developing and deploying AI/ML solutions in industrial, technical, or other complex operational environments is preferred.

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or similar languages, and proficiency with modern development environments such as VS Code.
* Hands-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch, as well as classical ML tooling (e.g. scikit-learn, gradient boosting methods).
* Experience with time-series analysis, optimization methods, and data-driven model development.
* Practical experience with GenAI and their surrounding stacks (RAG, vector databases, A2A)
* Experience handling unstructured data; technical documents, specifications, reports; alongside structured and tabular data.
* Solid grounding in cloud services and architecture (Azure, AWS)
* Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals: SQL, data pipelines, and structured/unstructured data handling.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, model deployment, and integration into production environments is an advantage.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Sound knowledge of artificial intelligence, combined with a strong interest in emerging technologies and digital trends.
* Understanding of industrial processes, electrification, power systems, or related technical domains, or business processes, is an advantage.
* Awareness of the regulatory and governance context around AI (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) is a plus.
* Experience in innovation management and/or patent-related work is a plus.

**Personal Attributes**

* Proven ability to translate complex business and technical challenges into practical, scalable AI-driven solutions.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with a high degree of self-motivation and a structured, goal-oriented working style.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across functions and disciplines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

title: Senior Emulation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Axiado is building the future of AI powered digital infrastructure. We are a fast-growing, well funded silicon, systems, and solutions company pioneering a new category of semiconductor called the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU) that combines advanced hardware security, AI driven resilience and efficiency, and real-time platform management. Our technology protects the world’s most critical infrastructure—from data centers to next generation cloud and AI platforms—by securing systems at the foundation levels of hardware, independent of host CPUs and operating systems.

Founded in 2019 and now over 150 employees are strong, Axiado has evolved into a recognized leader in the convergence of AI, security, and silicon innovation. We partner with and are actively engaged in commercial programs with multiple Tier 1 industry leaders, validating both our technology and our long-term market trajectory. Axiado has also won numerous industry awards for our ground-breaking products and technological innovations, including being named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Security, winning the 2025 Global InfoSec Award for Outstanding AI Security Solution, and being named a finalist for the Global Semiconductor Alliance’s 2025 “Start-Up to Watch” award.

At Axiado, developing breakthrough technology takes more than great engineering—it takes a team of exceptional people who collaborate boldly, challenge assumptions, and take pride in building what comes next. We value curiosity, execution, respect, and a shared desire to make a meaningful impact on the security and reliability of the digital world.

If you’re driven to innovate, energized by hard problems, and excited to help define the future of secure AI infrastructure, we invite you to apply and join us on this journey.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Emulation Engineer position is your opportunity to join one of the industry’s leading companies in platform security management and ransomware detection for cloud datacenters, 5G infrastructure and disaggregated compute ecosystems. We are looking for an emulation engineer to run and debug system-level workloads on Synopsys ZeBu emulation platforms and to own the integration and bring-up of transactors (XTORs) that connect the emulated SoC to real and virtual interfaces. Your focus is what happens once the design is running: getting the interfaces alive, executing firmware, OS, and use-case validation, triaging failures, and finding issues before silicon. This role is critical for validating the interoperability of our design with commercial AI servers, and for bridging the gap between hardware and software, as well as supporting SW development.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Runtime validation**

* Execute and debug system-level tests, firmware, and software workloads on ZeBu emulation models
* Bring up and validate secure boot flows (ROM, bootloader, Linux/RTOS) and platform security features such as root of trust, attestation, and firmware update on the emulated SoC
* Develop and run use-case scenarios covering platform security management, ransomware detection workloads, and datacenter/5G traffic patterns
* Triage failures and isolate root cause across RTL, firmware, driver, testbench, XTOR, and emulation environment; produce clear, reproducible bug reports
* Use ZeBu runtime debug capabilities (waveform capture, triggers, memory/register access, checkpoint/restore, force/release) to debug efficiently at speed
* Run and manage long-running regressions and soak tests; track pass rates, failure trends, and run-to-run stability
* Perform power-aware and performance validation runs: activity capture, bandwidth/latency profiling, and use-case benchmarking

**XTOR integration and bring-up**

* Integrate and configure ZeBu transactors and speed adapters (PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, NVMe, DDR/LPDDR, I2C/I3C/SMBus, SPI, UART, JTAG, etc.) at the testbench and runtime level
* Bring up XTOR-to-DUT links from first connectivity through link training, enumeration, and stable data traffic; resolve protocol-level and configuration issues
* Develop host-side software and drivers that control XTORs (C/C++, Python, SystemVerilog DPI, ZeBu API), including connections to real devices, virtual peripherals, or hybrid platforms
* Debug XTOR-related failures using protocol analyzers, waveforms, and logs; determine whether the issue lies in the DUT, the XTOR, clocking/speed-adapter configuration, or the host
* Tune XTOR configuration for throughput, latency, and emulation-frequency compatibility
* Maintain XTOR configuration, version control, and documentation across model releases
* Configure host servers, boot environments to interact with the emulated design
* Integrate, develop and debug transactors, bridges and protocol adapters as needed
* Debug and root-cause embedded HW, SW and test failures in emulation
* Collaborate with RTL, DV and SW teams to resolve system level bugs

 **Qualifications**

* BS or MS degrees or higher in EE, CE or related fields
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in prototyping, emulation, SOC design and validation
* Self-driven, good problem solving and communication skills
* Hands-on experience running and debugging designs on Synopsys ZeBu (or comparable emulators such as Palladium or Veloce), including runtime control (NGTB or C based), waveform capture, and checkpoint/restore
* Experience integrating and debugging high-speed and low-speed interfaces
* Familiarity with embedded software bring-up and bootloader/kernel interactions
* Proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL) for automation
* Preferred qualifications include: experience in design verification, hardware/software co-simulation, Linux device drivers, bare-metal FW or boot loaders

 **Additional Information**

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Embedded Software Technical Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.
* Board and SoC bring-up using JTAG and other debug mechanisms; ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
* Experience interfacing with hardware and peripherals using SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C and JTAG, and implementing bootloaders, secure boot and firmware update flows.

title: Senior Payroll Specialist (APAC)
description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

### **The role**

The Senior Payroll Specialist-APAC owns end-to-end payroll for the company's APAC entities and plays a hands-on role in US payroll; both regions are core to the role. This role harmonizes, simplifies, and continuously improves payroll execution and payroll accounting across the region's countries, entities, pay groups, payroll providers, and systems. This is to make sure payroll remains accurate, compliant, trusted, and understandable as the company grows in APAC without a proportional increase in manual work or risk. The role works alongside the US payroll owner on pay cycles, employment tax compliance, year-end, and controls, and provides full continuity during peak periods and absences.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Own end-to-end payroll execution for the company's APAC entities across countries, pay groups, and payroll providers; define consistent execution standards that meet each jurisdiction's statutory and employment requirements.
* Ensure statutory compliance across APAC jurisdictions: income tax withholding, social security and provident fund contributions, employer levies, monthly and annual statutory filings and employee tax certificates, new-country and new-entity registrations, and timely resolution of authority notices.
* Administer regulated and complex pay items accurately: statutory bonuses and gratuity, leave encashment, full-and-final settlements, equity income (RSU/option) taxation, benefits deductions, taxable perquisites, and expatriate or cross-border arrangements.
* Support US payroll execution alongside the US payroll owner: process and review multistate pay cycles and off-cycle payments, own assigned workstreams in the US payroll calendar, share year-end delivery (W-2 season), and provide full continuity during peak periods and absences.
* Drive process harmonization and simplification across APAC countries to reduce manual steps, handoffs, rework, and off-cycle runs.
* Lead payroll execution during transitions (new country or entity launches, vendor changes, system changes, restructures/M&A), ensuring continuity and control.
* Ensure payroll accounting remains clean as scope changes: consistent journals, accruals, reversals, and reconciliation standards across entities and currencies.
* Monitor preventative controls by design, including SOX-aligned payroll controls; improve evidence pack quality and audit readiness.
* Govern payroll providers against agreed SLAs and KPIs; drive remediation where service quality falls short.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring payroll, accounting, or service failures; design and implement durable fixes.
* Act as escalation owner for complex or sensitive pay issues in the region; provide authoritative explanations to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Ops, Finance, Legal/Compliance, benefits providers, and payroll vendors to deliver scalable operating models and service quality.
* Provide training and guidance to new team joiners when needed.

**We expect you to have:**

* 7+ years of payroll experience spanning APAC and US payrolls, including multi-country scope with in-country providers in complex environments (growth, change, or hybrid in-house/outsourced models).
* Deep working knowledge of payroll and employment-tax compliance across APAC jurisdictions, including India: statutory withholding and social contributions, statutory bonuses and terminations, year-end reporting, and expatriate/cross-border considerations.
* Working knowledge of US payroll fundamentals (multi-state withholding, FICA/FUTA/SUI, W-2 year-end) and readiness to act as the designated US backup, including overlap with US working hours when covering.
* Strong payroll controllership skills: ability to design controls, enforce SoD/approvals, and ensure audit-ready evidence.
* Proven capability improving payroll processes (standardization, automation enablement, reducing manual effort and errors).
* Strong payroll accounting knowledge, including multi-currency environments, and experience working with Finance during close and audits.
* Demonstrated ability to lead transitions (vendor/system/new country or entity) with structured planning and issue resolution.
* Excellent stakeholder management across time zones and cultures; comfortable acting as an escalation owner and payroll authority.

**It will be an added bonus if you have:**

* Hands-on experience with multi-country payroll platforms or aggregators and their HRIS/GL integrations.
* Experience operating payroll controls in a SOX-compliant, US-listed company environment.
* Hands-on US payroll processing experience, ideally in a shared-services or follow-the-sun support model. Knowledge and experience with US statutory requirements at Federal, State and local levels
* Experience with payroll operating models and vendor governance (SLAs, KPIs, remediation).
* Experience turning statutory/operational requirements into system/workflow requirements.
* Project management certification or comparable experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

#### **Competencies & Behavioral Traits:**

* Systems thinking: redesigns the process so it scales, rather than adding checks and manual work.
* Bias for prevention: anticipates issues and builds guardrails.
* Influence without authority; can align multiple stakeholders and vendors around standards.
* Comfort with ambiguity and change; makes decisions with incomplete information.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Firmware Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Firmware Lead**, you will lead implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for Kandou's Randa 1.6T Active Electrical Cable platform. This is a coding-heavy technical leadership role: you will spend the majority of your time writing and reviewing C/C++, debugging firmware and hardware interactions, and supporting pre-silicon and post-silicon bring-up. You will turn the Firmware Architect's system design into production code, own implementation quality and delivery, and mentor engineers while remaining active in the codebase.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the implementation and delivery of real-time embedded firmware for AEC retimer silicon across 224G/lane, 448G/lane and forward-looking 896G/lane configurations; remain a hands-on C/C++ contributor.
* Implement and maintain boot, configuration, calibration, link-training, fault-recovery and run-time supervision state machines on resource-constrained RISC-V or ARM platforms.
* Translate approved firmware architecture into module designs, APIs, task and interrupt models, memory budgets and hardware/software contracts; surface implementation tradeoffs early.
* Code, debug and optimize firmware for SerDes equalization and adaptation, FEC-aware monitoring and re-adaptation, telemetry capture, thermal behavior and power management.
* Own low-level drivers and management interfaces including SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C, MCTP and JTAG, and integrate firmware services with the CMIS management layer.
* Drive pre-silicon development and first-silicon bring-up; isolate issues across firmware, RTL, boards and lab setups using JTAG, register traces and targeted instrumentation.
* Set coding and review standards; build unit, integration and hardware-in-loop tests; enforce CI, static analysis and release evidence; improve Python-based build, debug and test tools.
* Break the roadmap into deliverable work packages, estimate and track execution, mentor firmware engineers and coordinate with architecture, ASIC, DV, validation, SI and applications teams.

**Essential Experience**

* 8+ years developing and debugging production real-time firmware in C/C++, including 2+ years leading firmware modules, projects or a small team.
* Expert hands-on C/C++ in resource-constrained systems, with recent evidence of personal code delivery, code review and complex defect resolution.
* Firmware experience on a retimer, gearbox, PHY, AEC, AOC, optical module, networking ASIC or comparable high-speed mixed hardware/software product.
* RISC-V and/or ARM bare-metal or RTOS firmware, including interrupts, traps, CSR or register access, concurrency and tight RAM/flash budgets.
* RTOS development with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent; ownership of scheduling, synchronization, timing and failure recovery.
* At least one silicon or board bring-up cycle using JTAG and related debug mechanisms, with root-cause analysis across firmware, drivers, RTL and hardware.
* Python, Git/GitLab, Make/CMake, CI, unit and integration testing, and static analysis, with disciplined reproducible development workflows.

BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience; strong communication, planning, mentoring and cross-functional leadership.

**Useful experience**

* IEEE 802.3ck or 802.3dj link training and equalization, SerDes adaptation algorithms, channel-quality monitoring and register-level PHY tuning.
* FEC exposure including KP4 or RS-544, pre-FEC and post-FEC telemetry, symbol-error analysis and FEC-aware recovery behavior.
* CMIS 5.x firmware integration, module or datapath state machines, VDM telemetry, and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C and MCTP.
* Bootloaders, secure boot, root of trust, authenticated A/B firmware updates, rollback protection and field-recovery mechanisms.
* Pre-silicon firmware development using QEMU, SystemC, FPGA, simulation or emulation; heterogeneous multicore or vector-processing systems.

PCIe or CXL, hyperscaler qualification, interoperability debugging, and production support for field or manufacturing issues.

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

title: Platform Validation Lead / Manager
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

We are looking for a Platform Validation Lead/Manager

Location: Hyderabad, India

**Responsabilities**

* Own the Hyderabad platform-validation strategy for Ethernet Retimers, converting product, silicon, firmware and standards requirements into traceable test plans, entry and exit criteria, sample coverage and release decisions.
* Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon validation using simulation, FPGA or emulation and hardware-in-loop environments; drive first-silicon bring-up through power, clocks, boot, register access and module enumeration.
* Validate server and switch host integration, CMIS module-management state machines, I2C/SMBus and SPI mailbox flows, hot-plug, power sequencing, telemetry, diagnostics and fault recovery.
* Build automated regression, conformance and release-readiness workflows with requirements-to-test traceability, reproducible configurations, a known-failure catalog and evidence-based defect disposition.
* Lead and mentor the Hyderabad validation team; establish benches, equipment and lab processes, plan capacity, review results and remain hands-on in system-level debug and root-cause isolation.
* Partner across Hyderabad, Lausanne and Taiwan with SoC, DV, firmware, characterization, interoperability, product and field teams to correlate results and deliver qualified customer-ready releases.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of silicon, system or platform validation experience on shipping SoCs, networking silicon, SerDes, retimers, PHYs, AEC/AOC or optical-module products.
* Direct ownership of at least one pre-silicon-to-post-silicon validation cycle, including first-silicon or board bring-up, qualification and release-readiness decisions.
* Hands-on system debug across silicon, boards, firmware, drivers and host applications, using JTAG, register traces, oscilloscopes, BERTs and related lab tools.
* Strong validation automation skills in Python and working C and/or C++ knowledge; experience with hardware-in-loop frameworks, CI, version control and reproducible test environments.
* Experience validating management and sideband interfaces such as CMIS, I2C//I3CSMBus, SPI, MDIO or MCTP, including state transitions, error paths, hot-plug and recovery behavior.
* Demonstrated requirements-traceable validation discipline: verification methods, pass/fail criteria, sample plans, environmental conditions, guard bands and clear evidence packages.
* Proven technical and people leadership, including hiring or mentoring engineers, managing lab priorities and driving cross-functional defect closure under a fixed schedule.

Excellent written and verbal communication; BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience. Ability to travel for bring-up and partner qualification windows.

**Useful Experience**

* Validation of 100G/lane or 200G/lane Ethernet, PAM4 SerDes, retimers, PHYs, AEC/AOC or optical modules.
* IEEE 802.3, OIF-CEI, CMIS 5.x, OSFP MSA or related electrical and module-management conformance.
* BER and FEC validation, link training and equalization, loopback test, eye and margin analysis, and correlation with characterization data.
* Secure boot, authenticated firmware update, image signing, rollback and recovery-path validation.
* Hyperscaler or tier-one OEM qualification, NIC or switch-ASIC interoperability, plugfests and customer escalation support.
* ATE or manufacturing-test correlation, EIA-364 or JEDEC qualification exposure, thermal and power validation, and multi-site program leadership.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

* Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

title: Dir, Software Engrg Mgmt
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

This role is for a software engineering director who leads a high-performing team of software engineers building AI-native and cloud-native applications on the ServiceNow platform. The Director combines deep technical credibility with strong people management capabilities, fostering a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. They are responsible for team performance, career development, hiring, and execution of key business initiatives. This role requires the ability to balance people development with business results, think strategically about AI integration and platform architecture, and influence across the organization to enable team success. The ideal candidate brings experience scaling AI-native teams and a passion for building leaders.

**What we do** - Finance and Procurement teams are at the forefront of AI-native engineering at ServiceNow—building autonomous solutions for the world's largest enterprises that handle mission-critical financial and procurement operations at unprecedented scale. They continuously learn and integrate the latest AI and cloud-native technologies to deliver performant, resilient systems that transform how businesses manage supplier lifecycles, procurement workflows, payments, and receivables.

**Responsibility Area: People Leadership & Development**

* Build, grow, and maintain a high-performing, diverse team of IC2-IC5 engineers; hire and develop talent at all levels
* Set clear expectations for individual and team performance; establish metrics and goals aligned with business objectives
* Conduct regular 1:1s with direct reports; provide coaching, feedback, and career guidance tailored to each engineer's growth stage
* Create a culture of psychological safety, learning, and ownership; encourage experimentation and learning from failures
* Support engineers through career transitions—from IC2 to IC3, IC3 to IC4, and technical-to-management pathways
* Identify high-potential engineers and invest in their development; prepare emerging leaders for increased responsibility
* Address performance issues promptly and professionally; provide clear paths for improvement or transition
* Sponsor team members for growth opportunities, stretch assignments, and leadership development programs
* Celebrate wins and recognize contributions; foster a positive, collaborative team environment
* Model vulnerability, continuous learning, and AI-native thinking; lead by example in your own growth

**Responsibility Area: Hiring & Team Building**

* Define hiring strategy and conduct recruitment for open positions; build a pipeline of qualified candidates
* Lead technical interviews and assessments for engineering candidates at all IC levels; make hiring decisions
* Partner with HR and recruiting teams on job descriptions, sourcing strategies, and candidate pipeline management
* Evaluate cultural fit and potential; hire for values and growth potential, not just current skills
* Onboard new engineers effectively; assign mentors and ensure smooth integration into the team
* Build a team with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives; actively work to improve representation
* Identify gaps in team capabilities (technical depth, domain expertise, AI/ML fluency) and address through hiring or development
* Build relationships with external technical communities to attract and recruit top talent
* Participate in employer branding and represent the organization at recruiting events and universities

**Responsibility Area: Technical Strategy & Product Leadership**

* Work with product, design, and cross-functional partners to define product roadmap and technical strategy aligned with business goals
* Establish technical direction for the team; make architecture and technology decisions that balance innovation, quality, and delivery
* Ensure the team's technical approach stays current with AI/ML advancements and ServiceNow platform evolution
* Champion AI-native thinking across the team and organization; help teammates understand how to build with AI at the core
* Lead architectural reviews and technical decision-making; provide guidance on complex technical trade-offs
* Advocate for technical investments (refactoring, infrastructure, tooling) that improve team productivity and code quality
* Set quality standards for code, testing, and security; establish practices that enable sustainable delivery
* Partner with IC4/IC5 engineers to set multi-year technical roadmaps and long-term strategic initiatives
* Represent the engineering team in product and executive discussions; influence organizational priorities

**Responsibility Area: Team Execution & Accountability**

* Drive team delivery of committed business objectives and product initiatives; maintain accountability for results
* Establish clear sprint goals, work-item prioritization, and delivery timelines; remove blockers for team success
* Track team metrics: velocity, quality, customer satisfaction, incident response, deployment frequency
* Conduct regular retrospectives; identify process improvements and drive adoption of better practices
* Manage team capacity; balance new feature development, technical debt reduction, and customer support
* Ensure team participation in on-call rotation; monitor incident response and post-incident learning
* Report on team progress, risks, and performance to senior leadership; provide transparent communication
* Escalate critical issues or resource constraints; collaborate with peer managers to solve cross-team dependencies
* Foster a culture of ownership where engineers take responsibility for quality, testing, and production outcomes
* Lead team through organizational changes and initiatives; maintain morale and focus during transitions

**Responsibility Area: Customer & Cross-Functional Engagement**

* Build and maintain relationships with key customers and stakeholders; understand their needs and priorities
* Participate in customer meetings, technical escalations, and business reviews; represent engineering capabilities and constraints
* Work closely with product management, customer success, and other teams; ensure alignment on priorities and capabilities
* Lead customer-critical incident response; ensure timely and professional resolution of critical issues
* Gather customer feedback and translate into product improvements; communicate back to customers how feedback is addressed
* Advocate for customers' needs within the engineering organization; ensure customer voice is heard in decision-making
* Build trust and credibility with customers through transparency, responsiveness, and technical leadership
* Participate in strategic customer discussions and technology roadmap reviews

**Responsibility Area: Organizational Leadership & Culture**

* Model the organization's values and desired behaviors; set tone for engineering culture within your team and across teams
* Contribute to hiring and interview training of other managers; build bench strength in people leadership
* Mentor junior managers or peers; contribute to manager development and leadership pipeline
* Participate in engineering leadership meetings; contribute to organizational strategy and policy
* Promote psychological safety, inclusion, and belonging; actively work to reduce barriers for underrepresented groups
* Foster knowledge sharing across the organization; encourage your team to contribute to brown bags, documentation, and communities
* Lead by example in work-life balance, continuous learning, and sustainable pace; prevent burnout
* Encourage your team to engage with the broader tech community (conferences, open source, speaking, writing)

**Responsibility Area: AI-Native Thinking & Innovation Leadership**

* Develop deep understanding of AI/ML capabilities, limitations, and integration patterns; become a thought leader on AI-native development
* Coach your team on AI-native thinking—how to build systems with AI at the core, not as an afterthought
* Help engineers understand prompt engineering, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and responsible AI principles
* Establish practices for evaluation-driven development, hallucination detection, and model performance monitoring
* Lead discussions on AI safety, data privacy, and responsible AI; ensure team builds with appropriate guardrails
* Create learning opportunities for the team to stay current with AI/ML advancements and frameworks
* Identify opportunities to apply AI to improve internal processes and team efficiency
* Contribute to organizational conversations about AI strategy and responsible AI practices
* Stay informed about LLM advancements, new models, and emerging techniques; share insights with your team

  
**Qualifications**  

* 12+ years of professional software development experience, with 5+ years in AI-native systems, cloud-native architecture, or equivalent
* 5+ years of people management experience leading software engineers; track record of developing talent and building high-performing teams
* 3+ years managing application development on SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar); deep understanding of platform architecture and constraints
* 3+ years hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices
* Demonstrated expertise in hiring, team building, and organizational development; ability to attract and develop top talent
* Expert-level understanding of modern software engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, security, deployment
* Strong technical credibility; ability to engage in technical discussions with IC4/IC5 engineers; hands-on coding experience still valued
* Proficiency in Python, Java, and JavaScript; understanding of ServiceNow scripting and platform APIs
* Track record of delivering significant business results through engineering teams; ability to drive accountability and execution
* Experience scaling teams and organizations; demonstrated ability to work at multiple levels of complexity
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills; ability to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong coaching and mentoring skills; ability to develop engineers across all career stages
* Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies; ability to adapt to team and organizational needs
* Demonstrated understanding of data security, compliance, and responsible AI practices
* Strong emotional intelligence; ability to navigate difficult conversations and build trust
* Experience with performance management, feedback delivery, and difficult personnel decisions
* Passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams where all engineers can thrive
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, or related field
* Experience leading teams through organizational change, technical migrations, or strategic initiatives
* MBA or management certification is a plus; however, demonstrated people leadership capability is more important
* Track record of developing talent into senior engineering leadership roles or managers
* Active engagement with engineering and AI/ML communities; thought leadership through speaking, writing, or open source is a plus
* Experience working with diverse teams and commitment to building inclusive organizations

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience managing managers or leading multiple teams
* Background in both individual contributor and manager roles (not just promoted from individual contribution)
* Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments
* Familiarity with data-driven decision making and analytics
* Experience with customer-facing or go-to-market organizations
* Understanding of product management and business metrics
* Track record of improving team efficiency, reducing cycle time, or improving quality metrics
* Experience mentoring individuals into management roles

  
**Additional Information**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

title: Customer Technical Support Specialist - French speaker
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI

**What We Do**

The Teradata Global Support Organization-Base (GSO BASE) Support team is a 24x7, high volume global support centre. Along with incident management, we provide technical/functional knowledge necessary to resolve customer’s problems, both internal and external. The support is provided in multiple languages across the globe.

**What You’ll Do**

The **Customer** **Technical Support Specialist** works in a fast-paced, demanding technical customer support center environment that requires timely solutions to complex technical problems, often of a critical nature to the customer. As a technical support specialist for Teradata’s Base Support team, you will perform troubleshooting activities, escalate problems to the appropriate party(s), and assist in communicating the solution to the customer. You will develop and maintain a working knowledge of current hardware, software, firmware, processes, and tools. You are required to have both strong technical and interpersonal skills. The work environment requires 24x7 coverage which is achieved via follow the sub-Model, on-call rotations, and extended hours, as needed, to accommodate customer needs. This position will also be supporting international customers in Japan for after hours and the ability to be proficient in English is a plus.

  

**Who You’ll Work With**

As the Technical Support Specialist French for GSO BASE typically works in a collaborative environment and interacts with various teams and individuals within Teradata. Some of the key stakeholders and colleagues that a Technical Support Specialist may work with Customers, Product Support Engineers, Platform support engineers, Service Experience Managers, Critical Support Managers, Infrastructure and Operations Teams, Training and Onboarding Teams, Third-party Vendors and other Engineering teams.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Effective oral and written communications skills in English & French language.

* 3-5 years of Technical Support related experience.
* Good Database and Operating System knowledge
* Experience in Help Desk/Customer service position is a plus
* Knowledge of Support Center procedures and troubleshooting protocols.
* Knowledge of UNIX, Linux, Windows and other current operating systems.
* Knowledge of Teradata support tools including the installation of remote tools is a plus.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow & Power BI reporting.

**What You’ll Bring**

As a Technical Support Specialist for GSO BASE, you will need to bring a combination of technical expertise, customer service skills, and problem-solving abilities to effectively assist customers with their cloud-related issues. You will serve as a bridge between customers and the technical aspects of Teradata services. Your ability to solve problems, provide excellent customer service, and stay current with cloud & Onprem technologies will be essential in ensuring customer satisfaction and success in this role. . Here's what you should bring to excel in this role:

* You should accept and respond to incoming calls and emails from English & French Speaking customers.
* You should be able to collaborate effectively with other support analysts, developers, engineers, and various teams to resolve complex issues.
* Provide Initial problem triage and clarify problem definition.
* Search knowledge bases for known solutions to known problems.
* Identification and management of duplicate incidents
* Extract logs, dumps, error files from customer systems and analyze.
* Prepare and transmit source upgrade files.
* Provide remote support to on-site resources.
* Log problem resolution and support knowledge creation
* Coordinates activities associated with product/service resolution issues.
* Apply search tools to identify previously developed solutions and recognize patterns and symptoms.
* Create monthly weekly reports and trend analysis.
* Attend Alert governance calls and isolate noise and redundant issues.
* Coordinate with customers and end-users to implement solutions.
* Track, monitor and maintain incident progress.
* Work set schedules including weekends and holidays in support of 24X7 coverage.

**Job Description**

Job Purpose :

Data Platform Services is building a governed, metadata-driven data integration and staging platform centered on SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and enterprise databases/data lakes — spanning source ingestion (SAP ERP/S/4HANA, non-SAP systems), a source-faithful central staging repository, long-term archival, and controlled distribution to multiple downstream systems.

We're looking for a DataOps Engineer who treats ETL pipeline design, data flows, and access-control logic as configuration, not one-off code — someone who builds and maintains systems where metadata tables and control frameworks drive what gets executed (jobs, interfaces, delta loads, transformations, and security masking), rather than hand-crafting individual one-off BODS jobs for every new dataset or consumer.

You'll work across ingestion (landing central staging archive), retention/partitioning strategy, and the routing/distribution rules engine that determines how data is extracted, transformed, filtered, or masked across multiple major downstream systems.

What You'll Do

* Build and operate robust batch and incremental change data capture (CDC) ingestion pipelines using SAP Data Services (BODS) from SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, SLT, ODP/Extractors) and non-SAP sources into central staging repositories/databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA, or Cloud Storage).
* Design and maintain metadata-driven ETL generation & execution frameworks — where dataset onboarding (new source table, delta logic, schema mapping, validation rules) is driven by configuration tables and reusable BODS templates/scripts rather than creating bespoke data flows from scratch.
* Implement and maintain partition-based retention, database archiving, and extraction routines for historical data and rolling window retention policies (e.g., current + N prior years).
* Build and maintain a dataset routing-rules engine: a governed metadata table (splittable, target\_systems[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) that programmatically directs and transforms BODS distribution jobs and target views per downstream system.
* Own BODS repository architecture & governance: manage local/central repositories, Data Services Management Console (DSMC), user access security, environment promotion (Dev/Test/Prod), and execution auditing/lineage.
* Drive DataOps & CI/CD automation: streamline BODS export/import/transport automation, repository synchronization, and job scheduling via Enterprise Scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys, Control-M, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory).
* Monitor pipeline health, job execution logs, CDC checkpoint integrity, schema drift, and data SLAs; establish automated alerting and self-healing for job failures and data-freshness breaches.
* Collaborate with upstream SAP functional/basis teams to define data contracts (e.g., Delta queue/ODP parameters, timestamps, extraction load impact) and downstream teams to translate their access/filter requirements into routing rules.
* Document pipeline architecture, data dictionaries, retention policies, and routing logic for auditability and seamless developer onboarding.

**️** Required Skills & Experience

Core Platform & SAP BODS

* Hands-on experience with SAP Data Services (BODS 4.x) designing complex Batch Jobs, Real-time Services, Workflows, Data Flows, and custom Scripts/Functions.
* Strong expertise in extracting data from SAP environments (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, ODP extractors, SLT, IDocs, RFC/BAPIs) as well as non-SAP flat files, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and relational database internals (e.g., SAP HANA, SQL Server, Oracle): query optimization, indexing, table partitioning, push-down SQL execution, and incremental CDC logic.
* Solid experience with BODS Central Repository management, object check-in/out workflows, version control, and multi-user development standards.

Metadata-Driven Engineering (Critical)

* Demonstrable background designing or maintaining metadata/config-driven ETL frameworks — e.g., control/registry tables driving dynamic SQL generation, parameterized BODS global variables, or generic reusable data flow templates.
* Strong understanding of keeping generated ETL processes and target tables in sync with a source-of-truth ruleset, including schema versioning and change auditability.
* Experience implementing automated audit logging, error handling, row-count reconciliations, and execution metrics captured directly via BODS scripts and database tables.

Platform Engineering / DataOps

* ETL Orchestration & Scheduling: Experience managing automated job schedules and dependency management via BODS Management Console, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, Airflow, or Autosys.
* CI/CD & Version Control: Experience applying software engineering discipline to BODS (e.g., Git integration/documentation, automated repository migrations, deployment scripts).
* Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to automate file transfers, API interactions, and operational tasks around the BODS platform.
* Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience setting up alerting, performance bottleneck troubleshooting (memory/buffer tuning in BODS), and data validation frameworks.

Governance & Collaboration

* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance: access control models, data lineage, retention/compliance-driven deletion, and data masking/obfuscation techniques for sensitive data (PII).
* Experience serving multiple downstream consumers with varying analytical and operational requirements by delivering filtered and governed interfaces.
* Clear written communication habits; ability to articulate complex ETL architectures and governance rules to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SAP Information Steward (data quality profiling, rule building, metadata management).
* Hands-on experience integrating SAP BODS with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS S3).
* Exposure to SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) or SAP Data Intelligence / Datasphere.
* Experience in large-scale multi-tenant enterprise environments supporting cross-functional business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial).

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

Config-Driven Onboarding: Standard source table onboarding (source

* landing/staging) is reduced to a configuration-driven process using reusable BODS templates, drastically reducing manual job creation.
* Automated Retention & Purging: Automated partition/date-based archiving and retention mechanisms are operational across staging repositories.
* Operational Routing Rules: A central metadata-driven routing table governs downstream extraction/distribution, dynamically applying required column masking and row filters.
* Resilient DataOps: Automated alerting, execution telemetry, and standard environment promotion workflows are established and fully documented.

title: Virtual Infrastructure - Senior Systems Engineer
description:
