title: Scientific Computing / Research Engineering Expert — Earth Sciences
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking experienced Earth Sciences experts to develop realistic, terminal-based scientific and computational tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will design challenging scientific tasks involving climate science, atmospheric processes, geophysics, oceanography, geology, hydrology, remote sensing, and environmental modeling. You will build reproducible computational workflows that require AI agents to analyze scientific datasets, execute code, run simulations, troubleshoot technical issues, and generate objectively verifiable scientific outputs.

**What you'll do:**

* Design realistic, multi-step scientific tasks based on authentic Earth Sciences, climate, geospatial, environmental, and geophysical research workflows.
* Prepare and process scientific datasets involving climate, weather, atmospheric conditions, oceanography, geology, hydrology, satellite imagery, and environmental systems.
* Develop computational tasks involving geospatial analysis, time-series processing, numerical modeling, interpolation, forecasting, remote sensing, and environmental risk analysis.
* Build reproducible, terminal-based computational environments using scientific libraries, command-line tools, and appropriate dependencies.
* Develop expert reference solutions using Python, R, Bash, Julia, or domain-specific scientific software.
* Create automated tests and evaluation criteria to verify scientific correctness, numerical accuracy, spatial and temporal consistency, and reproducibility.
* Validate coordinate reference systems, measurement units, timestamps, missing-data handling, uncertainty, and scientific assumptions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues involving geospatial projections, large scientific datasets, software dependencies, computational performance, and numerical stability.
* Ensure tasks require meaningful multi-step scientific reasoning and cannot be solved through simple shortcuts or hard-coded outputs.
* Document dataset sources, computational workflows, expected outputs, edge cases, and scientific limitations.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Earth Sciences, Climate Science, Atmospheric Science, Geophysics, Oceanography, Geology, Hydrology, Environmental Science, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, Bash, Julia, or another relevant scientific programming language.
* Hands-on experience working in Linux and terminal-based computational environments.
* Practical expertise in at least one major area: scientific data processing, numerical modeling, geospatial analysis, climate modeling, remote sensing, or environmental data analysis.
* Strong understanding of spatial datasets, time-series analysis, scientific modeling, numerical accuracy, uncertainty, and data quality control.
* Experience working with real-world scientific datasets, including geospatial, climate, atmospheric, oceanographic, geological, or hydrological data.
* Ability to independently develop, execute, debug, and validate reproducible scientific computational workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify scientific inaccuracies, data inconsistencies, and computational errors.
* Ability to design objective validation methods and clearly document technical solutions and scientific assumptions.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with scientific computing and geospatial libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, xarray, rasterio, GeoPandas, Cartopy, GDAL, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with scientific data formats such as NetCDF, HDF5, GeoTIFF, shapefiles, GRIB, and other geospatial or environmental data formats.
* Experience working with climate, weather, oceanographic, seismic, satellite, hydrological, or geological datasets.
* Familiarity with Docker, Conda, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience using high-performance computing (HPC) environments or processing large-scale scientific datasets.
* Experience with Earth-system models, environmental forecasting, remote sensing applications, or geophysical simulations.
* Research software engineering experience, including developing scientific tools, simulation pipelines, or reproducible research workflows.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, scientific benchmarks, or automated grading systems.
* Publications, research contributions, or open-source development experience in Earth or Environmental Sciences.
* Prior experience in AI training, scientific quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: AI Harness Engineer
description:
We're hiring an experienced AI-native engineer to build the core systems behind Diligent's AI agents. This is not a prompt-writing role. This is a software engineering role for someone who can design reliable AI systems: prompts, context, tools, evals, orchestration, memory, observability, and production workflows.

**About Us**

Diligent is the new venture from the founding team of Leverage Edu, a Series D edtech company. There, our founders built and scaled multiple businesses from zero, including student mobility, cross-border payments and student housing.

Diligent is building the AI growth team every business deserves. Instead of hiring an agency or a five-person marketing team, our clients get a squad of AI agents that research competitors, plan budgets, generate creatives, and run and optimise campaigns on Meta and Google, with senior marketers guiding every move. A campaign that takes an agency weeks to set up goes live in under 30 minutes.

We're a small team building fast. Everyone here uses AI every day, and you will too.

**The Role**

You'll work on the core agent architecture behind Diligent.

Your job will be to build the harness around frontier models: prompt engineering, context engineering, tool design, agent orchestration, evals, memory, model routing, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop systems.

You should be equally comfortable thinking about system design and writing production code.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and build AI agent workflows for marketing, growth, reporting, creative analysis, SEO/AEO, lead intelligence, and reputation monitoring.
* Build production-grade harnesses around LLMs using prompts, context, tools, memory, structured outputs, evals, guardrails, and human review loops.
* Work on prompt engineering, context engineering, tool calling, workflow decomposition, and agent orchestration.
* Build backend systems that connect with databases, APIs, CRMs, ad platforms, Slack, WhatsApp, dashboards, and internal tools.
* Design systems for ingesting, cleaning, storing, and retrieving business context for AI agents.
* Build evaluation pipelines to test prompt changes, model changes, agent quality, regressions, and edge cases.
* Implement model routing strategies to balance quality, latency, and cost. Improve observability: logs, traces, prompt versions, model outputs, failure analysis, and feedback loops.
* Work closely with product and growth teams to convert messy business workflows into reliable AI systems. Own engineering quality across architecture, code, testing, debugging, deployment, and maintenance.

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong backend engineering and system design fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs, AI agents, prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, tool calling, or agent frameworks.
* Strong software development fundamentals: clean code, APIs, databases, queues, testing, debugging, version control, and deployment.
* Experience with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or similar backend stacks.
* Comfort working with Postgres, Redis, vector databases, queues, schedulers, and production services.
* Understanding of structured outputs, JSON schemas, retries, validation, error handling, and deterministic workflows.
* Ability to break ambiguous business workflows into clear technical systems.
* High ownership and comfort working in an early-stage startup environment.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, LangChain, MCP, or similar tools.
* Experience building evals for AI systems.
* Experience with tool servers, workflow engines, agent infrastructure, or automation platforms.
* Experience with marketing/adtech/growth tools such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, HubSpot, Zoho, Shopify, Slack, WhatsApp, or CRMs.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar cloud platforms.
* Experience with observability, tracing, logging, and production monitoring

description:
**Marketing Executive**

*Detailed Job Description — Infozech*

**Location:**Mohan Cooperative, New Delhi | Experience: 3 years |Full-time

**Industry:**B2B Technology — Telecom & Tower Software & Solutions

**About Infozech**

Infozech is a leading technology solution provider to large telecom operators and tower companies worldwide, helping towercos, MNOs, and enterprises optimize operations with data-driven insights. We are looking for a dynamic, AI-fluent Marketing Executive to strengthen our brand, automate our marketing engine, and generate demand — someone who treats AI as the default way to work smarter across content, search, and campaigns.

**How We Think About Content & Campaigns**

**This is not a volume role.** Success is not measured by how much content is produced, but by how deeply it resonates with the CXOs and functional heads of large telecom and tower companies. Every asset starts from a real pain point these leaders face, positions Infozech's solutions as the answer, and is engineered — in format and distribution — to reach influential decision-makers and convert their attention into enquiries and demand. Quality of resonance and distribution matter more than quantity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI-Driven Marketing & Workflow Automation**

* Design and build, run, and improve AI-linked marketing workflows — automating campaign curation, orchestration, scheduling, and lifecycle management end to end.
* Use AI to sharpen content, SEO, AEO, thought leadership, and campaigns — from ideation and drafts to optimization, formatting, and repurposing for distribution.
* Automate repetitive operations — nurture sequences, segmentation, tagging, reporting — so time is freed for what actually moves CXOs.

**2. Pain-Point Content & CXO Storytelling**

* Start from the real pain points of CXOs and functional heads of towercos and telecom operators, and craft narratives that position Infozech's solutions and capabilities as the answer.
* Storyboard, ideate, draft, and proofread across blogs, case studies, whitepapers, newsletters, and social posts — aligned to Infozech's brand voice and industry context.
* Write pain-first, curiosity-led B2B copy that is credible and skimmable for busy senior leaders.

**3. AEO & SEO (AI-Linked Search Visibility)**

* AEO: structure and format content so Infozech surfaces in AI-generated answers, generative search, snippets, and LLM responses — via question-led formats, structured data, and entity clarity.
* SEO: keyword research, on-page and meta-tag optimization, technical hygiene, and Google Business Profile (GMB) ratings and listings.
* Render every asset for easier, better distribution — the right format, structure, and metadata so it travels well to the people who matter.

**4. Campaigns & Demand Generation**

* Build sharply targeted, pain-point-led campaigns aimed at CXOs and functional heads — not broad-reach noise, but narratives that name a real problem and position Infozech as the solution.
* Engineer how each asset is rendered and distributed so it reaches influential people in the format most likely to land — and track how it converts into enquiries and qualified demand.
* Use automation to curate and manage the campaign lifecycle — audience building, sequencing, delivery, follow-up — so targeting and timing stay precise at scale.
* Measure success by resonance and demand generated (enquiries, conversations, pipeline), not content volume.

**5. Collaboration, Social & CRM**

* Interview product, presales, sales, the CEO, and product owners to co-create credible content grounded in real customer problems; partner with design for collateral.
* Run LinkedIn-led thought leadership and social engagement for senior telecom/towerco audiences, and promote events and webinars.
* Execute targeted email campaigns (Zoho CRM, Mailchimp), nurture and qualify leads with sales, and keep the marketing database clean.

**6. Market Research & Competitive Analysis**

* Research market trends, competitors, and — above all — the evolving pain points of telecom and towerco leaders; track performance and recommend differentiation.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

BBA, B.Tech, MBA, or a degree in Journalism, English, Communication, or an equivalent field. 3 years in B2B marketing, preferably in technology, SaaS, or telecom.

**Technical (in order of priority)**

* **AI & Automation —** using AI to automate content, SEO, AEO, thought leadership, and campaigns.
* **Content & Storytelling —** pain-point-led storyboarding, blog ideation, drafting, proofreading for a senior audience.

description:
**About us:**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

Who you will work with

* BCN Labs is a Center of Excellence (CoE) functioning akin to a small R&D boutique startup within the Bain ecosystem, delivering end-to end data-driven client deployable solutions across a wide variety of sectors and industries.
* BCN Labs work directly with other CoEs and Practices within Bain as part of the Expert Client Delivery system and interface with global teams across.
* BCN Labs is first and foremost business thought partner working on intelligent ways of using analytical techniques and algorithms across the spectrum of disciplines that can enable building world-class solutions.
* Our goal is to build a disruptive high-impact business-enabled end-to-end analytical solutions delivery system across all verticals of Bain.

About you

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 6+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or AI (5+ years with a relevant Master’s degree), including experience leading technical workstreams and providing technical direction and mentorship to junior Data Scientists.
* Proven hands-on experience developing Data Science and AI solutions, with strong foundations in statistical modelling and Machine Learning and meaningful hands-on exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI applications.

What you’ll do

* Lead Data Science & AI Workstreams: Lead Data Science and AI workstreams from problem definition and solution design through development, evaluation, and deployment, working closely with business stakeholders and engineering team

* Hands-on Data Science & AI Development: Remain hands-on in developing models and prototypes, conducting technical deep-dives, troubleshooting complex problems, and reviewing critical components of solutions.
* Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning: Design and guide solutions across statistical modelling, Machine Learning, forecasting, optimization, NLP, and other advanced analytics techniques, selecting appropriate approaches based on business problems and available data.
* Generative & Agentic AI: Design and build GenAI solutions using LLMs, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, and agentic workflows, making informed choices across models, prompts, retrieval, context, and orchestration approaches.

* Technical Planning & Problem Solving: Translate business problems into analytical workstreams, estimate and prioritize technical tasks, identify technical risks, and work with the team to resolve implementation challenges.
* Mentorship & Team Leadership: Guide and mentor junior Data Scientists through technical direction, modelling and code reviews, and structured problem solving, helping them build stronger technical capabilities and operate independently.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, and engineers to understand requirements, communicate analytical findings and technical trade-offs, and develop solutions that address real business needs.

What makes us a great place to work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents..

title: Principal AI Engineer- I
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the engineering hub of Deutsche Telekom, Europe’s #1 telecom brand. We build the digital products that millions of customers across Europe use every day. AI-first by design, we don't just adopt new technology, we build with it.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

With the right team, anything is possible. This is where AI stops being a feature and becomes the product. OneAI builds the intelligence layer that powers customer-facing AI experiences across Deutsche Telekom, from conversational assistants to recommendation engines that actually understand context. If you want to work on AI that millions of people interact with every day, not in a lab, not in a demo, but in the real world at real scale, this is your team. We don't just deploy models. We build the systems that make them trustworthy, useful, and impossible to ignore.

**YOU ASK WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? WE SAY,**

**What exactly is the objective of this role?**

* Design and ship AI-powered product features (LLMs, RAG, agents, ML APIs) into our existing services, working closely with backend, frontend, and data science teams.

**JOIN US!**

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point-of-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back-office software solutions as well as industry-leading hardware and drive-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
  
  
**Position Description**
PAR is looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer to be the technical cornerstone of our newly formed AI Platform team. You will design, build, and operate a production-grade, multi-tenant AI Platform on AWS using LLM orchestration services, tools and libraries, enabling engineering teams in PAR Restaurant group to build, deploy, and scale AI agents and agentic workflows that surface directly to customers.
  
  
The ideal candidate is deeply technical with 7–8 years of hands-on ML/AI engineering experience, especially with building AI platform components, and equally effective as a communicator, team player and a collaborator. You write production code, define architectural standards, and can explain a policy-as-code framework, a RAG pipeline, and a team sprint plan with equal clarity.
  
  
This is an ideal role for someone who is hands-on, obsessed with performance and scalability, and deeply experienced with productionizing multi-agent systems, from graph-based orchestration and real-time streaming to RAG pipelines and multi-model routing at production scale.
  
  
**Position Location:**
Gurugram / Jaipur, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director of AI and Analytics
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
AI Platform Engineering – Core Orchestration & Runtime
  
  
Build the PAR Restaurant AI Platform - a dual-purpose system that at build time gives product engineering teams the APIs, SDKs, tool registry, and knowledgebase services to author and deploy agents, and at runtime hosts those agents in production across all PAR product lines with multi-tenant isolation, security guardrails, content safety, governance, and compliance controls
  
  
Design and build production-grade GenAI microservices (e.g. FastAPI) and stateful multi-agent workflows, including selection of the appropriate orchestration pattern (model-driven, graph-based etc.) based on auditability, latency, and complexity requirements of each agent class
  
  
Design and operate an automated content ingestion pipeline that includes content upload, chunking, embedding model selection, vector storage, and OpenSearch Serverless indexing - exposing knowledgebase retrieval as a fully managed, self-service capability for all product teams
  
  
AI Platform Engineering – Tooling & Developer Experience
  
  
Build and maintain the platform APIs and developer tooling, including MCP-compatible tool interfaces, real-time streaming APIs (SSE / WebSocket), and agent configuration SDKs, that allow engineers to create, deploy, run, and observe multi-agent workflows with configurable guardrails and content safety controls per agent class
  
  
Own internal AI SDK ergonomics for both audiences: agent-authoring engineers and application-backend engineers consuming the streaming invocation API
  
  
Build and maintain the Platform Onboarding Copilot (Slack-integrated); produce clear, actionable technical documentation and architectural decision records (ADRs); present platform strategy to non-technical stakeholders
  
  
Own the platform observability stack as a product, not an afterthought. Provides platform tools for engineers to fetch observability metrics, and distributed traces auto-provisioned on every agent deployment; an LLM eval suite (e.g. LangSmith, Ragas) that gates CI/CD on quality regressions; and per-tenant cost attribution with spend alerting giving every engineering team full visibility into their inference consumption
  
  
Define quality bars and eval suites per agent class; no agent reaches production without a documented, passing score threshold, thereby establish evaluation as a first-class engineering discipline across the team
  
  
Governance, Compliance, Multi-Tenancy
  
  
Design multi-tenant isolation from day one, including namespace isolation, tenant\_id injection, and policy-as-code enforcement ensuring there is no cross-brand data or context pollution.
  
  
Own the policy-as-code library for PAR-specific policy sets covering PAR Restaurant product lines while ensuring platform compliance with SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA; author and maintain the GDPR deletion pipeline
  
  
Define and implement content safety guardrails: grounding checks and content filtering mandatory for all customer-facing agents
  
  
Act as the quality and cost-economics gatekeeper for all agents entering pre-production, such as running standardised eval suites, enforcing agent best practices, and validating inference cost-per-run against approved thresholds before any agent is cleared for production deployment
  
  
Collaborate with DevOps (owners of CI/CD automation) through a well-defined infrastructure contract and build version promotion pipeline (e.g. GitHub Actions)
  
  
**Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:**
7–8 years of hands-on Machine Learning / AI Engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on production GenAI or LLM systems
  
  
Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a closely related field
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing and building multi-tenant, production-grade ML platforms or developer-facing AI infrastructure
  
  
Proven track record of shipping ML systems end-to-end, from architecture and deployment through to operational observability, eval pipelines, and cost management
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  
AWS (Deep): API Gateway, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, EKS (Kubernetes + IRSA), OpenSearch Serverless, KMS, SageMaker, Step Functions, WAF, PrivateLink, CloudWatch, IAM
  
  
GenAI & LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, AWS-native GenAI services
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Systems: Vector stores (FAISS, ChromaDB, Pinecone, Weaviate), OpenSearch Serverless - designing end-to-end ingestion, chunking, embedding, and hybrid retrieval pipelines
  
  
ML Ops: MLflow (tracking, model registry, job orchestration), Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, notebooks), automated retraining workflows
  
  
Programming: Expert-level Python (FastAPI / Flask / Django); proficient TypeScript / Node.js (Express / NestJS); clean code, OOP, scalable architecture
  
  
Data Stores: Delta Lake, Elasticsearch, Redis, NoSQL, columnar stores (Databricks, BigQuery)
  
  
CI/CD & DevOps Collaboration: GitHub Actions; familiarity with Terraform Cloud / HCP Terraform workflows; container-native development on EKS
  
  
Observability & Monitoring: CloudWatch (metrics, logs, dashboards, alarms), distributed tracing (AWS X-Ray or equivalent), LLM evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Ragas, or similar)
  
  
Security & Policy: Policy-as-code frameworks, IAM policy design, multi-tenant namespace isolation, PCI DSS and GDPR technical controls
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can explain a policy-as-code enforcement model to a security auditor and a RAG pipeline to a product manager in the same meeting
  
  
Strong collaboration instincts - platform engineers serve internal customers; you measure success by adoption, not just uptime
  
  
Emerging leadership skills - you have mentored engineers, led design reviews, or owned a technical domain end-to-end
  
  
Comfort with ambiguity - this is a greenfield platform with real architectural decisions to make, not a maintenance role
  
  
Flexibility to occasionally collaborate with teams in California (PST) and Toronto (EST) for cross-time zone syncs
  
  
Bonus Points
  
  
Familiarity with restaurant, hospitality, or retail domains
  
  
Experience building or fine-tuning domain-specific LLMs or embedding models
  
  
Experience building enterprise-scale Text-to-SQL applications
  
  
Multi-agent orchestration and A2A protocols; familiarity with workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n) for MCP-compatible tool interoperability
  
  
Experience building LLM-specific observability beyond standard infra monitoring, e.g. hallucination tracking, groundedness scoring, per-session cost and cost attribution
  
  
Contributions to open-source ML or GenAI projects
  
  
Experience with policy-as-code frameworks for cloud access control at scale
  
  
Familiarity with defining and executing sprint plans, technical roadmaps, managing weekly standups and quarterly OKRs for a team
  
  
Prior people management or tech lead experience
  
  
**Interview Process**
Interview #1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team
  
  
Interview #2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)
  
  
Interview #3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)

**Introduction To Team**
Distribution & Supply Technology (DST) powers the platform that lets travelers search, book, and experience travel across Expedia Group's brands, including Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. DST owns Pricing, Inventory, Content, and Marketplace Trust & Safety. Together, these teams source high-quality supply, price it competitively, enrich it with trusted content, and keep our two-sided marketplace safe for travelers and partners.
  
  
Machine learning is central to all of it. Our Content systems manage hundreds of millions of digital assets, using ML and LLMs to enrich listings, summarize reviews, and moderate text. Our Pricing models optimize real-time prices across millions of products. Our Trust & Safety models detect policy violations, fraud, and safety risks before they become traveler-facing failures.

That includes batch and real-time inference pipelines, model evaluation and monitoring, and platform capabilities that cut duplicated effort across teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.

* Experience delivering machine learning products or services at scale, with a focus on performance, reliability, security, operational excellence, and measurable customer or business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of machine learning applications.

title: Sr Engineer - Process Engineering
description:
The Senior Engineer – Process Engineering is responsible for independently executing and owning assigned process engineering and customer application engineering scope for boiler and thermal power plant service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), and new product introduction (NPI) programs. The role is expected to develop technically compliant, competitive, and customer-focused engineering solutions across inquiry-to-order (ITO), execution, and product implementation phases within assigned scope.
  
The position requires strong technical knowledge in boiler performance, thermal system analysis, steam-water cycle integration, and process engineering deliverables, along with the ability to develop and review technical inputs for bids, proposals, technical clarifications, and risk assessments. The role works closely with global engineering teams, regional stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality engineering output aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and GE Vernova standards for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Independently execute and own assigned process engineering scope related to boiler performance, thermal system analysis, and steam-water cycle integration for service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), and new product introduction (NPI) programs.

* Prepare and review engineering deliverables such as process calculations, process flow diagrams, P&IDs, process descriptions, operating philosophies, performance evaluations, and related technical documentation.

* Analyze customer enquiries, tender documents, operating data, and technical specifications to define technically compliant, competitive, and executable application engineering solutions within assigned scope.

* Develop and Review customer application engineering activities, including preparation of technical inputs for bids and proposals, compliance matrices, customer submittals, process schemes, technical deviations, assumptions, scope clarifications, and feasibility evaluations.

* Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to explain proposed solutions, engineering assumptions, and application feasibility.

* Contribute to opportunity assessment for boiler upgrade and retrofit packages, including emissions-related modifications and performance improvement solutions.

* Coordinate with commercial, sourcing, execution, controls and instrumentation, mechanical, and project engineering teams to develop optimized technical solutions and ensure alignment of scope, assumptions, interfaces, and deliverables.

* Identify, assess, document, and support mitigation of technical deviations, assumptions, risks, and opportunities during application engineering, project execution, and product implementation phases.

* Work closely with global engineering teams, regional stakeholders, and subject matter experts to align technical solutions with customer requirements, fleet needs, business objectives, and implementation constraints.

* Drive technical risk assessment reviews with global teams and subject matter experts to identify design, performance, operability, reliability, maintainability, and execution risks associated with proposed boiler solutions.

* Take ownership of assigned ITO activities through project handover.

* Ensure high-quality and consistent engineering output related to performance calculations, thermal assessments, design reviews, optimization studies, and technical evaluations.

* Support NPI activities through evaluation of new or modified process concepts, product features, design changes, engineering validation requirements, and implementation considerations.

* Contribute to technical excellence through participation in design reviews, technical reviews, constructability reviews, lessons learned implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

* Provide technical guidance and review support to less experienced engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing and capability building across the team.

* Ensure engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with applicable standards, customer requirements, product requirements, and business processes, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC).

* Contribute to functional initiatives and metrics related to Life Saving Rules, Product Safety embedded in design, On-Time Delivery, Right First Time, Kaizen, productivity, cost-out, quality, and Lean Six Sigma.

  

**Qualifications / Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or equivalent from an accredited university or college.

* Relevant experience in boiler engineering, process engineering, thermal engineering, performance engineering, or steam power plant applications.

* Relevant experience in process engineering for service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), customer application engineering, or related thermal power projects.

* Strong technical knowledge of boiler performance, thermodynamics, heat and mass balance, combustion-related process considerations, and steam power plant systems.

* Experience preparing and reviewing process engineering deliverables and technical documentation for boiler or thermal power applications.

* Familiarity with engineering tools, methods, and systems relevant to process engineering, performance evaluation, and power plant applications.

* Demonstrated ability to define engineering assumptions and support resolution of technical issues within assigned scope.

* Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and manage technical risks within assigned scope with appropriate urgency and discipline.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

* Ability to work to committed timelines while maintaining safety, quality, and engineering integrity.

* Willingness to travel to sites and flexibility to support business requirements, as needed.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills.

* Demonstrated ability to develop practical, technically sound, and customer-focused engineering solutions.

* Experience supporting customer application engineering, technical proposals, or tendering activities.

* Familiarity with NPI, product change management, validation support, or technology implementation in an engineering environment.

* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across functions, regions, and engineering disciplines.

* Familiarity with Lean, continuous improvement, and standardization practices.

* Customer-focused mindset with balanced attention to technical, commercial, and execution priorities.

* Ability to influence through technical depth, clear communication, and disciplined execution.

* Experience using digital engineering tools, structured documentation systems, and productivity tools in a global engineering environment.

* Awareness of AI-enabled tools for engineering productivity, document quality improvement, technical knowledge retrieval, and data analysis, with appropriate engineering validation.

* Ensure high-quality and consistent engineering output related to performance calculations, thermal assessments, design reviews, optimization studies, and technical evaluations.
* Support NPI activities through evaluation of new or modified process concepts, product features, design changes, and engineering validation requirements.
* Contribute to technical excellence through participation in design reviews, technical reviews, constructability reviews, lessons learned implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to team knowledge sharing and continue building technical capability in boiler process engineering methods, tools, and standards.
* Ensure engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with applicable standards, customer requirements, product requirements, and business processes, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC).

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent from an accredited university or college.
* Relevant experience in boiler engineering, process engineering, thermal engineering, performance engineering, or steam power plant applications.
* Strong knowledge of boiler systems, combustion, heat transfer, thermal performance, pressure parts, and steam generation process.
* Relevant experience in process engineering for service, retrofit, renovation and modernization (R&M), customer application engineering, or related thermal power projects.

* Experience preparing process engineering deliverables and technical documentation for boiler or thermal power applications.
* Familiarity with engineering tools, methods, and systems relevant to process engineering and power plant applications.
* Demonstrated ability to apply engineering assumptions and support resolution of technical issues within assigned scope.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and document technical risks and escalate issues within assigned scope with appropriate urgency and discipline.
* Ability to work to committed timelines while maintaining safety, quality, and engineering integrity.
* Willingness to travel to sites and flexibility to support business requirements, as needed.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  
  

* Experience with utility boilers, including subcritical and supercritical units.
* Knowledge of emissions reduction, combustion improvement, and fuel flexibility solutions.
* Familiarity with cross-functional proposal and service engineering workflows.
* Strong analytical and technical problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with NPI, product change management, validation support, or technology implementation in an engineering environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across functions, regions, and engineering disciplines.
* Awareness of technical risk assessment methods in engineering and proposal development.
* Experience working with global teams across functions and regions.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities and work effectively in a matrix organization.
* Customer-focused mindset with strong ownership and technical rigor.
  

  

**Tools and Digital Skills**

  
  

* Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Engineering calculation and thermal performance analysis tools.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted productivity tools for technical documentation, and analysis.

description:
**Job title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated **Cloud Service Engineer** to join the Digital Workplace Services team and support the security, administration and governance of our cloud and SaaS environment. The role will work across platforms including **Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Box** and other enterprise SaaS applications, supporting operational security, access governance, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build hands-on experience across **cloud security, identity, SaaS security, data protection and AI security** within a large enterprise environment, working closely with senior engineers, security teams, platform owners, application teams and vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **SaaS & Cloud Security:** Support administration, security governance, onboarding, configuration, lifecycle management and periodic reviews for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet and other enterprise SaaS platforms.
* **Identity & Access Management:** Support Microsoft Entra ID and Google Cloud Identity administration, including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access, MFA, authentication methods, guest access and privileged role governance.
* **Data Protection & Security Operations:** Assist with Microsoft Purview, Defender, DLP alert monitoring, external sharing reviews, security triage, remediation tracking and operational reporting.
* **AI & Emerging Technology Security:** Support governance and monitoring for enterprise AI services, Copilot, Copilot Studio, GenAI applications, agents, connectors and related data protection controls.
* **Security Monitoring & Investigation:** Monitor dashboards and alerts across SaaS and cloud platforms, perform initial investigation, use tools such as Defender, Purview, Sentinel and SaaS security platforms, and escalate complex issues where required.
* **Platform Operations & Troubleshooting:** Provide second-line support for authentication, provisioning, synchronization, SSO, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, API integrations, vendor issues, change implementation and validation.
* **Governance, Documentation & Improvement:** Maintain inventories, ownership records, runbooks, knowledge articles, configuration records and operational procedures while identifying automation and process improvement opportunities.

**Key Technologies**

The role will have exposure to the following technology areas:

* **Identity & Cloud:** Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Identity and Google Workspace.
* **Security:** Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, Conditional Access, DLP and SaaS security/application governance.
* **SaaS Platforms:** Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet, Adobe Apps and other enterprise SaaS applications.
* **AI Security:** Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI / AI Foundry, AI governance and data protection controls.
* **Automation & Technical Tools:** PowerShell, KQL, Power Automate, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, SAML, SCIM and OAuth.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in cloud administration, SaaS administration, IT security, identity management or a related technical role.
* Basic understanding of Microsoft 365 and/or Azure, identity and access management, SSO, MFA and authentication concepts.
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, least privilege, data protection and operational security monitoring.
* Good troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to investigate issues using logs, dashboards and administrative portals.
* Basic PowerShell or scripting knowledge, with willingness to learn KQL and security monitoring tools.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, ability to work with technical teams and vendors, and strong attention to detail in documentation.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Sentinel/KQL, Google Workspace Administration, Google Cloud Identity, Box administration/Box Shield, SaaS security or CASB.
* Experience with OAuth application governance, SAML, SCIM, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Power Automate, cloud security, DLP, AI security or AI governance.

Relevant Microsoft, Google, security or cloud certifications would be advantageous but are not mandatory.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Independently handle routine SaaS and cloud security operations.
* Identify and resolve common identity, access, platform configuration and security alert issues.
* Maintain accurate application, access, security governance and remediation records.
* Improve documentation, repeatable processes, automation and operational efficiency.
* Develop deeper expertise across Microsoft, Google, SaaS, cloud, data protection and AI security platforms.

The role will work closely with Digital Workplace Services, Cyber Security/SOC, Identity & Access Management, Microsoft 365/Azure engineering teams, Google Cloud/Google Workspace teams, Data Protection/Privacy, Application and Enterprise Architecture teams, SaaS application owners and external technology vendors.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Description:**

Technical Lead, CPaaS Platform About the role We are hiring a Technical Lead to drive the architecture and engineering quality of our CPaaS platform. The platform lets businesses message their customers over WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Instagram and voice from one API, one inbox and one automation builder. You will design the backend systems that move millions of messages reliably and bill for them correctly. You are also expected to be comfortable in the frontend, where customers build campaigns, flows and templates. This is a hands-on role: you will write code most weeks, lead design reviews, and help grow a small team of backend and full stack engineers.

**Location: Gurugram · Experience: 5+ years**

**What you'll do**

Backend architecture and design Drive the design of core services:

messaging send and receive, delivery receipts, contacts, campaigns, workflow automation, integrations and billing.

**Design for high-volume, event-driven traffic:**

idempotent sends, retries with backoff, outbox patterns, at-least-once delivery and correct reconciliation of delivery status. Shape multi-tenant data models with strong isolation (row-level security, scoped credentials, per-org limits). Define clean contracts between services and with telecom and messaging providers, and keep them versioned and tested. Write and review design docs and ADRs; make trade-offs explicit and choose options that hold up as we scale.

**Frontend and product**

Review and contribute to our web app and admin panel: campaign builder, flow builder, inbox, template management and billing screens. Make sure APIs serve the UI well: pagination, optimistic updates, error states and real time updates. Work with product and design to turn fuzzy requirements into a buildable, phased plan.

**Engineering leadership**

Lead and mentor a team of 3–5 engineers; run design and code reviews, and take part in technical hiring. Set standards for testing, CI gates, observability and secure coding, and keep them enforced in the pipeline rather than by memory. Help own production health: on-call practice, incident response, blameless postmortems and SLOs for send latency and delivery. Partner with DevOps on cloud infrastructure, deploys and cost.

**What we're looking for**

**Backend design (the core of this role)**

5+ years building production backend systems, with some experience leading a small team or owning a major component end to end. Strong experience with TypeScript/Node.js (NestJS preferred), or strong Go/Java/Kotlin with willingness to work in TypeScript. Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query plans, transactions, migrations on live tables. Hands-on experience with event streaming and queues (Kafka or similar): partitioning, ordering, consumer lag, dead-letter handling. Distributed-systems judgement: idempotency, exactly-once vs at-least-once, race conditions, back-pressure, rate limiting. Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS: tenant isolation, authn/authz (JWT, RBAC), audit trails. Has shipped and run services on a public cloud (GCP preferred) with containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. Solid observability practice: structured logs, metrics, tracing, alerting you actually act on.

**Frontend fluency**

Working knowledge of React and Next.js: can read, review and ship features, not just consume APIs. Understands state management, data fetching and caching, forms, and accessibility basics. Can spot when a UI problem is really an API problem, and fix it at the right layer. Leadership and ways of working Writes clear design docs and explains trade-offs to engineers and non-engineers. Reviews code for correctness first: edge cases, concurrency, failure modes, security Values tests that can actually fail, and verifies behaviour in real environments before declaring done. Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving priorities in an early-stage product.

**Nice to have**

CPaaS, telecom or messaging experience:

WhatsApp Business API, SMS aggregators, RCS, DLT registration in India, or delivery-report handling. Workflow orchestration (Temporal or similar) for long-running automations and scheduled journeys. Usage-based billing: wallets, prepaid credits, metering, payment-gateway webhooks. Integrations with commerce and CRM platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Meta lead ads) via OAuth and webhooks. Security depth: secrets management, KMS, webhook signature verification, dependency and supply-chain hygiene. Load testing and capacity planning for bursty campaign traffic. Experience using AI coding tools well, with review and guardrails in place.

**Our stack**

**Area Backend Data**

**What we use**

TypeScript, NestJS, TypeORM, microservices PostgreSQL with row-level security, Redis Messaging and workflows Kafka (Redpanda), Temporal Frontend Mobile Cloud and infra Channels React, Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui Flutter GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, KMS), OpenTofu, GitHub Actions WhatsApp, SMS, RCS, Instagram, voice.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks and architectures.

Explore and implement AI-driven approaches to improve test automation and engineering productivity.  

Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment

Mentor team members and contribute to automation strategy and technology evolution.

* 6–8+ years of relevant experience in software testing, test automation, or SDET

roles.  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, such as

B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, MCA, or M.Tech/M.Sc. in Computer Science.  

* Strong Python programming and object-oriented design skills.
* Strong hands-on experience with Pytest.
* Experience designing test automation architecture, frameworks, reusable

components, and test strategies.  

* Proven experience with Selenium and/or Playwright; Appium experience is an

advantage.

tasks.

tools.  

* Good understanding of software testing, QA methodologies, and quality

engineering practices.

title: Global AI/ML Engineer Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

**Product & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner closely with product owners, functional leaders, and stakeholders within the People function to define requirements, shape backlog items, and translate business problems into technical solutions.
* Work with global and local market teams during rollouts to understand adoption, identify gaps, and continuously improve the solution.
* Partner with enterprise teams across architecture, security, Responsible AI etc. to seek approvals for the AI solutions during deployments and rollouts
* Communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure GenAI solutions are designed and delivered in accordance with Responsible AI, security, privacy, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish appropriate AI guardrails covering areas such as prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, unsafe outputs, and inappropriate model behaviour.
* Partner with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to obtain necessary approvals and establish production-readiness standards.
* Ensure appropriate documentation of AI system architecture, model usage, data flows, risks, evaluations, and operational controls.
* Embed responsible AI and security considerations throughout the product lifecycle rather than treating them as post-development activities

**GenAI Architecture & Technical Strategy**

* Define the technical vision, architecture, and engineering strategy for enterprise GenAI products.
* Design and guide implementation of LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, tool/function calling, and AI-powered decision-support solutions.
* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, AI platforms, retrieval technologies, orchestration frameworks, and cloud services based on business and technical requirements.
* Establish reusable GenAI architecture patterns, reference architectures, engineering standards, and technical accelerators across the AI CoE.
* Make pragmatic build-vs-buy, model-selection, and platform decisions considering quality, scalability, security, latency, and cost.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams and workstreams.

**AI Evaluation & Quality**

* Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI applications covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, safety, robustness, latency, and cost.
* Establish automated evaluation and regression-testing strategies for models, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Partner with Product and business stakeholders to define AI quality and product success metrics.

**LLMOps / MLOps & Production Engineering**

* Establish production-grade LLMOps/MLOps practices covering model and prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement.
* Define operational metrics covering AI quality, latency, reliability, usage, and cost.
* Establish CI/CD and automated testing practices for GenAI applications, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Design AI systems for scalability, availability, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

* Lead and coach a team of GenAI/ML engineers and data scientists delivering enterprise AI solutions end to end—from problem definition and design through development, deployment, and rollout.
* Own execution and delivery: planning, prioritization, agile ceremonies, timelines, and quality of outcomes.
* Provide technical direction, unblock teams, and ensure pragmatic, scalable solutions aligned with business needs.

**Hands-on Technical & Full-Stack Engineering**

* Remain hands-on in full-stack development, solution design, code reviews, and technical architecture.
* Guide development of production-grade GenAI-enabled applications across the frontend, backend, AI/ML, and data layers.
* Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and integrations required to support AI-powered products.
* Guide development of modern frontend applications and user experiences that integrate GenAI capabilities into enterprise workflows.
* Work effectively across frontend technologies such as React/TypeScript or equivalent frameworks, and backend technologies such as Python/Java or equivalent technologies.
* Guide integration of LLMs, AI agents, enterprise APIs, business systems, and data platforms into end-to-end product experiences.
* Remain hands-on in Python-based GenAI/ML development while providing technical direction across the broader application stack.
* Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks, including GitHub-based workflows, containers/Kubernetes, Airflow, CI/CD, observability, and data pipelines.
* Promote modern software engineering practices across full-stack, AI, and ML development.
* Remain hands-on in Python-based development, code reviews, and solution design.
* Guide development of GenAI-enabled features and applied ML solutions in a product context.
* Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks (e.g., GitHub-based workflows, Airflow, containerized/Kubernetes-based deployments, data pipelines).
* Promote modern software engineering practices across AI/ML development.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, ML/AI engineering, or data science, including significant experience designing and delivering production-grade GenAI/AI products and leading engineering teams.
* Hands on engineering development expertise to build and deploy production grade digital products.
* Demonstrated ability to lead delivery teams and grow into broader leadership responsibilities.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, outcomes-oriented approach.
* Proven experience leading teams of data scientists, ML engineers, or GenAI engineers delivering enterprise AI or digital products for internal or commercial products.
* Strong delivery and execution mindset, with experience owning timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage product owners, functional leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong hands-on experience with: Python /Applied AI / ML / GenAI in production environments
* Cloud-based development and deployment environments
* Data pipelines and production-grade systems
* Ability to identify the right technical approach to solve business problems and guide teams accordingly.

Who You'll Work With

You will work closely with the People function & AI CoE leadership, Team Builder Product Owner, Tech owner, AI engineers, data scientists and stakeholders across the People function. You’ll partner with product functional and technical teams to ensure successful delivery and global adoption of AI solutions.

Additional info

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Manager – GenAI Engineering to lead the engineering, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and AI products within BCG's Internal People function and will play a critical role in driving the technical strategy, engineering delivery from build, QA to production and global adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities for various BCG's internal digital products that supports HR/People processes.

The Senior Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team of GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists while remaining hands-on in architecture, solution design, Python development, technical reviews, and production engineering.

The role requires a combination of deep GenAI technical expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, product thinking, delivery leadership, and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

title: Machine Learning Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**  
Distribution & Supply Technology (DST) powers the platform that lets travelers search, book, and experience travel across Expedia Group's brands, including Expedia, Hotels.com , and Vrbo. DST owns Pricing, Inventory, Content, and Marketplace Trust & Safety. Together, these teams source high-quality supply, price it competitively, enrich it with trusted content, and keep our two-sided marketplace safe for travelers and partners.
  
  
Machine learning is central to all of it. Our Content systems manage hundreds of millions of digital assets, using ML and LLMs to enrich listings, summarize reviews, and moderate text. Our Pricing models optimize real-time prices across millions of products. Our Trust & Safety models detect policy violations, fraud, and safety risks before they become traveler-facing failures.
  
  
You'll work closely with Machine Learning Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product partners in a fast-paced Agile environment to build, deploy, and operate production ML and GenAI systems at scale. That includes batch and real-time inference pipelines, model evaluation and monitoring, and platform capabilities that cut duplicated effort across teams.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain machine learning software and solutions that deliver reliable, secure, and measurable product or engineering outcomes.
* Translate product, business, and technical requirements into scalable machine learning solutions using sound software engineering practices.
* Contribute to low-level system design, API design, data modeling, and technical decisions that support maintainable, resilient, and operationally reliable applications.
* Own machine learning features or components through design, implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, production support, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate across engineering, product, design, data, and other technical teams to deliver outcomes and apply your expertise across multiple problem spaces.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions, using foundational AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, and customer outcomes.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience owning machine learning features or components within a service or application from design and implementation through testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Proficiency in software development, machine learning solution development, API integration, data modeling, version control, automated testing, debugging, and production support.
Familiarity with low-level system design and developing maintainable, reliable, secure, and operationally resilient software solutions.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering machine learning products or services at scale, with a focus on performance, reliability, security, operational excellence, and measurable customer or business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of machine learning applications.
* Experience contributing to architecture and design decisions across multiple services or technical domains while collaborating effectively with partner teams.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, or customer outcomes.
Experience safely integrating, monitoring, and operating AI/ML-enabled features in production, with attention to reliability, governance, and measurable impact.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Lead Data Engineer - T&T
description:
**Lead Data Engineer - T&T**
============================

GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

  

**What We Bring To The Table:**

The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits you’d expect from a global leader (401k, health insurance, paid time off, etc.) we also offer:

* Competitive compensation

* Career growth opportunities

* Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices

* We prioritize our communities and the planet we share. We are proud to be awarded as a Diversity Inc. Top 50 company for Diversity and have multiple Sustainability awards (ranking #22 in the World and #1 in Food Products)

* Wellbeing programs including Physical, Mental and Financial wellness

* Tuition assistance

  

**Position Overview**

As a Data Engineer at McCormick, you will play a pivotal role in the build and delivery of data products from simple to complex and supporting McCormick business units with their data and analytics needs.

Your responsibilities will include delivering and supporting data for existing analytics solutions, tooling, and solutions, researching new features and implementing automations. You will support business users, Data Scientists and Data Analysts to convert business expectations into data products and data models usable by business to deliver AI, analysis, reporting, and data-driven recommendations to stakeholders and executives.

This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineer will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from 1-3 source systems.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Execute

* Collaborate with data product managers to gather data requirement

* Execute ETL solutions including data security, data quality and performance requirements.

* Prepare documentation of data product lineage and all other related ETL topics.

2. Data Extraction, Load and Transformation

* Implement and maintain ELT pipelines to efficiently ingest and transform data from a wide variety of data sources and deliver datasets that meet business requirements.
* Ensure efficient and reliable data mapping to support business needs.
* Deliver complete documentation and knowledge transfer sessions for the Team and business partners.
* Maintain existing solutions, implement optimizations and enhancements, monitor data quality.
* Support the development and maintenance of scalable data pipelines leveraging Azure Synapse, PySpark, APIs, and SQL & performing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and manipulation to ensure high-quality, and reliable data flows.

3. Process Improvement, Performance and Cost optimization tuning

* Collaborate with Data Science, AI, and Data product teams to optimize performance and cost effectiveness of their solutions.
* Identify and support the design of internal process improvements, including automating manual processes, optimizing data product delivery, and redesigning solutions for enhanced scalability.
* Implement solution adjustments to improve performance and cost-effectiveness of data products.

4. Issue Resolution and Support

* Assist stakeholders with data-related product pipeline issues and support their data product needs.
* Work with the Analytics Operational Support team to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve data errors / discrepancies.
  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

**Level of Education and Discipline**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Science, or related field
  

**Certifications and/or Licenses**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-900) or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate or related cloud technologies, Fabric IQ/databricks certifications a plus
  

**Experience**

* 8-12 years of data engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability coding in one or more languages (PySpark preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Basic SQL performance tuning.
* Structured + semi-structured data handling.
* Unit testing for pipelines.
* Git-based workflow.
* Exposure to medallion architecture.
* Understanding of data privacy basics.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Effective communication skills and ability to communicate effectively on technical and business issues both internally and externally.
* Ability to work independently, navigate problems, resolve conflicts, and bring solutions to the table.
* Build strong interpersonal relationships
* Time management and prioritization skills
* Strong technical curiosity and passion for problem solving and innovation
* Ongoing aspiration to learn about new industry tools

**Other Skills & Competencies**

* Knowledge of data analysis, visualization techniques, and frameworks.
* Experience performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience with the following tooling:
* SQL, Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, Azure DevOps (for CI/CD), OR (Secondary)
* GCP BigQuery, FiveTran, GCP Cloud Composer, GCP DLP (Data Loss Prevention), GCP Cloud Run, Vertex AI etc

  
  

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

**WHY WORK AT MCCORMICK?**
--------------------------

As a McCormick employee you’ll be empowered to focus on more than your individual responsibilities. You’ll have the opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself—to have a say in where the company is going and how it’s growing.

Between our passion for flavor, our 130-year history of leadership and integrity, the competitive and comprehensive benefits we offer, and our culture, which is built on respect and opportunities for growth, there are many reasons to join us at McCormick.

title: Staff IAM Engineer
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Senior Manager - AI & IT

### **What You Will Be Doing**

You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
