title: Sr Engineer II - SecOps Insider threat
description:
At Aristocrat, we are at the forefront of entertainment and technology, pushing boundaries to build world-leading gaming content. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play, and our culture is built on innovation, creativity, and integrity. As a Sr Security Analyst, you will play a crucial role in our Security Operations Center (SOC), ensuring the safety and integrity of our systems. This is an outstanding opportunity to join a dynamic team, collaborate globally, and drive impactful security initiatives. Your expertise will be instrumental in protecting our assets and supporting our mission to deliver world-class gaming experiences. Join us and be part of an ambitious team that values connection and strives for excellence!

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the incident lead for handling and investigating high-severity and complex security incidents from beginning to end. Focus on defining the incident scope, containment, eradication, and recovery phases. Work closely with technical and business partners. Assume responsibility for the root-cause analysis.
* Lead complex, multi-stage investigations across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS telemetry, including advanced malware analysis, credential-compromise, and lateral-movement investigations.
* Define detection strategy aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and the organization’s threat model; identify and recommend new detection logic across SIEM, XDR, EDR, and SOAR.
* Conduct threat hunts guided by threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and gaps in detection coverage; convert findings into new detections, playbooks, and control recommendations.
* Lead Tier 2 SOC operations, ensuring shift priorities, case load, and blocking issue flow meet SLAs and quality standards.
* Build and maintain SOC playbook, runbook, and knowledge-based library; ensure content stays current with tooling and threat changes.
* Identify, build, and recommend process improvements across the SOC, measuring and reporting their impact.
* Chip in to and help implement the multi-year security operations strategy, including detection coverage roadmap, telemetry strategy, automation targets, and capability maturity.
* Interpret security findings as risk-centered advice for security engineering, IT, and business collaborators.
* Mentor and develop Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts through structured mentoring, investigation walkthroughs, and technical training.
* Participate in cross-functional forums and collaborate with global security teams to ensure a cohesive, consistent approach to security operations.
* Provide senior on-call coverage for major incidents involving blocking issues.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or an equivalent blue-team role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Advanced certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, Microsoft SC-200 or equivalent are highly regarded.
* Expert knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and Entra ID charge techniques; able to reconstruct an intrusion from raw logs without a playbook.
* Strong experience in cloud security monitoring and response across at least one major provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Proficiency in Python or PowerShell for automation, data analysis, and tooling integration.
* Deep solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, the incident response lifecycle, malware analysis, and phishing investigation.
* Track record of defining standards, processes, and playbooks, and of improving them based on evidence.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor analysts and raise the technical bar of a team.
* Clear, structured technical writing, including incident reports, RCAs, and briefings for senior technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong influencing and teamwork skills; able to work with engineering, IT, and business groups locally and globally to promote change without direct authority.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links

2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/

title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**

ASCENRA Technologies is looking for a Lead Security Engineer to become our first dedicated security hire and own security across our product and cloud platform.  
You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and CEO, owning security architecture, cryptography, cloud security, application security, CI/CD security, threat modelling, detection and incident response.  
This is a hands-on security engineering and architecture role, not a security operations or scanner-management position.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own security architecture across cloud, application, cryptography and platform security.
* Design and manage encryption, key hierarchies, KMS/HSM, certificate lifecycle and mTLS.
* Secure AWS environments including IAM, KMS, SCPs, VPC segmentation, CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Security Hub.
* Lead application security for Node.js/TypeScript applications, including OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, authorization and multi-tenant isolation.
* Build and maintain threat models and security controls.
* Implement security gates across CI/CD including SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanning.
* Lead security incident response and act as incident commander when required.
* Own tenant isolation, secure SDKs, supply-chain security and secure software releases.
* Drive security assurance, VAPT, penetration testing and compliance controls.
* Work on AI/LLM security including Amazon Bedrock, RAG pipelines and vector stores.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* **7+ years** of security engineering experience.
* **3+ years as a Lead/Senior-most Security Engineer** owning security design decisions for a production software product.
* Strong hands-on experience with **AWS Security**, IAM, KMS, SCPs, VPC, CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Security Hub.
* Strong applied cryptography experience including **envelope encryption, key hierarchies, key rotation, HSM/KMS, certificates and mTLS**.
* Strong **Application Security** experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, authorization and multi-tenant security.
* Hands-on experience with **OWASP Top 10 / API Security**.
* Experience building **CI/CD security gates** using SAST, SCA, secret scanning and IaC scanning.
* Hands-on **threat modelling** experience.
* Experience leading **security incident response**.
* Strong **Terraform** skills and scripting experience with Python or Shell.
* Ability to distinguish genuine security risks from scanner noise and communicate security trade-offs clearly.

**Good to Have**

* Merkle trees, hash chaining, signed receipts or trusted timestamping.
* BYOK/HYOK, HSM or KMIP.
* Wiz/CNAPP/CSPM.
* Amazon Bedrock, RAG and LLM security.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on AWS Connect & CX AI Engineer to design, build, and maintain reusable customer experience demonstrations on AWS -Amazon Connect as the core contact center platform.

  

This role combines Amazon Connect engineering, conversational AI, generative AI, backend integration, analytics, and demo development. The primary objective is to create client-ready solutions that can be rapidly configured for RFPs, pursuits, workshops, and industry-specific CX use cases.

  

The ideal candidate can independently translate a business use case into a working AWS demonstration, explain the architecture to business and technical stakeholders, and document the solution for reuse by other team members.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Key Responsibilities 1. Amazon Connect Administration & Omnichannel Configuration Configure and administer Amazon Connect instances, users, security profiles, queues, routing profiles, hours of operation, phone numbers, and agent workspace. Design and develop contact flows for inbound and outbound customer journeys. Configure voice and chat capabilities and integrate email, SMS, and WhatsApp use cases where supported by the selected architecture. Configure agent, supervisor, recording, monitoring, and reporting experiences. Set up and demonstrate Tasks, Cases, Customer Profiles, and outbound engagement capabilities where applicable. 2. Conversational AI & Customer Self-Service Develop Amazon Lex voice and chat bots using intents, slots, prompts, validation, fulfilment, and fallback logic. Build conversational IVR and self-service journeys for authentication, intent discovery, knowledge retrieval, transaction completion, confirmation, and escalation. Design controlled handoff from bots to human agents with relevant customer and interaction context. Create reusable conversational components, prompts, business rules, and industry-specific customer journeys. 3. Generative AI, Agent Assist & Agentic AI Configure Amazon Q in Connect for knowledge recommendations, contextual guidance, suggested responses, interaction summaries, and after-contact work. Develop generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, knowledge bases, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, guardrails, and validation controls. Build AI agents for customer self-service, agent assistance, workflow execution, and exception handling. Design MCP-enabled tools or equivalent service interfaces that allow AI agents to retrieve information and execute approved actions. Implement human-in-the-loop controls, confirmation steps, and traceability for agentic workflows. 4. AWS Integration & Development Develop backend business logic and integrations using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and CloudWatch. Integrate Amazon Connect journeys with mock or enterprise CRM, case management, order management, billing, appointment, and service management systems. Develop secure REST API and event-driven integration patterns with appropriate IAM and access controls. Use Python for backend development and automation; working knowledge of Node.js or TypeScript is preferred. Apply source control, deployment, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting practices across demo assets. 5. Conversation Analytics & Quality Monitoring Configure Contact Lens for transcription, conversation analytics, sentiment analysis, contact themes, keyword detection, and interaction search. Build demonstrations for automated quality evaluation, compliance checks, contact-driver analysis, interaction summaries, and supervisor insights. Create dashboards and outputs that explain self-service completion, transfer reasons, customer themes, and operational opportunities. Validate analytics outputs and clearly document assumptions, limitations, and data dependencies. 6. Demo Factory Development & Presales Support Build reusable AWS CX demo environments and accelerators that can be configured for retail, banking, utilities, healthcare, telecom, education, and other industries. Develop end-to-end demonstrations covering self-service, human handoff, agent assist, workflow completion, conversation analytics, and reporting. Partner with CX transformation, solution, engineering, sales, and presales teams to convert client requirements into credible demonstrations. Create demo scripts, architecture diagrams, sample data, configuration guides, deployment documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. Support RFP responses, client workshops, technical walkthroughs, and live demonstrations. Document security considerations, production dependencies, known limitations, and assumptions without overstating demo readiness. 7. Engineering Ownership & Reusability Own the design, build, test

----------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–18 years of overall experience in cloud application development, contact center technology, conversational AI, or related engineering roles.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and developing solutions on Amazon Connect.
* Practical experience building voice and chat bots using Amazon Lex.
* Experience with Amazon Q in Connect and Contact Lens, including agent assistance, knowledge recommendations, analytics, or quality use cases.
* Hands-on AWS development experience using Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, and REST APIs.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, knowledge bases, guardrails, and AI agent patterns.
* Strong Python development capability; exposure to Node.js or TypeScript is preferred.
* Experience integrating contact center solutions with CRM, case management, order, billing, or service platforms.
* Ability to independently design, build, test, demonstrate, document, and troubleshoot an end-to-end solution.
* Good understanding of contact center operations, customer journeys, routing, quality monitoring, and operational reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building reusable demo environments, proof-of-concepts, solution accelerators, or presales prototypes.
* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, or similar agent integration patterns.
* Experience with Amazon Connect Customer Profiles, Cases, Tasks, outbound campaigns, and related workforce or quality capabilities.
* Knowledge of OpenSearch, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or Terraform.
* Integration experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Relevant AWS certifications in Solutions Architecture, Development, Machine Learning, or related areas.
* Experience supporting client workshops, technical presentations, RFPs, and live demonstrations.
  

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong hands-on ownership and delivery orientation
* Structured problem-solving and solution design capability
* Ability to operate independently in an evolving presales environment
* Clear communication with business and technical stakeholders
* Ability to convert requirements into practical and demonstrable customer journeys
* Strong collaboration across transformation, sales, architecture, and engineering teams
* Focus on reusability, documentation, reliability, and technical credibility

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
The MongoDB Documentation team is a group of writers and engineers who develop and maintain the documentation for the MongoDB product family. Our goal is to help our readers, both humans and AI, successfully use MongoDB products by providing outstanding documentation. The MongoDB Documentation team is a part of the MongoDB Core Product organization and is tightly integrated with the engineering teams responsible for each product.

The Docs team is responsible for documenting all aspects of the MongoDB data platform including the database, query language, Atlas, Vector Search, VoyageAI models, Full-Text Search, Stream Processing, client libraries, administrative tools, connectors, and more.

Your AI-forward mindset coupled with strong writing and technical skills will create clear reference docs and tutorials on high-complexity features. Your work, along with the other two MongoDB Docs teams, support AI agents, answer engines, and a large global community of new and experienced MongoDB users.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon, Bengaluru or Mumbai for our hybrid working model.

### **Candidate Profile:**

Candidates must have experience in a technical writing, technical communications, developer relations, or similar role in the software industry. Beyond industry experience, we are looking for someone who:

* Has experience writing technical documentation from scratch in English
* Possesses strong critical reading and writing skills
* Has hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate documentation work
* Leverages sound editorial judgment to evaluate AI-generated content against source material for technical accuracy
* Has experience with cloud and database technologies
* Is able to read code for technical examples in at least one programming language (e.g., C++, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript)
* Has experience testing and validating documentable features and concepts

### **Position Expectations:**

* Advocate for users in everything you write
* Work with technical and non-technical teams to meet the documentation needs of our users
* Research complex product features and validate with diligent testing
* Produce technically accurate and well-written documentation
* Contribute feedback to the team through copy review and planning discussions

### **Success Measures:**

In 3 months:

* You'll be comfortable with our toolchain, AI tooling, and writing workflow
* You can implement small to medium complexity documentation requests
* You're getting to know our server engineers and are getting comfortable with participating in intra and inter team discussions
* You've completed the required technical training and courses required for MongoDB Engineering

In 6 months:

* You are getting comfortable doing deep dives into database architecture and technology as part of feature documentation
* You've got a working knowledge of the MongoDB data platform and know who to follow up with when you need to learn more
* You've adapted to our style of writing and your work demonstrates technical writing best practices
* You begin reviewing the work of your peers and learning from it
* You and your manager have discussed your career trajectory and growth opportunities
* You've helped the team improve and establish effective, well-vetted AI-assisted workflows for drafting and review

In 12 months:

* You're creating consistently high quality documentation for entire feature sets, complex tutorials, and high level concepts
* You know how much work you can manage and are contributing at a healthy pace
* You provide quality copy and technical reviews for your team members
* You provide best practices and coaching on AI-assisted workflows for your team members

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Design Engineer — PCB & Embedded Boards
description:
THE ROLE

We build industrial inspection systems — computer vision and AI retrofitted onto factory automation lines. The cameras, controllers, and I/O boards those systems run on are designed in house, and we are looking for the engineer who owns them.

This is not a supervised seat. You will take compact camera and embedded boards from block diagram through to a validated, manufacturable revision, and stay with them through bring-up, pilot builds, and the field issues that follow. Expect 4–8 layer boards, tight mechanical envelopes, and hardware that has to survive a shop floor.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

* Architecture and schematic capture for industrial camera and embedded compute boards — power tree, sensor interfaces, connectors, protection, and component selection you can defend.
* Multilayer PCB layout end to end: stackup and impedance planning, placement, routing of high-speed interfaces (MIPI CSI-2, USB, LVDS, Ethernet), power integrity, and EMI/thermal decisions.
* Design review discipline — ERC/DRC clean, DFM/DFA reviewed with the assembler, and manufacturing packages (Gerbers, drills, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly notes) released without rework loops.
* Board bring-up and validation: test plans, bench measurement, debugging with scope and analyzer, failure analysis, and revision notes that close the loop into the next spin
* Vendor and supply ownership — fabricators, assemblers, and distributors; second sources, lifecycle risk, and cost per board.
* Library and documentation standards in KiCad, plus mentoring one or two interns on layout and release hygiene

WHAT WE EXPECT

* 2–5 years designing production electronics; B.E./B.Tech in ECE, EEE, or equivalent practice.
* At least two boards you took from schematic to a manufactured, working revision — you can walk us through the mistakes and what the next spin fixed. Fluent in KiCad, or fluent in Altium/OrCAD and willing to move to KiCad as the house tool.
* Comfortable with datasheets, reference designs, and layout guidelines as primary sources; comfortable saying a design is not ready.
* Hands-on lab ability: soldering and rework, scope, DMM, logic analyzer, bring-up of an unpowered board you have never seen working.
* Written communication that survives handoff — schematics, notes, and reviews that another engineer can act on.

STRONG BONUS

* Image sensor integration, camera modules, or optics-adjacent hardware.
* SoM/SBC carrier design (NVIDIA Jetson, i.MX, Raspberry Pi CM) or FPGA-attached interfaces.
* Industrial I/O and field robustness — 24 V rails, isolation, surge and ESD, IP-rated enclosures.
* Firmware or driver literacy (C, embedded Linux device trees) enough to debug across the hardware boundary.
* Experience taking a board through EMC pre-compliance or a certification cycle.
* Mechanical CAD collaboration — STEP exchange, connector and mounting fit checks.

WHAT YOU GET

* Full ownership of the hardware line — your name on the boards, not on a subsection of someone else's.
* Short loop from design to deployment: our boards ship into live factory lines within months, not years.
* Prototyping budget, lab access, and no approval theatre for parts and spins you can justify.
* Flexible hours, and a small team where hardware sits in the room with the vision and firmware engineers.

HOW TO APPLY

Send a resume plus one page on a board you designed: what it did, the layout constraint that hurt most, and how you solved it. Gerbers, schematics, or photographs welcome — a portfolio beats a keyword list.

Process: portfolio screen → 60-minute technical conversation walking through your own design → a short take-home review of a real schematic → offer.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Lead Engineer - L3 Observability
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies.
* Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles.
* Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented.
* Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads.
* Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends.
* Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management.
* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices).
* Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout.
* Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including:
* Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups.
* APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments.
* Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs.
* Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance.
* SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level.
* Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments.
* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.
* Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units.

**Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic)**

* Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers.
* Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging.
* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents.
* Strong documentation and process-governance discipline.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Work Details**

* **Level:** L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations

title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
description:
**Senior AI Evaluation Analyst**

**Location:**
Kochi

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Role Overview**

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation.
* Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets.
* Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency.
* Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems.
* Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
  
  
With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. description:

Role

Enterprise Solutions AI Applied Engineer

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Core Mission
  
  
The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. The role focuses on implementing agentic and Generative AI features using established patterns, grounded in enterprise knowledge and data.
  
  
This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role combining hands-on implementation with light product ownership and operational discipline.
  
  
1. Applied Solution Delivery & Iteration (65% of time)
  
Build and enhance AI-powered features (e.g., copilots, summarization, classification, routing, Q&A) aligned to defined business workflows.
  
Partner with business users to clarify requirements, run demos, capture feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes.
  
Support pilot launches, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to smooth adoption through user training and clear documentation.
  
  
2. Knowledge-Based Agents & Conversational Design (25% of time)
  
Develop agents grounded in the company’s internal knowledge base, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and retrieval quality improvements.
  
Design conversational flows for internal functions (e.g., HR helpdesk), including intent handling, escalation paths, and handoff to human support when needed.
  
Implement simple agentic or predictive models for operational use cases (e.g., predicting customer support ticket volume) under guidance from senior engineers.
  
  
3. Product Execution, Quality & Documentation (10% of time)
  
Manage the feature backlog for an AI product area: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and coordinate UAT.
  
Contribute to evaluation and regression testing using approved checklists; help monitor quality, latency, and cost for deployed features.
  
Create and maintain documentation (how-to guides, runbooks, and user enablement materials) to support long-term sustainability.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
3+ years of experience in software engineering or applied solutions development (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Proficiency in Python and API-based integration; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns.
  
Working familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to implement tool/function calling patterns.
  
Basic understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements; ability to follow established guardrails and escalate risks early.
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

title: Kafka Senior Engineer - Officer
description:
**Kafka Senior Engineer**

  

**Who we are looking for**

As a Senior Middleware Platform Engineer, you will be working in a fast paced environment in a team of highly skilled engineers responsible for leading platform engineering, design, and implementation of next generation messaging infrastructure. You will also be expected to assist and act as final level of support for the production services supported by the team.

What you will be responsible for

  
  

**As Kafka Senior Engineer you will:**

* Design, Engineer, and Evangelize Kafka Messaging across the enterprise

* Lead in the design and engineering of our first Kafka Cluster on a Public Cloud (Azure, AWS, other) using Ansible, Terraform, Python

* Lead and assist in providing direction for Junior Engineers

* Work with Enterprise Architecture team in identifying and implementing use cases best suited for Kafka

* Write code to automate tasks ( request processing, product installations, health checks, proactive monitoring, alerting, reporting, predictive analytics )

* Write Kafka producer code and Kafka consumer code within consumer groups to test the Kafka client APIs, develop Kafka application best practices, and help safely onboard Kafka applications to our Kafka platforms (across programming languages/platforms)

* Configure and test pre-built Kafka Connectors for integrating Kakfa with other systems

* Design, code, and test new Kafka Connectors where needed for integrating Kakfa with other systems

* Perform optimization and tuning of Kafka

* Design monitoring solutions for the platform and baseline statistics reporting

* Work on creating best practices, standards, Integration patterns and on-boarding process automation

* Ability to work with application development teams to understand usage pattern and provide solutions

* Lead in collaborating with other infrastructure teams to achieve high resiliency and scalability of our Kafka Messaging platforms

* Provide technical expertise in scoping end to end business requirements and assist in reflecting them in implementation for different Kafka connectors

* Conduct technical reviews of integration implementation for all SDLC phases to assess the quality of integration solutions built on Kafka

* Strive to provide highly resilient Kafka Messaging systems using the latest high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) technology solution

  
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

* Love of writing code/programming

* Solid coding ability to write robust, fault tolerant, well tested code. Any scripting/programming language is fine but with willingness to learn Python, Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Shell. Experience with source code control system

* Experience working on Red Hat Linux

* Deep level of understanding of Kafka Messaging or another Messaging technology

* Experience with finding root cause for problems with Kafka or Applications using Kafka (or another Messaging technology)

* Experience with tuning Kafka systems (or other Messaging systems)

* Experience with supporting Application architectures SEDA, Kappa, and Lambda or similar

Education & Preferred Qualifications

* Programming and automation experience.

* 8+ years of experience preferred but not required depending on candidate

* Computer science degree preferred but not required depending on candidate

* Experience with high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions for middleware or other platforms

Additional requirements

* This is a “hands on keyboard” engineering position

* L4 ability to drive a project and collaborate within our team and with other application and infrastructure teams

* L4 ability to troubleshoot complex issues

* Occasional weekend work may be required for Prod deployments/changes

* Our engineers will need to create new docs and SOPs for use by our support team and perform some cross training of the support team members

  

**Work Schedule**

* No Hybrid Working. It is fully Working from Office

* Schedule – APAC or EMEA time

* Location – Bangalore or Hyderabad (Candidates not willing to relocate need not apply)

  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of Platform Engineering Middleware, a function that is vital to the company as we execute over 2 million job runs per day in Autosys, support 3,500 web sites on over 3,000 servers (both internal and external facing), 5 Billion messages per day traverse Kafka and MQ across more than 150,000 queues, and we handle over 2 million file transfers per day. State Street is one of 6 banks designated by the federal reserve as GSIB (Global Systemically Important Bank) with nearly 4 trillion USD in AUM. Our Middleware platforms touch all areas of the company and are the vital plumbing serving all the banks activities. As a GSIB we operate under a strict oversight program from the Federal Reserve and must ensure our systems are operating at full capacity 24/7.

  

**About State Street**

**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

  
  

**About State Street**

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

**All about the role**

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager.

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner.

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way.

**About the CDI Experience Organization**

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI.

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation.

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently.

**What you'll do**

* Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders.
* Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms.
* Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side.
* Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release.
* Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click).
* Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion.

Work across a stack that includes:

* Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor.
* Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas.
* Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices.
* Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible.
* Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets.
* Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met.
* Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends.

But…the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement.

**Who are you**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter.
* Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript.
* Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards.
* Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery.
* Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**Desirable qualifications and experience**

* Knowledge of AWS.
* Heap dump and thread dump analysis.
* Experience with Git.
* Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud.
* Strong understanding of Datadog RUM.

**Where you'll be**

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred.

**Benefits Highlights**

* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

title: Senior Java Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

### **Position Description**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end-to-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship & State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security & Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft-delete, restore, permanent-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product & Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality & Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).
* **Data Management:** Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., **MySQL**) and caching strategies (e.g., **Redis**) to manage state and high-throughput data snapshots.
* **API Design:** Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust **RESTful APIs** for enterprise integration.
* **Problem Solving & Ownership:** Proven track record of independently breaking down ambiguous requirements into clean, scalable software designs.

### **Nice to Haves**

* Familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Experience with resilient systems design (e.g., retry strategies, circuit breakers, rate limiting).
* Hands-on experience with feature flagging frameworks and gradual/canary deployment strategies.
* Experience with queueing systems or message brokers (e.g., Kafka).

### **Education and Training**

* **B.S. or M.S.** in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

description:

**Invent the future with us.**

  
  
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.

* Be part of the emulation verification execution team and be responsible for planning, development, and execution of test content in varied domains including system stress, cache coherency and concurrency.

* **Full-Stack & Dashboards:** Develop microservices (Node.js, Python/FastAPI) and front-end monitoring tools (React) to visualize fleet health, telemetry logs, and control remote edge assets in real time.

* **Field Testing & System Validation:** Lead integration testing on physical hardware setups, simulate adverse network conditions (latency, intermittent drops), and support operational detachments or field-site deployments for root-cause diagnosis.

title: Engineer III - Site Reliability, Kubernetes
description:
