We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike is hiring an Engineer III to join the Kubernetes Platform team supporting the continued global expansion of the Falcon platform. You will be a key member of our India-based coverage for the Kubernetes environments that run CrowdStrike services across our own data centers and public clouds. We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on engineer with solid Kubernetes operating experience who can independently own platform support and improvement work, handle production incidents during India hours, and help grow less experienced engineers on the team.

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Independently operate and support large-scale Kubernetes clusters across custom data centers and public clouds (AWS, GCP, OCI), owning their availability, health, and lifecycle
* Serve as a primary responder for platform incidents during India hours — diagnosing complex node, networking, DNS, storage, and control-plane issues, driving them to resolution, and handing off cleanly across time zones
* Plan and execute cluster upgrades, add-on rollouts, and capacity changes end to end, including risk assessment, testing, and rollback planning
* Improve the reliability of the platform: identify recurring issues and technical debt, propose fixes, and see them through
* Design, build, and improve monitoring, alerting, and dashboards with Prometheus, Thanos, Alertmanager, and Grafana so problems are caught before customers notice
* Develop automation and tooling in Go to eliminate toil, and contribute to Kubernetes controllers and operators used by the team
* Evaluate open-source tools and Kubernetes add-ons and help integrate them into existing workflows
* Use AI technologies to streamline operational workflows, accelerate troubleshooting, and improve decision-making
* Write design docs, runbooks, and post-incident reviews that are clear to engineers, on-call responders, and stakeholders
* Mentor Engineer I and II team members through pairing, code review, and design review, and take part in interviewing new team members

**What You'll Need:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering, including 3+ years operating production Kubernetes clusters at scale
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes internals and operations: control plane (API server, etcd, scheduler), kubelet and container runtime, networking/CNI, DNS, storage, and upgrades
* Experience with Prometheus, Thanos, Alertmanager, and Grafana
* Proficiency in Go; Python a plus
* Experience with large-scale, business-critical Linux environments
* Experience operating in at least one public cloud (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and in on-premises or custom data centers
* Experience with infrastructure as code and deployment tooling (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitOps) and version control with git
* Familiarity and ability to manage on-call shifts [aligned to India business hours]
* Demonstrated experience using AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, and improve efficiency
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

  

* Experience writing Kubernetes operators or controllers
* Experience operating Kubernetes on bare metal
* Experience deploying microservices
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience mentoring or onboarding other engineers
* Proven ability to work effectively with both local and remote teams across time zones

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

  
A day in the life  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.  
  
Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.  
  
Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times  
  
About the team  
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.

* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.

This Manager MP&L - AI and Digital Transformation role will play a strategic and transformational leadership role responsible for pioneering the next gen capabilities identifying opportunities to improve Planning, Material Fulfilment, Logistics, Material flow & inventory pillars through innovative thinking, intelligent automation and scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

The candidate will bridge the gap between complex supply chain operations and advanced technology, transforming real-time data into predictive, self-healing, and highly optimized material planning and logistics networks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the AI and Innovation roadmap for MP&L department aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Identify, evaluate and implement high-impact projects where AI/ML, Generative AI, Computer Vision, IoT, and Digital Twins can optimize inventory levels, Improve BOM Health, reduce freight costs, mitigate supplier risks, and streamline material handling and improving operational performance.
* Establish metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the business value, ROI, and operational efficiency gains of deployed AI solutions.
* Champion innovation by evaluating emerging technologies, piloting new concepts, and scaling successful solutions across the organization.
* Develop predictive and prescriptive analytics for demand forecasting, inventory optimization, material shortage prediction, supplier risk management, and logistics optimization.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain, Purchasing, PD, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance IT, GDIA and external partners to deliver innovative and scalable solutions.
* Drive utilizing the governance forums to monitor innovation initiatives and AI solutions, track business benefits and drive continuous improvement.
* Foster an innovation culture by promoting idea generation, facilitating innovation workshops, sharing best practices, and building AI and digital capabilities across the function.
* Serve as the MP&L liaison to external innovation ecosystems, including tech startups, university research labs, supply chain / logistics software vendors, and industry consortiums.
* Drive change management and training initiatives to foster a data-driven, innovation-first culture within the global MP&L organization.
* Apply Lean / Six Sigma principles alongside digital tools to eliminate waste, lower carbon footprints (sustainable logistics), and enhance supply chain resilience.

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* **AI & Analytics:** Practical understanding of machine learning algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, time-series forecasting), optimization modelling, deep learning, computer vision, and Generative AI applications.
* **Supply Chain Systems:** Expertise in modern ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), and Material Requirements Planning (MRP).
* **Data & Cloud Platforms:** Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI), and data processing architectures (SQL, Python/R capabilities).
* **Emerging Tech:** Exposure to IoT sensors, RFID tracking, Digital Twin simulation tools, Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), and edge AI.
* Strategic Thinking, Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Change Leadership, and Cross-functional Collaboration

**Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies**

* **Strategic Thinking:** Ability to translate complex operational challenges into actionable AI technical roadmaps.
* **Change Management:** Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, from plant floor operators to executive leadership.
* **Agile Delivery:** Experience working in Agile environments for software and product development.
* **Communication**: Exceptional storytelling and executive presentation skills with the ability to articulate technical AI concepts in clear business terms.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations research, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Technology, or a related discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 8–12 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Material Planning and Logistics areas.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, analytics, automation, or digital transformation initiatives in a manufacturing or automotive environment.
* Proven track record of taking AI/ML or advanced analytics projects from concept to production with measurable business impact

  **Preferred Certifications (Plus)**
* Certified in Production and Inventory Management or Certified Supply Chain Professional.
* Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.
* AI/Data Science professional certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty).

title: AI Full Stack Developer
description:
**AI Full Stack Developer**  
**Contact : kiruthiga@ztshr.com / 9940999250**

**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an AI Full Stack Developer to build AI systems from data preparation and model training through inference, APIs and user interfaces. The role requires hands-on work across model fine-tuning, alignment, agent development and production deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Model Training and Fine-Tuning**

* Prepare training datasets through deduplication, quality filtering and data curation.
* Run continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning and instruction-tuning pipelines.
* Apply LoRA, QLoRA, adapters or full fine-tuning based on task requirements.
* Work with distributed training using FSDP, DeepSpeed or parallel training approaches.
* Track configurations, datasets, seeds, checkpoints and evaluation results.
* Measure model quality and catastrophic forgetting after training.

**Alignment and Evaluation**

* Build preference datasets and reward models.
* Apply methods such as RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, KTO, ORPO or reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.
* Design reward functions and identify reward hacking.
* Incorporate safety and refusal behaviour into alignment datasets.
* Maintain benchmarks, custom evaluation datasets and regression tests.

**Agents and Context Management**

* Build agents that plan, call tools, verify results and recover from errors.
* Develop agent control loops, tool routing, state management, retries and stop conditions.
* Build MCP servers and clients to connect tools, data and services.
* Manage retrieval, memory, summarisation and context compaction.
* Evaluate task success, tool errors and cost per task.

**Inference and Application Development**

* Serve models using vLLM, TGI or llama.cpp.
* Apply quantisation and measure its impact on model quality.
* Optimise time to first token, throughput, latency and GPU utilisation.
* Build asynchronous FastAPI services with Pydantic validation.
* Implement streaming through Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.
* Add authentication, rate limits, quotas, audit logs and background workers.
* Build React or Next.js interfaces using TypeScript.
* Develop dataset viewers, annotation tools and evaluation dashboards.

**Infrastructure and Operations**

* Containerise services with Docker and deploy on Kubernetes or managed GPU platforms.
* Maintain CI/CD for code, models and datasets.
* Monitor traces, logs, token usage, latency, errors and model drift.
* Maintain rollback procedures for model releases.

Required Skills

* Strong Python skills and working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Hands-on experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TRL, PEFT, Accelerate and Datasets.
* Experience with SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, distributed training and dataset curation.
* Practical experience in at least one alignment method, with measured results.
* Knowledge of tool calling, MCP, agent loops and context management.
* Experience with model serving, quantisation and latency optimisation.
* FastAPI, asynchronous Python, Pydantic, PostgreSQL and Redis.
* Embeddings, vector databases and RAG pipelines.
* Docker, Git, Linux, CI/CD and GPU memory planning.
* Strong evaluation, debugging and technical documentation skills.

Preferred Skills

* Federated learning or privacy-preserving training.
* Custom CUDA or Triton kernels.
* Model distillation and merging.
* Guardrails, red teaming and jailbreak testing.
* Multimodal models involving vision, speech or documents.
* On-premises or air-gapped deployments.
* Relevant open-source contributions.

Application Requirements

Share an updated CV along with one of the following:

* A model training or fine-tuning project with evaluation results.
* A repository containing an agent, MCP server or inference service.
* A short case study explaining an AI problem solved and how results were measured.

title: AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Description: AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Designation:** AI-Powered Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist  
**Experience:** 2–4 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on, AI-enabled Digital Content & Social Media Marketing Specialist to strengthen brand visibility, audience engagement, and digital marketing performance across social media platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end content production, including video shooting, video editing, graphic design, creative content development, social media scheduling, organic promotion, paid campaign coordination, and performance reporting.

The role requires someone who can transform business updates, product information, industry insights, expert inputs, and internal marketing materials into engaging digital content using a combination of creative skills, AI tools, and data-driven marketing practices.

The candidate must be comfortable coordinating with internal teams, subject-matter experts, and management to collect information, obtain approvals, maintain consistent brand messaging, and deliver content that supports business and marketing objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Video Shooting & Production — Primary Responsibility**

* Plan, shoot, and produce short-form and long-form videos for social media, websites, campaigns, and business promotions.
* Independently handle video shooting using smartphones, cameras, microphones, lighting equipment, and other available production tools.
* Record interviews, expert discussions, product demonstrations, company updates, educational videos, behind-the-scenes content, and promotional videos.
* Plan video concepts, scripts, storyboards, shot lists, and production schedules.
* Edit videos with appropriate cuts, subtitles, captions, transitions, graphics, voiceovers, music, and brand elements.
* Create platform-specific video formats, including vertical short-form videos, reels, shorts, and landscape videos.
* Use AI-assisted video tools for captioning, transcription, background cleanup, audio enhancement, translation, resizing, and editing efficiency.
* Ensure videos are technically sound, visually appealing, factually accurate, and consistent with the approved brand identity.
* Maintain an organised library of raw footage, edited videos, source files, and approved final assets.

**B. Graphic Design & Creative Content Production**

* Design social media posts, carousels, infographics, promotional creatives, banners, thumbnails, event creatives, and campaign materials.
* Convert internal documents, product information, research findings, testimonials, case studies, and expert insights into visually engaging marketing assets.
* Create graphics that simplify technical, scientific, and business information for relevant audiences.
* Use design tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, or equivalent applications.
* Use AI-assisted design tools to generate creative concepts, visual variations, layouts, and supporting assets.
* Verify all AI-generated visuals and text for accuracy, licensing considerations, brand suitability, and misleading representations.
* Maintain consistent typography, colour palettes, logos, visual styles, and messaging across channels.
* Prepare multiple creative formats and dimensions for different platforms.

**C. AI-Powered Content Creation**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and suitable image, audio, and video tools to support ideation, scripting, editing, repurposing, and campaign development.
* Develop video scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, calls to action, hashtags, and content variations.
* Repurpose a single approved source into multiple assets, such as a video, carousel, infographic, LinkedIn post, newsletter visual, and short-form clip.
* Create AI-assisted content workflows and reusable prompts to improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Fact-check claims, statistics, technical statements, testimonials, and AI-generated information before publication.
* Ensure content is original, audience-focused, natural, and aligned with the organisation's expertise and positioning.
* Avoid fabricated customer stories, misleading synthetic visuals, unverified claims, and unauthorised use of personal likenesses or voices.

**D. Social Media Content Planning & Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain a monthly social media content calendar aligned with marketing priorities, campaigns, launches, events, and industry developments.
* Plan content themes, formats, publication dates, channels, target audiences, and calls to action.
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and other business-relevant channels.
* Coordinate with internal teams to collect updates, footage, product information, expert inputs, and campaign requirements.
* Ensure all posts follow brand guidelines, platform specifications, and internal approval procedures.
* Maintain a publishing tracker containing content status, approval records, scheduled dates, live URLs, and performance results.
* Ensure consistent posting while prioritising quality, relevance, and audience needs.

**E. Social Media Promotion & Audience Engagement**

* Promote published content through appropriate organic distribution strategies and relevant professional communities.
* Identify suitable industry groups, partner pages, expert networks, and audience segments for legitimate content distribution.
* Coordinate approved paid social campaigns with the marketing lead when required.
* Monitor comments, shares, messages, mentions, and audience feedback.
* Respond to routine audience interactions within approved communication guidelines and escalate business enquiries, complaints, or sensitive issues to the relevant team.
* Encourage meaningful engagement through educational content, expert perspectives, interactive posts, polls, and question-led formats.
* Coordinate with internal teams to amplify relevant company updates and approved campaigns.
* Avoid fake engagement, automated spam, purchased followers, and misleading engagement tactics.

**F. Platform-Specific Content Strategy**

* **LinkedIn:** Develop professional posts, industry insights, expert clips, company updates, carousels, thought-leadership content, and B2B campaign assets.
* **Instagram:** Create reels, stories, carousels, behind-the-scenes videos, and visually engaging educational content where relevant.
* **YouTube:** Produce educational videos, expert interviews, explainers, product demonstrations, and Shorts.
* **Other relevant channels:** Adapt content to audience behaviour and business objectives rather than publishing identical content everywhere.
* Optimise captions, titles, thumbnails, descriptions, hashtags, and calls to action according to platform best practices.

**G. Social Media Analytics & Engagement Reporting**

* Track content performance using native platform analytics and relevant reporting tools.
* Monitor reach, impressions, views, watch time, average viewing duration, completion rate, engagement rate, shares, saves, comments, profile visits, link clicks, and audience growth where available.
* Track website traffic, leads, enquiries, and conversions attributable to social campaigns where measurement is available.
* Identify top-performing content, underperforming formats, audience preferences, and opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular reviews of posting times, creative formats, hooks, video lengths, and calls to action.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports with screenshots, live URLs, metrics, comparisons, insights, and recommended actions.
* Distinguish organic performance from paid campaign results and report the measurement period and platform accurately.
* Use performance insights to refine the next content calendar and improve engagement quality over time.

**H. Internal Coordination & Brand Governance**

* Coordinate with Business Development, Sales, Product, Research, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations teams to collect content inputs.
* Obtain testimonials, case studies, expert commentary, product updates, customer insights, and event materials.
* Convert the collected inputs into publication-ready visual and video content.
* Obtain management approval before publishing external content, following the organisation's established approval process.
* Ensure brand positioning, terminology, claims, and visual identity remain consistent.
* Obtain consent and necessary permissions before publishing customer testimonials, interviews, identifiable individuals, or confidential business information.
* Maintain records of source materials, approvals, final creatives, publication links, and performance reports.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or relevant qualification in Digital Marketing, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in digital content production and social media marketing, preferably supported by a portfolio.
* Hands-on video shooting, editing, graphic design, and creative content production skills.
* Practical experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of AI tools for content creation, video editing, design assistance, transcription, and creative ideation.
* Experience managing content calendars, scheduling posts, and publishing across multiple platforms.
* Understanding of social media analytics, engagement metrics, audience behaviour, and content optimisation.
* Strong visual storytelling, writing, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently from content planning through production, publishing, and reporting.
* Good organisational skills and the ability to meet publishing schedules.

**4. Preferred Skills**

* Experience with B2B, SaaS, manufacturing, food, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, scientific, or technology brands.
* Experience filming professional interviews and creating educational or technical videos.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn analytics, YouTube Studio, Meta Business Suite, and scheduling tools.
* Understanding of AI-assisted video generation, synthetic voice tools, automated captioning, and creative automation.
* Familiarity with UTM links, website analytics, campaign tracking, and lead attribution.
* Experience supporting paid social campaigns and optimising content based on performance data.

Specific monthly targets should be established after assessing available resources, existing audience size, platform baselines, and campaign priorities. Success should not be measured by follower count or post volume alone.

description:
**Job Description: AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist**

**Department:** Marketing  
**Designation:** AI Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

We are seeking an AI-aware Content Marketing & Thought Leadership Specialist to develop high-quality marketing content, strengthen brand positioning, and improve visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.

The candidate will coordinate with internal teams, industry experts, and subject-matter specialists to collect business information, customer testimonials, case studies, product insights, research inputs, and technical information. These inputs must be transformed into clear, engaging, fact-checked, and approved marketing materials.

The role involves industrial article writing, expert interviews, email newsletters, LinkedIn content, AI search visibility monitoring, brand messaging consistency, content reporting, and preparation of authoritative brand information for appropriate online platforms.

The ideal candidate should combine excellent writing and reporting skills with practical knowledge of AI-assisted content workflows, SEO, and emerging AI search and answer engines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Internal Marketing Coordination & Content Development**

* Coordinate with internal teams, including Business Development, Sales, Product, Research, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations, to collect marketing information and supporting materials.
* Obtain customer testimonials, case studies, success stories, product information, technical insights, research findings, and business updates.
* Convert internal inputs into usable marketing assets, including website content, articles, brochures, newsletters, social media posts, presentations, and sales-support materials.
* Conduct follow-ups with responsible team members to obtain missing information, supporting documents, evidence, and approvals.
* Maintain a structured content repository containing source materials, drafts, approved versions, publication links, and supporting references.
* Ensure all marketing materials are reviewed and approved by the designated authority before publication.

**B. AI-Assisted Content Creation & Quality Assurance**

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and other relevant platforms for research assistance, content structuring, drafting, editing, summarization, and content repurposing.
* Convert technical and industry-specific information into accurate, readable, audience-appropriate content.
* Develop reusable AI prompts, content templates, and workflows to improve productivity and consistency.
* Fact-check AI-generated content against reliable sources and approved company information.
* Verify statistics, scientific claims, quotations, references, and regulatory statements before publication.
* Ensure AI-generated content is original, useful, natural, and aligned with the brand's expertise and tone.
* Avoid fabricated testimonials, unsupported claims, invented citations, and unverified AI-generated answers.
* Maintain records of source materials, fact-checking, editorial reviews, and content approvals.

**C. Industrial Articles & External Publications**

* Research and write articles for relevant industrial magazines, trade publications, industry portals, and professional publications.
* Identify suitable publications and prepare content pitches, article proposals, author profiles, and submission emails.
* Coordinate with subject-matter experts to obtain technical inputs, industry perspectives, and supporting evidence.
* Translate expert knowledge into authoritative articles, explainers, opinion pieces, and thought-leadership content.
* Track editorial submissions, acceptance status, revisions, publication dates, and published links.
* Ensure that external articles meet the publication's editorial guidelines and preserve the company's approved positioning.

**D. Expert Coordination & Interviews**

* Identify relevant internal and external experts for interviews, expert commentary, technical articles, and thought-leadership campaigns.
* Coordinate interview schedules, prepare interview questions, collect background information, and manage follow-ups.
* Convert interviews, transcripts, and expert inputs into articles, Q&A features, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, and website content.
* Obtain expert review and approval for technical accuracy and publication consent where required.
* Maintain an expert database containing areas of expertise, interview records, approved quotations, and content opportunities.

**E. Email Newsletter Development**

* Plan and prepare periodic email newsletters for relevant audiences, including industry stakeholders, customers, partners, and professional networks.
* Collect approved updates from internal teams and convert them into concise, useful newsletter content.
* Develop newsletter subject lines, headlines, summaries, calls to action, and supporting links.
* Coordinate review, approval, scheduling, and distribution with the responsible marketing or email operations team.
* Monitor delivery, open rates, click-through rates, engagement, and other available performance metrics.
* Maintain consistent messaging and ensure mailing practices follow applicable privacy and consent requirements.

**F. LinkedIn & Brand Communication**

* Prepare and manage a content calendar for LinkedIn and other approved professional channels.
* Create posts, industry insights, article summaries, expert quotations, company updates, case-study highlights, and campaign content.
* Repurpose approved long-form content into short-form posts, carousels, newsletters, and other suitable formats.
* Coordinate with internal teams to obtain relevant updates, visuals, data, and approvals.
* Maintain consistent brand voice, terminology, positioning, and visual-content coordination.
* Monitor engagement and use performance insights to improve future content.

**G. AI Search Visibility & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)**

* Monitor the brand's visibility and representation across AI-powered search and answer platforms, where measurable.
* Track relevant industry keywords, brand mentions, citations, source references, and the accuracy of AI-generated answers.
* Develop content that clearly answers relevant industry questions and demonstrates expertise, experience, authority, and trustworthiness.
* Create question-led articles, FAQs, expert explainers, comparison content, and evidence-backed educational resources.
* Improve content structure, factual clarity, source attribution, and entity consistency to support discoverability in traditional search and AI-generated answers.
* Record representative AI-generated answers for selected queries, identify missing or inaccurate brand information, and recommend corrective content improvements.
* Monitor conventional SEO performance through Google Search Console and other available analytics tools.
* Prepare periodic AI visibility reports using a consistent set of prompts, queries, platforms, and observation dates.

**Important:** AI answer visibility can fluctuate and cannot be guaranteed. Reporting should distinguish observed mentions and citations from estimated visibility, and should not treat a single AI response as proof of ranking or authority.

**H. Keyword & Content Performance Monitoring**

* Maintain a keyword and topic tracker covering target keywords, search intent, content status, rankings, and visibility trends.
* Identify content gaps and new opportunities through keyword research, competitor analysis, industry questions, and customer-facing team inputs.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic impressions, clicks, engagement, referrals, and conversions where measurable.
* Review content performance regularly and recommend updates, new articles, or content consolidation where appropriate.
* Prepare actionable reports highlighting progress, gaps, risks, and next steps.

**I. Wikipedia & Authoritative Brand Information**

* Prepare factual, neutral, well-sourced company or industry background write-ups for editorial review and potential use on appropriate knowledge platforms.
* Research reliable independent sources, published coverage, verifiable company information, and relevant industry references.
* Draft encyclopedic-style content that follows the relevant platform's notability, neutrality, sourcing, and conflict-of-interest policies.
* Distinguish independently published sources from company-owned materials and press releases.
* Coordinate transparent, policy-compliant submissions or edit suggestions where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate company descriptions and consistent brand facts across approved business profiles and public information sources.

**Wikipedia compliance:** Creating a write-up does not guarantee that a Wikipedia article will be accepted or retained. The candidate must not create promotional or unsupported content, disguise a conflict of interest, or promise a Wikipedia page as a deliverable.

**J. Reporting, Documentation & Content Operations**

* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing content reports with measurable outputs and outcomes.
* Maintain trackers for content requests, source-material collection, drafting, review, approval, publication, and performance.
* Report the number of assets created, articles submitted and published, expert interviews completed, newsletters delivered, and LinkedIn posts published.
* Maintain evidence of published work, URLs, campaign results, approvals, and source references.
* Prepare management-ready summaries, dashboards, and presentations.
* Highlight pending inputs, approval delays, content gaps, and recommended priorities.
* Ensure that every reported activity is traceable to a document, published link, tracker entry, or analytics source.

**3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Marketing, Life Sciences, Food Science, Biotechnology, or a related discipline.
* Strong written English, editing, proofreading, research, and documentation skills.
* Practical experience using AI tools for research assistance and content development.
* Knowledge of SEO, keyword research, content optimization, and AI search visibility concepts.
* Ability to coordinate professionally with internal teams, industry experts, and external publications.
* Strong reporting, spreadsheet, presentation, and documentation skills.
* Ability to understand technical or scientific information and communicate it accurately to business audiences.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn content, email newsletters, editorial submissions, and content calendars.
* High attention to detail, fact-checking, source verification, and approval processes.

**4. Preferred Skills**

* Experience in B2B, SaaS, scientific, manufacturing, food, nutraceutical, cosmetics, healthcare, or regulatory-focused industries.
* Experience contributing articles to trade magazines or professional publications.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent tools.
* Experience preparing case studies, customer stories, expert interviews, and executive thought-leadership content.
* Understanding of Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and AI search monitoring.
* Experience with newsletter tools, editorial calendars, and content performance dashboards.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance should be assessed on both output quality and measurable results.

* **Content coordination:** Timely collection of required inputs from internal teams and experts.
* **Content production:** Number of approved articles, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, case studies, and other marketing assets completed.
* **Publication outcomes:** Articles pitched, accepted, published, and linked to verifiable publication evidence.
* **Expert engagement:** Interviews coordinated and approved expert contributions converted into content.
* **AI content quality:** Accuracy, originality, source verification, and approval compliance.
* **SEO performance:** Target keyword coverage, organic impressions, clicks, and relevant ranking trends.
* **AI search monitoring:** Completed prompt/query checks, observed brand mentions, citations, and documented improvement opportunities.
* **Brand consistency:** Compliance with approved positioning, terminology, tone, and messaging.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of accurate weekly and monthly reports.
* **Process compliance:** Proper documentation, traceability, and approval before external publication.

Targets should be finalized after reviewing the existing content pipeline, available expert inputs, publication opportunities, and marketing resources.

You will lead penetration testing, application security, and vulnerability management; embed Secure SDLC/DevSecOps with engineering; secure and govern AI-enabled capabilities; and communicate security risk clearly to technical and business stakeholders. title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (LLM)
description:
**Job Description:**

**Don't Apply if you are a Fresher**

**Senior AI/ML Engineer (LLM) — Nabo.E**

About Nabo.E

Nabo.E builds conversational AI agents and customer intelligence for businesses that serve customers at scale. Our agents handle voice, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, email and web chat end to end, from first enquiry to confirmed booking, and turn every conversation into intelligence that grows revenue.

We are in production with government bodies and fast-growing businesses in India. . The models behind this are the product, and we are hiring the engineers who will build the next generation of them.

**The role**

Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (LLM) Experience: 5+ years

Location: Hyderabad Type: Full-time

You will own the training, fine-tuning and serving of the large language models that power Nabo.E's agents. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will write the training code, run it on multi-GPU clusters, evaluate the results on real customer conversations and ship models to production across six channels in multiple Indian languages.

You report to [Head of AI / CTO] and work directly with the founders, the platform team and client-facing engineers.

**What you'll do**

\* Design, pretrain and fine-tune transformer language models at 30B+ parameter scale, from data pipeline to checkpoint.

\* Run distributed training across multi-node GPU clusters using FSDP, DeepSpeed or Megatron-LM; profile and fix throughput, memory and stability issues.

\* Build and maintain data pipelines for large-scale text and conversation corpora: deduplication, filtering, tokenization, quality scoring, multilingual (Indian language) coverage.

\* Post-train models for Nabo.E's agents: SFT, DPO/RLHF, tool use, function calling and structured output on real customer conversations.

\* Build evaluation suites that measure what matters to us: intent classification accuracy, booking conversion, hallucination rate, latency, multilingual quality.

\* Optimise models for production serving: quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, vLLM/TensorRT-LLM deployment, cost per conversation.

\* Train the predictive models behind our playbooks: booking likelihood, drop-off risk, best time and channel, add-on fit.

\* Write clean, tested, reviewable Python; own your code from experiment to production.

\* Mentor other engineers and set the technical bar for ML work at Nabo.E.

Must have

\* 5+ years of hands-on ML/AI engineering, with at least 2 years on large language models.

\* Conversational intelligence experience. You have built or worked on a conversational AI or customer-intelligence platform in production: chatbots, voice agents, contact-centre AI, intent classification, dialogue management, conversation analytics. You understand what breaks when real customers talk to a model at scale.

\* Python expert. Deep understanding of the language itself: the data model, memory and the GIL, async, generators, typing, metaprogramming, packaging and profiling. You write idiomatic, performant code and libraries others depend on. We will test this.

\* Strong algorithms and data structures. You reason about complexity and choose the right structure under real constraints, and you can solve hard problems on a whiteboard and in code.

\* Architectural ability. You have designed systems end to end: data pipelines, training infrastructure, model serving, APIs. You make trade-offs deliberately and can defend them.

\* Logical, structured thinking. You break ambiguous problems into clear parts, form hypotheses, and let evidence decide.

\* Data science fundamentals. Statistics, experiment design, evaluation metrics, exploratory analysis with pandas/NumPy/SQL; you can pull insight out of millions of conversations.

\* Deep PyTorch expertise: custom modules, autograd, mixed precision, torch.compile, CUDA-aware debugging.

\* Proven experience training or fine-tuning models at 30B+ parameters, including distributed training across multiple nodes (FSDP, DeepSpeed ZeRO, Megatron-LM, or equivalent). You can explain the parallelism choices you made and why.

\* Strong understanding of transformer internals: attention variants, positional encodings, MoE, KV-cache, tokenizers, scaling laws.

\* Experience building large-scale data pipelines for pretraining or fine-tuning corpora.

\* Experience with post-training methods: SFT, DPO, RLHF, or similar.

\* Experience taking models to production: serving, monitoring, cost and latency optimisation.

\* Linux, Git, containers and at least one cloud GPU platform (AWS, GCP, Azure, Lambda, or on-prem clusters).

\* Clear written and spoken communication; you can explain a training run's results to a non-ML founder.

Nice to have

\* Contributions to open-source ML projects (PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, DeepSpeed, etc.) or published research.

\* Experience with speech models: ASR, TTS or speech-to-speech for voice agents.

\* Experience with Indian languages (Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Odia, Tamil and others) in NLP or LLM work.

\* Custom CUDA/Triton kernels, FlashAttention internals, or low-level performance work.

\* Experience with agent frameworks, tool use, RAG and conversation state management.

\* Background in recommendation or propensity modelling.

\* Previous startup experience or having built an ML team from scratch.

Who thrives here

\* You have trained something big and have the war stories: the NaN losses, the straggler nodes, the tokenizer bug found at 40% of the run.

\* You care whether the model actually converts a booking, not only whether the benchmark number went up.

\* You are a builder: you would rather ship a working v1 this week than a perfect design next quarter.

\* You can work with ambiguity, decide, and own the result.

\* You raise the bar for the people around you.

**Hiring process**

1. Intro call (30 min) with [name].

2. Technical deep-dive (60 min): a conversational AI system and a large training run you owned, and how you architected them.

3. Python, algorithms and data structures round (60 min, live coding).

4. Take-home: a small ML/data-science problem on conversation data, 2–3 hours.

5. Final round with founders.

**How to apply**

Send your CV, GitHub and a short note on the largest model you have trained or fine-tuned to

hr@nabo.enterprises. Links to papers, blog posts or open-source work are welcome.

, and we are an early, enthusiastic adopter of agentic AI development workflows.

**About the Role**

As a Machine Learning Engineer II, you will work alongside Senior and Staff engineers to build and maintain production ML pipelines, contribute to model development, and grow into a well-rounded ML engineer who bridges data science and software engineering. This is a hands-on role for someone with roughly 2–4 years of experience who is eager to work on high-impact ML systems at scale — from probabilistic identity graphs to single-title affinity models — and who wants to develop deep expertise across the full ML lifecycle.

**What You’ll Do**


ML Development & Modeling

Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and batch inference across use cases such as identity resolution, audience segmentation, and content affinity modeling.

Implement and experiment with supervised, unsupervised, and ranking models in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch).

Engineer features from first-party viewership, engagement, subscription, and behavioral signals, guarding against data leakage, collinearity, and training/serving skew.

Run structured offline experiments; evaluate with the right metrics (precision/recall, F1, AUC-ROC, calibration, lift) and document findings in MLflow.

ML Infrastructure & Engineering

Develop and maintain data and feature pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, Delta, Workflows) that feed the feature store and model-training workflows, with attention to idempotency and reproducibility.

Write clean, tested, production-quality Python following engineering best practices (unit tests, code reviews, CI/CD).

Use MLflow for experiment tracking, model registration, and versioning under the guidance of senior engineers.

Support deployment and monitoring of batch inference jobs integrated with downstream activation platforms (e.g., Mosaic, FreeWheel, GAM) and data in Snowflake.

Agentic AI & Modern Tooling

Use AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) to accelerate coding, debugging, and documentation under guidance.

Leverage
**Databricks Genie**
for natural-language exploration of governed Unity Catalog datasets — querying ML feature tables, model outputs, and audience segments.

Use
**Snowflake Cortex**
(Copilot / Cortex Analyst) to accelerate data analysis and SQL authoring against audience and identity schemas.









Learn and apply prompt-engineering patterns for LLM-assisted data exploration and feature generation, and participate in evaluating MCP (Model Context Protocol) tooling as the team expands agentic workflows.

Collaboration & Growth

Partner with Senior and Staff MLEs to understand system-design decisions and contribute meaningfully to technical discussions.

Work cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Feature Engineering, and Analytics to ensure data quality and pipeline reliability.

Document models, pipelines, and experiments clearly for team knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring
**Required**

2–4 years of industry experience in machine learning, data science, or ML engineering (or 1–2 years with a relevant M.S.).

Strong Python proficiency; experience with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and at least one deep-learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).

Hands-on experience with Spark/PySpark or equivalent large-scale data processing.

Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with cloud data warehouses/lakehouses (Snowflake or Databricks).

Experience with experiment-tracking tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar).

Solid grasp of core ML concepts: classification, regression, ranking, embeddings, and model evaluation; plus strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, clean code).

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).

Ability to use AI tools to independently improve productivity across the ML lifecycle, and clear written and verbal communication.

**Preferred**

Experience with Databricks (notebooks, Delta Lake, Workflows/DLT, Unity Catalog, MLflow).

Exposure to recommendation systems, audience segmentation, identity resolution, or forecasting.

Familiarity with AWS services (SageMaker, S3, Lambda) and/or feature stores (Databricks Feature Store, Feast).

Exposure to agentic AI tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex, or MCP.

**Job Description**
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, validate, and deploy machine-learning solutions that improve optical transceiver calibration quality, test time, yield, and equipment utilization.
* Build supervised-learning models for prediction, classification, regression, anomaly detection, and early test-outcome prediction using high-volume production and engineering test data.
* Evaluate and apply optimization techniques—including Bayesian optimization, reinforcement learning, and hybrid/model-based approaches—where they provide measurable benefit for multi-parameter tuning and expensive test operations.
* Develop robust feature-engineering, data-quality, model-training, and model-evaluation pipelines for test and trace data.
* Integrate ML inference and optimization services with production test software, Python APIs, databases, and existing automation frameworks.
* Establish model validation criteria, including accuracy, repeatability, test-time reduction, false-pass/false-fail risk, yield impact, and fallback behavior.
* Monitor production model performance, data drift, and operational failures; implement versioning, logging, alerting, rollback, and retraining mechanisms.
* Analyze test and manufacturing data to identify bottlenecks, correlations, failure signatures, and opportunities for test-suite optimization.
* Work closely with test-development, product engineering, manufacturing, and software teams to translate technical requirements into deployable solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers through technical reviews, design guidance, and hands-on problem solving.
* Prepare clear technical documentation, results summaries, and business-impact reporting for engineering and management stakeholders.
* Contribute to invention disclosures, patents, or technical publications where applicable.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Applied Physics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience developing and deploying applied AI/ML solutions in an engineering, manufacturing, test, semiconductor, optics, industrial, or similar environment.
* Demonstrated experience delivering at least one ML solution beyond proof of concept, including integration, validation, and operational support.
* Experience working with time-series, sensor, measurement, manufacturing, test, or high-dimensional engineering data is strongly preferred.
* Experience in optical transceivers, semiconductor test, high-speed electronics, signal integrity, or hardware test automation is a strong advantage.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong Python software-development skills, including clean, maintainable, testable, and production-oriented code.
* Hands-on experience with PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, or equivalent ML frameworks.
* Strong understanding of model development and evaluation: data preparation, feature engineering, cross-validation, metrics, bias/variance, model explainability, and error analysis.
* Experience with regression, classification, anomaly detection, and statistical analysis of engineering or manufacturing data.
* Experience building or consuming REST APIs and integrating ML components into larger software systems.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data-processing tools such as pandas, NumPy, and Parquet/CSV-based data pipelines.
* Familiarity with source control, code review, CI/CD, containerization, and Linux-based development environments.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Bayesian optimization, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, or constrained optimization applied to real-world systems.
* Experience with MLOps practices such as experiment tracking, model registry, model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining workflows.
* Experience with FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Airflow, MLflow, or similar production data and ML platforms.
* Familiarity with test automation or instrumentation interfaces, including oscilloscopes, DCA, BERT, optical power meters, source-measure units, or equivalent equipment.
* Knowledge of optical-transceiver test parameters such as extinction ratio, OMA, BER, TDECQ, equalization, bias control, and calibration workflows.
* Experience with statistical process control, yield analysis, correlation studies, and measurement-system analysis.
* Exposure to C#, .NET, LabVIEW, or integration with established test-execution frameworks.

**Working Conditions**

* Primarily onsite role based in Hyderabad, with collaboration across global engineering and manufacturing locations.
* Flexibility to support meetings with teams in different time zones when required.

* Ability to work with production and engineering test environments, subject to applicable site safety and access requirements.

title: AI Solution Expert
description:
**About The Company**
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
  
  
At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
  
  
B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
  
  
**About The Role.**
As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.
  
  
This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities.
  
  

* Architect and lead AI-driven solutions that automate content creation, adaptation, review, approval, and distribution across all content channels and markets
* Build and maintain production-grade applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, and related platform services
* Integrate large language models, image generation models, video models, and multi-modal AI systems into scalable content workflows
* Design and implement data pipelines that connect AI models to enterprise content repositories, PIM systems, DAM platforms, and downstream delivery channels
* Drive initiatives through the full lifecycle — from POC through MVP to enterprise-scale deployment — establishing engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and governance at each stage
* Collaborate cross-functionally with brand marketing, e-commerce, regulatory/legal, medical affairs, creative agencies, and IT to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, foundation models, and Azure services to continuously advance the content ecosystem
* Define governance standards for AI model usage, data quality, content compliance, brand safety, and responsible AI practices
* Mentor developers and engineers on AI/ML engineering patterns, cloud-native development, and Azure best practices

General Business
  
  
**Required Qualifications.**

* 8+ years of experience in software/application development, with a significant portion focused on AI/ML solution engineering
* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services
* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks
* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures
* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation
* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)
* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)
* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns
* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC → MVP → enterprise production
* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production
* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)
* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen
* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions

**Required Technical Skills.**
Cloud & AI Platform
  
  
Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service
  
  
Data Engineering
  
  
Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake
  
  
AI/ML Frameworks
  
  
LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX
  
  
Generative AI
  
  
Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines
  
  
DevOps & MLOps
  
  
Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS, MLflow, Weights & Biases, model registry, CI/CD for ML
  
  
App Development
  
  
REST / GraphQL APIs, React or Angular, FastAPI / Flask, microservices, serverless, event-driven architectures
  
  
Security & Governance
  
  
Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, responsible AI tooling, content safety APIs
  
  
General Business
  
  
Languages: Python, TypeScript / JavaScript, SQL
  
  
Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.
  
  

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations
* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)
* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics
* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)
* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)
* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments
* Knowledge of packaging artwork, labeling workflows, and regulatory/legal review cycles
* Familiarity with point-of-sale and in-store activation material production
* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)
* Understanding of regulatory submission, claims substantiation, and content compliance frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, local market regulations)
* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets
* Experience integrating with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Veeva, Salesforce, or Others
* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)
* Track record of working in AI Centers of Excellence or capability-building functions
* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

What You’ll Impact.
  
  

* Speed and cost-efficiency of content production across global markets
* Brand consistency and regulatory compliance across all consumer and professional touchpoints
* Data-driven decision-making through AI-powered content insights and performance analytics
* AI agentic automation and process efficiency gains
* The organization’s long-term AI and content technology roadmap

You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: AI Solutions Expert
description:

description:
**Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer (Databricks)**

Chryselys is looking for a Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer with strong experience in Databricks to run the machine learning lifecycle from experiment to production.

You will set up Databricks environments, turn notebooks into scheduled jobs, and package and deploy models with consistent runtimes, versioning, and monitoring. You will work with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders in healthcare and pharmaceutical domains.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set up and maintain Databricks for ML: workspaces, clusters, instance pools, cluster policies, Repos, and runtime versions.
* Provide notebook and job templates, shared libraries, and pinned environments so experiments can be repeated.
* Build CI/CD to promote notebooks, jobs, workflows, and models across development, staging, and production environments using Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps, with Databricks Asset Bundles or the Jobs and Repos APIs.
* Track, package, register, and deploy models with MLflow on Databricks, including batch scoring and model serving jobs.
* Build Databricks Workflows for training, retraining, evaluation, and inference, with task dependencies, retries, and alerts.
* Support classification, forecasting as Python and Spark jobs on Databricks.
* Tune cluster size, autoscaling, Spark settings, and Delta Lake reads and writes so jobs stay reliable and cost-efficient.
* Convert Data Scientist notebooks into production pipelines with clear inputs, outputs, and fixed dependencies.
* Apply Databricks controls: Unity Catalog for data and model access, secret scopes, service principals, and model versioning.
* Fix failed jobs, slow Spark runs, library conflicts, and environment differences across workspaces.
* Write standards and runbooks for workspace layout, cluster policies, job templates, and promotion from dev to production.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6–12 years in ML Engineering, MLOps, or platform engineering, including hands-on ML work on Databricks.
* Databricks experience with workspaces, clusters and policies, Jobs and Workflows, Repos, Delta Lake, and Spark (batch and streaming).
* MLflow on Databricks for experiment tracking, model packaging, and the model registry.
* Strong Python, plus working knowledge of PySpark or Spark SQL.
* CI/CD for Databricks with Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience deploying ML models on Databricks, Azure, AWS services.
* Clear debugging skills and the ability to work with data science and platform teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform, or workspace-as-code.
* Unity Catalog, cluster policies, and service principals for job runs.
* Azure ML services such as Azure Machine Learning and Amazon SageMaker for training, pipelines, or model deployment.
* Healthcare or pharmaceutical domain experience.
* Agile or Scrum.
* Python packaging on Databricks (pip or conda, and runtime libraries).

**Good to Have:**

* SQL and PySpark for reading, joining, and transforming data on Databricks.
* Simple pipelines that ingest data, clean it, and store it in Delta Lake.
* Data quality checks and schema handling.
* Familiarity with healthcare or pharma data, such as EHR, clinical, or patient and drug datasets.
