Conversion UX Strategist – Funnel Planning, Landing Pages & AI-Assisted UI

Job Description

We are looking for a **Conversion UX Strategist** who can plan, design, and improve landing pages that turn paid advertising traffic into qualified enquiries, leads, calls, WhatsApp conversations, and bookings.

This is a **strategy-first landing page role, not a website development or coding role**. You will understand the client's business, product or service, target audience, and campaign objective before planning the user journey and designing pages using AI-powered tools.

You will take ownership of the process from research and funnel planning to strategy documentation, client approval, AI-assisted UI design, launch coordination, and post-launch optimization.

We are looking for someone who can explain not just how a landing page should look, but **why each section exists, how it supports the campaign goal, and how the page encourages visitors to enquire**.

What You’ll Do1. Business, Offer & Audience Research

* Understand the client's business, main product or service, unique selling proposition (USP), and competitive advantages.
* Clarify the business goal and campaign objective, such as phone calls, WhatsApp enquiries, form submissions, or bookings.
* Define the target audience, including customer needs, pain points, motivations, objections, and reasons to trust the business.
* Research competitor landing pages, advertising messages, offers, and conversion approaches.
* Identify gaps in the client's current messaging and opportunities to improve relevance, clarity, and conversion potential.

2. Funnel Planning & Customer Journey

* Plan the complete conversion journey from advertisement to landing page, enquiry form or contact action, and thank-you page.
* Ensure the landing page message matches the advertisement that brought the visitor to the page.
* Define the next action visitors should take at each stage of the journey.
* Identify potential points of confusion, hesitation, or drop-off and recommend ways to address them.
* Align the landing page experience with the campaign objective and the client's sales process.

3. Landing Page Strategy & Structure

* Plan the page structure based on audience needs, offer strength, customer intent, and conversion goals.
* Define the purpose and content of key sections, including headlines, offers, benefits, proof points, FAQs, and calls to action.
* Plan the messaging hierarchy so visitors quickly understand what is offered, who it is for, and why they should take action.
* Recommend trust-building elements such as customer reviews, testimonials, case studies, certifications, and relevant business credentials.
* Plan enquiry forms and conversion actions that make it easy for visitors to contact the business.
* Explain the reasoning behind section order, content choices, CTA placement, and trust elements rather than relying on generic templates.

4. Strategy Documentation, Wireframes & Client Approval

* Prepare a clear landing page strategy document that explains the business objective, audience, offer, funnel journey, and recommended page structure.
* Create wireframes or structured page layouts to communicate the proposed user journey and information hierarchy.
* Document the purpose of each section, key messaging requirements, conversion actions, and credibility elements.
* Identify missing information and prepare focused questions for the client.
* Present the strategy in simple, professional language that clients can understand and approve.
* Incorporate relevant client feedback and obtain approval before proceeding with the final page design.

5. AI-Assisted Landing Page & UI Design

* Use AI-powered design tools to turn the approved strategy and wireframes into landing page UI.
* Create clean, conversion-focused layouts that support the campaign objective and user journey.
* Follow a mobile-first approach to ensure landing pages work effectively on smartphones and other screen sizes.
* Maintain consistency between ad messaging, landing page content, visual hierarchy, and calls to action.
* Review AI-generated designs for usability, content clarity, layout consistency, and conversion flow.
* Refine the design based on the approved strategy rather than allowing visual preferences to drive decisions.

6. Launch Coordination & Conversion Tracking

* Coordinate with the advertising team and developers to prepare landing pages for launch.
* Communicate page structure, content requirements, design specifications, and conversion actions clearly.
* Help ensure that forms, call buttons, WhatsApp links, thank-you pages, and other conversion elements function as intended.
* Work with the relevant team to confirm enquiry tracking and campaign measurement are set up correctly.
* Support the team in identifying issues that may affect the visitor experience or lead tracking.

7. Performance Review & Conversion Optimization

* Review post-launch performance using available campaign and analytics data.
* Evaluate enquiries, conversion rates, user drop-off, and other relevant performance indicators.
* Identify potential improvements to messaging, offers, page structure, forms, CTAs, and trust elements.
* Recommend and prioritize changes based on campaign objectives and observed performance.
* Collaborate with the advertising and development teams to implement and evaluate improvements.
* Use performance feedback to make future landing page strategies more effective.

Tools & Platforms

* AI-powered UI and design tools
* Wireframing and prototyping tools
* Google Docs for strategy documentation
* Landing page and website preview tools
* Analytics and conversion tracking platforms
* Advertising campaign dashboards
* Google Sheets for research and performance reporting
* AI-powered research and content tools

Experience

Practical experience in landing page strategy, conversion rate optimization (CRO), funnel planning, UX research, digital marketing, or AI-assisted UI design is preferred.

We value demonstrated ability over job titles. Candidates who can show landing page strategies, wireframes, client-approved plans, campaign landing pages, or measurable conversion results are encouraged to apply.

Experience planning landing pages specifically for paid advertising campaigns is an advantage.

Who Can Apply

* Freshers and experienced candidates who can demonstrate strong practical ability and strategic thinking.
* Candidates with experience in landing page planning, conversion optimization, funnel strategy, UX, or digital marketing.
* Individuals who research the business goal and target audience before making design decisions.
* Candidates who can independently plan a complete journey from advertisement to enquiry.
* People who can explain the purpose of each landing page section and justify their recommendations.
* Candidates who can write clear strategy documents and present plans for client approval.
* Individuals comfortable using AI tools to create wireframes and UI designs.
* Candidates who can collaborate with advertising teams and developers without needing to build or code the website themselves.

Skills Required

* Landing page strategy and conversion-focused UX
* Funnel planning and customer journey mapping
* Business, audience, and competitor research
* USP and offer positioning
* Landing page content structure and messaging hierarchy
* Wireframing and information architecture
* CTA strategy and enquiry flow planning
* Mobile-first UI design using AI tools
* Trust-building and objection-handling strategy
* Strategy documentation and client presentations

This Role Is NOT for You If

* Your primary experience is building websites on WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or similar platforms.
* You mainly work on HTML, CSS, or website development and do not want to focus on strategy.
* You begin projects by selecting a template or designing screens before understanding the business objective.
* Your portfolio contains only website screenshots without explaining the strategy, conversion goal, or results.

This Role IS for You If

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented QC Reviewer to ensure the quality and consistency of robot manipulation video annotations produced by our annotation team. You'll review labeled video segments against a detailed style guide and reference examples, catch errors or inconsistencies, and provide clear, constructive feedback to annotators. This role is critical to maintaining the accuracy and reliability of training data used for robotics AI models.

**Project Details:**

* Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotation QC
* Location: Remote in India/Philippines
* Employment type: Freelance
* Pay Rate: US$4.03/hour

**What You'll Do**

* Review completed annotations of robot manipulation videos across three levels of labeling detail (atomic motion, skill/subtask, task/goal).
* Cross-check annotator descriptions against all three camera views (overhead and both wrist-mounted cameras) to verify accuracy of described actions, object identification, and contact/grasp details.
* Verify full coverage of each video — confirm there are no gaps in labeling, including idle or pause moments.
* Check that descriptions accurately reflect what actually happened in the video, including failures, drops, or slipped grips — flagging any instances where outcomes were inaccurately described or "smoothed over."
* Evaluate annotations for adherence to the style guide: correct vocabulary usage, spatial/directional accuracy, consistent terminology for objects and actions, and appropriate language variation (avoiding repetitive phrasing).
* Identify recurring errors or patterns of confusion among annotators and report them to the team lead for calibration purposes.
* Provide specific, actionable feedback on rejected or revised annotations, referencing the style guide and reference examples.
* Participate in periodic calibration sessions with the team and client to align QC standards with evolving guidelines or edge-case resolutions.
* Maintain a QC log or tracking sheet documenting review outcomes, common error types, and annotator performance trends (as required by the project).

**What We're Looking For**

**Required:**

* Excellent written English and strong reading comprehension — you'll be evaluating precise, nuanced language choices, not just checking for typos.
* Exceptional attention to detail — able to catch subtle mismatches between video content and written description (e.g., a mislabeled grasp type, an incorrect object part, a missed failure event).
* Strong grasp of spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, object parts like handles, lids, edges) to verify annotator accuracy.
* Ability to apply a detailed, structured style guide consistently and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.
* Comfort giving clear, specific, and constructive feedback to annotators (written feedback, not just pass/fail marks).
* Reliable, self-directed work habits, with the ability to work independently while meeting review turnaround expectations.

**Nice to Have:**

* Prior experience in a QC, editing, proofreading, or annotation review role.
* Experience with video annotation, data labeling, or transcription QA specifically.
* Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation).
* Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio, including review/approval workflows.

title: AI Video Annotator
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.

**Project Details:**

* Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator
* Location: Remote in India/Philippines
* Employment type: Freelance
* Pay Rate: US$3.5/hour

**What You'll Do**

1. Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

2. Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

3. Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

* Atomic motion (a few seconds) — a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")
* Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) — a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")
* Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) — the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

4. Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels — no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

5. Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

6. Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

7. Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

8. Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.

**What We're Looking For**

Required:

1. Strong written English — you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

2. Sharp attention to detail — able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).

3. Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.

4. Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges).

5. Reliable, self-directed work habits — this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision.

Nice to Have:

1. Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work.

2. Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) — helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained.

3. Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.

title: Track Manager (Support & Operations)
description:
Track Manager (Support & Operations)

Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Applied AI Technologist**

*(AI Experience Technologist)*

**About the role**
==================

We're looking for an Applied AI Technologist who can turn a customer's business problem into a working, production-ready AI solution. You'll work at the point where customer conversations and hands-on building meet. You'll understand what the customer needs, picture the end state, build it quickly with AI-assisted development, and make sure it holds up in a real enterprise environment.

This is a builder role for someone with sound engineering judgment. Vibe coding lets you move fast, and your fundamentals decide what is good enough to ship.

Experience : 3 to 10 years

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Customer and requirements**
-----------------------------

* Work directly with customers to understand their business problems, clarify vague requirements, and turn them into clear solution outcomes.
* Picture the end state for customers and end users, and show it early with prototypes, mockups and demos.
* Get up to speed quickly on new domains and customer contexts, and know when to bring in specialists.
* Explain solutions, trade-offs and risks clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

**Building with AI**
--------------------

* Design and build solutions quickly with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
* Guide LLMs precisely, with structured prompting, context engineering and step-by-step iteration, so the output is accurate and consistent.
* Build LLM-powered applications, including agentic workflows, RAG pipelines and tool or function-calling integrations where relevant.
* Design user experiences that are intuitive, useful and fit how end users actually work.

**Engineering quality and production readiness**
------------------------------------------------

* Review, test, debug and harden AI-generated code. Understand what the AI produced before shipping it, and reject what doesn't meet the bar.
* Take solutions from prototype to production: deployment, integration with customer systems (APIs, identity, data sources) and maintainable handover.
* Design evaluations, test cases and guardrails to measure and improve LLM output quality, reliability and safety.
* Apply security, data-privacy and responsible-AI practices in every solution, especially when handling customer data.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

* **Programming:** Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or front-end (React, JavaScript/TypeScript) or back-end development, with solid software engineering fundamentals: code structure, testing, debugging, version control and basic architecture.
* **AI-assisted development:** Expert in vibe-coding workflows. Can break problems into steps, steer AI agents effectively, and review output critically.
* **Prompting and LLM steering:** Deep expertise in prompt design, including system prompts, few-shot examples, reasoning techniques, structured outputs, tool use and context management.
* **LLM evaluation:** Experience defining success criteria, building test sets and evaluating model output systematically.
* **Deployment and integration:** Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), APIs, containers or serverless, and CI/CD basics.
* **Security and responsible AI:** Understanding of data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection risks and enterprise compliance.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and spoken English. Can explain complex ideas clearly and concisely, and present with confidence to customers.
* **Mindset:** Learns fast, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows what AI should and shouldn't be used to build.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, MCP) or enterprise AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI).
* Experience in a customer-facing, consulting or pre-sales role.
* A background in UX, design thinking or product management.
* A portfolio of AI solutions, demos or open-source work that you've built and deployed.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Selection process**
=====================

* **Screening conversation:** background, communication and customer orientation.

* **Live build exercise (90–120 minutes):** Candidates get a deliberately vague customer brief. They are expected to:

* + ask questions to clarify the requirement
  + build a working solution using AI tools of their choice
  + walk through what they built and what they would fix, secure or test before production.

* **Customer-scenario discussion:** role-play presenting the solution to a business stakeholder.

* Take solutions from prototype to production: deployment, integration with customer systems (APIs, identity, data sources) and maintainable handover.
* Design evaluations, test cases and guardrails to measure and improve LLM output quality, reliability and safety.
* Apply security, data-privacy and responsible-AI practices in every solution, especially when handling customer data.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

* **Programming:** Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or front-end (React, JavaScript/TypeScript) or back-end development, with solid software engineering fundamentals: code structure, testing, debugging, version control and basic architecture.
* **AI-assisted development:** Expert in vibe-coding workflows. Can break problems into steps, steer AI agents effectively, and review output critically.
* **Prompting and LLM steering:** Deep expertise in prompt design, including system prompts, few-shot examples, reasoning techniques, structured outputs, tool use and context management.
* **LLM evaluation:** Experience defining success criteria, building test sets and evaluating model output systematically.
* **Deployment and integration:** Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), APIs, containers or serverless, and CI/CD basics.
* **Security and responsible AI:** Understanding of data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection risks and enterprise compliance.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and spoken English. Can explain complex ideas clearly and concisely, and present with confidence to customers.
* **Mindset:** Learns fast, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows what AI should and shouldn't be used to build.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, MCP) or enterprise AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI).
* Experience in a customer-facing, consulting or pre-sales role.
* A background in UX, design thinking or product management.
* A portfolio of AI solutions, demos or open-source work that you've built and deployed.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Selection process**
=====================

* **Screening conversation:** background, communication and customer orientation.

* **Live build exercise (90–120 minutes):** Candidates get a deliberately vague customer brief. They are expected to:

* + ask questions to clarify the requirement
  + build a working solution using AI tools of their choice
  + walk through what they built and what they would fix, secure or test before production.

* **Customer-scenario discussion:** role-play presenting the solution to a business stakeholder.

Design and develop contact flows for inbound and outbound customer journeys. Configure voice and chat capabilities and integrate email, SMS, and WhatsApp use cases where supported by the selected architecture. Configure agent, supervisor, recording, monitoring, and reporting experiences. Set up and demonstrate Tasks, Cases, Customer Profiles, and outbound engagement capabilities where applicable. 2. Conversational AI & Customer Self-Service Develop Amazon Lex voice and chat bots using intents, slots, prompts, validation, fulfilment, and fallback logic. Build conversational IVR and self-service journeys for authentication, intent discovery, knowledge retrieval, transaction completion, confirmation, and escalation. Design controlled handoff from bots to human agents with relevant customer and interaction context. Create reusable conversational components, prompts, business rules, and industry-specific customer journeys. 3. Generative AI, Agent Assist & Agentic AI Configure Amazon Q in Connect for knowledge recommendations, contextual guidance, suggested responses, interaction summaries, and after-contact work. Develop generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, knowledge bases, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, guardrails, and validation controls. Build AI agents for customer self-service, agent assistance, workflow execution, and exception handling. Design MCP-enabled tools or equivalent service interfaces that allow AI agents to retrieve information and execute approved actions. Implement human-in-the-loop controls, confirmation steps, and traceability for agentic workflows. 4. AWS Integration & Development Develop backend business logic and integrations using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, and CloudWatch. Integrate Amazon Connect journeys with mock or enterprise CRM, case management, order management, billing, appointment, and service management systems. Develop secure REST API and event-driven integration patterns with appropriate IAM and access controls. Use Python for backend development and automation; working knowledge of Node.js or TypeScript is preferred. Apply source control, deployment, monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting practices across demo assets. 5. Conversation Analytics & Quality Monitoring Configure Contact Lens for transcription, conversation analytics, sentiment analysis, contact themes, keyword detection, and interaction search. Build demonstrations for automated quality evaluation, compliance checks, contact-driver analysis, interaction summaries, and supervisor insights. Create dashboards and outputs that explain self-service completion, transfer reasons, customer themes, and operational opportunities. Validate analytics outputs and clearly document assumptions, limitations, and data dependencies. 6. Demo Factory Development & Presales Support Build reusable AWS CX demo environments and accelerators that can be configured for retail, banking, utilities, healthcare, telecom, education, and other industries. Develop end-to-end demonstrations covering self-service, human handoff, agent assist, workflow completion, conversation analytics, and reporting. Partner with CX transformation, solution, engineering, sales, and presales teams to convert client requirements into credible demonstrations. Create demo scripts, architecture diagrams, sample data, configuration guides, deployment documentation, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. Support RFP responses, client workshops, technical walkthroughs, and live demonstrations. Document security considerations, production dependencies, known limitations, and assumptions without overstating demo readiness. 7. Engineering Ownership & Reusability Own the design, build, test

* 4–18 years of overall experience in cloud application development, contact center technology, conversational AI, or related engineering roles.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and developing solutions on Amazon Connect.
* Practical experience building voice and chat bots using Amazon Lex.
* Experience with Amazon Q in Connect and Contact Lens, including agent assistance, knowledge recommendations, analytics, or quality use cases.
* Hands-on AWS development experience using Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, and REST APIs.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, knowledge bases, guardrails, and AI agent patterns.
* Strong Python development capability; exposure to Node.js or TypeScript is preferred.
* Experience integrating contact center solutions with CRM, case management, order, billing, or service platforms.
* Ability to independently design, build, test, demonstrate, document, and troubleshoot an end-to-end solution.
* Good understanding of contact center operations, customer journeys, routing, quality monitoring, and operational reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

----------------------

* Exposure to Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, or similar agent integration patterns.
* Experience with Amazon Connect Customer Profiles, Cases, Tasks, outbound campaigns, and related workforce or quality capabilities.
* Knowledge of OpenSearch, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or Terraform.
* Integration experience with Salesforce, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Relevant AWS certifications in Solutions Architecture, Development, Machine Learning, or related areas.
* Experience supporting client workshops, technical presentations, RFPs, and live demonstrations.

* Strong hands-on ownership and delivery orientation
* Structured problem-solving and solution design capability
* Ability to operate independently in an evolving presales environment
* Clear communication with business and technical stakeholders
* Ability to convert requirements into practical and demonstrable customer journeys

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**Brand:** RASA

**Location:** Emaar Digital Greens, Gurugram

**Industry:** Real Estate Development – Plotted Developments

At **RASA**, we are developers exclusively focused on premium plotted developments—with active projects spanning from Naugaon (Rajasthan) to South of Haryana and Uttar Pradesh.

We are not your typical real estate company. **We don’t care about years of experience - we care about execution.** We are building a lean, niche team where **accountability, ownership, and end-to-end execution are paramount**. If you are someone who moves fast, takes high ownership, and consistently gets the job done in the best possible way, you will thrive here. We are looking for an all - rounder - a **one-stop-shop Marketing Professional** capable of taking complete ownership of our brand presence, driving marketing initiatives from initial concept to high-impact execution. You will be the single point of contact responsible for strategy, branding, content, and vendor management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **End-to-End Execution & Accountability:** Take 100% ownership of all marketing deliverables, from brand naming and positioning to project launches, collateral creation, and on-ground campaigns.
* **Social Media Management & Content Creation:** Independently handle end-to-end social media channels—generating engaging posts, reels, and stories, writing compelling captions, and managing daily posting schedules across platforms.
* **Plotted Development Marketing:** Develop and execute tailored marketing strategies specifically designed for our current and upcoming niche plotted land development projects.
* **Internal & External Communication:** Serve as the central anchor for all project communication, coordinating with external digital agencies, graphic designers, video production crews, and marketing vendors.
* **Video Content & Media Shoots:** Plan, direct, and oversee regular video shoots, site walkthroughs, and photography to capture authentic project progress and create compelling visual content.
* **Digital & AI-Powered Workflows:** Leverage modern AI tools alongside Meta, Google, and social platforms to streamline content creation, optimize ad workflows, and generate quality leads.
* **Brand & Collateral Development:** Create and maintain project presentations, brochures, site signage, sales kits, and digital communication materials.
* **Site Visits & On-Ground Content:** Travel to project sites whenever needed for work to record real-time updates, monitor branding execution, capture visual content, and understand project progress on the ground.
* **Performance Tracking:** Monitor campaign performance, track marketing KPIs, and optimize lead pipelines in close coordination with the sales and management teams.

**DESIRED COMPETENCIES & ATTITUDE**

* **Relentless Execution & Ownership:** A "get-things-done" mindset. You take full responsibility for outcomes without needing constant supervision or hand-holding.
* **Real Estate / Plotted Interest:** Prior exposure to land development, plotted layouts, or real estate marketing is a major plus, but a sharp learning curve matters more.
* **Social Media & Content Expertise:** Hands-on capability in content writing, social media management, reel creation, and audience engagement.
* **AI-Fluent:** Well-versed in leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney, Canva AI, video generation tools, etc.) to multiply your speed and output quality.
* **Video & Visual Storytelling:** Strong comfort level with planning, shooting, and directing video content on-site and in-studio.
* **Agency & Vendor Management:** Ability to manage external partners, hold them accountable, and enforce strict timelines.
* **Clear Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for client-facing messaging and internal alignment.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Proficiency with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or modern AI-driven design/editing platforms.
* Experience running or auditing Meta Ads, Google PPC, and performance marketing campaigns.
* Knowledge of video editing, drone shoot planning, and visual content production.

**WORK LOCATION & TRAVEL**

* **Office Location:** Emaar Digital Greens, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram.
* **Site Travel:** Travel to project sites across Rajasthan, Haryana, and UP whenever needed for work. Site visits and travel are an integral part of this role.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Engineer II - SecOps Insider threat
description:
At Aristocrat, we are at the forefront of entertainment and technology, pushing boundaries to build world-leading gaming content. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play, and our culture is built on innovation, creativity, and integrity. As a Sr Security Analyst, you will play a crucial role in our Security Operations Center (SOC), ensuring the safety and integrity of our systems. This is an outstanding opportunity to join a dynamic team, collaborate globally, and drive impactful security initiatives. Your expertise will be instrumental in protecting our assets and supporting our mission to deliver world-class gaming experiences. Join us and be part of an ambitious team that values connection and strives for excellence!

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the incident lead for handling and investigating high-severity and complex security incidents from beginning to end. Focus on defining the incident scope, containment, eradication, and recovery phases. Work closely with technical and business partners. Assume responsibility for the root-cause analysis.
* Lead complex, multi-stage investigations across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS telemetry, including advanced malware analysis, credential-compromise, and lateral-movement investigations.
* Define detection strategy aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and the organization’s threat model; identify and recommend new detection logic across SIEM, XDR, EDR, and SOAR.
* Conduct threat hunts guided by threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and gaps in detection coverage; convert findings into new detections, playbooks, and control recommendations.
* Lead Tier 2 SOC operations, ensuring shift priorities, case load, and blocking issue flow meet SLAs and quality standards.
* Build and maintain SOC playbook, runbook, and knowledge-based library; ensure content stays current with tooling and threat changes.
* Identify, build, and recommend process improvements across the SOC, measuring and reporting their impact.
* Chip in to and help implement the multi-year security operations strategy, including detection coverage roadmap, telemetry strategy, automation targets, and capability maturity.
* Interpret security findings as risk-centered advice for security engineering, IT, and business collaborators.
* Mentor and develop Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts through structured mentoring, investigation walkthroughs, and technical training.
* Participate in cross-functional forums and collaborate with global security teams to ensure a cohesive, consistent approach to security operations.
* Provide senior on-call coverage for major incidents involving blocking issues.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or an equivalent blue-team role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Advanced certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, Microsoft SC-200 or equivalent are highly regarded.
* Expert knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and Entra ID charge techniques; able to reconstruct an intrusion from raw logs without a playbook.
* Strong experience in cloud security monitoring and response across at least one major provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Proficiency in Python or PowerShell for automation, data analysis, and tooling integration.
* Deep solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, the incident response lifecycle, malware analysis, and phishing investigation.
* Track record of defining standards, processes, and playbooks, and of improving them based on evidence.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor analysts and raise the technical bar of a team.
* Clear, structured technical writing, including incident reports, RCAs, and briefings for senior technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong influencing and teamwork skills; able to work with engineering, IT, and business groups locally and globally to promote change without direct authority.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links

title: Staff IAM Engineer
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Senior Manager - AI & IT

### **What You Will Be Doing**

ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.  
  
**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.
* Platform experience: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Cloud Secrets Manager, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container security platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, CI/CD, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP. (good to have)

**Location**  
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company needs, we will contact you directly.

ChargePoint is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes and supports all qualified individuals. In alignment with this commitment, we ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the employment process.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access any other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us at **accommodations@chargepoint.com**.

ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Technical Lead – PS Consultant
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

Professional Services Consultant

Your Role  
As our Cybersecurity Professional Services Consultant you will be responsible for deploying and implementing our data Security and protection solutions in customer enterprise environments. In this position, the consultant has a central role in the organisation, generating revenue in coordination with sales, interfacing with the customer, and coordinating with R&D and product management to enhance and optimise the solution to meet customer’s needs.

* **Client Engagement & Implementation:**
* In this role, you will be a trusted advisor, delivering high-quality consulting services and technical implementations that protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with security standards.
  + Lead technical implementations of Thales data security products and services (e.g., CipherTrust Data Security Platform, CipherTrust Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Imperva Data Security Fabric, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Data Protection on Demand (DPoD), etc.)

o Conduct security assessments and data protection workshops with clients.

o Customize and configure data security solutions to meet client-specific requirements.

o Integrate security solutions with clients’ existing infrastructure (cloud, hybrid, on-prem).

* **Solution Design & Architecture:**

o Design scalable and secure architectures for data security solutions.

o Collaborate with pre-sales teams to understand customer needs and define technical scopes.

o Translate business and compliance requirements into technical controls and processes

* Delivery of customer engagements in the area of HSM, CipherTrust Data Security Platform, CipherTrust DSPM, SafeNet Trusted Access, and/or PKI  
  + Design – Role, Policies and Procedures
  + Documentation and hands on deployment including hardware security modules
* **Training & Support:**

o Provide knowledge transfer and training to client security and IT teams.

o Offer post-deployment support and troubleshoot complex technical issues.

o Serve as a liaison between clients and product engineering teams for escalations and feedback.

* **Documentation & Reporting:**
* + Create detailed implementation documentation, security plans, and user guides.
  + Deliver executive-level and technical reports outlining project outcomes and recommendations.

**Your Experience**  
This is a highly hands-on and technical role with extensive customer-facing responsibilities. You will work with cross-functional teams at customer sites, focusing mainly on IT security, data security, and data encryption and key management, to install and configure Thales data security products. To be successful in this role you will bring the following:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, professional services, or technical consulting

* Hands-on experience implementing Thales CipherTrust, HSM, or equivalent enterprise data security and encryption products
* Strong understanding of network and endpoint security fundamentals
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS security models
* Understanding of data discovery & classification, tokenization, and data masking techniques for protecting sensitive data
* Solid experience of encryption, key management and hardware security modules (HSM) experience
* Experience in onsite and remote projects delivery model
* Experience in database administration (mainly Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL, DB2, and/or Informix)

**Key Competencies:**

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong client relationship and communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Passion for continuous learning in cybersecurity.

**Preferred:**

* Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, GIAC, CCSP).
* Cloud Certifications (Architect ) (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Proficiency in scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Analyst – BI & Data
description:
We are seeking a highly detail‑oriented Data Analyst to support the Strategic Growth Team (SGT), US, with executive‑level reporting, analytics, and opportunity review. This role is central to strengthening data quality, ensuring timely insights for senior leadership, and maintaining reporting accuracy that meets the expectations for executive consumption.

In addition to core reporting responsibilities, the analyst will assist with opportunity review during non‑peak reporting periods.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capability, impeccable attention to detail, and an excellent understanding of CRM/Sales systems, with proven experience in reporting for senior audiences.

This role will be based in the Noida/ Bengaluru office.

  

Executive Reporting & Analytics

* Develop, maintain, and deliver executive-level dashboards and reports with zero‑defect accuracy, supporting US leadership’s strategic decision‑making.
* Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, exceptions, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Validate weekly and monthly reporting inputs to ensure completeness and correctness, addressing the gaps previously observed in team reporting.
* Collaborate with SGT leaders to clarify reporting requirements and ensure output meets expectations.

Data Quality, Governance & System Support

* Conduct data audits, cleanse datasets, and troubleshoot discrepancies across system.
* Partner with technical teams to recommend improvements to data flows and business processes.
* Support review of missing or incorrect data fields in opportunities and take corrective actions aligned with Horizon standards.
* Assist with structural data requirements for new software tools and maintain accurate data models.

Opportunity Review

* Provide supplemental support for opportunity review during workload surges, ensuring SGT remains current on weekly pipelines as directed by leadership.
* Prioritize core reporting tasks before accepting additional intake—reflecting leadership’s requirement that reporting accuracy must not be compromised by backlog work.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

* Work closely with Horizon Sales Administrators and PMs.
* Proactively communicate blockers or data issues and recommend solutions for continuous improvement.
* Work with management to prioritize business and information needs and propose solutions and strategies to business challenges
* Analyze and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports
* Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and undertake pre-processing of structured and unstructured data
* “Clean” data by reviewing performance indicators to locate and correct code problems
* Create and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality
* Analyse structural requirements and advise data architecture for new software and applications development by collaborating with engineering and product development teams
* Locate and define new process improvement opportunities and identify valuable data sources to automate collection processes
* Where essential, propose migration of data from legacy systems to new solutions
* Design conceptual and logical data models and flowcharts. Present information using data visualization techniques
* Build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms

  

Key Competencies / Skills / Qualifications

Masters in Computer Science/Statistics/Maths/Information Technology

* Relevant domain certifications
* Proven work experience of 4-7 years as a Data Analyst or similar role
* Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining, and segmentation techniques
* Strong experience with SQL, Python/R, Excel, and enterprise BI tools (Tableau, Power BI).
* Solid understanding of Sales CRM systems, preferably Horizon or other enterprise CRM environments.
* Ability to analyze large datasets, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
* Strong communication skills to present findings clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage competing tasks without compromising data accuracy or deadlines.

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer | LLM Applications & Agentic AI

**Company:**
Finarb Analytics Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Kolkata

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site / Hybrid

About Finarb

Finarb is a data science, AI, and technology consulting firm that helps businesses solve complex problems through advanced analytics, machine learning, and intelligent automation. We work with global clients across healthcare, financial services, private equity, and other industries, developing solutions that combine data engineering, predictive modeling, generative AI, and enterprise applications.

Our work spans traditional machine learning and deep learning to emerging areas such as large language models, agentic AI, and decision intelligence. We focus on building practical, scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value.

About the Role

We are looking for an
**AI Engineer**
with strong Python skills and hands-on experience building applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and agentic AI frameworks.

The role involves designing and developing AI applications that can reason over enterprise data, interact with tools and APIs, execute multistep workflows, and integrate with existing business systems.

We are particularly interested in engineers who understand the fundamentals of machine learning and data engineering, rather than just working with LLM APIs. You should be comfortable taking an AI application from initial development through testing, evaluation, and production deployment.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered applications using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Build agentic AI systems using
  **LangChain, LangGraph**
  , and similar frameworks, including tool calling, planning, state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
* Develop reusable agent tools and skills that can be chained together to execute complex analytical and business workflows.
* Build and optimize
  **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
  pipelines, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking.
* Integrate AI applications with databases, APIs, enterprise systems, and external tools, including MCP-based integrations.
* Develop backend services and APIs using
  **Python and FastAPI**
  .
* Design evaluation frameworks to measure LLM response quality, retrieval accuracy, agent reliability, and overall application performance.
* Implement appropriate guardrails, error handling, logging, and monitoring for production AI systems.
* Optimize applications for accuracy, latency, scalability, and inference costs.
* Work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and software developers to build and deploy AI solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

* **2–5 years of experience**
  in software engineering, machine learning, or AI application development, including hands-on LLM application development.
* Strong programming skills in
  **Python**
  , including object-oriented programming, asynchronous processing, and API development.
* Practical experience with
  **LangChain, LangGraph**
  , or comparable orchestration frameworks such as LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Experience building agentic workflows involving tool/function calling, state management, memory, and multistep execution.
* Experience developing RAG applications, working with embeddings, and integrating vector databases.
* Strong understanding of
  **SQL, data processing, data pipelines, and data quality**
  .
* Working knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including model training, evaluation, overfitting, and common failure modes.
* Understanding of transformer architectures, LLM capabilities, and limitations.
* Familiarity with statistical concepts such as distributions, sampling, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing.
* Experience developing REST APIs using FastAPI or similar Python frameworks.
* Good understanding of software engineering practices, Git, testing, and debugging.

Good to Have

* Experience with vector databases such as
  **pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search**
  .
* Knowledge of advanced RAG techniques, including hybrid search, reranking, and agentic retrieval.
* Experience with
  **PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers**
  , and open-source LLMs.
* Familiarity with fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA.
* Experience with
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**
  and developing integrations with external tools.
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or Braintrust.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.
* Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment.
* Understanding of AI security, prompt injection, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience optimizing LLM inference through model selection, caching, and routing.

What We're Looking For

We value engineers who can think beyond prompts and frameworks. You should understand how the underlying data, models, and application components work together and be able to make sensible technical decisions.

You should be comfortable experimenting with new approaches, evaluating results objectively, debugging complex workflows, and building systems that remain reliable outside controlled demonstrations.

Experience building and deploying
**real-world AI applications**
