title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
description:
**Senior AI Evaluation Analyst**

**Location:**
Kochi

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Role Overview**

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation.
* Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets.
* Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency.
* Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems.
* Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

**Generative & Agentic AI:**

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/
  
2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/

title: Business Analytics Leader
description:
Bangalore Full-Time Senior

**About this role**
-------------------

Mission Brief: Be the Analytical Brain Beside Every Decision-Maker at Lenskart

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who will sit shoulder-to-shoulder with Lenskart's functional leaders — the CEO, Business Heads, Supply Chain Head, Technology Head, and the leaders running our individual geographies — and turn data into the decisions that move the business forward.

  

You will not run a back-office reporting function. You will be a thinking partner in the room where strategy happens, translating the firehose of Lenskart's data into sharp, timely insight that changes what we do next. Your mandate is to make Lenskart's decision-making faster, sharper, and more AI-native than any retailer in the world.

  

The Context: Where Lenskart Already Is

You are not being asked to start from zero — you are being asked to take a fast-moving machine and accelerate it. Today at Lenskart, our meetings are transcribed and processed by our AI agents, our global technology and revenue roadmaps are part of the training context for our internal AI agents, and those agents already analyze weekly revenue trends on their own. Every Monday they surface what should be on the agenda for our weekly business reviews — what we're building, what's working, and what we're missing. Anonymized signals from Slack, email, and other communications flow into our analytics engine, which crisply summarizes the next steps for the organization.

  

That is the baseline. We are looking for someone who can natively operate in this environment and push it considerably further.

  

Core Mandate

1. Insight Partnership to Functional Leaders (The Decision Focus) Embed alongside the CEO, business heads, supply chain, technology, and geography leaders as their trusted analytics partner. Frame the right questions, pressure-test assumptions with data, and deliver the insight that drives concrete business decisions — pricing, assortment, expansion, capital allocation, and growth bets. Own the quality and speed of the insight that reaches the leadership table.

  

2. AI-First Transformation of Analytics & Decision-Making (The AI Focus) Be the fastest adopter — and the chief evangelist — of emerging AI tools, models, and analytics technologies across Lenskart. Reimagine how analysis itself is produced and consumed, moving the organization from dashboards-on-request toward autonomous, agent-driven insight. Set the standard for how decisions are made in an AI-native company and bring every function along with you.

  

3. Advancing Lenskart's AI & Analytics Systems (The Builder Focus) Take ownership of evolving our existing AI infrastructure — the meeting-intelligence pipelines, the roadmap-trained agents, the weekly revenue-trend analysis, and the communications summarization engine. Partner with Data Science and Engineering to extend these systems' reach, reliability, and sophistication, ensuring they remain a genuine competitive advantage rather than a novelty.

  

4. Cross-Functional Leadership & Adoption (The Culture Focus) Drive a data-and-AI-first decision-making culture across every function and geography. Challenge the status quo, raise the analytical bar of the leaders you support, and mentor a high-performing team of analysts who can operate at the pace of a high-growth global retailer.

  

The Essentials

Track Record: A strong record of partnering directly with senior executives and influencing material business decisions through analytics, data science, or strategy/decision-support work.

AI Fluency: Demonstrated, hands-on adoption of modern AI and analytics tooling (LLMs, agentic workflows, ML-driven forecasting and decision systems) — not as a spectator, but as an early and aggressive practitioner who has put these tools into real operational use.

Technical Acumen: Deep, practical command of analytics and data — SQL and modern data stacks, statistical and ML modeling, and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous, scalable analysis.

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a highly quantitative field — Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science, or similar.

The Mindset

AI-Native by Default: You reach for AI to solve problems instinctively, you stay at the frontier of new tools, and you are energized by the idea of building a company where agents do the first draft of analysis and humans make sharper decisions because of it.

Executive Presence & Influence: You are a compelling communicator who can sit across from any functional leader, distill complexity into a clear recommendation, and earn the right to shape the decision.

Analytical Rigor & Speed: You thrive on data complexity and turn ambiguity into clear, profitable action at the pace of a high-growth tech company.

Builder's Bias: You see analytics as a living product and an evolving system — never finished, always being made faster and smarter.

Operations

From cutting-edge eyewear design to seamless omnichannel experiences, we combine technology, fashion, and customer obsession to deliver clarity to millions. Join us and be part of one of India’s fastest-growing consumer brands redefining vision care.

title: Manager, Data Analysis
description:
**Job Summary**
A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
  

* Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
* Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
* Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
* Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
* Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function

Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**

* Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
* Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
* Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
* Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
* Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
* Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* SQL Querying skills
* Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
* Banking domain knowledge

**Other Skills**

* AML knowledge
* Interpersonal skills
* Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
**Skills and Eligibility**

* Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
* Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
* A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
* Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage
* Able to seamlessly move and translate between detailed functional data requirements and non-technical general terms
* The ability to write clear, concise and detailed business requirements that can be understood by data engineers and developers as well as business stakeholders
* Strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
* Competence with data profiling tools and methodologies (SQL at a minimum), with a preference for dedicated and sophisticated tools such as Paxata or Tableau
* Familiar with data documentation, delivery workflow and defect tracking tools – JIRA and Confluence in particular
* Demonstrated experience in handling and understanding large datasets and relational databases
* Experience in analytical roles with a large technical component, although not necessarily from a purely data perspective (e.g. they may have prior working knowledge of upstream or downstream processes that is relevant from a data perspective)
* Evidenced ability to execute and enhance a process to maintain data transformation requirements over time and constantly seek to improve these
* High quality written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to focus on multiple initiatives and data subjects (types of data or varying sources of data) at the same time
* Evidence a very strong attention to detail, reflecting the very low tolerance for error in FCC data

title: Senior Project Associate
description:
**Job title: Senior Project Associate**

**Project and job description:**

Applications are invited for the position of Senior Project Associate under ISRO RESPOND project titled “Large and small-scale ionospheric plasma irregularities using airglow imaging and GNSS TEC measurements“.

This is a two-year project involving collaboration between Krea University and Physical Research Laboratory (PRL).

The primary work location would be Krea University campus in Sri City.

The aim of the project is to develop low-cost imagers to capable of observing ionospheric irregularity structures in the faint oxygen airglow lines emanating from the thermosphere-ionosphere region. In addition, machine learning based automatic sequestration and data analysis algorithms should be developed to process the images. These datasets will be invaluable to study the large-scale ionospheric plasma irregularities and they will be co-studied using existing GNSS TEC measurements from Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) and Krea University.

The candidate should possess knowledge of machine learning and deep learning methods, fundamental physics, be passionate about research, assist in gathering and analyzing datasets, and support overall administrative and research activities of the project wherever

required.

**Essential Qualifications:**

M.Sc./BS-MS/Four-year B.Sc. (Honours)/B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, Data

Science, Physics, Atmospheric Science, Meteorology, Space Physics, Geophysics, or a

related discipline and four years of research and development experience in industrial or

academic institutions or science and technology organizations.

(OR)

M.E./ MTech./Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Computer Science,

Data Science, Space Science and Technology, Instrumentation and two years of

experience in industrial or academic institutions or science and technology organizations.

(OR)

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Space Physics, Atmospheric Sciences, Geosciences, or a

related discipline.

Desirable Skills: Knowledge on Machine learning methods, Space Plasma Physics,

Atmospheric Science, Proficiency in Python and MATLAB programming.

* **Job Location:**
  Sri City
* **Salary:**
  Rs. 42000/- per month + 10% HRA.
* **Duration:**
  The initial offer will be for six months and renewable subject to satisfactory performance. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project with a maximum duration of 2 years.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates may apply by sending a single PDF file containing their cover letter, detailed curriculum vitae, and scanned copies of marksheets and certificates to
**research.hiring@krea.edu.in**
with the subject line
**‘Application for Senior Project Associate in ISRO RESPOND project’**
.

For any inquiries regarding the project and nature of research, please email
lakshmi.narayanan@krea.edu.in
(kindly do not send applications to this email id)

* **Deadline: 20 October 2026**

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding further examination and interview.

title: Senior Engineer, IAM with designing and architecturing AI/ML systems
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about using data, experimentation, and analytics to shape product strategy and customer experiences? Do you enjoy helping teams make better decisions through evidence, measurement, and actionable insights? Does the opportunity to influence products used by millions of customers through data-driven recommendations excite you? If so, we would love to talk to you.

We are the Data & Applied Sciences team for Windows in Hyderabad, India. Our mission is to use data science, analytics, experimentation, and measurement to inform decision making, improve customer experiences, and maximize business impact across the Windows ecosystem. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, and business stakeholders to answer critical questions, evaluate investments, measure outcomes, and influence product strategy.

We're looking for an experienced **Senior Data Scientist** to help drive product and business decisions through data-driven insights, experimentation, measurement frameworks, and advanced analytics for experiences running on Windows devices worldwide.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will tackle complex business and product challenges by applying analytical rigor, statistical techniques, experimentation, and data-driven thinking. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, evaluate product investments, measure customer impact, and influence strategic decisions.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Partnering with Product, Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders to identify key business questions and translate them into measurable outcomes.
* Defining and operationalizing key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics for customer-facing experiences.
* Designing and analyzing experiments, causal inference studies, and observational analyses to evaluate product investments and business outcomes.
* Developing analytical frameworks that help teams understand customer behavior, product health, engagement trends, and growth opportunities.
* Identifying actionable insights and translating them into recommendations that influence product strategy and prioritization.
* Measuring the impact of product launches, feature investments, and strategic initiatives.
* Communicating analytical findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.
* Contributing to best practices in experimentation, measurement, statistical rigor, and decision science across the organization.
* Mentoring peers, participating in technical reviews, and helping raise the quality bar for data science across the team.

**AI Evaluation & Modern Analytics**

* Help design evaluation methodologies and success metrics for AI-powered and intelligent product experiences.
* Apply statistical and experimental methods to assess the impact, quality, reliability, and customer value of AI-enabled capabilities.
* Leverage modern AI-assisted analytical tools responsibly while maintaining high standards of scientific rigor and analytical excellence.

* Bachelor's Degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline.

* Deep experience in experimentation, A/B testing, causal inference, and statistical analysis.
* Experience designing and operationalizing product, customer, or business success metrics.

* Passion for mentoring others and continuously learning emerging analytical and AI-related techniques.

* Experience building executive-facing narratives and communicating complex analytical findings in a simple, actionable manner.

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.
  + Use data and telemetry to identify AI quality gaps, generate insights, and deliver **proofs of concept** that apply research innovations to real‑world operational challenges.
  + Design robust **multi‑step reasoning and tool‑use strategies**, including function calling, code execution, APIs, and secure connectors, with strong safety and reliability guardrails.
  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**
  + Define task‑level evaluation metrics for agentic behavior, including **success rate, tool‑call accuracy, step efficiency, hallucination rate, safety violations, time‑to‑completion, and user satisfaction**.
  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design
    - A/B experimentation and telemetry‑driven iteration loops
* **Collaborate Across Disciplines and Lead Technical Execution**
  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.
  + Lead design reviews and influence engineering decisions across **agent frameworks, model integration, and system architecture**.
  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

  
**Qualifications**

* **Required Qualifications**
* **PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, NLP**, or related field, OR 10 years of experience in delivering production grade AI systems.
* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.
* Proficiency in **Python** and experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and model serving/inference.
* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

While not required, we also look for the following**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Cloud technology Stack
* Experience with **parameter‑efficient fine‑tuning** techniques (e.g., LoRA) for LLMs or multimodal models.
* Hands‑on experience building **agentic or tool‑augmented LLM systems**, including function calling, planners, and API/tool integration.
* Experience with **advanced RAG architectures**, such as hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citation strategies.
* Strong **AIOps depth**, including quality drift detection, alerting, rollback, and telemetry‑driven optimization.
* Experience optimizing systems for **latency, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency** at enterprise scale.
* Prior experience working on **mission‑critical or large‑scale enterprise AI systems**.
* Demonstrated mentorship or technical leadership within applied science or engineering teams.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Data Analyst – Identity & Graph Analytics
description:
**Job Role: Data Analyst – Identity & Graph Analytics**
=======================================================

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Experience:** 5+ Years

**About Anblicks**
------------------

Anblicks is a Great Place to Work® Certified™ Data and AI company helping enterprises transform data into actionable insights through modern data platforms, cloud technologies, and advanced analytics. We partner with leading technology providers to deliver innovative, scalable, and data-driven solutions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a detail-oriented **Data Analyst – Identity & Graph Analytics** with strong expertise in SQL, Python, data quality, and statistical analysis to support the validation and optimization of large-scale Identity Graph products.

In this role, you will analyze complex datasets, evaluate identity resolution results, assess matching accuracy, and identify anomalies across person-level and household-level records. You will collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to improve identity matching quality, validate graph behavior, and drive continuous product enhancements.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with hands-on data investigation skills and an interest in identity resolution, entity matching, and graph-based data systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Identity Graph Analysis:** Analyze identity resolution outputs and client datasets to identify fragmented identities, duplicate or anomalous person records, and incorrect household groupings.
* **Match Quality Assessment:** Investigate false positives, false negatives, and matching inconsistencies to evaluate identity resolution accuracy.
* **Data Validation & Testing:** Validate graph matching behavior across real-world scenarios, business rules, and identity use cases.
* **SQL & Python Analytics:** Use SQL and Python to query, transform, analyze, and validate large, complex datasets.
* **Benchmarking & Test Data:** Create, maintain, and enhance datasets for graph testing, quality validation, performance benchmarking, and regression analysis.
* **Exploratory Data Analysis:** Perform deep-dive and ad hoc analyses to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, and opportunities for improving graph quality.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to investigate issues and recommend improvements to matching accuracy and graph performance.
* **Statistical Measurement:** Support the evaluation of match quality using metrics such as precision, recall, false-positive rate, and false-negative rate.
* **Reporting & Insights:** Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and documentation highlighting graph quality, validation results, performance trends, and improvement opportunities.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Support testing backlogs, validation workflows, quality monitoring, and research initiatives in collaboration with the Lead Data Scientist.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **5+ years of experience** in data analytics, data quality, data validation, or a related analytical role.
* Strong proficiency in **SQL**, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling, and analysis of large datasets.
* Hands-on experience with **Python or R** for data analysis, data manipulation, and statistical evaluation.
* Strong understanding of data quality assessment, data validation techniques, and exploratory data analysis.
* Experience identifying duplicates, inconsistencies, anomalies, and patterns across complex datasets.
* Knowledge of statistical analysis and data-driven problem-solving techniques.
* Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable insights and communicate results clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and a structured approach to investigating data issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in **identity resolution, entity matching, record linkage, or customer identity analytics**.
* Familiarity with identity graphs, graph-based systems, relationship mapping, or large-scale data processing platforms.
* Understanding of person-level identity, householding, customer profiles, and identity matching logic.
* Experience designing test datasets, benchmark datasets, and regression testing scenarios for data-intensive products.
* Practical knowledge of match-quality metrics, including precision, recall, F1-score, and false-positive/false-negative analysis.
* Exposure to Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), MarTech, AdTech, or identity intelligence solutions.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.

**What Makes You a Good Fit?**
------------------------------

* You enjoy investigating complex datasets and uncovering hidden patterns and inconsistencies.
* You can combine SQL, Python, and statistical analysis to evaluate data quality and matching accuracy.
* You are comfortable working with large-scale data and translating findings into practical recommendations.
* You collaborate effectively with technical teams to solve data quality challenges and improve product performance.

title: Data Analyst – Audience Analytics

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Support the Lead Data Scientist and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams on validation, testing, and research initiatives.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Contribute to testing backlogs, validation workflows, quality monitoring, and measurement processes to improve audience product adoption and reliability.

* **4+ years of experience** in data analytics, data quality, data validation, or a related analytical role.

* Hands-on experience with **Python or R** for data analysis, data manipulation, and statistical evaluation.
* Strong understanding of data quality assessment, validation methodologies, and exploratory data analysis.
* Experience identifying anomalies, duplicates, inconsistencies, and patterns across complex datasets.
* Knowledge of statistical analysis and data-driven problem-solving techniques.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in **audience analytics, audience generation, identity resolution, entity matching, or customer identity data**.
* Familiarity with audience data products, data crosswalks, identity mapping, and person-level or household-level data relationships.
* Experience working with large-scale, data-intensive platforms and complex client/vendor datasets.
* Understanding of match-quality measurement, including false-positive and false-negative analysis.
* Experience creating benchmarking datasets, test scenarios, and regression testing workflows.
* Exposure to Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), MarTech, AdTech, audience intelligence, or digital marketing ecosystems.
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent technologies.

**What Makes You a Good Fit?**
------------------------------

* You enjoy investigating complex datasets and identifying meaningful patterns and data quality issues.
* You can use SQL, Python, and statistical techniques to validate data and measure product effectiveness.
* You have a structured approach to problem-solving and can convert analytical findings into measurable improvements.
* You work effectively with cross-functional teams to enhance data accuracy, connectivity, and product performance.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/
  
2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/

title: Apprentice, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
**Apprentice – Data Analytics (CSDD)**

**Overview**

The Apprentice – Data Analytics supports the day-to-day execution of data analytics and reporting activities within the Content and Student Digital Delivery (CSDD) team. Working under the close direction of the Lead Specialist, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence, the role focuses on preparing, cleaning, and analysing data, and supporting the build of dashboards and reports with accuracy, consistency, and a commitment to quality.

This role is designed for individuals who are building their foundational skills in data analytics, demonstrating analytical curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. The Apprentice follows established analytical workflows and standard operating procedures (SOPs), maintains accurate data records, and escalates issues promptly within defined channels. Exposure to Python for data manipulation and to AI-driven or automation projects is a core part of this role.

The ideal candidate has up to 1–2 years of relevant experience or equivalent internship exposure. Prior experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or AI/automation project environments is an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Preparation & Analysis**

Collect, clean, and transform data from multiple sources using Python (e.g., pandas) and SQL, following established analytical workflows. Perform exploratory analysis, produce accurate outputs within agreed timelines, and support the wider team during key reporting and delivery cycles.

**Dashboarding & Reporting**

Support the build and maintenance of dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI, Excel, or equivalent tools. Ensure metrics, definitions, and visualisations are accurate, consistent, and aligned with PMO governance standards, and provide timely status updates to the supervisor.

**AI & Automation Project Support**

Contribute to AI and automation initiatives – such as reporting automation, Copilot/agentic pilots, and workflow optimisation – by preparing datasets, testing outputs, documenting results, and supporting proof-of-concept work under guidance. Apply consistent judgement when reviewing AI-generated outputs for accuracy and quality.

**Process Documentation & Record Keeping**

Follow documented analytical workflows and standard operating procedures. Maintain accurate data records, query logs, and version-controlled outputs in SharePoint or designated repositories. Assist in updating Job Aids and process documentation as directed.

**Issue Identification & Escalation**

Identify routine data quality or analytical issues during task execution and escalate promptly to the supervisor with sufficient context for rapid resolution. Distinguish expected data variation from non-routine anomalies that require review.

**Stakeholder Communication**

Communicate analysis status, findings, and workflow updates clearly and consistently to the immediate supervisor. Participate constructively in team check-ins, reviews, and analytics working sessions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, computing, or analytical discipline (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience.
* Up to 1–2 years of relevant work experience. Candidates with relevant internship or placement experience will be considered.
* Working knowledge of Python for data manipulation and analysis and automation
* Exposure to AI or automation projects – whether academic, internship, or professional – is required.
* Prior exposure to data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or digital operations environments is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear and structured updates to supervisors.
* High attention to detail, analytical diligence, and the ability to manage concurrent priorities within defined timelines.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Analytical thinking: Ability to interpret data, spot patterns and anomalies, and translate findings into clear, accurate outputs.
* AI/automation awareness : Familiarity with AI, machine learning, or automation concepts and a willingness to apply them to reporting and workflow tasks.
* Attention to detail : careful adherence to analytical procedures, governance requirements, and data quality expectations.
* Learning orientation : willingness to absorb new tools, techniques, and domain knowledge quickly and apply them as directed.
* Data tooling comfort : working with data, documentation, and reporting/BI tooling in a structured operational environment.
* Team player with a positive, collaborative approach to reviews, check-ins, and cross-functional working sessions.
* Clear and timely communication of analysis status and issues to supervisors.

**Tools & Systems**

Candidates should have working knowledge of, or a demonstrated willingness to learn, the following:

* Python (basics) – data cleaning, transformation, and analysis
* Querying and extracting data from Looker, Oracle PDH,JIRA
* Power BI / Excel – dashboarding, visualisation, and reporting
* AI & automation tools – Microsoft Copilot Studio, agentic/AI reporting solutions, and workflow automation
* JIRA & Smartsheet – task tracking, workflow management, and operational trackers
* Microsoft Teams, Planner & SharePoint – collaboration, file management, and cross-team communication

**Success Metrics**

Effectiveness at this level is demonstrated by:

* Consistent and accurate completion of assigned analytical tasks within agreed timelines, following established workflows and SOPs.
* Low error rate and minimal rework on data preparation, analysis, and reporting outputs.
* Reliable, accurate dashboards and reports with correct metrics, definitions, and version control.
* Constructive contribution to AI and automation pilots, with well-documented and tested outputs.
* Timely and appropriately contextualised escalation of data quality or analytical issues to the supervisor.
* Positive feedback from the supervisor on reliability, analytical rigour, and attention to detail.
* Constructive participation in team check-ins, reviews, and retrospectives.

*This role sits within the Content and Student Digital Delivery (CSDD) team and reports into the Lead Specialist, Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (Parul Mishra). It works closely with the PMO and Business Support function and cross-functional teams across CSDD.*

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links

title: Principal AI Architect for Enterprise AI Platform
description:
An enterprise AI platform is scaling quickly. It is running more customer pilots and taking on heavier platform demands, and it needs a senior architect to set its technical direction. You will own the architecture of its retrieval and knowledge layer: how enterprise data is structured, connected through knowledge graphs, and retrieved for LLMs and AI agents. You will also act as the senior technical voice for a growing engineering team. The work balances hands-on design with technical leadership. You’ll fix current problems with performance, accuracy, and scalability, and you’ll shape the approach for the customer-specific projects coming next.

**What You’ll Do**

* Provide senior architectural leadership across the AI platform, with clear technical direction for Generative AI, retrieval, and data design.
* Design, evaluate, and improve RAG and GraphRAG architectures for enterprise AI applications.
* Build and optimize knowledge graph and retrieval architectures, including ontology and semantic data modeling.
* Diagnose and resolve challenges in retrieval accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Improve how enterprise data is structured, indexed, and retrieved by AI agents.
* Work hands-on with Neo4j, Weaviate, and LangChain, or with equivalent graph, vector, and orchestration tools.
* Support the development of AI agents and their integration with enterprise data and workflows.
* Define technical approaches and reference architectures for upcoming customer-specific pilots.
* Mentor junior AI engineers through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
* Partner with engineering leadership and technical stakeholders so the architecture stays scalable and maintainable as the customer base grows.

**What You Bring**

* Senior- or principal-level experience in Generative AI and AI architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and shipping RAG and/or GraphRAG systems in production.
* Deep understanding of knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic data modeling.
* Experience with Neo4j or a comparable graph database (e.g., Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, Stardog).
* Experience with Weaviate or a comparable vector database (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Strong experience with LangChain or a comparable LLM orchestration framework (e.g., LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel).
* A track record of designing production-grade AI systems, with a strong grasp of LLM-based retrieval and data architecture.
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers within a collaborative team.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms or agentic AI systems.
* Background in AI governance, security, or data access controls (e.g., permission-aware retrieval).
* Experience optimizing AI systems for accuracy, performance, and cost, including evaluation frameworks.
* Experience delivering customer-specific AI implementations or pilots.
* Experience in a fast-growing startup environment.
* Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern AI/ML development frameworks.

* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

* Exposure to streaming/event technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).
* Experience with data governance or cataloging tools.
* Basic understanding of ML workflows or MLOps concepts.
