Business Expansion

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You'll own the quality of the data that underpins every routing rule, territory, forecast and ARR number at CodeRabbit. You'll start by working the requests our GTM and Finance teams send to RevOps every day, and you'll turn each kind of request into a written runbook. Then you'll build the Data Quality Agent: an AI agent that handles most of those requests itself, routes the risky ones to a human for approval, and keeps a full record of everything it does. You'll join Business Systems, a small team that builds with agentic tools every day, and you'll work on the same engineering harness our engineers use to ship Salesforce and internal tool changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the tier-1 data queue for internal GTM systems data support: account ownership changes, account creation, merges, parent-child hierarchies, lead conversion, and linking billing subscriptions to the right Salesforce account.
* Resolve requests within the team's response standard and leave a record any teammate can pick up.
* Write and maintain a runbook for every recurring request type: the trigger, the checks, the steps, the edge cases, and when to escalate.
* Design, build and run the Data Quality Agent with Code Rabbit Coding Agent and our engineering harness, starting in shadow mode and earning its autonomy one workflow type at a time.
* Define the agent's approval tiers: what it can fix on its own, what it proposes for human approval, and what it always escalates.
* Run duplicate detection and merge cohorts across accounts, contacts and leads, and keep account hierarchies accurate as customers grow, merge and reorganize.
* Close enrichment gaps (firmographics, domains, HQ location, parent company) using our enrichment tools and the data warehouse.
* Track the request queue and data health with clear metrics: volume by request type, time to resolve, agent accuracy, and how often humans override the agent.
* Find the root cause behind repeat requests and bring proposals to the engineers so the fix lands upstream.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years in CRM data operations, sales operations, RevOps or data quality at a B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: the Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity data model, ownership and sharing basics, reports, and bulk data tools.
* Strong SQL. You can answer your own questions from the warehouse without waiting on an analyst.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to automate real work, and you can show us something you built: a prompt chain, a script, an agent, or an automation that saved hours.
* You write clear, step-by-step documentation that someone else can follow without asking you questions.
* Careful judgment with production data. You know which changes are easy to undo and which are not, and you treat them differently.
* Comfortable working across time zones with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dedupe and merge tools such as Traction Complete, DemandTools, Cloudingo or Salesforce duplicate rules.
* Python or JavaScript scripting, Git, and comfort working in a code repository.
* Experience with enrichment and prospecting data tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Exposure to billing systems such as Chargebee, and how subscriptions can map to CRM data.
* Experience with BigQuery, dbt or another cloud data warehouse.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows: approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logs and evaluations.
* Familiarity with developer-tools or technical B2B SaaS go-to-market (GTM).

**Our Values**
--------------

  

* **Collaborative Humans**: Prioritizing collective intelligence

* **Fearless Innovators**: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

* **Persistent, Passionate Developers**: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

* **Impact-Driven Creators**: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

* **Rapid Learners and Un-learners**: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world

**What We Offer**
=================

  

* Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

* Collaborative and innovative environment

* Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

To apply, submit your resume and relevant project samples or GitHub profiles. CodeRabbit is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

**Who We Are**

* Collaborate with other zOS teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and resolutions to support consistent operations.

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required skills and experience**  

* Technical college degree and/or relevant work experience.
* Key skills including knowledge of ISPF, JES2, JCL, REXX, SMP/E, PCOMM, Parallel Sysplex, Disaster Recovery and product maintenance/upgrades.

* Experience working within structured processes such as incident, problem, change and inventory management.
* Demonstrated focus on delivering reliable outcomes for customer environments.

* Experience with automation tools or scripting for system programming tasks.
* Familiarity with zcloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience working in multi-vendor or enterprise-scale IT environments.
* Relevant technical certifications.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. * You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.

We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.

* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.

* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.

This Manager MP&L - AI and Digital Transformation role will play a strategic and transformational leadership role responsible for pioneering the next gen capabilities identifying opportunities to improve Planning, Material Fulfilment, Logistics, Material flow & inventory pillars through innovative thinking, intelligent automation and scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

* Champion innovation by evaluating emerging technologies, piloting new concepts, and scaling successful solutions across the organization.

title: Manager - AI/ML
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth. At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. As a **Tech Lead/Architect (M) – AI and ML Tech Stack**, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on enabling and delivering AI-driven solutions that create measurable business outcomes. * Experience implementing enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.

* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.

The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

description:

Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). title: Lead - Network & Design Engineer (DNS, BIND, Route53)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled Network & DNS Design Engineer to join our Network Engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, governance, automation and L3 support of enterprise DNS, domain management and core network services across cloud, datacentre and corporate environments.

The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert in DNS technologies including AWS Route53, Microsoft Active Directory-integrated DNS and BIND, with responsibility for ensuring the availability, security and scalability of critical name resolution services supporting both internal users and customer-facing platforms.

The role requires a strong engineering mindset, a passion for automation, and practical experience applying AI-driven solutions to improve operational efficiency, governance and service reliability.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and manage enterprise DNS services across AWS Route53, Microsoft DNS and BIND platforms.

* Own the design and governance of public and private DNS infrastructure, including hosted zones, delegation, forwarding, conditional forwarding and resolver services.

* Manage the organisation's domain portfolio, including registrations, renewals, transfers, security controls and lifecycle governance.

* Design and support DNS services integrated with Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), ensuring reliable operation of authentication, Group Policy and Windows-based services.

* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex DNS, domain and network-related incidents.

* Develop and maintain DNS, domain and network standards, documentation and operational processes.

* Design and implement automation solutions using APIs, scripting and Infrastructure as Code.

* Leverage AI-assisted tooling to improve DNS management, domain governance, change validation, troubleshooting and operational reporting.

* Collaborate with infrastructure, security and application teams to deliver resilient and secure services.

* Contribute to the design and support of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing and hybrid-cloud networking solutions.

### **Essential skills & experience:**

* Extensive experience with AWS Route53, including public and private hosted zones, delegation and DNS governance.

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft DNS running on Active Directory Domain Controllers.

* Strong experience with BIND DNS administration and architecture.

* Deep understanding of DNS protocols, DNSSEC, recursive and authoritative DNS services.

* Experience managing enterprise domain portfolios and registrar relationships.

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching and network security principles.

* Experience with DNS/IPAM integration and tooling.

* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform or similar.

* Experience using APIs and Infrastructure as Code to automate operational processes.

* Experience applying AI technologies to infrastructure management, operational efficiency or service automation.

### **Desirable experience:**

* AWS networking and infrastructure services.

* F5 DNS/GTM and load balancing technologies.

* NetBox, SolarWinds, Infoblox or similar IPAM platforms.

* VPN, firewall and cloud networking technologies.

* GitOps and modern infrastructure automation practices.

* Experience supporting large-scale global enterprise environments.

### **Key Attributes**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

* Automation-first mindset.

* Excellent documentation and governance discipline.

* Ability to lead technical standards and best practices.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Passion for innovation and the practical application of AI within infrastructure operations.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

title: AI Solutions Expert
description:

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

  
  

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

  
  

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

  
  

About the Role.

As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

  
  

This includes finance, commercial, advertising, social media, e-commerce, email marketing, HCP communications, packaging, point-of-sale materials, in-store activations, and regulatory submissions.

  
  

Key Responsibilities.

title: Senior MLOps Consultant (Databricks)
description:
**Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer (Databricks)**

Chryselys is looking for a Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer with strong experience in Databricks to run the machine learning lifecycle from experiment to production.

You will set up Databricks environments, turn notebooks into scheduled jobs, and package and deploy models with consistent runtimes, versioning, and monitoring. You will work with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders in healthcare and pharmaceutical domains.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set up and maintain Databricks for ML: workspaces, clusters, instance pools, cluster policies, Repos, and runtime versions.
* Provide notebook and job templates, shared libraries, and pinned environments so experiments can be repeated.
* Build CI/CD to promote notebooks, jobs, workflows, and models across development, staging, and production environments using Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps, with Databricks Asset Bundles or the Jobs and Repos APIs.
* Track, package, register, and deploy models with MLflow on Databricks, including batch scoring and model serving jobs.
* Build Databricks Workflows for training, retraining, evaluation, and inference, with task dependencies, retries, and alerts.
* Support classification, forecasting as Python and Spark jobs on Databricks.
* Tune cluster size, autoscaling, Spark settings, and Delta Lake reads and writes so jobs stay reliable and cost-efficient.
* Convert Data Scientist notebooks into production pipelines with clear inputs, outputs, and fixed dependencies.
* Apply Databricks controls: Unity Catalog for data and model access, secret scopes, service principals, and model versioning.
* Fix failed jobs, slow Spark runs, library conflicts, and environment differences across workspaces.
* Write standards and runbooks for workspace layout, cluster policies, job templates, and promotion from dev to production.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6–12 years in ML Engineering, MLOps, or platform engineering, including hands-on ML work on Databricks.
* Databricks experience with workspaces, clusters and policies, Jobs and Workflows, Repos, Delta Lake, and Spark (batch and streaming).
* MLflow on Databricks for experiment tracking, model packaging, and the model registry.
* Strong Python, plus working knowledge of PySpark or Spark SQL.
* CI/CD for Databricks with Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience deploying ML models on Databricks, Azure, AWS services.
* Clear debugging skills and the ability to work with data science and platform teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform, or workspace-as-code.
* Unity Catalog, cluster policies, and service principals for job runs.
* Azure ML services such as Azure Machine Learning and Amazon SageMaker for training, pipelines, or model deployment.
* Healthcare or pharmaceutical domain experience.
* Agile or Scrum.
* Python packaging on Databricks (pip or conda, and runtime libraries).

**Good to Have:**

* SQL and PySpark for reading, joining, and transforming data on Databricks.
* Simple pipelines that ingest data, clean it, and store it in Delta Lake.
* Data quality checks and schema handling.
* Familiarity with healthcare or pharma data, such as EHR, clinical, or patient and drug datasets.
* Docker for packaging jobs and model services.
* Kubernetes and KServe for deploying and scaling models.
* Helm, Kubeflow, or Seldon for model deployment.
* MLflow, GitHub Actions, and Terraform for tracking, CI/CD, and environment setup.
* Model performance monitoring, data drift detection, alerting, and rollback for production models.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are a fast-growing technology startup preparing new products for production. We're looking for a hands-on **Database Platform Engineer** to own our PostgreSQL databases on AWS end to end: keeping them fast, reliable and secure at high concurrency, building the data pipelines that feed them, and automating how they are deployed and changed. You'll work closely with our principal engineer and backend team, and your decisions will shape the platform as it scales.

Key responsibilities

**Database administration**

* Own PostgreSQL on AWS RDS / Aurora in production, including high availability, replication and failover.
* Design and test backup and point-in-time recovery to meet defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Tune performance using execution plans, pg\_stat\_statements and Performance Insights; manage indexes, partitions, vacuum and bloat.
* Configure RDS parameter groups and connection pooling (PgBouncer / RDS Proxy) for high-concurrency workloads.
* Plan and run zero-downtime schema changes, data migrations and major version upgrades.
* Review database designs from developers for performance, integrity and security.

**Data engineering**

* Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT, CDC) using Python, SQL and AWS services.
* Move data reliably between transactional databases, event streams and analytics stores.

**DevOps and automation**

* Provision and manage database infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate database deployments through CI/CD pipelines using Flyway or Liquibase.
* Set up monitoring, alerting and dashboards with CloudWatch and Grafana; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Enforce database security: access control, encryption, auditing and secrets management.
* Automate routine operations with Bash and Python scripts.

Must-have skills

* 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production, including databases of 1 TB or more.
* Strong experience with AWS RDS or Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, Multi-AZ, read replicas, snapshots and upgrades.
* Proven experience with backup, PITR and restore, plus performance tuning and lock troubleshooting under high concurrency.
* Experience delivering zero-downtime schema changes and data migrations.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* CI/CD for database changes (Flyway, Liquibase, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline).
* Strong SQL plus scripting in Python and Bash; comfortable on Linux.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Pay: ₹691,000.00 - ₹1,900,000.00 per year

title: Delivery Director
description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong spirit in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team's health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**

Proven experience building, scaling and leading complex delivery organisations at scale (50+ people) spanning engineering, QA and delivery, including experience managing managers.

* A delivery and operator mindset first. Genuine fluency across data and digital product engineering, sufficient to work credibly with Tech Leads and architects on trade-offs, quality and risk, without requiring a hands-on engineering background yourself.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders without formal authority, across technical, commercial and client audiences.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Eligible to work in India.

Nice to Have

* A formal delivery or PMO background, or certification (Scrum, PRINCE2 or equivalent).
* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

Location and Travel

Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.

Able to travel to Vancouver, London, and Melbourne twice a year.

You’ll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM. As the most senior Two Circles leader in our Hyderabad office, you’ll also play an important role in our work with the BCCI, our most important partner in India. The role is based in Hyderabad.

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You’ll build and run a high-performing team and set the tone for its culture. You’ll bring discipline and predictability to how we deliver and make the India team’s performance visible to the rest of the business.

You’ll bring enough fluency in engineering and software delivery to earn the respect of our team, understanding trade-offs, spotting risk, and knowing when and how deep to go. You’ll govern quality and standards within the technical direction set by our global Engineering Directors and ensure excellence in the process for how we deliver software. You won’t be expected to set that direction yourself, but you will be expected to make sure it’s executed brilliantly in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Key responsibilitiesLeading the team and its culture

* Lead, grow and retain the India team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the culture of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You’ll treat culture as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and engineering excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Work with our Tech Leads to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed, in line with the direction set by our Engineering Directors for Data and Digital Products & CRM.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, metrics and governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team. It should cover hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality and performance, and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how the project leaders the India team works with in other regions rate its work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.

Global collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.

What success looks like in your first year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.
* A strong culture in our Hyderabad office, measured against our regular pulse checks.
* Our agentic engineering practices widely adopted across the India team.
* A clear monthly view of the India team’s health, shared with the wider business through a regular governance process.
* An India leadership layer in place that can support continued growth.

  
**Requirements**  

* 15+ years’ experience, including senior leadership of an organisation of 50+ people across engineering, QA and delivery, and experience managing managers.
* Direct leadership of engineering and QA teams, ideally having started your career as an engineer. You can contribute credibly to architecture and code-quality discussions across both data engineering and digital product engineering.
* Senior client-facing experience in a services, agency or consultancy business.
* Experience working within a multi-region or global delivery model.
* Hands-on ownership of the software delivery lifecycle, delivery processes, resourcing and talent management.
* Strong emotional intelligence and resilience, and the ability to influence senior peers and stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead and inspire teams and engage a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
* An interest in AI-enabled development practices and the drive to lead their adoption.
* Eligibility to work in India.
* Able to travel regularly to Vancouver, London and Melbourne.

Nice to have

* Familiarity with the platforms we build on (CMS, identity, video, CRM and e-commerce) and modern cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with sports and entertainment.
* Experience building or leading a Global Capability Centre or an India-based global delivery hub.
* Experience in both startup-style and enterprise-scale environments.

description:
Job Title: Marketo QA Engineer

**Experience:** 2+ years  
**Location:** Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune and Gurgaon  
**Work Model:** Hybrid – 3 days Work From Office  
**Shift:** 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM  
**Budget:** Up to ₹1 Lakh per month  
**Payroll:** Haparz

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Marketo QA Engineer to ensure the accuracy, functionality, and quality of marketing campaigns, automation workflows, data processes, and platform integrations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience validating Marketo campaign configurations, email programs, smart lists, lead data, and integrations with Salesforce or other marketing platforms.

The role requires strong analytical skills, systematic test execution, and the ability to identify campaign, workflow, and data issues before production activation.

Roles and Responsibilities

**1. Campaign and Email Quality Assurance**

* Validate email content, hyperlinks, images, personalization tokens, and dynamic content.
* Test nurture campaigns, triggered campaigns, wait steps, flow actions, and conditional logic.
* Verify A/B testing configurations, audience allocation, and campaign variants.
* Test landing pages and forms, including field validation, submission handling, and confirmation messages.
* Check email rendering across browsers, devices, and email clients.

**2. Marketo Program and Workflow Testing**

* Validate event registration, confirmation emails, reminders, and post-event follow-up workflows.
* Verify smart lists, segmentation criteria, audience counts, and program membership.
* Test form-to-program flows, lead capture, routing, and campaign progression.
* Validate content syndication feeds, field mappings, and data synchronization.
* Confirm that campaign logic meets the defined business requirements before activation.

**3. Data Quality and Validation**

* Validate lead and contact uploads for completeness, correct formatting, mandatory fields, and duplicates.
* Verify data normalization, field values, and list counts against expected results.
* Identify data inconsistencies before campaign execution.
* Use Excel and basic SQL, where applicable, to validate records and investigate data discrepancies.
* Verify that campaign and lead data remain consistent across connected platforms.

**4. Integration and Platform Testing**

* Validate Marketo-to-Salesforce synchronization, field mappings, and data consistency.
* Test API-based integrations and manual data exchanges with external platforms.
* Verify third-party email HTML, tracking links, and campaign data transfers.
* Document integration failures, investigate root causes, and coordinate resolution with technical teams.

**5. Test Documentation and Defect Management**

* Prepare and execute test cases, test scenarios, and regression test suites.
* Record defects with clear reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence.
* Perform retesting after fixes and validate business-critical workflows before release.
* Collaborate with marketing operations, campaign managers, developers, and business stakeholders in Agile or sprint-based environments.

Required Qualifications

* 2+ years of relevant QA experience, preferably in marketing automation or MarTech platforms.
* Hands-on knowledge of Adobe Marketo Engage, including campaigns, smart lists, program flows, and segmentation.
* Experience testing email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and marketing automation workflows.
* Understanding of lead data validation, deduplication, field mapping, and platform integrations.
* Basic SQL and Excel skills for data verification.
* HTML fundamentals for email validation, link inspection, and form troubleshooting.
* Strong attention to detail, test case documentation, defect reporting, and regression testing.

Good to Have

* Salesforce CRM and Marketo integration testing experience.
* API testing and third-party data integration validation.
* Exposure to performance or load testing.
* Experience with Jira or similar defect-tracking tools.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery and sprint-based QA.

title: Observability Engineer - Managed Services Engineer II
description:
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

  

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

As a Managed Services Engineer II, you will design, build, deploy, and optimize AI-powered solutions that support business and technology transformation. In this role, you will work across product, engineering, customer, and stakeholder teams to deliver scalable solutions from discovery and design through production rollout and post-go-live optimization. You will apply software engineering, systems integration, and AI capabilities to help solve complex business and technology challenges.

**Work you'll do**

As a Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

you will play a critical role in strengthening end-to-end visibility, reliability, and performance across cloud-native platforms. You will lead the migration from Elastic Stack (ELK) to Amazon Web Services (AWS) OpenSearch, ensuring a seamless transition of logging pipelines, dashboards, alerting strategies, and historical data retention. This includes redesigning ingestion flows, optimizing index structures, and improving query performance to enable scalable, real-time observability.

You will design and implement comprehensive observability solutions that help teams understand system behavior, accelerate troubleshooting, and make data-driven decisions. You’ll build and maintain robust monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks using modern tools and best practices—standardizing log formats, developing Grok patterns, defining index lifecycle management (ILM) policies, and ensuring efficient storage and search strategies that support both operational and business metrics.

You will also automate infrastructure provisioning and deployment pipelines using continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices to enable consistent, repeatable, and secure releases across environments. This work extends to Kubernetes and containerized workloads, where you will enhance visibility into cluster health, application performance, and distributed service interactions.

Collaboration is central to the role. You will work closely with development, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), and cloud engineering teams to troubleshoot issues, optimize performance, and embed observability as a core engineering practice. You will mentor junior engineers and promote best-in-class standards, fostering proactive monitoring, fast incident response, and continuous improvement.

**The team**

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.

**Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad

**Shift Timings:** 24/7 Rotational

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience with OpenSearch and ELK.
* Strong administration experience with Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and Beats (Filebeat/Metricbeat).
* Strong experience with OpenSearch alerting, deployment models, and migration strategies.
* Experience migrating and creating visualizations, dashboards, rules, alerts, and triggers using GitHub pipelines.
* Experience automating snapshot backup and restore to OpenSearch using pipelines.
* Expertise in log management, Grok patterns, ILM policies, and Query DSL.
* Proficiency with Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience with AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda.
* Strong understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM), Virtual Private Cloud (VPC), and cloud security best practices.
* CI/CD pipeline development using GitHub Actions.
* Proven leadership in large-scale infrastructure migrations.
* Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:

* Experience with application performance monitoring (APM) tools (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus).
* SRE/DevOps mindset with incident management exposure.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation.
* Experience with Nginx (reverse proxying, load balancing, performance tuning).
* Knowledge of WebLogic administration, deployment automation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with service-oriented architecture (SOA) concepts, integration patterns, and legacy modernization.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure services (monitoring, logging, infrastructure components).
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database performance tuning, query optimization, and availability best practices.
* Networking fundamentals (DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancers).
* Experience with incident and change management aligned to ITIL practices.
* ELK Certification.

#OBSENG

**Job Description**

Job Purpose :

Data Platform Services is building a governed, metadata-driven data integration and staging platform centered on SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and enterprise databases/data lakes — spanning source ingestion (SAP ERP/S/4HANA, non-SAP systems), a source-faithful central staging repository, long-term archival, and controlled distribution to multiple downstream systems.

We're looking for a DataOps Engineer who treats ETL pipeline design, data flows, and access-control logic as configuration, not one-off code — someone who builds and maintains systems where metadata tables and control frameworks drive what gets executed (jobs, interfaces, delta loads, transformations, and security masking), rather than hand-crafting individual one-off BODS jobs for every new dataset or consumer.

You'll work across ingestion (landing central staging archive), retention/partitioning strategy, and the routing/distribution rules engine that determines how data is extracted, transformed, filtered, or masked across multiple major downstream systems.

What You'll Do

* Build and operate robust batch and incremental change data capture (CDC) ingestion pipelines using SAP Data Services (BODS) from SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, SLT, ODP/Extractors) and non-SAP sources into central staging repositories/databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA, or Cloud Storage).
* Design and maintain metadata-driven ETL generation & execution frameworks — where dataset onboarding (new source table, delta logic, schema mapping, validation rules) is driven by configuration tables and reusable BODS templates/scripts rather than creating bespoke data flows from scratch.
* Implement and maintain partition-based retention, database archiving, and extraction routines for historical data and rolling window retention policies (e.g., current + N prior years).
* Build and maintain a dataset routing-rules engine: a governed metadata table (splittable, target\_systems[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) that programmatically directs and transforms BODS distribution jobs and target views per downstream system.
* Own BODS repository architecture & governance: manage local/central repositories, Data Services Management Console (DSMC), user access security, environment promotion (Dev/Test/Prod), and execution auditing/lineage.
* Drive DataOps & CI/CD automation: streamline BODS export/import/transport automation, repository synchronization, and job scheduling via Enterprise Scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys, Control-M, Airflow, or Azure Data Factory).
* Monitor pipeline health, job execution logs, CDC checkpoint integrity, schema drift, and data SLAs; establish automated alerting and self-healing for job failures and data-freshness breaches.
* Collaborate with upstream SAP functional/basis teams to define data contracts (e.g., Delta queue/ODP parameters, timestamps, extraction load impact) and downstream teams to translate their access/filter requirements into routing rules.
* Document pipeline architecture, data dictionaries, retention policies, and routing logic for auditability and seamless developer onboarding.

**️** Required Skills & Experience

Core Platform & SAP BODS

* Hands-on experience with SAP Data Services (BODS 4.x) designing complex Batch Jobs, Real-time Services, Workflows, Data Flows, and custom Scripts/Functions.
* Strong expertise in extracting data from SAP environments (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, ODP extractors, SLT, IDocs, RFC/BAPIs) as well as non-SAP flat files, REST APIs, and relational databases.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and relational database internals (e.g., SAP HANA, SQL Server, Oracle): query optimization, indexing, table partitioning, push-down SQL execution, and incremental CDC logic.
* Solid experience with BODS Central Repository management, object check-in/out workflows, version control, and multi-user development standards.

Metadata-Driven Engineering (Critical)

* Demonstrable background designing or maintaining metadata/config-driven ETL frameworks — e.g., control/registry tables driving dynamic SQL generation, parameterized BODS global variables, or generic reusable data flow templates.
* Strong understanding of keeping generated ETL processes and target tables in sync with a source-of-truth ruleset, including schema versioning and change auditability.
* Experience implementing automated audit logging, error handling, row-count reconciliations, and execution metrics captured directly via BODS scripts and database tables.

Platform Engineering / DataOps

* ETL Orchestration & Scheduling: Experience managing automated job schedules and dependency management via BODS Management Console, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, Airflow, or Autosys.
* CI/CD & Version Control: Experience applying software engineering discipline to BODS (e.g., Git integration/documentation, automated repository migrations, deployment scripts).
* Scripting & Automation: Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to automate file transfers, API interactions, and operational tasks around the BODS platform.
* Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience setting up alerting, performance bottleneck troubleshooting (memory/buffer tuning in BODS), and data validation frameworks.

Governance & Collaboration

* Working knowledge of enterprise data governance: access control models, data lineage, retention/compliance-driven deletion, and data masking/obfuscation techniques for sensitive data (PII).
* Experience serving multiple downstream consumers with varying analytical and operational requirements by delivering filtered and governed interfaces.
* Clear written communication habits; ability to articulate complex ETL architectures and governance rules to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SAP Information Steward (data quality profiling, rule building, metadata management).
* Hands-on experience integrating SAP BODS with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS S3).
* Exposure to SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT) or SAP Data Intelligence / Datasphere.
* Experience in large-scale multi-tenant enterprise environments supporting cross-functional business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial).

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

Config-Driven Onboarding: Standard source table onboarding (source

* landing/staging) is reduced to a configuration-driven process using reusable BODS templates, drastically reducing manual job creation.
* Automated Retention & Purging: Automated partition/date-based archiving and retention mechanisms are operational across staging repositories.
* Operational Routing Rules: A central metadata-driven routing table governs downstream extraction/distribution, dynamically applying required column masking and row filters.
* Resilient DataOps: Automated alerting, execution telemetry, and standard environment promotion workflows are established and fully documented.

**Required Skills**

Agile Methodology, Banking Capital Markets, Collaboration Tools, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), SAP Global Trade Services, SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP), SAP Solution Composer, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Success Factors, SAPUI5, SAP Warehouse Management System (WMS), Storytelling, Transaction Support, Treasury Accounting, Treasury Cash Management, Treasury Management

The Teradata Global Support Organization-Base (GSO BASE) Support team is a 24x7, high volume global support centre. Along with incident management, we provide technical/functional knowledge necessary to resolve customer’s problems, both internal and external. The support is provided in multiple languages across the globe.

**What You’ll Do**

The **Customer** **Technical Support Specialist** works in a fast-paced, demanding technical customer support center environment that requires timely solutions to complex technical problems, often of a critical nature to the customer. As a technical support specialist for Teradata’s Base Support team, you will perform troubleshooting activities, escalate problems to the appropriate party(s), and assist in communicating the solution to the customer. You will develop and maintain a working knowledge of current hardware, software, firmware, processes, and tools. You are required to have both strong technical and interpersonal skills. The work environment requires 24x7 coverage which is achieved via follow the sub-Model, on-call rotations, and extended hours, as needed, to accommodate customer needs. This position will also be supporting international customers in Japan for after hours and the ability to be proficient in English is a plus.

  

**Who You’ll Work With**

As the Technical Support Specialist French for GSO BASE typically works in a collaborative environment and interacts with various teams and individuals within Teradata. Some of the key stakeholders and colleagues that a Technical Support Specialist may work with Customers, Product Support Engineers, Platform support engineers, Service Experience Managers, Critical Support Managers, Infrastructure and Operations Teams, Training and Onboarding Teams, Third-party Vendors and other Engineering teams.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Effective oral and written communications skills in English & French language.

* 3-5 years of Technical Support related experience.
* Good Database and Operating System knowledge
* Experience in Help Desk/Customer service position is a plus
* Knowledge of Support Center procedures and troubleshooting protocols.
* Knowledge of UNIX, Linux, Windows and other current operating systems.
* Knowledge of Teradata support tools including the installation of remote tools is a plus.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow & Power BI reporting.

**What You’ll Bring**

As a Technical Support Specialist for GSO BASE, you will need to bring a combination of technical expertise, customer service skills, and problem-solving abilities to effectively assist customers with their cloud-related issues. You will serve as a bridge between customers and the technical aspects of Teradata services. Your ability to solve problems, provide excellent customer service, and stay current with cloud & Onprem technologies will be essential in ensuring customer satisfaction and success in this role. . Here's what you should bring to excel in this role:

* You should accept and respond to incoming calls and emails from English & French Speaking customers.
* You should be able to collaborate effectively with other support analysts, developers, engineers, and various teams to resolve complex issues.
* Provide Initial problem triage and clarify problem definition.
* Search knowledge bases for known solutions to known problems.
* Identification and management of duplicate incidents
* Extract logs, dumps, error files from customer systems and analyze.
* Prepare and transmit source upgrade files.
* Provide remote support to on-site resources.
* Log problem resolution and support knowledge creation
* Coordinates activities associated with product/service resolution issues.
* Apply search tools to identify previously developed solutions and recognize patterns and symptoms.
* Create monthly weekly reports and trend analysis.
* Attend Alert governance calls and isolate noise and redundant issues.
* Coordinate with customers and end-users to implement solutions.
* Track, monitor and maintain incident progress.
* Work set schedules including weekends and holidays in support of 24X7 coverage.

title: Senior Specialist, Cybersecurity Engineering
description:
Job Description
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Join our IT Risk Management Security team and play a key role in protecting a global enterprise’s most critical systems, accounts, and secrets. As a Privileged Access Secrets Management Engineer, you will design, deploy, and operate HashiCorp Vault and privileged access capabilities that reduce cyber risk and enable secure, automated secrets delivery. This role offers the opportunity to help shape enterprise privileged access and secrets management capabilities while working across identity, automation, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**  

* Design, implement, and support HashiCorp Vault in on-premises environments.
* Develop reusable patterns, standards, and onboarding guidance for HashiCorp Vault and secrets management across application, infrastructure, and automation teams.
* Support HashiCorp Vault integrations with CI/CD platforms, deployment pipelines, automation workflows, and application delivery processes.
* Enable secure injection, retrieval, rotation, and lifecycle management of secrets used by build, release, and runtime environments.
* Integrate PAM with enterprise applications, infrastructure and cloud platforms, and APIs.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and support production operations.
* Develop automation, standards, and operational processes that improve security, efficiency, and improve audit readiness.

**Required Qualifications:**  

* 5 years of experience designing, deploying, and supporting HashiCorp Vault in on-premises environments, including integrations with CI/CD tools, automation frameworks, APIs, and application deployment workflows.
* Strong understanding of secrets lifecycle management including dynamic secrets, secrets engines, and auth methods for service accounts, workloads, applications, and non-human identities.
* Practical knowledge of privileged account management techniques: vaulting, password rotation, secrets management, least-privilege access, and service account security.
* Experience integrating security platforms with Windows, Linux/Unix, databases, cloud services, applications, and APIs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to change, and work effectively within large, global, matrixed organizations.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and explain technical concepts to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
* Hands-on experience with identity platforms such as Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, cloud identity management, etc.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow for change and incident management and experience automating tasks with PowerShell or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with NIST, ITIL, or related security frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, Security, or similar credentials.
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles, cloud security, and modern identity security practices.

**Who we are:**

**Job Description**
-------------------

**SENIOR DATAOPS ENGINEER (ORACLE ADMIN) (MUMBAI, ON-SITE)**

Joining and work location: Mumbai, strictly on-site at the client

Experience: 3+ years as a production Oracle DBA | Joining: Immediate | Employment: Full time, XenonStack Private Limited

**ABOUT XENONSTACK**

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments. We build enterprise-grade platforms across the agentic stack:

- Akira AI - Reasoning and agent orchestration.

- ElixirData - Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes.

- NexaStack - Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on-prem.

- MetaSecure - Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security.

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI + Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise-ready.

**ABOUT THE ENGAGEMENT**

We are building a Managed Services team to support a large-scale enterprise data platform. The platform spans Cloudera on AWS, an on-premises Oracle data warehouse, Oracle GoldenGate replication, Apache Spark for ETL and data processing, and Alation for data governance. L1 support is handled by our existing team; this role is part of L2/L3 operations.

**ROLE MISSION**

Own the administration, availability and performance of the on-premises Oracle data warehouse and the GoldenGate replication that feeds the data platform.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Administer Oracle databases supporting the enterprise data warehouse.
* Perform backup and recovery (RMAN), restore validation and disaster recovery drills.
* Monitor and tune database performance using AWR/ASH, SQL tuning and indexing strategies.
* Plan and apply patches, upgrades and configuration changes with proper change control.
* Manage tablespaces, storage, users, roles and privileges in line with audit and compliance requirements.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Oracle GoldenGate replication, including lag, abends and data synchronization issues.
* Handle L2/L3 incidents with root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Support audit requests and maintain DBA documentation and runbooks.
* Guide Junior DataOps engineers on database-related issues.

**REPORTING**

Reports to the Managed Services delivery lead; works with the Data Security team and the client's DBA team.

**HOW WE WORK WITH AI**

AI is part of the daily workflow at XenonStack, not an add-on.

* Within XenonStack's own systems, AI tools are open for use: log and incident analysis, runbook and RCA drafting, scripting and documentation.
* At the client site in Mumbai, you follow the client's compliance and information security policy: use only client-approved tools, and never put client data, logs, credentials, queries or configurations into any tool the client has not approved.
* Every AI-assisted output is verified by you before it is relied on or shared.
* Come ready to talk about what is in your AI stack, how you verify its output, and how you keep it compliant in a regulated environment.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Backups verified by regular restore tests; DR drills meet the agreed RTO and RPO.
* GoldenGate lag within agreed limits, with abends resolved quickly and root-caused.
* No unplanned downtime from patches or changes.
* Audit requests answered on time with complete evidence.

**MUST-HAVE SKILLS**

* Oracle DBA experience on 12c/19c in production
* RMAN backup and recovery
* Performance tuning (AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning)
* Patching, tablespace and storage management
* User, role and privilege management
* Linux administration and shell scripting basics

**GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS**

* Oracle GoldenGate administration and troubleshooting (strongly preferred)
* Data Guard, RAC, ASM or Exadata
* Python scripting; exposure to Spark or data pipelines
* Familiarity with Alation

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent; Oracle certification (OCP) is an advantage
* Experience as a production DBA in an enterprise environment; regulated-industry exposure preferred
* Strong troubleshooting skills and discipline around change and audit processes

**HIRING PROCESS**

Pre-screening assessment (about 10 minutes, at application) Technical interview (video) Technical assessment round (live video; in person at our Mohali office for Chandigarh Tricity candidates) HR and Leadership round Background verification Offer.

**TERMS**

* Joining and work location: Mumbai, strictly on-site at the client.
* Immediate joining.
* Regulated production environment; background verification (BGV) is mandatory.
* Support model: 16x5 core support with P1 24x7 on-call, on a rotational basis, as per the client's support model.
* Relocation support and on-call allowance are discussed at the offer stage.
* Compensation as per company policy and budget band.

**HOW WE WORK**

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options, not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort.

**OUR VALUES**

Agency - Be self-directed and proactive | Taste - Sweat the details and build with precision | Ownership - Take responsibility for outcomes | Mastery - Commit to continuous learning and growth | Impatience - Move fast and challenge inertia | Customer Obsession - Always put the customer first

**WHY JOIN US**

* Run a large-scale enterprise data platform.
* AI-first environment: work alongside the agentic platforms we build.
* Great Place to Work-Certified, 14+ years, headquartered in Mohali.
