title: Global L&D Innovation Director
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Global L&D Innovation Director, you will lead the innovation engine within BCG's Global Learning & Development Strategy & Transformation Office. Reporting to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director, you will run a ringfenced innovation team focused on identifying, prototyping, and PoC testing the next generation of online learning experiences for BCG.

BCG's L&D model is evolving to deliver faster, more personalized, data-informed, and AI-enabled upskilling in support of BCG's 2030 strategy. You will be a critical leader in making that roadmap real, helping stand up the innovation team and tech squad, pilot adaptive learning, develop agentic learning prototypes to scale new products and experiences over time.

You will lead work across three connected domains:

* Innovation portfolio management - shaping the intake, prioritization, sequencing, governance, and delivery discipline for a portfolio of high-priority L&D innovation initiatives
* Experimentation and product development - leading the development and validation of new audience-facing learning experiences, products, formats, and AI-enabled solutions
* Implementation and scaling - partnering across L&D, Talent, IT/Product, and business stakeholders to move successful pilots into durable products, programs, platforms, or operating routines

The work will include experimentation with AI tools, AI workflows and automation for L&D internal transformation, and prototyping and piloting of agentic and adaptive learning experiences aligned to the 2030 L&D strategy. You will help BCG shift from slower, programmatic learning cycles toward rapid upskilling in short cycles - weeks, not years - particularly for emerging business needs and technical skills.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in innovation, product management, digital transformation, learning transformation, talent/capability building, strategy execution, or enterprise program leadership
* Experience leading teams in complex, global, matrixed environments, with a strong track record of coaching, developing, and mobilizing talent
* Demonstrated ability to move work from ideation through design, build, pilot and value proof.
* Experience in designing innovation with scale in mind, anticipating the technical, integration, and operating requirements needed to move successful pilots into production and enable a smooth handover to Product and IT
* Curiosity and the desire to change the status quo.
* Strong technology literacy, including comfort working with AI-enabled tools, digital products, workflow automation, learning platforms, or data-enabled solutions
* Experience managing a portfolio of initiatives with competing priorities, limited resources, and senior stakeholder visibility
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional partners, and manage tradeoffs with sound judgment
* Experience working with agile, product-led, design-thinking, test-and-learn, or rapid prototyping approaches
* Strong problem-solving and structured thinking, with the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous or fast-changing topics
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or conceptual ideas into clear business and learning implications
* Comfort operating at both strategic and executional levels - you can set direction and personally help get the work done
* Experience in L&D, talent, capability building, HR transformation, or professional services is preferred, but not required for candidates with strong innovation, product, or transformation experience
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Senior Director and lead the innovation team within the Global L&D Strategy & Transformation Office.

Your direct leadership scope will include the ringfenced innovation team responsible for developing and validating new learning experiences, products, formats, AI-enabled workflows, and agentic/adaptive prototypes. This team will act as a rapid experimentation and delivery capability for the L&D organization, helping relieve pressure from teams managing structured curricula and foundational programs while responding to accelerating demand for digital and AI upskilling.

You will work closely with:

* L&D Strategy Implementation & Transformation to align innovation priorities with the broader 2030 L&D roadmap, governance, investment choices, and transformation milestones
* Rapid AI Adoption teams to connect innovation efforts with urgent business-critical skill needs, AI upskilling priorities, and emerging technical capability requirements
* L&D Business Partners to understand demand from BCG's cohorts, businesses, regions, and functions and translate that demand into prioritized innovation opportunities
* Learning Architecture and Curriculum teams to ensure successful pilots can be embedded into learning journeys and sustained beyond the innovation team
* Learning Product and Operations teams to transition proven solutions into scalable delivery models, platforms, processes, and operating routines
* IT, Product, Data, and AI teams to ensure prototypes and pilots are technically feasible, well-integrated, secure, and aligned with BCG's broader technology ecosystem
* HR, Talent, and People Strategy teams to connect learning innovation to broader skill, performance, talent, and workforce priorities
* Vendors and external partners where third-party platforms, content, tools, or technical capabilities can accelerate delivery

Together, you will help BCG build a faster, more adaptive, more technology-enabled learning ecosystem - one that strengthens our world-class apprenticeship and faculty-led learning while creating scalable, personalized, data-informed learning experiences for the future.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT-**

* Taking ideas from concept to implementation - You can start with an ambiguous business or learning need, shape the problem, define the opportunity, mobilize the right people, test a technical solution, and evaluate what is needed to drive adoption and scale.
* Running a high-quality innovation portfolio - You bring structure to fast-moving work. You can manage intake, prioritization, resourcing, stage gates, decision rights, dependencies, risks, and handoffs without slowing the team down.
* Leading agile, multidisciplinary teams - You know how to lead teams that may include a mix of learning designers, product owners, technologists, data and analytics colleagues, AI specialists, vendors, and business SMEs. You create clarity, energy, accountability, and momentum.
* Applying technology and AI pragmatically - You are tech literate and curious. You do not need to be an engineer, but you can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what AI and digital tools can and cannot do, and translate emerging capabilities into usable learning solutions.
* Building solutions that are learner-centered and business-backed - You can connect business goals to skill needs, translate those needs into learning experiences, and keep outcomes at the center of the work.
* Collaborating across a complex ecosystem - You can operate in a global, matrixed environment and build strong partnerships with L&D Business Partners, Learning Architecture, Product and Operations, Talent, HR, IT, Product, and senior business stakeholders.
* Managing stakeholders with confidence and judgment - You know how to shape demand, negotiate tradeoffs, communicate progress, surface decisions, and keep stakeholders aligned across seniority levels and functions.
* Experimenting with discipline - You are comfortable with rapid prototyping, piloting, feedback loops, and iteration, but you also know when to stop, pivot, scale, or hand off.
* Leading people through ambiguity and change - You build trust, coach teams, manage performance, and help people do excellent work in a space where priorities, tools, and expectations are evolving quickly.
* Translating innovation into adoption - You understand that a successful prototype is only valuable if it is used. You think ahead about change management, communications, enablement, measurement, and integration into existing workflows.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps

title: Data Migration Engineer (SWP Workstream)
description:
**Req ID:**
390200
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Migration Engineer (SWP Workstream) to join our team in Gurgaon, Haryāna (IN-HR), India (IN).
  
  
Role Overview
  
  

* The Senior Data Migration Engineer serves as a hands-on technical contributor and delivery anchor, responsible for designing and implementing Python-based extract/load pipelines, dbt-based transformations, and Airflow-based orchestration for a large-scale migration from Informatica PowerCenter to a modern data stack.
* This role requires deep expertise in converting complex Informatica workflows into Python, dbt, and Airflow, and the ability to deliver production-quality, functionally equivalent output at enterprise scale.Key Responsibilities
* Assess complex Informatica workflows including sessions, mappings, and parameterizations and translate them into equivalent Python EL scripts and dbt transformation models.
* Develop and maintain Python EL pipelines to land high-volume data, including billion-row tables, into the target warehouse using SQLAlchemy, cx\_Oracle, pyodbc, and bulk export tools such as Oracle Data Pump and SQL Server BCP.
* Design and develop dbt transformation models based on Informatica mapping logic, incorporating dbt best practices including model layering, macros, incremental strategies, and snapshot patterns.
* Develop dbt-native tests as well as custom Python unit tests to validate transformation correctness and data quality.
* Develop Airflow DAGs to orchestrate Python EL and dbt scripts end-to-end, producing output that is functionally equivalent to the source Informatica workflows.
* Contribute to GitLab CI/CD pipeline for dbt and Airflow code, including lint gates, automated testing, and deployment to shared NAS.
* Perform peer code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback to fellow engineers.
* Troubleshoot performance issues and data discrepancies during SIT and UAT, including row-count reconciliation between source Oracle/SQL Server systems and the target warehouse.
* Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, and handover materials.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of Informatica PowerCenter experience - mappings, sessions, workflows, and parameterization
* 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
* Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
* 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing
* 5+ years of SQL experience - complex joins, window functions, aggregations across large datasets
* Experience with Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp) or SQL Server BCP / BULK INSERT for high-volume data movement

**Preferred**

* Experience with SQLAlchemy, cx\_Oracle, or pyodbc for Python-based database connectivity
* Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers in offshore delivery models..

title: Senior Python Engineer - Data ( Remote, Full-Time) [AS340]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  

**About the Role**

  

As a Senior Python Engineer (Backend / Data), you will join an existing engineering team to strengthen backend development and data engineering capabilities. This is a long-term, ongoing opportunity (subject to confirmation), focused on building and maintaining reliable production systems.

  

You will work closely with the engineering team and an existing DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure, deployments and releases. The role requires independent ownership of assigned work, collaboration across engineering functions and an understanding of how data pipelines support the wider product.

  

You will contribute to engineering decisions, maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing, and propose solutions rather than simply execute assigned tasks. Reliability and thoroughness in production are key priorities.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines in Python on AWS.
  
* Build and maintain backend services and APIs using Django and FastAPI.
  
* Model, query and optimise data across PostgreSQL and search/NoSQL databases, including OpenSearch, Elasticsearch and DynamoDB.
  
* Deploy and run services on Kubernetes, working alongside the DevOps engineer.
  
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned work, including design, testing, code reviews, releases and production support.
  
* Work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating closely with the engineering team and DevOps/SRE engineer on infrastructure and releases.
  
* Maintain high standards of data quality, correctness and testing while understanding how data pipelines contribute to the wider product.
  
* Follow established engineering practices, including code reviews and CI/CD, while adapting to changing priorities.
  
* Proactively identify problems, propose solutions and challenge technical decisions when necessary rather than simply executing tickets.
  
* Prioritise thoroughness, reliability and production stability when developing and maintaining data pipelines and data stores.
  
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years of commercial Python development.
  
* 5+ years of Python backend development experience, with strong hands-on engineering capabilities.
  
* 3+ years of experience in data pipelines and data engineering, including ETL/ELT processes and batch processing. Relevant technologies include Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, AWS Glue and Step Functions.
  
* 3+ years of AWS experience, with practical experience developing and maintaining cloud-based backend services and data pipelines. Strong GCP or Azure experience may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
  
* 3+ years of experience with Python web frameworks, particularly Django or FastAPI. Flask is an acceptable alternative.
  
* 3+ years of PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling, querying and optimisation. MySQL or SQL Server experience may be considered where strong SQL expertise is demonstrated elsewhere.
  
* 2+ years of experience with non-relational or search databases, such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or DynamoDB. Relevant alternatives include MongoDB, Redis and Cassandra.

description: Company OverviewKKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will own the end-to-end architecture of a layered, event-driven data platform — spanning sourcing, ingestion, entity mastering, a bitemporal golden copy, and an API-first distribution layer — and drive it from vision to production. You will be the senior-most engineering voice on reference data, shaping platform strategy, establishing engineering standards across teams, and partnering with product, data, and infrastructure leaders to deliver a scalable, vendor-agnostic master data capability. The ideal candidate is an expert Python engineer and data architect with deep experience in master data management (MDM) and reference data within the financial industry — including market data and vendor feeds — combined with hands-on experience applying Generative AI to data platforms, distributed data processing, and building reusable, independently scalable platform components.Roles & Responsibilities Own the architecture of a layered reference-data platform, defining the contracts between sourcing, ingestion, mastering, golden-copy, and distribution layers so each is independently buildable, deployable, and scalable. Set technical direction for entity mastering — standardization, blocking, matching, survivorship, and crosswalk/lineage — designing rules as configuration (data, not code) that scale from exact-match fast paths to full-population fuzzy resolution. Architect the durable golden copy: a bitemporal, point-in-time source of truth with match evidence, per-attribute provenance, and a schema-last serving model that adapts to new sources and domains without migration. Design the API-first, self-documenting distribution surface (REST, curated data products, subscriptions) governed by data contracts and consumable by applications, analytics, and AI/agents. Drive the platform’s storage and compute strategy over an open lakehouse (Apache Iceberg, Snowflake) and elastic compute (Spark), ensuring an open, vendor-agnostic, no-lock-in foundation. Establish engineering standards, reference patterns, and a reusable component library (a layered monorepo) that make capabilities build-once, reuse-everywhere across domains. Lead cross-team technical design reviews, resolve the hardest architectural trade-offs, and align engineering execution with the firm’s data strategy. Champion data quality, governance, security, entitlements, audit, and observability as first-class, cross-cutting foundations of the platform. Mentor senior and staff engineers, grow technical depth across the team, and set the bar for engineering excellence. Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate reference-data needs into a durable, scalable platform roadmap.Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time as a technical lead or architect of data-intensive platforms. Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services, data pipelines, and platform frameworks. Proven experience architecting master data management (MDM) or reference/entity-data systems — entity resolution, survivorship, golden records, crosswalk, and lineage. Deep data engineering expertise: data modeling, ETL/ELT design, distributed processing (Spark), and data distribution patterns at scale. Hands-on experience designing API-first services and event-driven / streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, CDC). Strong command of modern data storage — relational, non-relational, and lakehouse formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) — and SQL. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and cloud-native deployment (containers, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD). Deep domain experience with reference and master data in the financial industry — parties / legal entities, instruments, portfolios, and accounts — and the identifier, hierarchy, and cross-referencing challenges specific to it. Hands-on experience integrating and mastering market data and vendor/administrator feeds (e.g., Bloomberg, exchange, and fund-servicing sources), including normalization, cross-referencing, and point-in-time handling. Practical experience applying Generative AI / LLMs to data platforms — e.g., grounded retrieval over governed data, entity-resolution and data-quality assistance, or AI/agent-ready data access with provenance guarantees. A track record of setting technical direction, driving architecture across teams, and mentoring senior engineers. Excellent judgment on architectural trade-offs, and the communication skills to align engineering, product, and business stakeholders.Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with bitemporal / point-in-time data modeling and governed, auditable data systems. Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) and lakehouse catalogs (e.g., Polaris, Nessie, Glue). Exposure to commercial or vendor MDM/ontology platforms (e.g., Palantir Foundry) and experience integrating them as pluggable engines within an open architecture. title: Head, GCFO AI Lead(Singapore, India)
description:
**Job Summary**
This role could be based in Singapore or India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
  
  

* The GCFO AI lead is accountable for transforming the Finance operating model through process excellence, re-engineering, intelligent automation, and artificial intelligence.
* The role leads the redesign and optimization of GCFO's end-to-end processes, controls, data, and operating model, embedding simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across the function. As the architect of Finance transformation, the role drives continuous improvement, productivity, control effectiveness, and digital innovation, creating a highly efficient, insight-led, and AI-enabled Finance organisation.
* Beyond GCFO, the role serves as the senior Finance representative across Bank-wide AI and transformation initiatives, ensuring GCFO priorities are reflected in the enterprise AI agenda while accelerating the adoption of responsible AI, automation, and emerging technologies across the function. The role partners with Technology, Data, Operations, Risk, and Business leaders to identify enterprise use cases, influence investment priorities, and scale innovation that delivers measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Define and own the GCFO Process Excellence and AI Strategy, establishing a clear vision for a future-state Finance platform that is integrated, scalable, resilient, data-driven, and AI-enabled.
* Shape and deliver the long-term GCFO transformation agenda, translating strategic objectives into a coherent platform roadmap with clear outcomes, milestones, investment priorities, and measurable business value.
* Serve as the Finance and Treasury champion for enterprise-wide AI transformation, representing GCFO across Bank-wide AI initiatives, influencing cross-functional priorities, and ensuring alignment with the Bank's AI strategy.
* Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Risk, Technology, Operations, Data, and the Businesses to identify, prioritize, and scale AI opportunities that deliver sustainable productivity, control, and commercial benefits.
* Architect future-ready operating models that support business growth, enhance organizational agility, and reduce complexity, operational risk, and cost.
* Champion intelligent automation and digital transformation through the adoption of workflow technologies, RPA, AI/ML, agentic capabilities, and next-generation productivity solutions.
* Ensure alignment with Group Finance, Risk, Technology, Data, and regulatory strategies while maintaining strong governance, controls, resilience, and audit readiness across both traditional and digital-asset environments.
* Contribute to the development of the Bank's AI standards, governance frameworks, control environment, and Responsible AI practices, ensuring safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of AI across the enterprise.
* Monitor emerging AI technologies, regulatory developments, and industry-leading practices, identifying opportunities that advance Finance and Treasury capabilities while strengthening the Bank's competitive advantage.

**Business**

* Strengthen GCFO’s business partnering model with Finance, Risk, Technology, and the wider business.
* Ensure GCFO PE and AI materially improves decision-making quality, speed, and insight through predictive, prescriptive, and generative analytics.
* Support growth, product innovation, and balance-sheet optimisation, including emerging tokenised financial products.
* Act decisively to address risk and control weaknesses, ensuring issues are remediated and escalated appropriately.

**Processes**

* Process, Control & Organisation Layer: Establish integrated controllership and operating-model capabilities including iCon, ARIS, Signavio, ProHance, M7, CIMCON, ServiceNow, and WalkMe, embedding control-by-design and auditability.
* Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units
* Drive technology enablement and integration across a complex systems landscape including SAP, non-SAP ERP applications, and emerging AI solutions, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation that reduces manual effort and strengthens controls.
* Pioneer the adoption of Agent AI and intelligent automation within controllership processes, evaluating use cases, managing implementation, and realizing measurable benefits in efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value delivery.
* Intelligence Layer: Deliver AI-enabled capabilities including Knowledge Graphs, vector stores, RAG, Digital Twins, LLMs, and Agents to enable advanced analytics and decision support across finance and digital-asset domains.
* Define defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processes

**People & Talent**

* Build and lead a high-performing GCFO Process excellence organisation spanning platform ownership, product management, data, AI, engineering, and digital-asset expertise.
* Develop future-ready GCFO talent and act as an evangelist for GCFO digital enablement, and AI adoption.

**Risk Management**

* Reinforce an exemplary risk and control culture across all GCFO platforms and processes, including those supporting digital assets and tokenised products.
* Maintain compliance with key regulatory and financial reporting standards.
* Strengthen the control environment while driving process simplification and efficiency.
* Embed audit readiness through disciplined governance, documentation, and testing.

**Governance**

* Establish control and review frameworks for GCFO platforms and processes, ensuring compliance with Group Control Governance and EUC policies.
* Define and update relevant policies, standards, and guidelines, and ensure platforms are benchmarked against industry best practice.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, regulatory compliance, and business conduct across GCFO.
* Resolve audit and regulatory issues with sustainable, long-term solutions.

**Key stakeholders**

* Group CFO and GCFO Leadership Team
* GCFO COO Management Team
* Group Finance, Risk, Technology, and Data Office
* Audit, Compliance, and Regulators
* Regional and Cluster CFOs.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* 20+ years of experience with a strong track record of transformation in Finance & Accounting including controllership , FP&A , Regulatory reporting etc
* Proven experience delivering large-scale finance transformation programmes in an international bank or equivalent regulated institution
* Strong understanding of Generative AI , LLMs , AI agents , Automation and Analytics
* Quantifiable benefits through cost reduction, productivity , faster close , better forecasting and controls
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Finance AI use cases – Experience applying AI to forecasting, reporting , treasury ,controllership and reconciliations
* AI Governance – Strong understanding of responsible AI, model risk , controls and regulatory requirements
* Technology ecosystem – Expert in ERP platforms such as SAP , cloud platforms , GenAI platforms and enterprise AI tools
* Deep, hands-on expertise in digital assets, process mapping, analysis, and redesign using tools like ARIS, Signavio, or Celonis
* Strong understanding of accounting, valuation, liquidity, capital, and risk implications of crypto assets, tokenised deposits, stablecoins, CBDCs, and other digital instruments.
* Experience integrating on-chain and off-chain data and distributed-ledger technologies into enterprise finance and risk platforms.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt certification preferred
* Professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CIMA, or equivalent) highly valued

**Role Specific Technical Competencies**

* Proven experience in delivering large scale global solution deployments preferably in the financial services environment
* Finance Domain expertise
* Process reengineering
* AI Strategy Roadmap
* AI Tools and Assets
* Identification & Management of project Risk/Assumptions/Issues/ Dependencies
* Advanced Components, e.g. Knowledge Graphs, Agents, LLMs
* Data and Analytics
* Change and Adoption
* Banking and Regulatory knowledge

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our R&D Department. The candidate will be responsible for validating web-scraped data, reviewing sample files, testing API responses, verifying client-specific requirements, and ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards before submission.

The candidate will work closely with developers, Team Leads (TLs), and Assistant Team Leads (ATLs) to identify defects, maintain quality benchmarks, and prevent recurring data extraction issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Quality Assurance**

* + Validate scraped data against the source website and client requirements.
  + Verify field-level accuracy, completeness, consistency, and data types.
  + Identify missing fields, incorrect values, duplicate records, and formatting issues.
  + Validate product details, pricing, availability, URLs, identifiers, and other relevant attributes.

**2. Sample and Deliverable Validation**

* + Review sample files before they are marked as QA-passed or submitted to clients.
  + Ensure that the output structure, column names, file naming conventions, and data formats match the specified requirements.
  + Validate samples against the approved requirements and reference examples.
  + Maintain evidence of validation and document any defects identified.

**3. API Testing**

* + Validate API requests and responses, including HTTP status codes, response structures, required fields, and error handling.
  + Verify JSON, CSV, Excel, and other required output formats.
  + Test pagination, filtering, and relevant request parameters wherever applicable.
  + Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.

**4. Defect Management and RCA**

* + Report defects with clear descriptions, sample records, screenshots, and reproduction steps.
  + Coordinate with developers and TLs/ATLs for defect resolution and retesting.
  + Identify recurring quality issues and contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  + Maintain defect logs and track issues until closure.

**5. Quality Process Improvement**

* + Develop and maintain QA checklists for different projects and platforms.
  + Identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation tasks using Python.
  + Track quality metrics, including defect rates, first-pass acceptance, rework, and sample rejection trends.
  + Recommend improvements to reduce recurring errors and improve delivery reliability.

**Required Skills**

* + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  + Experience in manual testing, data validation, or software QA.
  + Basic to intermediate Python knowledge for data validation and automation.
  + Experience working with JSON, CSV, Excel, and structured datasets.
  + Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and response validation.
  + Familiarity with Postman, Excel, and basic SQL/MongoDB queries.
  + Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Experience in web scraping, crawling, e-commerce data, or data extraction projects.
  + Knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, XPath, and browser developer tools.
  + Experience with automated testing frameworks or data comparison scripts.
  + Familiarity with Git and issue-tracking systems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* + Accuracy and completeness of QA validation.
  + Number of defects identified before client submission.
  + Reduction in recurring defects and sample rejections.
  + Compliance with project-specific QA checklists.
  + Timely completion of QA reviews.
  + Quality and completeness of defect reports and RCAs.
  + Effectiveness of retesting and defect closure.

**Expected Outcome**

The QA Engineer will establish an independent quality checkpoint within the R&D workflow, ensuring that samples and deliverables are validated against client requirements before final approval and reducing avoidable rework and quality escalations.

description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies.
* Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles.
* Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented.
* Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads.
* Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends.
* Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management.
* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices).
* Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout.
* Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including:
* Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups.
* APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments.
* Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs.
* Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance.
* SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level.
* Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments.
* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.
* Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units.

**Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic)**

* Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers.
* Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging.
* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents.
* Strong documentation and process-governance discipline.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**The Role**

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.
* Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.
* Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.
* Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.
* Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.
* Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.
* Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.
* Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).
* Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.
* Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).
* Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.
* Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Observability Platform Skills**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.
* Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting.
* Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).
* APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.
* Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.
* RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces.
* Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.
* Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.

**Application and Architecture Understanding**

* Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.
* Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns.
* Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.
* Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).
* Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.
* Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).

**Soft Skills**

* Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.
* Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents.
* Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Work Details**

* **Level:** L2 (Mid-level, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** 24x7 rotational shifts, with on-call/escalation coverage as needed
* **Reporting To:** L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead

description:

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Salesforce Lead – Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**

**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Location:** Kochi / Bangalore / Hyderabad (Hybrid)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** Service Delivery Manager / Salesforce Architect

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable **Salesforce Lead** to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation **Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform** powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can **lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.

This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:
  + Incident Management
  + Service Request Management
  + Change Management
  + Problem Management
  + Knowledge Management
  + Employee Support Services
  + CMDB Management
  + IT Asset Management
  + Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**

**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:
  + Service Cloud
  + Sales Cloud
  + Experience Cloud
  + Salesforce Platform
* Deep technical expertise in:
  + Apex
  + Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  + Salesforce Flows
  + SOQL/SOSL
  + Platform Events
  + Integration Patterns
  + REST/SOAP APIs
  + Salesforce Security Model
* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Data Architecture
  + Security & Sharing Models
  + DevOps & CI/CD
  + Release Management
  + Application Lifecycle Management
* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:
  + CMDB
  + IT Asset Management (ITAM)
  + Service Catalog
  + Enterprise Operations Management
* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are seeking professionals who:

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges.
* Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations.
* Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.
* Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation.
* Influence platform architecture and engineering direction.
* Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team.
* Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders.
* Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways.
* Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued.

**Join Us ?**

If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of **Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**. This role offers the opportunity to combine **technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence** while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.

title: Inventory Analyst
description:
The **Inventory Analyst** is responsible for collecting and interpreting inventory data from our ERP system, evaluate the efficiency of overall stock holding and help identify streamlined purchasing methods. Contribute to the monthly inventory forecasting process, providing clear instruction for the branches to ensure we have an accurate account of inventory levels for the coming months to meet our cash targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Inventory Forecasting**

· Analyse inventory data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization.

· Coordinate the monthly inventory planning processes, ensuring all data is collected in a timely manner, and regional reviews take place before submission to Longview.

· Weekly monitoring of perpetual inventory levels to ensure we are in line with forecast and highlighting areas of concern.

· Work closely with branches to improve inventory performance against targets, identifying specific customers or elements within the supply chain that are contributing to any significant change in gross inventory.

· Analyse and report on specific customer Actual v Forecasted sales, identifying fluctuations that could affect our overall stock holding.

· Analyse aged 1 year + or slow-moving inventory, report back to the branches and track commercial claim opportunities.

· Provide regular updates on rejecting material values, helping to ensure branch personnel are taking appropriate action.

**Purchasing Responsibilities**

· Monitor purchasing patterns at the Int branches and track value of open order books to ensure management is aware of any fluctuations that may affect cash targets.

· Monitor the information held within the ERP database to ensure Materials personnel can make informed decisions when deciding what to purchase

· Identify continuous improvement opportunities within purchasing and contribute to updating processes and procedures.

· Assist with training new buyers/planners to ensure all buyers use the ERP system as expected and are aware of relevant procedures.

· Support new product introductions (NPI) and product lifecycle inventory planning.

**General Analysis & Reporting**

· Develop and maintain inventory reporting, dashboards, and KPIs (e.g. stock turns, ageing, service levels).

· Help identify and drive opportunities for best practice improvements within the dept.

· When required, assist with planning & purchasing activity at specific branches

· Interact with Logistics colleagues to ensure we can consolidate shipments between branches and move products by the most economical means.

· Assist when required with data analysis for other key parts of the business.

· Maintain and improve master data accuracy within ERP/MRP systems.

· When required, assist with planning & purchasing activity at specific branches

· Interact with Logistics colleagues to ensure we can consolidate shipments between branches and move products by the most economical means.

· Assist when required with data analysis for other key parts of the business.

· Maintain and improve master data accuracy within ERP/MRP systems.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 years’ experience in inventory planning, forecasting, purchasing, or supply chain analysis.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large volumes of data and identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Experience monitoring inventory performance, stock levels, and forecasting accuracy.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems to manage inventory and purchasing data.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to create reports, dashboards, and KPI analysis.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate master data.
* Experience producing and presenting management reports and recommendations.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Experience in a manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or supply chain environment is preferable.
* Experience supporting new product introductions (NPI) and product lifecycle management.
* Understanding of purchasing processes and supplier management.
* Knowledge of logistics, transportation planning, and shipment consolidation.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹750,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Operations Analyst, Credit Bureau Reporting- Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We're looking for a detail-oriented Operations Analyst to join our Credit Bureau Reporting Operations team, where you'll play a critical role in ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant credit bureau reporting.  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and delivering credit bureau reports by extracting data from data warehouses and ensuring full compliance with all applicable reporting guidelines and regulatory standards. You will manage the end-to-end dispute resolution process for disputes received from Credit Information Companies (CICs) — investigating each case thoroughly and responding with accurate, well-documented, and detailed responses within defined turnaround times (TAT).  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Extract, validate, and reconcile data from data warehouses to prepare accurate and timely credit bureau reports in compliance with all regulatory and organizational reporting guidelines  
Manage the end-to-end dispute resolution process for disputes received from Credit Information Companies (CICs), ensuring each dispute is thoroughly investigated and resolved within defined turnaround times (TAT)  
Draft and deliver clear, detailed, and well-documented dispute responses through email and designated dispute management portals  
Monitor and track dispute aging, TAT adherence, and resolution metrics to ensure consistent compliance with service-level agreements (SLAs)  
Handle client communications professionally, including responding to queries, providing status updates, and managing interactions across email and specified portals  
Manage and resolve escalations promptly, coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and satisfactory outcomes  
Maintain accurate records and documentation for all reporting activities, dispute cases, and client interactions for audit and compliance purposes  
Identify gaps, trends, and patterns in dispute data to recommend process improvements and enhance reporting accuracy  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on reporting standards, dispute handling procedures, and regulatory updates  
  
A day in the life  
Your day begins with reviewing overnight dispute queues from Credit Information Companies (CICs) and prioritizing cases based on TAT deadlines. You'll extract and validate data from data warehouses to prepare credit bureau reports, ensuring every submission meets regulatory guidelines. Mid-day, you'll draft detailed dispute responses and update case statuses on designated portals. You'll handle client emails, address escalations, and coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex cases. Before wrapping up, you'll track TAT metrics, flag aging disputes, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks — keeping reporting accurate and clients informed every step of the way.  
  
About the team  
The Credit Bureau Reporting Operations team at Amazon is dedicated to ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant credit reporting across all regulatory frameworks. We work at the intersection of data, compliance, and customer trust — managing everything from report generation to end-to-end dispute resolution with Credit Information Companies (CICs). Our team thrives on precision, accountability, and continuous improvement. We collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to uphold the highest standards of data integrity and regulatory compliance. If you're someone who takes ownership, sweats the details, and wants to make a real impact — you'll fit right in.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in any field of study
* Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Any data analyis courses

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: GTM Data Quality Analyst
description:
**Location**
------------

Bengaluru

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**

Hybrid

**Department**
--------------

Business Expansion

**About CodeRabbit**
--------------------

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

  

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation — building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

You'll own the quality of the data that underpins every routing rule, territory, forecast and ARR number at CodeRabbit. You'll start by working the requests our GTM and Finance teams send to RevOps every day, and you'll turn each kind of request into a written runbook. Then you'll build the Data Quality Agent: an AI agent that handles most of those requests itself, routes the risky ones to a human for approval, and keeps a full record of everything it does. You'll join Business Systems, a small team that builds with agentic tools every day, and you'll work on the same engineering harness our engineers use to ship Salesforce and internal tool changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the tier-1 data queue for internal GTM systems data support: account ownership changes, account creation, merges, parent-child hierarchies, lead conversion, and linking billing subscriptions to the right Salesforce account.
* Resolve requests within the team's response standard and leave a record any teammate can pick up.
* Write and maintain a runbook for every recurring request type: the trigger, the checks, the steps, the edge cases, and when to escalate.
* Design, build and run the Data Quality Agent with Code Rabbit Coding Agent and our engineering harness, starting in shadow mode and earning its autonomy one workflow type at a time.
* Define the agent's approval tiers: what it can fix on its own, what it proposes for human approval, and what it always escalates.
* Run duplicate detection and merge cohorts across accounts, contacts and leads, and keep account hierarchies accurate as customers grow, merge and reorganize.
* Close enrichment gaps (firmographics, domains, HQ location, parent company) using our enrichment tools and the data warehouse.
* Track the request queue and data health with clear metrics: volume by request type, time to resolve, agent accuracy, and how often humans override the agent.
* Find the root cause behind repeat requests and bring proposals to the engineers so the fix lands upstream.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years in CRM data operations, sales operations, RevOps or data quality at a B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience: the Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity data model, ownership and sharing basics, reports, and bulk data tools.
* Strong SQL. You can answer your own questions from the warehouse without waiting on an analyst.
* You have used AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to automate real work, and you can show us something you built: a prompt chain, a script, an agent, or an automation that saved hours.
* You write clear, step-by-step documentation that someone else can follow without asking you questions.
* Careful judgment with production data. You know which changes are easy to undo and which are not, and you treat them differently.
* Comfortable working across time zones with stakeholders in the US and Europe.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with dedupe and merge tools such as Traction Complete, DemandTools, Cloudingo or Salesforce duplicate rules.
* Python or JavaScript scripting, Git, and comfort working in a code repository.
* Experience with enrichment and prospecting data tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Exposure to billing systems such as Chargebee, and how subscriptions can map to CRM data.
* Experience with BigQuery, dbt or another cloud data warehouse.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows: approval steps, confidence thresholds, audit logs and evaluations.
* Familiarity with developer-tools or technical B2B SaaS go-to-market (GTM).

**Our Values**
--------------

  

* **Collaborative Humans**: Prioritizing collective intelligence

* **Fearless Innovators**: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

* **Persistent, Passionate Developers**: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

* **Impact-Driven Creators**: Crafting intuitive tools for developers

* **Rapid Learners and Un-learners**: Adapting quickly in our fast-paced technological world

**What We Offer**
=================

  

* Work on cutting-edge technology with real-world impact

* Collaborative and innovative environment

* Competitive salary, equity, and benefits

* Professional development opportunities

To apply, submit your resume and relevant project samples or GitHub profiles. CodeRabbit is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.
