title: IT Compliance & Controls Analyst II
description:
**Description**

The IT Compliance/Controls Analyst II is a pivotal role within the Global Information Security (GIS) department, dedicated to advancing IT governance and managing organizational risk. This position ensures the robust implementation and operational effectiveness of critical IT controls. A primary focus is maintaining rigorous compliance with key global regulatory and assurance obligations, including but not limited to CFTC, SEC, Fedline Assurance, and SWIFT CSP, for independent effective challenge and minimize corporate risk. The incumbent will conduct comprehensive security risk assessments, with a specialized emphasis on evaluating AI/ML deployments and frontier model concepts. Furthermore, the role involves driving automated AI-based risk and compliance initiatives to keep the organization at the forefront of technological and process evolution.

**Primary Accountabilities**

* Internalize and contribute to the strategic goals of the CME Group Technology Compliance Team.
* Maintain expert knowledge of the company’s IT infrastructure, applications, and governance standards.
* Execute control assessments to verify the adequacy of internal controls and adherence to corporate policies.
* Conduct comprehensive security risk assessments to preemptively address audit findings and reduce risk.
* Evaluate security risks associated with AI/ML deployments and emerging frontier model technologies.
* Lead forward-looking AI-driven risk initiatives to ensure continuous alignment with regulatory advancements.
* Design and implement Python-based control automation pipelines, integrating with enterprise APIs (Archer GRC, CyberArk, AD, HashiCorp Vault) for programmatic evidence validation.
* Ensure strict compliance with regulatory obligations, including CFTC, Fedline, and SWIFT CSP frameworks.
* Produce detailed, logical work-papers documenting testing procedures, results, and expert conclusions.
* Streamline control testing and risk processes utilizing automation and AI tools (e.g., Python, Gemini).
* Foster collaborative relationships with stakeholders to enhance the efficiency of the controls testing program.

**Key responsibilities include**

* Test internal technology controls in alignment with global regulatory requirements.
* Develop and recommend strategic remediation plans for identified control gaps.
* Identify opportunities for automation within IT control and risk assessment workflows.
* Provide regular status reporting and assist in the development of performance metrics for senior leadership.
* Partner with senior team members to advise management on strengthening controls and mitigating risks.
* Assess existing controls against evolving industry best practices and legal obligations.
* Execute standard lifecycle security risk assessments across diverse technical domains.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with emerging AI/ML technologies and frontier models.
* Support the establishment and refinement of compliance frameworks for AI applications.
* Maintain strict alignment with global regulatory standards in all remediation and testing activities.

  

The incumbent will collaborate with key partners such as IT Control Owners, Corporate Compliance, Business Process Owners and Global Assurance (i.e. Internal Audit) with supporting and establishing new approaches or changes in existing processes around documented requirements for mitigation of associated risks. Given the current control environment, precedents will need to be established to determine how to properly respond, leveraging defined controls but continuing to establish a policy reflecting a culture of compliance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in IT audit, risk advisory, or information security within a financial or professional services firm.
* Professional certification highly desirable (CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or ISO 27001).

* Experience in technical aspects of IT Risk Management, Information Security, Technical Privacy, and/or IT Audits
* Working Knowledge in technologies and environments leveraging operational knowledge of Information Security best practices and industry standards to define the security controls and processes
* Experience as an Information Security analyst in a professional services firm or large enterprise, which includes interfacing with key control stakeholders, and participating in the planning and execution of projects in one or more of the following areas - Information Security, Risk Management, Technical Compliance, IT Security Audit, Remediation, and / or IT Risk Management (or) Experience in one or more Technology areas like Information Security, Software Development, IT Architecture, RPA, Data Analytics, etc. with a willingness to move to an IT audit role.
* Proficiency in Python-based automation for continuous control monitoring and data analysis.
* Ability to recommend and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of compliance controls.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001, EU AI Act) and best practices.
* Ability to participate in key team discussions and meetings; preparing concise, accurate documents and balancing project deadlines with the occurrence of unanticipated issues.
* Possess strong written and verbal communication skills/presentation skills, and ability to work with diverse teams
* Demonstrate thorough abilities as a team player; creating a positive environment while meeting project expectations and respecting the work-life quality of team members, providing candid, meaningful feedback in a timely manner, and keeping leadership informed of progress and issues.
* Interfacing with key stakeholders on control solutions. Participating in planning and execution of projects in: Information Security, Risk Management, Technical Privacy/Compliance, IT Security Audit, and / or IT Risk Management.
* Knowledge of industry frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, CFTC, and SOC2.
* Experience working with CAATs/data analytics tools and technologies such as Cloud, DevOps, Microservices, etc.
* Proficient usage of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) & Audit tools

title: Digital Quality Analyst - Marketing Tech Team
description:
At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving.

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.

And we believe in you.

  

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear’s Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry.

The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues.

  

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE**

  

* **Communication, Collaboration & Leadership** : Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others.
* **Knowledge** : Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees.
* **Metrics** : Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
* **Quality Standards** : Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks.
* **Test Strategy & Planning** : Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases.
* **Test Execution** : Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes.
* **Mentorship** : Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team.

**YOU ARE**

* **Genuinely curious — you ask why, not just whether.** You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around.
* **Shift-left by default.** You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor — spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first.
* **A master of async defect communication.** You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to — self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation.
* **Globally minded** , with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US–India collaboration genuinely cohesive — and you've built those habits in practice.
* **Methodical and detail-oriented** — you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file.
* **A collaborative teammate** , comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane — you go where quality needs attention.

**YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor’s Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 4+ years’ experience
* Proficiency with **Postman** for API testing — structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification.
* Experience with **email QA** — template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar).
* Working knowledge of **tag management QA** — understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the **Adobe Experience Platform Debugger** or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of **agile/Scrum delivery** — shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning.
* Experience with **Jira** for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows.
* Experience testing across a **multi-phase test lifecycle** : QA SIT UAT E2E Production validation.
* Demonstrated experience working on a **globally distributed or cross-timezone team** — including a US–India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills — including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call.  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **Adobe Analytics** validation — understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR).
* Familiarity with **OneTrust** or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context).
* Experience testing on **Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)** — navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration.
* Knowledge of **CI/CD pipeline integration** for test automation — CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration).
* Exposure to **Liquid templating** in ESP platforms — ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates.

title: Manager, Data Analysis
description:
**Job Summary**
A Data Analyst interprets data and helps turn it into information that enables or improves a business process, thus affecting business decisions. Data Analysts gather information from various sources and interpret patterns and trends to make it digestible for others. They must have strong analytical skills, but above all have a burning curiosity to understand, and make sense of, data. They will work closely with:
  
  

* Data Managers, who define the team's business requirements, objectives, strategy and priorities
* Data Engineers, who design and implement the processes by which data is collected and generated
* Data Quality Analysts, who define data quality control requirements and oversee these on a day to day basis to ensure constant system health
* Upstream data teams, who provide the data that the analyst is sourcing
* Downstream Process Owners, who depend on the data to perform their business function

Data Analysts spend much of their time working with stakeholders to define data requirements, data transformation logic and supporting the delivery of these requirements from start to finish. They are experts in profiling data to understand its contents and will also have a working understanding of the business process or product that generated it in the first place. Data Analysts are the entry point to the FCC Data Team for most external stakeholders and as such will have a broad, but still detailed, understanding of all the data available and constantly seek opportunities for innovation and expansion. They are the primary liaison between up- and downstream teams
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities for FCC Data Analysts:**

* Define clear, concise and detailed business requirements for FCC Data that clearly document the data elements and formats that are needed, outline detailed transformation expectations and list the critical data elements that will enable downstream processes to operate effectively
* Create and maintain documentation that articulates the process by which data is extracted, transformed and loaded in FCC that can be shared and understood by others
* Work with downstream FCC business process owners to constantly improve, refine and expand the datasets to improve the quality and effectiveness of those processes, as well as help them to make sense of the data, providing training where required, and derive meaningful BI / MI
* Conduct detailed analysis of upstream changes that impact FCC data – for example the introduction of a new products – to ensure that requirements remain up to date and define any new ones as necessary
* Identify areas of overlap or data gaps that can lead to increased value, either by eliminating redundant processes or expanding existing data models
* Produce accurate and insightful dashboards and reports detailing the health, content and insights available from the data, making that actionable for stakeholders and meaningful for management decision making

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* SQL Querying skills
* Payments knowledge of Swift network and ISO 20022
* Banking domain knowledge

**Other Skills**

* AML knowledge
* Interpersonal skills
* Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**
**Skills and Eligibility**

* Minimum 10+ years of professional experience as business change analyst in financial markets related banking products
* Degree (or similar) in Engineering and MBA is preferred
* A strong understanding of Cash Management systems or Payment Systems or Core Banking functionality / data flows – will be desired
* Good understanding of systems and data flows in Financial Crime Compliance / Anti Money Laundering etc. will be an added advantage

title: Energy Analyst / Energy Science Associate
description:
Energy
  
  
Energy Analyst / Energy Science Associate
  
  
Analyze energy consumption, smart meter data, and grid behaviour while supporting energy modelling, demand flexibility assessments, facility energy audits, and the development of data-driven energy intelligence solutions.
  
  
Explore other opportunities
  
  
Who we are?
  
  
Elements Energy is a climate-tech company building practical sustainability solutions across energy, carbon, air, and water. Based at and incubated by IIT Madras, we work with real-world institutions and utilities to help make cleaner operations simpler, smarter, and measurable.
  
  
IIT Madras
  
  
Based & Incubated
  
  
Govt. of India

Top 20
  
  
Startup at India AI Summit
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a technically inclined and analytical professional to work at the intersection of energy science, electrical systems, data analytics, and software development. The candidate will study energy consumption and grid behaviour, analyze smart meter and facility-level data, conduct energy modelling and simulations, and collaborate with the software team to translate energy engineering concepts into practical analytical tools.
  
  
The role also involves conducting energy audits at commercial, industrial, and institutional facilities, researching emerging energy technologies, and developing insights to support demand flexibility, energy efficiency, and grid optimization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Energy Science and Systems Analysis
* Develop a strong understanding of energy generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption across electrical grids and consumer facilities.
* Study electricity demand patterns, load profiles, power consumption, power quality, and time-of-day variations.
* Analyse the relationship between consumer behaviour, electricity demand, grid loading, and energy efficiency.
* Research demand-side management, demand response, renewable energy integration, energy storage, and emerging energy technologies.
* Apply energy science principles to identify opportunities for improving grid efficiency and optimizing energy use.
* Energy Data Analytics
* Collect, process, and analyse smart meter data, electricity consumption records, load profiles, and other energy datasets.
* Identify peak demand patterns, consumption trends, anomalies, and opportunities for load shifting.
* Perform consumer segmentation and assess the energy consumption characteristics of residential, commercial, and industrial consumers.
* Develop analytical reports, visualizations, and performance metrics to communicate findings.
* Support the development of energy intelligence solutions using data-driven methodologies.
* Grid and Consumer Analytics
* Analyse grid-level and consumer-level electricity demand to identify demand flexibility potential.
* Evaluate peak and non-peak consumption patterns and assess the feasibility of shifting electricity usage across time periods.
* Study the impact of consumer load shifting on peak demand reduction and grid efficiency.
* Support the development of consumer selection methodologies using consumption, sanctioned demand, and peak demand parameters.
* Assist in evaluating demand flexibility programmes and measuring energy shifted, demand reduction, and associated benefits.
* Energy Modelling and Simulations
* Develop and conduct simulations to study electricity demand, consumer load profiles, and different energy consumption scenarios.
* Model the potential impact of demand flexibility interventions on consumer demand and aggregate grid load.
* Evaluate scenarios involving renewable energy integration, energy efficiency measures, and energy storage.
* Support the validation of energy models, forecasting methodologies, and analytical calculations.
* Translate simulation results into practical recommendations for utilities, facility managers, and software developers.
* Software and Product Development Collaboration
* Work closely with the software development team to translate energy science concepts and engineering calculations into software requirements.
* Define energy-related parameters, calculation logic, business rules, and analytical methodologies for the energy intelligence platform.
* Validate platform outputs, dashboards, and analytics for technical accuracy.
* Assist in designing algorithms for load profiling, energy forecasting, demand flexibility assessment, and energy performance monitoring.
* Help bridge the gap between energy engineering concepts and their implementation in software products.
* Energy Audits and Facility Assessments
* Visit commercial, industrial, and institutional facilities to understand their electrical infrastructure and energy consumption.
* Collect information on electrical equipment, operating schedules, connected loads, energy bills, and available meter data.
* Analyse facility energy usage and identify opportunities for energy efficiency and demand optimization.
* Assess the feasibility of shifting flexible loads without affecting operations.
* Prepare audit observations, technical reports, and recommendations based on site assessments.
* Research and Technical Documentation
* Research emerging developments in energy science, grid modernization, smart metering, demand-side management, and decarbonization.
* Prepare technical reports, simulation studies, research notes, case studies, and project documentation.
* Support pilot projects with DISCOMs and commercial and industrial consumers.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytical models, methodologies, and the energy intelligence platform.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Energy Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
* Strong interest in energy systems, electricity grids, energy consumption, and sustainability.
* Basic understanding of electrical power systems, energy principles, and energy efficiency.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to interpret datasets, perform calculations, and communicate technical findings.
* Willingness to travel to client facilities for energy audits and project assessments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with Python, SQL, MATLAB, or other data analysis and modelling tools.
* Knowledge of smart meters, load curves, time-of-day tariffs, demand response, and demand-side management.
* Exposure to energy modelling, electrical simulations, load forecasting, or statistical analysis.
* Understanding of renewable energy, battery storage, power system operations, or building energy management systems.
* Experience with data visualization, technical report writing, or research projects.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Scientific thinking and technical curiosity.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and attention to detail.
* Ability to connect energy science principles with real-world data.
* Effective collaboration with software, engineering, and product teams.
* Clear technical communication and documentation.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn in a fast-paced climate-tech startup.

What We Offer
  
  

* Hands-on experience with real-world energy systems and smart meter datasets.
* Exposure to grid-scale demand flexibility programmes and utility projects.
* Opportunity to work on AI-powered energy analytics and energy management software.
* Practical experience in energy audits, simulations, and applied energy research.
* The opportunity to contribute to technology that improves grid efficiency and accelerates decarbonization.

**Role purpose:**  
Candidate with eCommerce knowledge that support TSLOTS as it builds a digital sales channel. Act as an analyst on the TSLOTS eCommerce program, working with the project manager, the business owner and product and marketing SMEs. – Work with Operations, Finance, Legal, Tax, Marketing and IT to assemble evidence for the Amazon pilot readiness gates. **Tracking and reporting**. Maintain the RAID log, decision log and deliverable tracker; monitor pilot KPIs, issues and returns through the Week 8 checkpoint.

**eCommerce -**  Business analysis on B2B or industrial eCommerce; hands-on with Amazon Seller Central or Amazon Business listings, catalogue and order processes. Platforms like Oracle Fusion (preferred), Salesforce etc.  
**Product data -**  PIM, catalogue syndication, product attributes and data quality; strong spreadsheet and data-mapping skills.

description:

Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.

**About Cigna:**

The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group

**Job Description**

* The Data Builder is the hands-on builder responsible for turning architectural design and business requirements into **trusted, reusable data products through MVP that are production grade.** Reporting to the Director, Data Operations & Data Management, this role builds to the enterprise-agnostic Silver foundation designed by Data Architecture and **co-designs and builds Gold data products** where business logic, metrics, and functional knowledge live.
* This is a hands-on individual contributor role — the **build authority** that blends **business fluency and data engineering discipline in equal measure**, authoring Gold data products that answer the question the first time and building them to production standard.
* This role is a critical execution counterpart to **Data Architecture and Data Analysis, Products & Integration**, building faithfully against their designs and requirements and compressing the path from new data to a production-grade, reusable asset. It is an exciting opportunity to join the team transforming how Cigna builds and reuses data — delivered through MVP.

**Key Responsibilities**

Rapid Build & Delivery

* Build architecture’s designs and analysis’s requirements into **production-ready solutions** through MVP.
* Work new and unfamiliar data quickly into a **working solution** that answers the business question at hand.
* Refactor **learning-stage and bespoke work** into durable, reusable, production-ready assets.

Silver — Build to Architecture’s Design

* Build the physical Silver structures to the **enterprise-agnostic Silver model** and reference patterns designed by Data Architecture.
* Implement the design faithfully and promote it to production through **governed CI/CD pipelines**.
* Capture **business context and metadata** at build, and hand off to trusted partner teams as readiness allows.

Gold — Democratized, Delivered Through MVP

* Treat the Gold layer as **democratized** — Data Operations may own specific Gold assets and assists other teams in building theirs.
* Deliver Gold solutions through **build-through-MVP**, promoted to production-grade through governed CI/CD pipelines regardless of owner.
* Uphold the **build standards and guardrails** any Gold solution must meet, so a federated Gold layer stays stable and production-grade across owning teams.

Engineering Discipline & Production Readiness

* Build to **production standards** from day one so the lift from MVP to production is simple, not a rebuild.
* Apply consistent **development patterns, naming conventions, and build standards** with specific focus on the connectivity across all data products to create a more connected data ecosystem.
* Move work through the CI/CD pipeline — develop, test, and productionize — clearing **quality, security, and cost checks** on first pass.
* Apply **AI and automation** to accelerate build and testing without bypassing governance, security, or quality expectations.

Partnership & Collaboration

* Partner with **Data Architecture** — building to their Silver design and co-designing Gold within the standards they set.
* Partner with **Data Analysis, Products & Integration** — who bring the requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria this role builds against.
* Partner with **Platform Engineering / IT and DevOps & AI Enablement** — who own ingestion, pipelines, and the automation frameworks this role builds on.
* Partner with **data science and business analytics teams** so Gold data products serve their models, analyses, and decisions.
* Partner with **data governance** **team** to ensure enterprise standards are consistently implemented
* Set the design and hold Data Operations standards across **the Hyderabad Data Operations team** and **outside service partners** as part of a global delivery model.

What This Role Is Not

* Not a pure data engineering or platform role.
* Not the owner of the enterprise Silver model.
* Not the primary business-engagement or requirements role.
* Not the owner of the Gold layer, which is democratized across teams.
* Not a governance policy, stewardship, or BI reporting role.
* This role exists to **build real data solutions that get used** — designed for the business, engineered to last, delivered through MVP.

Required Experience & Capabilities

* **3+ years building production-grade data solutions**, with demonstrated depth in analytics engineering or equivalent business-plus-build work.
* A genuine **50/50 blend of business fluency and hands-on engineering discipline**.
* Hands-on experience with **Databricks, Spark, Unity Catalog, SQL, and Python**.
* Familiarity with **Snowflake and Teradata** in addition to a Databricks-first stack.
* Expert knowledge of **dimensional and medallion (Silver / Gold) modeling** within an enterprise-agnostic data model.
* Working knowledge of **CI/CD pipelines, automated code evaluation, and controlled promotion** to production.
* Strong **software-engineering discipline** — version control (Git), code review, and efficient, reusable code.
* **Performance-tuning and cost-optimizing Spark and SQL transformations** at scale.
* Familiarity with **data governance and cataloging tooling** such as Collibra.
* **Automated data-quality testing and validation** built into every solution.
* Demonstrated ability to **learn a new data domain fast** and turn business logic into reusable data products.
* Demonstrated ability to apply **AI and automation** to accelerate build while preserving quality and governance.
* Experience in **complex, regulated enterprises** preferred; healthcare or PBM data a plus.
* Design and implement **automated data observability and reliability reporting**
* Experience working in regulated or compliance‑driven environments

Measures of Success

* New data reaches a trusted, production-grade asset in a short cycle time.
* Gold data products are delivered and reused across use cases, with democratized ownership held to a common build standard.
* Silver builds implement architecture’s design faithfully and are handed off without loss of quality.
* Solutions reach production through governed CI/CD pipelines, clearing quality, security, and cost gates on first pass.
* Build acceleration through AI and automation is achieved without compromising governance, quality, or security controls.

**Work Hours:**

* 2:30 PM IST to 11.30PM IST

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

*Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.*

**About Evernorth Health Services**

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

* Identify potentially fraudulent investment schemes, misleading promotions, scams, and other suspicious financial activities.
* Conduct quality checks and maintain accurate records of reviewed content and financial findings.

* Meet established productivity, accuracy, and quality targets while maintaining compliance with service-level agreements (SLAs).

* Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information responsibly.
* Stay updated on internal policies, financial regulations, and content moderation procedures.

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in financial analysis, financial operations, transaction monitoring, content moderation, or a related role.
* Experience reviewing financial content, financial advertisements, investment-related information, or user-generated content is preferred.
* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies and potential risks.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.
* Ability to work with defined policies, quality standards, productivity targets, and deadlines.

Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, web-based applications, sales support tools. Prior experience in pricing, deal desk or finance roles, or roles related to procurement.

title: Data Governance Analyst -Tableau , Alteryx ,Python
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You're a curious, hands-on problem solver who wants to build (or pivot) your career at the intersection of automation, analytics, and delivery governance—working with a modern technology stack and real stakeholders. Join the Automation Lab Central Hub Team in CF/TCIO CDO and help scale automation safely and efficiently in our hub-and-spoke Citizen Developer model, with a single intake/portfolio view and clear decision rights.

As a Data Governance Analyst within CF/TCIO CDO, you will help run the “engine room” of our automation program: managing intake and triage, maintaining a transparent portfolio, coordinating delivery paths, and ensuring our work is standardized, controlled, and auditable. The Central Hub provides cross-domain coordination and owns key controls, platform/stack enablement, and coaching/code review - while Citizen Developers deliver smaller in-domain automations within guardrails. !

You will partner closely with business stakeholders, domain Citizen Developers, technology teams, control partners, and governance forums (including the Efficiency Council, which owns prioritization, capacity, and decision rights) to progress automation work end-to-end – especially where work crosses domains or has higher risk / platform dependencies.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage intake and triage for automation requests, ensuring submissions are complete, clearly defined, and ready to be actioned in a single work management and portfolio view.
* Maintain portfolio hygiene by keeping statuses, ownership, dependencies, and timelines current to enable transparent reporting and reliable decision-making.
* Prepare prioritization and capacity inputs for governance decision forums, including impact, complexity, dependencies, risk considerations, and effort estimates, and track decisions through execution.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery across business, data, product, and technology teams to progress work end-to-end and resolve cross-domain dependencies.
* Route work through the appropriate delivery path based on ownership, risk, cross-domain impact, and platform or technology dependencies, and document the rationale.
* Own delivery standards, templates, and ways of working, promoting reusable patterns and consistent documentation across domains.
* Enable domain developers through light coaching, structured review loops, and clear escalation paths, and escalate higher-risk or cross-domain work to the Central Hub.
* Coordinate control activities including registration, release readiness, and monitoring requirements to support safe, standard, and auditable delivery.
* Track execution progress, remove blockers, monitor aged items, and escalate risks and delays to domain leads and Central Hub leadership as needed.
* Produce governance materials and program reporting, including portfolio views, status updates, metrics, and documented exceptions with clear rationale.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in finance, business, data analytics, information systems, engineering, risk, or a related field.
* Practical experience using analytics and/or automation tools (for example: data visualization tools, workflow automation tools, scripting languages, collaboration sites, work management tools, and spreadsheet analysis).
* Demonstrated execution discipline, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, drive workflows to closure, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort coordinating across business and technology stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, structured problem-solving skills, and sound judgment on when and how to escalate.
* Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Word.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Experience with work management or ticketing tools (for example, Jira) and maintaining transparent backlogs and portfolios.
* Familiarity with data governance, control frameworks, operational risk concepts, or audit-ready documentation practices.
* Exposure to platform enablement concepts and an understanding that some delivery paths require dedicated technology execution and support.
* Understanding of treasury or finance domains (for example, regulatory reporting, liquidity, capital, or interest rate risk) and the ability to translate business needs into structured delivery work.
* Experience working in cross-functional programs with multiple dependencies and stakeholder groups.

Morgan and Chase brands. Business Analyst

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Responsibilities:**

**Business Requirement Management:**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and document business requirements.
* Translate business needs into structured specifications for process flows, data pipelines, Ontology models, and Workshop applications.
* Ensure alignment between business logic and technical implementation.

**Project Tracking and Execution:**

* Manage timelines, milestones, and deliverables for data and application projects.
* Use collaborative tools to track progress and resolve blockers.
* Ensure alignment with program and product delivery phases.

**Dataset Validation and Business Coordination:**

* Coordinate with business users and data engineers to validate datasets.
* Facilitate data walkthroughs and feedback sessions to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
* Support data profiling and quality checks.

**Application Development Support (Workshop):**

* Collaborate with developers to design and test user-centric applications using Foundry’s Workshop.

* Apply domain knowledge of automotive operations (e.g., supply chain, manufacturing, quality, warranty) to ensure solutions reflect real-world business flows.

**Insight Generation and Visualization:**

* Use Foundry tools such as Contour and Quiver to explore data and extract actionable insights.
* Present findings through dashboards and narratives to support strategic decisions.

**Change Management and User Enablement:**

* Support user onboarding and training for new applications and workflows.
* Gather feedback and iterate on features to drive adoption and usability.

**Governance, Documentation, and Compliance:**

* Ensure documentation aligns with internal governance frameworks such as ITPM and Sarbanes-Oxley.
* Collaborate with IT and data governance teams to uphold data privacy and security standards.
* Motivates the immediate reporting staff for better performance and effective service and encourage team spirit.
* Coordinates with the senior and junior management of other departments as well, as every department in the organization is directly or indirectly associated with the finance department.

We are seeking a skilled
**Power BI Developer – Marketing Analytics**
to support the Marketing Intelligence function. The role will focus on developing, maintaining, and publishing Power BI dashboards and reports while supporting the data foundation that powers business intelligence and reporting.

The successful candidate will translate analytical outputs into clear, governed, and decision-ready visualizations for senior stakeholders. This role will enable the internal analytics team to focus on strategic analysis, generating insights, and driving commercial outcomes, while ensuring consistent, accurate, and high-quality reporting delivery.

* Develop, maintain, and publish Power BI dashboards and reports across customer segmentation, marketing performance, eCommerce, and spend optimization.

* Establish and maintain reporting standards, templates, documentation, and data refresh schedules.
* Support the development of a consistent performance intelligence framework to make insights accessible and actionable across business functions.

* Identify and escalate data pipeline, tracking, and data quality issues to the appropriate stakeholders, implementing fixes within the scope of the role.
* Collaborate closely with the internal analytics team, which retains ownership of analytical validation, classification standards, and output accuracy.

  **Microsoft Power BI**

  skills, with the ability to query and work with large transactional datasets.

* Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data integration concepts.

title: Senior Research Analyst - Shareholder/Asset Recovery Research
description:
**About the Role**  
**The Wealth Finder** is looking for a **Senior Research Analyst** to strengthen its Research team, **which identifies and verifies shareholders to support the recovery of clients' lost shares and assets**. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can independently deliver high-accuracy research while also raising the bar for the analysts working alongside them. You will be expected to hit your own research and case targets and, in parallel, review and guide the work of junior analysts to keep data accuracy and turnaround consistent across the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct **detailed online research to identify and locate shareholders using criteria such as name, father's name, and address, working independently through your own case load.**
* Work with **online databases, public records, and other research tools to track down shareholder details and support the end-to-end share/asset recovery process**.
* Meet individual research output, accuracy, and turnaround targets as defined by Management
* Review the research findings, shareholder identification, and verification work completed by junior analysts before cases are closed or moved forward, checking for accuracy and completeness.
* Cross-check and verify shareholder details flagged by junior analysts, catching errors, mismatches, or gaps before they reach the client or the next stage of recovery.
* Provide structured feedback and on-the-job guidance to junior analysts to improve their research accuracy and speed over time.
* Collaborate with the wider team to ensure data accuracy and timely recovery of shares for clients across all active cases.
* Flag recurring errors, data-source issues, or inconsistencies in team output proactively to Management rather than after the fact.
* Contribute to improving internal research processes, verification checklists, and case-tracking practices used by the team.

**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in **online research, data mining, public-records research, or similar investigative/verification work**.
* Proven **ability to independently identify, cross-check, and verify individuals' details (name, family details, address) with a high degree of accuracy**.
* Comfortable reviewing and correcting someone else's research work, with the judgment to catch genuine errors or gaps before a case moves forward.
* Strong command of search engines, public records, and other online resources used to locate and verify shareholder information.
* Clear, precise documentation habits — findings must be easy for the team and Management to verify and act on.
* Self-driven and comfortable being accountable for both your own case output and the quality of work around you.

title: Global HR Data Analyst II
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview/Primary Purpose**
The Global HR Data Analyst II is acting as a senior analyst in global HR data management and organizational management (OM) initiatives. This position is responsible for handling medium to complex HR data reporting, large-scale global mass uploads (including global ASR loads), and ensuring compliance with internal and external audit requirements. The Global HR Data Analyst II will execute end-to-end OM data initiatives, including managing the accuracy and consistency of the global organizational hierarchy within SuccessFactors Employee Central (SFEC) and SAP HCM.
  
  
In addition, this role will collaborate with global HR Business Partners and Managers, providing guidance on HR data and OM processes and offering professional executive support through a dedicated communication channel. The Global HR Data Analyst II will be instrumental in contributing to projects, managing cyclical events, and ensuring effective delivery of day-to-day tasks. By identifying key dependencies, this role will proactively enhance the customer service experience for employee inquiries. The Global HR Data Analyst II will also drive process improvements, provide insights for continuous service enhancement.
  
  
Additionally, this role will support junior team members, helping them increase their independence and contributing to the training and onboarding of new employees.
  
  
Accountable for ensuring data quality and consistency, this role will also be responsible for compliance and control measures (including SOX), providing consistent customer service, and ensuring that global HR data standards are met.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Complex Global HR Reporting & Mass Uploads:Lead the creation and execution of medium to complex global HR reports, ensuring high-quality, accurate data delivery to stakeholders. Manage large-scale HR data mass uploads (including ASR loads), ensuring seamless integration and error-free data transmission across global systems.
* Audit Support & Compliance: Serve as senior analyst for internal and external audits, ensuring data compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. Gather HR data for audits and resolve audit findings, ensuring all processes adhere to compliance standards, including SOX regulations.
* Organizational Management (OM) Data: Perform OM data initiatives, including the management of the global organizational hierarchy, position management, and employee data integrity within SFEC and SAP HCM. Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and alignment across systems.
* Reconciliation & Data Accuracy: Perform reconciliation of HR data across global systems, ensuring data accuracy and consistency by proactively comparing and validating data across systems. Identify discrepancies, resolve data issues, and ensure seamless alignment and integration of global HR data.
* Data and Replication Monitoring & Issue Resolution: Support design and implement validation reports to monitor OM data fields, proactively identifying any discrepancies or gaps. Perform corrective actions necessary to resolve OM-related issues, ensuring continuous data quality and governance. Serves as a subject matter expert of SFEC & SAP HCM OM data management. Monitors OM content type replication failures daily. Makes corrections as necessary to resolve errors for successful replication and recommend improvements to prevent recurrences.
* Organizational Design & Strategic Projects: Support large-scale organizational design projects, working closely with Product Owners and business stakeholders to ensure that organizational changes are accurately reflected in HR systems. Provide guidance and support to the business on data impacts and system configurations maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction by providing timely and accurate information.

* System testing: Participate in special projects, including performing configuration testing, integrations & data mapping & ad-hoc report requests and support more junior team members in testing.

**Required Qualifications**
**Level of Education and Discipline**

* College Degree preferred, but not required.

**Experience - Functional/industry/commercial Knowledge, Business Acumen**

* Over 3 years’ experience in data management in a multinational company.
* with experience of high-volume data processing for multiple countries with in-depth experience in SFEC, SAP HCM, Organizational Management (OM), and HR data management including reporting and mass uploads.
* Proven expertise in managing complex global HR reporting, data uploads, and data quality checks, particularly in large-scale HR systems implementations.
* Knowledge of global HR processes, organizational design, and OM-related data management.
* Demonstrated experience in leading audits, ensuring compliance, and resolving audit findings.
* Ability to design and implement proactive reports to monitor data quality and identify issues.
* Strong subject matter expertise in OM data, including troubleshooting within SFEC and SAP HCM.

**Interpersonal Skills - Leadership, Interactions, Communication, Influence**

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns, troubleshoot issues, and provide data-driven recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with business stakeholders and provide expert guidance on data management and organizational design.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage cross-functional projects and prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Customer service-oriented with a commitment to maintaining high levels of satisfaction and providing expert-level support.
* A mindset of continuous improvement, consistently seeking to refine processes and enhance team and organizational performance.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Analyst-BI & Analytics
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 2 or more years of business experience in a data, analytics, or finance environment. Working knowledge of Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, and report and dashboard development. Familiarity with JIRA for tracking tasks, sprints, and delivery status
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to adapt to a changing environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet tight deadlines
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and reporting purposes is preferred but not required
* Experience assisting with technical documentation such as Technical Design Documents is preferred but not required
* Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, or another quantitative field required

* Develops Power BI dashboards and coordinates data engineering delivery to support analytics and reporting needs for the Finance department.
* Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports, including data modeling, DAX measures, and row-level security, to support the business intelligence and analytics needs of the Finance department
* Support data and analytics requests by transforming raw pipeline and project data into clear, production-ready business intelligence reports and visual insights
* Work closely with data engineers and business stakeholders, tracking tasks, dependencies, and blockers in JIRA to keep the delivery pipeline on schedule

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in data engineering, Power BI development, and process optimization in Gurugram, India, where we are actively integrating AI-powered tools to enhance our analytics workflows and drive smarter, faster insights for the business.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Quick Commerce Business & Data Analyst
description:
**Senior Quick Commerce Business & Data Analyst**

**Location:**
Noida, Sector 80

**Experience:**
4–7 years

**Industry:**
Food / FMCG / D2C / Quick commerce

**About Us**

**The Cinnamon Kitchen (TCK)**
is a fast-growing food brand focused on building better-for-you, plant-based and gluten-free food products across categories including
**bakery, snacks and everyday food products**
.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Business & Data Analyst**
who can take ownership of business data and convert it into meaningful insights for the leadership team.

The person will work closely with
**Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Founders**
to bring data from different functions and platforms together, create a single source of truth, analyse business performance and support data-driven decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business & P&L Analysis**

* Own and consolidate business data across different functions.
* Prepare and analyse
  **monthly P&L, revenue, COGS, gross margin and profitability**
  .
* Analyse
  **SKU/product-level profitability and contribution margins**
  .
* Track revenue, expenses, production costs, procurement costs, wastage and operational expenses.
* Identify
  **cost leakages, inefficiencies and opportunities to improve margins**
  .
* Analyse business performance against budgets, targets and previous periods.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and business planning.

**ERP & Data Management**

* Work extensively with the company's
  **ERP system**
  to extract, validate and analyse business data.
* Consolidate data across
  **finance, inventory, procurement, production, sales and operations**
  .
* Ensure ERP data and financial/operational data are accurately aligned.
* Build a reliable
  **single source of truth**
  for management reporting.
* Identify data discrepancies and work with respective teams to resolve them.
* Improve and automate existing reporting and data processes.

**Quick Commerce & Channel Analytics**

* Analyse performance across
  **Quick Commerce platforms**
  such as Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and other relevant channels.
* Track channel-wise
  **sales, discounts, commissions, margins, returns, inventory and profitability**
  .
* Analyse SKU-wise performance across Quick Commerce channels.
* Evaluate channel-level contribution and profitability.
* Identify opportunities to improve
  **sales, margins, assortment and inventory availability**
  .
* Reconcile Quick Commerce platform data with ERP and internal business data.

**MIS & Business Intelligence**

* Build and maintain
  **MIS, dashboards and management reports**
  .
* Create dashboards for sales, profitability, inventory, procurement, production and operational performance.
* Develop daily, weekly and monthly business performance trackers.
* Identify key trends, deviations and business risks.
* Automate repetitive reporting wherever possible.
* Present key insights and recommendations to the leadership team.

**Cross-Functional & Leadership Support**

* Work closely with
  **Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing and Procurement**
  teams.
* Partner with the Founders and senior leadership on data-driven business decisions.
* Provide ad-hoc analysis for new products, channels, pricing, costs and business initiatives.
* Translate complex data into
  **simple, actionable business insights**
  .
* Clearly communicate not only
  **what happened, but why it happened and what should be done next**
  .

**Requirements**

* **4–7 years of experience**
  in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, MIS, FP&A, Business Intelligence or a similar role.
* Experience in
  **Food, FMCG, D2C, Retail or Food-Tech**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of
  **P&L, COGS, revenue, gross margins, contribution margins and profitability**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **ERP systems**
  .
* Experience working with
  **Quick Commerce / Marketplace data**
  is strongly preferred.
* Advanced
  **Excel / Google Sheets**
  skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

We are looking for someone who can move beyond
**MIS and reporting**
and become a strong
**business analytics partner to the leadership team**
.

**Apply**
- You can share you cv at career@cinnamon.kitchen

title: Business and Growth Intern
description:
Business & Growth Intern

Duration: 6 Months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Kolkata

Company: PopLotus (Nutralike Superfoods Pvt. Ltd.)

Role Summary

PopLotus is a growing Indian snacking brand focused on building the next generation of premium, better-for-you makhana products. As a Business & Growth Intern, you will work closely with the core team across multiple functions of the business and gain hands-on exposure to how a consumer brand is built and scaled.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role designed for someone who wants to understand the complete business rather than work within a single function. Your responsibilities will span e-commerce and quick commerce, exports and foreign trade, business analytics, marketing and brand building, general trade, logistics, and HR/business operations.

You will be expected to take ownership of projects, work with data, identify opportunities, coordinate with external partners, and contribute directly to business decisions.

What Success Looks Like
  

Success in this role means becoming someone the core team can rely on to independently take a problem, analyse it, execute a solution, and measure the outcome.

By the end of the internship, you should have developed a strong understanding of how a consumer/FMCG business operates across online, offline, domestic and international channels, while having contributed tangible results to PopLotus' growth.

Responsibilities
  

* Support the growth and management of PopLotus across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms, including marketplace operations, catalogue management, pricing, promotions, inventory and platform performance.
* Analyse sales, customer, SKU and channel-level data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data-driven dashboards and reports to track sales, margins, inventory, channel performance and other key business metrics.
* Support foreign trade and export development, including identifying potential buyers and distributors, researching international markets, generating leads, coordinating samples, and assisting with export documentation and follow-ups.
* Research international markets data to identify potential opportunities for Indian makhana and better-for-you snacking products, including competitor, pricing and market analysis.
* Contribute to brand building and marketing initiatives, including campaign planning, content coordination, market research, consumer insights and competitor tracking.
* Assist in expanding PopLotus' general trade and distribution network, including distributor research, retailer mapping, lead generation, outreach and sales coordination.
* Develop an understanding of the Indian makhana and FMCG snacking ecosystem, including sourcing, grades, pricing, competitors, distribution models and consumer trends.
* Coordinate with logistics partners, warehouses, vendors and internal teams to support inventory movement, order fulfilment, dispatches and operational efficiency.
* Assist with vendor and partner coordination across different business functions and ensure timely follow-ups and execution.
* Support HR and people operations, including recruitment coordination, candidate screening, onboarding, intern coordination and other day-to-day HR activities.
* Conduct market and competitor research across products, brands, pricing, distribution, consumer behaviour and emerging trends.
* Take ownership of ad-hoc strategic and operational projects that contribute to the growth and development of PopLotus.
* Work closely with the founding/core team and provide regular updates on project progress, findings, challenges and recommendations.

Qualifications
  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Management, Commerce, Economics, Marketing, Finance or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to work comfortably with numbers and data.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets; familiarity with data analysis and dashboards is an advantage.
* Strong research skills and the ability to independently find, interpret and present information.
* Interest in FMCG, D2C brands, e-commerce, quick commerce, exports, consumer businesses or startups.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where responsibilities can evolve quickly.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, vendors, distributors, logistics partners and other external stakeholders.

What You Will Gain

* Hands-on exposure to building and scaling an FMCG consumer brand from the ground up.
* Exposure to e-commerce, quick commerce, general trade and international markets.
* Practical experience in exports and foreign trade.
* Experience working with real business data and making data-driven decisions.
* Direct interaction with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Cross-functional exposure across sales, marketing, operations, logistics, analytics and HR.
* An opportunity to take ownership of projects with measurable business impact.

title: Deputy Manager - Material Planning
description:
**Deputy Manager – Material Planning**
Group Bayport | Supply Chain Management | Gandhinagar, Gujarat
  
  
**About Group Bayport**
Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce B2B2C, B2B and B2C organisation that has re-defined the business of delivering high-quality custom products through a unique blend of innovative digital technologies, robust manufacturing capabilities, and a global supply chain. An industry leader in print technology, Group Bayport operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and India through its family of brands — Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media and Neon Earth.
  
  
From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades, to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients and partners make a personalised statement through customisation.
  
  
While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1,450+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.
  
  
Learn more: https://groupbayport.com/about-us/
  
  
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an analytical and initiative-taking Deputy Manager – Material Planning to own material planning for a defined set of brands and strategic accounts.
  
  
Group Bayport operates a predominantly made-to-order custom manufacturing model across a high-SKU environment. That makes material planning the difference between an order shipping on time and a production line standing idle. The role is accountable for having the right materials available when production needs them, for holding inventory at the agreed norms, and for working closely with Procurement, Production Planning and Operations so that plans translate into actual availability on the floor.
  
  
**Position details**
Designation: Deputy Manager – Material Planning
  
  
Function: Supply Chain Management – Centralised Material Planning
  
  
Reporting to: Deputy General Manager – Supply Chain Planning
  
  
Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat
  
  
Experience: 6 – 10 years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Planning ownership**

* Own the material plan end to end for assigned brands and strategic accounts.
* Build material requirement plans from sales orders, customer forecasts, and production schedules.
* Convert requirements into purchase requisitions and release them to Procurement with the correct priority and timing.
* Maintain planning parameters in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master data.

**Material availability and risk**

* Ensure availability of all production inputs — textiles, printing media, inks, hardware, packaging, and consumables.
* Review material availability against the production plan daily and flag risks before they affect output.
* Track supplier lead times and escalate slippage to Procurement early enough to act on it.
* Identify shortages and build contingency plans — alternate material, alternate source, or re-sequencing with Production Planning.

**Inventory management**

* Hold inventory at agreed norms — neither short nor in excess.
* Analyse consumption trends and recommend stocking strategy for fast-moving and critical materials.
* Review inventory ageing and slow-moving or non-moving stock and drive corrective action.
* Lead inventory optimisation initiatives without compromising service levels.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Work closely with Sales, Production Planning, Procurement, Stores and Operations to ensure seamless material flow.
* Participate in the S&OP cycle and support demand planning.
* Publish daily, weekly, and monthly planning reports and KPIs.
* Improve planning processes through data analysis and better use of the ERP.

**Scope boundary**
This role plans, triggers and tracks material requirements. Purchase order placement, supplier negotiation and vendor follow-up sit with Procurement. The planner is accountable for raising the right requirement at the right time and for escalating risk; Procurement is accountable for the buy.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like In The First 90 Days**

* Material plans running for all assigned accounts without manual workarounds.
* A daily, published view of which materials are at risk and what is being done about them.
* Planning parameters in the ERP accurate, complete, and actively maintained.
* At least one measurable inventory improvement delivered and evidenced.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Material availability for production (%)
* Production stoppages attributable to material shortage
* Inventory turns and inventory days of cover.
* Inventory record accuracy.
* Excess, slow-moving and obsolete inventory as a percentage of total.
* Planning accuracy — requirement plan against actual consumption
* Purchase requisitions raised on or before the planned date
* Inventory carrying cost.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA or PGDM in Operations or Supply Chain Management preferred.

**Experience**

* 6 to 10 years in material planning, production planning, supply chain, or inventory management.
* Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar.
* Experience in a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is a strong advantage.
* Experience planning across multiple brands or business lines is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
* Firsthand experience with an ERP system — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, dashboards, and modelling.
* Comfortable analysing consumption patterns and demand data to reach a recommendation.

**Competencies**

* Analytical, with a bias for working from data rather than assumption.
* Organised, and able to carry several priorities without dropping any of them.
* Communicates clearly across functions and manages stakeholders well.
* Takes ownership of outcomes rather than of tasks.
* Strong diligence and comfortable working at pace.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Signage manufacturing
* Digital and large format printing
* Textile manufacturing
* Packaging
* Custom or made-to-order manufacturing

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a meticulous and initiative-taking Senior Executive – Material Planning to plan all general inventory items and domestically sourced materials across our Gandhinagar manufacturing operations.
  
  
The role keeps production supplied — planning requirements against the production schedule, raising purchase requisitions, following them through with the Domestic Procurement team, and holding inventory at the right level. It suits someone who is methodical, follows things to closure, and would rather prevent a shortage than report one.
  
  
**Position details**
Designation: Senior Executive – Material Planning
  
  
Function: Supply Chain Management – Centralised Material Planning
  
  
Reporting to: Deputy General Manager – Supply Chain Planning
  
  
Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat
  
  
Experience: 2 – 5 years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Planning and requirement generation**

* Plan and monitor material requirements for all general inventory items across manufacturing operations.
* Generate material requirement plans from production schedules, forecasts, and consumption patterns.
* Raise purchase requisitions on time and with accurate quantities and dates.
* Maintain planning data in the ERP — reorder levels, safety stock, lead times, and material master records.

**Follow-through and availability**

* Coordinate with the Domestic Procurement team to ensure requirements convert into timely purchase orders.
* Track open purchase orders and supplier lead times and follow up proactively to avoid production delays.
* Review daily material availability against the production plan and highlight potential risks early.
* Support new product launches by planning and securing required materials in time.

**Inventory control**

* Monitor inventory levels and maintain optimum stock to prevent both shortages and excess.
* Analyse material consumption trends and recommend inventory optimisation actions.
* Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory and recommend corrective action.
* Support cycle counts and inventory accuracy improvement with Stores.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Work closely with Production Planning, Procurement, Warehouse, Quality and Stores for seamless material flow.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on inventory status, shortages, purchase follow-ups, and planning performance.
* Ensure adherence to company inventory policies and planning processes.

**Scope boundary**
This role plans requirements and follows them through to delivery. Supplier selection, negotiation, and purchase order placement sit with the Domestic Procurement team. The planner is accountable for raising the right requirement at the right time and for escalating delays early.
  
  
**What success looks like in the first 90 days?**

* All general inventory items under an active, maintained plan.
* Open purchase requisitions and orders tracked daily, with delays escalated before they affect production.
* ERP planning parameters cleaned up and accurate for the assigned material groups.
* A working daily shortage report that production and procurement both rely on.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Material availability for production (%)
* Stock-out incidents.
* Inventory turns and inventory record accuracy.
* Purchase requisitions raised on or before the planned date
* Open purchase order follow-up adherence
* Reduction in excess and obsolete inventory
* Planning accuracy — requirement plan against actual consumption
* Production schedule adherence attributable to material availability

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Commerce, or a related field.
* A diploma or certification in Supply Chain or Inventory Management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 2 to 5 years in material planning, inventory management, or production planning.
* Experience coordinating with domestic suppliers and an internal procurement team.
* Manufacturing background preferred — signage, printing, textiles, packaging or similar.
* Exposure to a high-SKU or made-to-order environment is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Good working understanding of Material Requirement Planning (MRP).
* Experience with an ERP system — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent.
* Strong Microsoft Excel — pivot tables, lookup functions, and reporting.
* Ability to analyse material consumption and demand trends.

**Competencies**

* Methodical, organised, and strong on follow-through.
* Analytical, with genuine diligence.
* Effective communication and coordination skills across departments.
* Able to prioritise multiple tasks in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Takes ownership and closes items rather than passing them on.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Signage manufacturing
* Digital and large format printing
* Textile manufacturing
* Packaging
* Industrial or custom manufacturing
