BOOKMYROOM HOSPITALITY SERVICES PVT LTD is a growing hospitality company focused on delivering comfortable, reliable, and cost-effective accommodation solutions. The organization emphasizes customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and consistent service quality across its properties. Team members collaborate closely to optimize occupancy, pricing, and guest experience while supporting sustainable business growth. The company values data-driven decision-making, professionalism, and integrity in all aspects of its operations. Working at BOOKMYROOM offers opportunities to contribute to a dynamic environment within the hospitality sector.

**Role Description**
The Revenue Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore. This position is responsible for monitoring and optimizing room rates, occupancy, and overall revenue performance across assigned properties. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing booking trends, demand patterns, and competitor pricing, preparing revenue reports, and recommending rate adjustments and promotional strategies. The Revenue Manager collaborates with sales, finance, and operations teams to develop and implement revenue plans, ensure accurate revenue recognition, and support budgeting and forecasting processes. The role also involves maintaining revenue-related systems, contributing to pricing policies, and providing insights to leadership to drive sustainable revenue growth.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven pricing and revenue decisions.
* Proficiency in revenue management and revenue recognition, including experience with pricing strategies, yield management, and forecasting.
* Solid foundation in finance and accounting, with the ability to understand financial statements, budgets, and profitability metrics.
* Experience in hospitality or related service industries, preferably in revenue or pricing-focused roles.
* Comfort with hotel reservation and revenue management systems, Excel, and other analytical tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, hospitality management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Attention to detail, organized work style, and ability to manage multiple properties or projects simultaneously.

title: SAP CPM-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – SAP – CPM Functional – Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP Commercial Project Management (CPM) Consultant to support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of SAP CPM solutions. The role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of large-scale SAP transformation programs while developing expertise at the intersection of finance, strategy, project delivery, and commercial management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Project Governance**

* Act as the commercial lead for SAP implementation, support, migration, and transformation programs.
* Establish and maintain commercial governance frameworks across project portfolios.
* Support project leadership in ensuring projects are delivered within approved budgets, schedules, and contractual commitments.
* Drive project profitability while balancing customer satisfaction and delivery objectives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements.

**Financial Management & Project Controlling**

* Own project financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting activities.
* Monitor project revenue, costs, gross margins, and cash flow performance.
* Analyze project financial health and proactively identify variances against forecasts.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews.
* Drive corrective actions to improve project profitability and financial performance.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition and project accounting in line with corporate and statutory requirements.

**Contract & Commercial Management**

* Review customer contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and change requests.
* Ensure contractual obligations, commercial terms, and project assumptions are properly managed.
* Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Lead commercial negotiations related to scope changes, claims management, and contract amendments.
* Support bid reviews and project handovers from sales to delivery teams.

**Risk Management**

* Identify financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop risk mitigation plans and track closure of identified risks.
* Monitor project performance indicators and escalate issues proactively.
* Support contingency planning and financial recovery strategies where applicable.

**Portfolio & Business Performance Management**

* Manage commercial oversight for multiple SAP projects and accounts.
* Track portfolio-level financial metrics including revenue, backlog, utilization, margin, and working capital.
* Provide insights and recommendations to improve overall business performance.
* Support leadership with dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

**Change Request and Scope Management**

* Ensure all scope changes are formally assessed and approved.
* Quantify financial and commercial impacts of project changes.
* Collaborate with delivery and customer stakeholders to secure change order approvals.
* Maximize revenue realization through effective scope management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Leads, and Customer Executives.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on commercial and financial matters.
* Communicate project financial performance to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support successful project execution.

**Compliance & Audit Support**

* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and governance requirements.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain project documentation supporting financial and commercial decisions.
* Ensure adherence to revenue recognition, procurement, and financial reporting standards.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Mentor and coach junior CPM professionals and project controllers.
* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8+ years of experience in project financial management, commercial management, project controlling, or program governance.
* Experience in SAP implementation, ERP transformation, managed services, or consulting environments.
* Strong understanding of project accounting, budgeting, forecasting, and revenue recognition.
* Knowledge of contract management and commercial risk management principles.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Senior AI Evaluation Analyst
description:
**Senior AI Evaluation Analyst**

**Location:**
Kochi

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Role Overview**

Seeking an experienced and detail-oriented professional to join its Machine Learning Science team, supporting the development and improvement of AI-powered travel products. The team works on conversational AI agents that help travelers discover options, compare products, plan trips, and receive assistance throughout their travel journey.

You will play a key role in evaluating the quality, accuracy, relevance, and reliability of AI-generated responses against established guidelines and quality metrics. You will analyze evaluation results, identify recurring errors and quality gaps, and translate findings into actionable insights that help improve AI agent performance.

This role requires a strong foundation in data annotation, quality evaluation, analytical problem-solving, and guideline-based decision-making. The position is suited to professionals who enjoy hands-on evaluation and analysis of AI outputs rather than traditional business reporting or dashboard development.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced, hands-on professional who combines strong evaluation and quality assurance skills with analytical thinking. They should be comfortable reviewing large volumes of information, applying structured guidelines, identifying recurring quality issues, and converting observations into meaningful insights.

Candidates with experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content quality, search relevance, or similar quality-focused roles are encouraged to apply. Direct experience with LLMs or conversational AI is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates with strong transferable experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate AI-generated responses from conversational agents against predefined guidelines, evaluation criteria, and quality standards.
* Perform and review data annotation, labelling, and classification to assess the accuracy, relevance, completeness, and appropriateness of AI-generated content.
* Identify and document incorrect, misleading, incomplete, inconsistent, or irrelevant responses, including potential AI hallucinations.
* Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and adherence to evaluation guidelines.
* Analyze large and complex datasets to identify recurring errors, quality trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Interpret quality metrics such as error rates, evaluation consistency, reviewer disagreement, and other relevant indicators.
* Investigate ambiguous or borderline cases and apply sound judgment while adhering to established evaluation criteria.
* Prepare clear documentation of evaluation findings, root causes, observations, and recommended improvements.
* Use Excel or Google Sheets and, where applicable, basic SQL to filter, analyze, and summarize evaluation data.
* Collaborate with Machine Learning Scientists, AI product teams, and other stakeholders to communicate quality insights and support improvements in AI agent performance.
* Contribute to the refinement of evaluation guidelines, quality frameworks, and review processes based on observed issues and emerging patterns.
* Maintain accurate documentation and track identified issues through appropriate ticketing and workflow management systems.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in data annotation, data labeling, AI evaluation, content quality, quality assurance, search relevance evaluation, or similar guideline-based assessment roles.
* Strong experience evaluating data, content, or system outputs against predefined guidelines, quality standards, and measurable criteria.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, investigate quality issues, and derive actionable insights.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or inconsistent information.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to apply evaluation criteria consistently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data filtering, analysis, quality tracking, and reporting.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to document findings, explain issues, and communicate insights clearly.
* Ability to work independently on evaluation tasks while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Genuine interest in artificial intelligence, conversational AI, and data-driven product improvement.
* Experience with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, AI training data validation, model output assessment, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, conversational agents, or AI-generated content evaluation.
* Familiarity with evaluating AI responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, helpfulness, and hallucinations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for extracting, filtering, and analyzing datasets.
* Experience with quality metrics such as error rates, inter-annotator agreement, reviewer disagreement, and evaluation consistency.
* Experience maintaining evaluation guidelines, quality documentation, review workflows, or issue-tracking systems.
* Exposure to travel, hospitality, customer experience, search relevance, policy evaluation, or content quality operations.

**SUMMARY: The Associate Director, Biostatistics and Programming, is a key member of the Biostatistics and Statistical Programming department. The provide daily supervision of Biostatistics and Statistical Programming operations and personnel to ensure the achievement of departmental goals and levels. This role will plan, analyze, and summarize the results of individual clinical studies or groups of studies (integrated summaries)in accordance with Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) or study specific guidelines. They will manage and mentor biostatistics and programming staff, lead department initiatives, report out to senior leadership, participate in business development activities and assist functional leads in the financial plus operational oversight of their projects.**
**Responsibilities**
Tasks may include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Provide oversight on multiple clinical research projects.
* Support Leads in low/moderate/high complexity studies in various phases of development.
* Effectively manage broad-based projects such as NDA submissions or complex, multi-protocol programs, potentially coordinating activities across multiple locations.
* Provide technical expertise, in conjunction with internal and external team members, to design, implement, analyze, report, and validate clinical trials.
* Collaborates with internal and external project team personnel, as needed, to meet project deliverables and timelines and ensure accurate, statistically valid deliverables.
* Ensure adequate staffing of all project teams and help coordinate resources across the Department.
* Represent department and company in a multi-disciplinary setting, including project team meetings, client meetings/presentations, and bid defense meetings.
* Provide statistical and programming advice/recommendations regarding clinical study design/study endpoints, sample size requirements, statistical methodology for the study protocol and clinical study report, programming strategy and document review/approval.
* Oversee all biostatistical and statistical programming activities, including statistical analysis plan development, database specification, reporting specification, statistical programming analysis, and statistical summary/report writing.
* Maintain awareness of project budgets and tasks, and effectively communicate the status of such tasks to Finance and/or senior Leadership. Help staff identify resource or scope of work changes.
* Lead implementation of departmental objectives and strategies, including but not limited to SOP development, training, professional development, standardizations, and team building activities.
* Attend and contribute to continuing education programs, professional meetings, and other career development activities.
* Assist in marketing and business development opportunities as needed.
* Position will have management responsibilities. Development, oversight, and direction of departmental staff which may include interviewing, Managerial Requirements/ terminations, training, personal growth, retention plans, coaching/performance management, goal setting, & salary.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.
  
  
**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Knowledge of clinical trial study design and multiple therapeutic areas.
* Advanced knowledge of SAS and other specialist software.
* Able to work independently and lead various teams and committees.
* Lead study team meetings as needed.
* Capable of conducting exploratory statistical analyses using statistical software packages.
* A high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Excellent presentation skills.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage priorities and workflow.
* Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities.
* Proven ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Global communication and time zone awareness.
* Ability to work effectively with a diversity of individuals at all organizational levels.
* Commitment to excellence and high standards.
* Creative, flexible, and innovative team player.
* Ability to travel for meetings or training activities.
* Ability to travel internationally may be required.
* Develop and guide implementation of departmental objectives and strategies.
* Proven ability to effectively manage and mentor junior staff.
* Ability to effectively engage with executive leadership.
* Experience with financial and budget management.

**Requirements**
Education:
  
  

* Master’s degree, equivalent, or higher in biostatistics or a related field.
* A satisfactory combination of education and experience may be accepted as a substitute for the specific education and experience listed above.

**Experience**

* A minimum of 10+ years of relevant work experience.
* A minimum of 5+ years line management experience.
* Previous experience in a pharmaceutical research or CRO setting required.
* Previous experience in multiple therapeutic areas, including oncology.
* Hands on Experience with CDISC/SDTM/ADaM Programming including but not limited to SAS: Data Step Manipulation, Merge, Sort, Transpose, Reporting (Proc Report), Comparison (Proc Compare), Error Checking (Log resolution), modeling, missing data handling approaches/procedures, figure development.
* Capable of conducting exploratory statistical analyses using statistical software packages.
* Experience developing custom SAS programs.
* Experience with P21 reporting and DEFINE, SDRG, ADRG development.
* Creation of annotated CRFs Base or Advance SAS certification preferred.

* Drive best practices in commercial management across SAP programs.
* Contribute to organizational capability development and process improvements.
* Participate in recruitment, performance management, and career development activities.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
**Conviva is the experience analytics platform for AI agents, apps, and streaming. Conviva pioneered quality of experience measurement for streaming video and has supported live digital experiences across 20 Super Bowls, 10 Olympic Games, and five FIFA World Cup tournaments. With full-census, real-time, stateful analytics, Conviva shows what consumers actually experience, not just whether systems are running, and connects that experience to revenue, retention, and risk.**

We are looking for a dynamic, growth-minded DevOps Engineer with over 8 years of experience to bridge the gap between our traditional on-premises infrastructure and our expanding multi cloud footprint (AWS, GCP, and OCI). Here is the honest truth: we don't expect you to be an absolute master of all three clouds and bare-metal setups on day one. We value your learning trajectory (your slope) over your current baseline knowledge (your intercept). If you have rock-solid systems fundamentals, a passion for automation, an unstoppable drive to figure things out, and a knack for deep-dive debugging, you will thrive here.

**What Success Will Look Like:**

* Hybrid & Multi-Cloud Orchestration: Assist in managing, scaling, and maintaining our on-premises infrastructure while expanding and supporting environments across AWS, GCP, and OCI.
* Identity & Access Management (IAM): Design, implement, and audit secure authentication and authorization workflows (OIDC, SAML, Cloud IAM, Least Privilege policies) across hybrid environments.
* CI/CD Pipeline Architecture: Build, maintain, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines to ensure safe, repeatable, and rapid code deployments.
* Observability & Debugging: Set up comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems. You will be the detective who tracks down root causes when complex, distributed systems misbehave.
* SecOps Integration: Embed security best practices directly into the infrastructure lifecycle (vulnerability scanning, secrets management, compliance-as-code).

**Who You Are and What You've Done:**

Technical Baseline (The Intercept)

* Experience: 8+ years in a DevOps, Site Reliability, or Systems Engineering role.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid hands-on experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.
* Operating Systems: Strong Linux administration and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, routing) for both cloud and physical hardware.
* Cloud Platforms: Foundational or deep experience in at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or OCI), with a strong conceptual understanding of how to translate those skills to the others.
* Containers: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (managed or bare-metal).
* Tooling Preferences: Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch), CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), and Secrets Management (HashiCorp Vault).

Growth Mindset (The Slope)

* Rapid Adaptation: The ability to pick up a completely new cloud provider or tool within weeks and apply it effectively.
* First-Principles Thinking: When an application fails, you don't just restart it; you want to understand why it failed at the OS or network level.
* Automation First: A strong aversion to manual, repetitive tasks; you automate yourself out of a job wherever possible.

Why You'll Love Working Here

* Uncapped Learning: You will gain rare, highly sought-after experience working across three major cloud providers and physical on-prem infrastructure simultaneously.
* High Autonomy: We trust our engineers. You will have the freedom to research, propose, and implement modern tools and methodologies.
* A Culture of Growth: We embrace mistakes as learning opportunities. We care about how fast you grow, not just what you knew yesterday.

conviva.ai

LinkedIn

YouTube

title: Sr Engineer - Cloud Enablement
description: About UsAs a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.Target Tech OverviewEvery time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target.com, they experience the impact of Target’s investments in technology and innovation. We’re the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities.Our global in-house technology team of more than 5,000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open-source software to adapt and build best-in-class technology for our team members and guests—and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning.Pyramid OverviewThe Cloud Enablement team builds and operates the foundational public cloud platform that engineering teams across Target rely on to deliver at enterprise scale. Working primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), the team owns a hardened, standardized cloud foundation spanning compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and identity — the core building blocks that power Target's digital and data-driven experiences. Our mission is to make cloud simple, secure, and cost-effective to consume: we design the opinionated patterns, policies, and guardrails that keep workloads safe and reliable, and we build the APIs, automation, and self-service tooling that let teams adopt and scale cloud services with confidence. title: Linux Engineer- Linux Fleet Management
description:
**INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING**

Infrastructure Engineer III - Linux Fleet Management

**Job Profile Summary**

Design, engineer, and continuously improve scalable Linux fleet management, automation, configuration management, patching, and lifecycle capabilities. Serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex infrastructure issues while driving automation, reliability, standardization, and operational maturity across the managed fleet.

**Career Level Summary**

* Requires in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge of infrastructure engineering and related disciplines.
* Solves complex and cross-platform technical problems with minimal guidance.
* Leads technical projects or significant workstreams and is accountable for technical outcomes.
* Designs and implements scalable infrastructure automation, configuration management, and fleet-management solutions.
* Defines and improves engineering standards and operational practices.
* Serves as a senior technical resource and escalation point for less-experienced engineers.
* Mentors Engineers I and II and contributes to long-term fleet strategy and modernization.

**Critical Competencies**

* **Excellence:**
  Demonstrates accountability, discipline, and consistent execution while maintaining reliable and supportable infrastructure.
* **Customer-driven:**
  Understands the needs of technology teams and delivers infrastructure services that support reliable business operations.
* **Expertise:**
  Builds and applies technical knowledge in Linux systems, fleet management, automation, and configuration management.
* **Agility:**
  Adapts to changing infrastructure requirements, technologies, and operational priorities.
* **Compassion:**
  Collaborates effectively, shares knowledge, and contributes to a positive and supportive engineering environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design scalable Linux fleet management, automated patching, and configuration-management solutions.
* Define and improve automated patching architectures, workflows, and operational controls.
* Design Puppet, Ansible, Jenkins, or equivalent automation patterns and reusable engineering frameworks.
* Develop advanced Python, Bash, or comparable automation for complex infrastructure use cases.
* Establish configuration-as-code, source-control, testing, and deployment practices for infrastructure automation.
* Define technical standards for Linux fleet configuration, patching, lifecycle management, and operational readiness.
* Lead complex end-of-life, modernization, and technical-debt remediation initiatives.
* Diagnose complex, systemic, and cross-platform infrastructure failures and drive root-cause remediation.
* Analyze fleet-wide operational metrics to identify systemic reliability and efficiency improvements.
* Lead technical projects from design through implementation and operationalization.
* Evaluate infrastructure automation and configuration-management technologies and recommend adoption approaches.
* Partner with architecture, cloud, application, security, and infrastructure teams on complex technical initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and serve as a senior escalation point for production infrastructure issues.

**Knowledge**

* Linux system administration and operating system concepts.
* Linux package management, patching, and operating system lifecycle management.
* Infrastructure automation and configuration management principles.
* Desired-state configuration, configuration drift, standardized deployment, and configuration-as-code practices.
* Server infrastructure, virtualization, and cloud computing concepts.
* Infrastructure vulnerability remediation and system hardening concepts.
* Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Deep knowledge of monitoring, availability, capacity, backup, recovery, and resiliency practices.
* Infrastructure architecture and engineering standards.
* Operational risk, lifecycle strategy, and technical-debt management.
* Advanced source-control, testing, and software engineering practices for infrastructure automation.

**Skills**

* Advanced Linux Systems Administration
* Operating System Patching
* Infrastructure Automation
* Configuration Management
* Deep knowledge of Ansible
* Bash / Shell Scripting
* Configuration-as-Code
* Git / Source Control
* Infrastructure Architecture
* Cloud Computing
* Virtualization
* Network/Systems Skills
* Vulnerability Remediation
* Infrastructure Monitoring
* Operational Metrics
* Project Management
* Technical Leadership
* Mentoring
* Process Improvement
* Knowledge of Linux Fleet Management, Python, Jenkins, Puppet are added advantage.

**Education**

* High School Diploma or regional equivalent required.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline preferred; relevant professional experience may substitute at the manager's discretion.

**Certifications**

Relevant industry certifications preferred. Examples include Linux, Red Hat, Ansible/Red Hat Automation, cloud, or infrastructure-related certifications. Equivalent technical experience may substitute for certifications.

**Experience**

3-6 years of relevant experience in Linux systems administration, infrastructure engineering, fleet management, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related technical role.

The above information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this classification. It is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of the employee assigned to this job.

title: Senior Platform Engineer, Network Infrastructure
description:
Cloud Foundations Reliability (CFR) is part of NVIDIA’s Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization. We deploy, integrate, and operate the Kubernetes-based platform and shared services used to provision, monitor, and operate NVIDIA’s global network across data centers, colocation facilities, and cloud environments. The team owns the architecture and lifecycle of this platform, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, GitOps delivery, observability, capacity, and service enablement. We build software and automation to standardize how network platforms and services are deployed, scaled, and managed across environments.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer to own the lifecycle and automation of the Kubernetes platform supporting GNI network systems. You will also provide production support for network services running on the platform, partnering with their engineering owners when issues or changes cross the platform boundary. You will take complex problems from design through production and remain accountable for the outcome. You will bring deep Kubernetes expertise and help establish consistent engineering practices across the US and Bangalore teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership and production responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design, build, and operate the Kubernetes platform that powers GNI network automation, telemetry, and operations across data center, colocation, and cloud environments.
* Own the lifecycle management for GNI Kubernetes environments, including cluster onboarding, upgrades, capacity, availability, and recovery.
* Develop production-quality software and automation for cluster provisioning, validation, upgrades, remediation, and safe multi-cluster delivery through GitOps.
* Provide production support for network services hosted on the platform, working with Network Automation and service teams that retain ownership of application architecture, code, and features.
* Diagnose complex Kubernetes platform and hosted-service failures involving control-plane health, cluster networking, storage, scheduling, workload placement, and multi-cluster dependencies. Drive issues from initial signal through verified resolution.
* Define production-readiness and observability standards for the platform and hosted network services, including health signals, capacity, alerts, runbooks, and recovery.
* Participate in CFR’s production on-call rotation, including scheduled after-hours and weekend coverage. Lead incident response and recovery, then drive corrective actions to completion.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, network infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Deep experience with Kubernetes at scale, including cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, and recovery.
* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Go or Python.
* Experience with GitOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and automated production delivery.
* Experience deploying and supporting network automation or telemetry services on Kubernetes.
* Experience with production on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and driving corrective actions to completion.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong knowledge of IP routing, data center fabrics, and cloud networking is a great plus.
* Experience designing and operating large, multi-region Kubernetes fleets, including fleet-wide upgrades and recovery.
* Hands-on experience with Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3 for bare-metal provisioning, cluster lifecycle, machine remediation, and upgrades.
* Experience building Kubernetes controllers or operators in Go using custom resources and reconciliation patterns. Experience designing or operating network automation and telemetry services on Kubernetes at global scale.
* Contributions to Cluster API, Metal3, or other open-source Kubernetes infrastructure projects.

NVIDIA’s deep learning platforms have made major impact to various fields is broadly used across leading academic institutions, start-ups, and industry, including the world’s largest Internet companies. We need passionate, hard-working and creative people to help us take on more of these unique opportunities in deep learning cloud solutions. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer, Platforms
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a backend/infrastructure engineer to join our founding team. We are working on building ML and data pipelines, which can be efficient, secure and highly scalable by design. As a platforms engineer you will be working on the deployments, observability and other aspects for scaling the production environment with customers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Wisdom is at an inflection point, with strong product market fit and the traction of Fortune 100 customers. We are looking for an early-stage engineer to build out the deployment, observability, and scaling of our growing production environments. You will work closely with experienced members of the team and customers to build systems to surpass the bottleneck of onboarding customers of any shape and size.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Owning the observability and deployments of Wisdom stack.
* Working with other software engineers and sales engineers to build the right processes and tooling for production change management.
* Work with modern cloud infrastructure to build cost efficient and scalable systems.
* Work closely with customers and founders to define the product and engineering roadmap.
* Shape up the engineering culture and tech stack for the company.

**Qualifications**

* Experience building highly available and scalable cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with Kubernetes/Terraform/Python.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field.
* Experience working in startup/fast paced teams is highly desirable.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. description:

Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e&), AT&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
  
  
Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:

It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform-as-a-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.

Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
  
  
**Job Role - Software Engineer II (DevSecOps)**
**Location - Bangalore , India**
**Role Description**
DevSecOps is a core, cross-functional discipline that spans the entire organization, offering the unique opportunity to collaborate with multiple teams across diverse products and platforms. Your role is central to ensuring software features are reliable, scalable, and ready for both build-and-launch and operational handoffs.
  
  
As a
**DevSecOps**
Engineer, you will operate as a hands-on individual contributor, responsible for proposing, designing, implementing, and troubleshooting robust CI/CD pipelines for multi-tier applications deployed on virtual machines and containerized platforms in public cloud environments. You'll collaborate closely with principal engineers across various teams.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a highly skilled team where your impact will be felt organization-wide. It also offers a platform to deepen your expertise in DevSecOps while enhancing both your technical and strategic business skill sets.
  
  
You will be immersed in a cutting-edge DevSecOps ecosystem featuring CI/CD automation, ephemeral (dynamic) environments, automated QA pipelines, fan-out deployment strategies, blue/green releases, and scalable deployment to partner environments—ranging from on-premises to multi-cloud platforms.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for containerized applications, covering the full lifecycle from build to deployment.
* Establish continuous delivery and deployment pipelines integrated with release workflows to support streamlined release orchestration.
* Diagnose and resolve issues in multi-layered, containerized applications deployed in cloud environments.
* Own infrastructure architecture and define non-functional requirements, ensuring alignment with the overall technology roadmap and platform launch objectives.
* Champion a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) culture across the organization by promoting industry best practices, standards, tools, documentation, and reusable code across engineering teams.
* Design, develop, and drive adoption of solutions that enhance observability, reliability, and operational efficiency across the platform.
* Integrate AI-driven solutions into the software development lifecycle to enhance development and operational efficiency.
* Automate manual, repetitive, or mechanical processes by applying software and scripting solutions wherever beneficial.
* Troubleshoot complex, cross-platform issues spanning OS, networking, and databases in a cloud-based SaaS environment; handle live production incidents and ensure implementation of SRE best practices.
* Conduct system discovery and analysis to identify and implement performance, availability, and reliability improvements.
* Collaborate with software engineers and QA teams to ensure the system meets non-functional requirements such as performance, availability, and security.
* Maintain comprehensive system documentation, develop runbooks, and ensure key system knowledge is accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage and monitor infrastructure deployment and orchestration, including servers, Docker containers, Kubernetes clusters, and other backend components.
* Stay up-to-date with security trends, proactively identify vulnerabilities, and troubleshoot complex security issues.
* Participate in an on-call rotation, including weekend support, to ensure high availability and quick incident response.

**Required Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelors or masters degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Certification Requirements (nice To Have)**

* Kubernetes CKA or CKAD certification is nice to have
* AWS or GCP DevOps related certifications is nice to have
* GCP or AWS certification on cloud architecture - associate/professional is nice to have

**Required Technical Competencies**

* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, Kubernetes, and a strong background in DevOps, SRE, and Agile methodologies.
* Proven experience in designing, setting up, and maintaining Kubernetes clusters and managing containerised pipelines.
* Expertise in developing, testing, and implementing CI/CD pipelines for automating build, deployment, and code promotion processes.
* Proficient in writing automation scripts and pipelines using Groovy or Python to streamline routine tasks and eliminate manual intervention.
* Strong background in troubleshooting CI/CD pipeline issues, especially for containerised and multi-layer applications deployed in GCP or AWS.
* Experience in infusing AI into the software development lifecycle to enhance automation and decision-making.
* Extensive experience working with cloud-native CI/CD environments, and container technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, and Helm.
* Solid experience as a Linux system administrator (e.g., Ubuntu, RedHat), with proficiency in command-line tools such as Bash, VIM, and SSH.
* Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and performance analysis tools like Grafana, Prometheus, DataDog, Nagios, and New Relic.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform deep root-cause analysis and implement effective solutions.
* Advanced knowledge of core infrastructure components including storage, systems, and networking.

**Required Business Skills**

* Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities independently with a collaborative, team-first attitude.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of clearly conveying ideas to diverse stakeholders using visual aids like PowerPoint and architecture diagrams.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities with a data-driven mindset to identify root causes, validate outcomes, and provide effective solutions.
* Quick to learn new technologies and apply them to deliver impactful, timely results with minimal supervision.
* Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to provide relevant project updates and insights to stakeholders efficiently.

**Desirable Technical Competencies**

* Experience integrating AI into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), particularly within CI/CD pipelines.
* Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Configuration Management as Code (CMaC), and Policy as Code (PoaC) is highly desirable
* In-depth knowledge of common internet protocols and applications such as SMTP, DNS, HTTP, SSH, SNMP, etc.
* Familiarity with platforms like GitLab or GitHub and technologies like ELK stack, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, and Etcd.

title: Azure DevOps + Splunk + Dynatrace
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps Engineer with strong experience in CI/CD, Azure infrastructure, automation, and containerized environments, complemented by administrative knowledge of Splunk and Dynatrace.

The role will focus on automating deployments, infrastructure, and observability setup—ensuring applications and services can be quickly onboarded, validated, and ready for production monitoring.

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD & Release Automation

Design and maintain pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools. Automate builds, testing, deployments, and post-deployment validation, incorporating approval controls, rollback mechanisms, and secure release practices.

Azure Infrastructure & Infrastructure as Code

Provision and manage Azure services, including AKS, App Services, Azure Functions, networking, and storage. Use Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent tools to automate provisioning, standardize configurations, and improve scalability and cost efficiency.

Containerization & Kubernetes

Build and maintain Docker images and Kubernetes deployment configurations. Manage AKS workloads, scaling, resource allocation, and health checks; troubleshoot container, connectivity, and deployment issues.

Automation & Security

Develop reusable scripts using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to reduce manual effort across infrastructure, deployments, and operational workflows. Automate configuration management and integrate security scanning, secrets management, and access controls into delivery processes.

Splunk & Dynatrace Administration, Automation & Production Readiness

Automate platform setup, agent/forwarder deployment, configuration, and application onboarding to accelerate production-monitoring readiness. Support access management, platform health, and troubleshooting. Integrate reusable automation and readiness checks into CI/CD pipelines to validate log ingestion, telemetry collection, and monitoring coverage before go-live.

SRE & Production Reliability

Apply SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and post-incident reviews. Partner with SRE L2/L3 teams to resolve production issues, reduce MTTR, and automate recurring operational and recovery activities.

Collaboration & Enablement

Provide reusable automation templates, operational runbooks, and engineering standards. Enable self-service provisioning and monitoring onboarding, integrate workflows with ServiceNow or Jira, and guide teams on deployment and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on DevOps or platform engineering experience, including CI/CD ownership, infrastructure automation, and production troubleshooting.

Strong experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools, along with Git-based workflows.

Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and Linux.

Strong scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, including API-based automation and tool integration.

Working administrative knowledge of both Splunk and Dynatrace, including access management, forwarder/agent configuration, data onboarding, platform health, and troubleshooting.

Ability to automate monitoring setup, streamline application onboarding, and validate production-monitoring readiness.

Understanding of SRE fundamentals, with strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting retail/e-commerce platforms, microservices, and distributed systems. Familiarity with Helm, GitOps/Argo CD, Prometheus, and Grafana.

Certifications in Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Splunk, or Dynatrace are good to have, but not mandatory.

Success Measures

Reduced time to onboard applications into production monitoring; increased automation and self-service adoption; validated monitoring coverage before go-live; fewer manual configuration errors; and improved deployment reliability and incident resolution time.

Pay: ₹1,400,000.00 - ₹1,630,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 8+ years of experience in DevOps/Platform Engineering with strong hands-on expertise in Azure, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep)?
* Do you have hands-on experience administering both Splunk and Dynatrace, including agent/forwarder configuration, application onboarding, access management, and troubleshooting?
* Have you worked hands-on with Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and automated deployments using Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting?
* Do you have practical experience implementing SRE practices, including monitoring readiness validation, incident management, root cause analysis, and reducing MTTR in production environments?
* Are you available to join immediately or within 30 days?

The Manager will partner closely with onshore DevOps leadership, HRP Engineering, Release Management, InfoSec, and Infrastructure Platform teams to execute the CI/CD modernization, AWS migration, and security remediation roadmap while building a resilient, well-coached team.

This is a hands-on people-management role: the Manager is expected to run day-to-day operations, remove blockers, coach engineers, and represent the offshore team's work and capacity accurately to onshore leadership — not simply relay status upward.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Manage and coach a team of offshore DevOps engineers, including 1:1s, performance feedback, and career development plans.
* Own sprint and quarterly planning for the offshore DevOps workstreams, ensuring realistic capacity allocation across CI/CD, security remediation, and AWS migration initiatives.
* Identify and remediate single-point-of-failure (SPOF) risk within the team by building cross-training plans and documented ownership for critical systems (CI/CD infrastructure, release tooling, environment automation).
* Provide regular, accurate status reporting to the Director, DevOps and onshore leadership using a decision-focused format (hot topics, upcoming milestones, blockers, risks).
* Escalate ownership, scope, or resourcing conflicts early, with clear recommendations rather than status updates alone.

**CI/CD & Platform Engineering Oversight**

* Guide execution of the Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions migration, including EKS-based runner architecture, GitHub Apps authentication, and CI/CD pipeline modernization.
* Oversee Infrastructure-as-Code (CDK/Ansible) provisioning for internal environments (Dev, QA, Perf, Shared, Preprod), maintaining the boundary that DevOps owns internal environments while Release Management owns customer-facing environments.
* Drive the Azure-to-AWS migration workstream for internally owned environments, coordinating with Infrastructure Platform and networking teams to resolve cutover blockers.
* Ensure code release, build, and deployment tooling (Nexus, Sonar, Jenkins) is kept current, secure, and migrated per the platform roadmap.

**Security & Compliance Execution**

* Lead the offshore team's execution of Q4 security initiatives originating from InfoSec, including dependency-tree generation, secrets detection/rotation, vulnerable-commit blocking, and Wiz runtime integration.
* Own DevOps' portion of the secrets remediation program: guardrail tooling, Secrets Manager/Vault integration, and coordination with repo owners and Release Management on rotation.
* Maintain clear RACI boundaries when scoping security work — DevOps owns pipeline-level guardrails; repo and environment owners drive remediation; Release Management owns customer-environment actions.
* Support FedRAMP 20x and CMS POC evidence requirements as they relate to DevOps-owned controls (STIG AMIs, TLS, Secrets Manager, GitHub Apps, IaC).

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with the Director, DevOps, onshore senior ICs, and HRP Engineering leadership to align on architecture, release cadence, and upcoming platform changes before they reach the team mid-quarter.
* Represent the offshore team in the monthly DevOps/Engineering cadence and biweekly senior IC forums, surfacing toil, risk, and proactive architectural concerns.
* Coordinate with Infrastructure Platform, InfoSec, and Release Management to resolve cross-team ownership gaps before they become production issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Platform Engineering roles, with at least 2–3 years in a people-management or team-lead capacity.
* Demonstrated experience managing distributed or offshore engineering teams, including performance management and coaching plans.
* Strong hands-on background in CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK, Ansible, Terraform), and cloud platforms (AWS required; Azure a plus).
* Working knowledge of GitHub administration, including GitHub Apps, PAT-to-App migrations, and repository governance at scale (400+ repositories).
* Experience with artifact and dependency management tooling (Nexus, Sonar) and secrets management platforms (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
* Familiarity with security remediation workflows: vulnerability scanning, dependency-tree analysis, secrets rotation, and runtime security tooling (e.g., Wiz).
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to produce concise, decision-focused updates for senior leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve single-point-of-failure risk and to build redundancy into critical operational functions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting healthcare technology, claims processing, or other regulated/compliance-heavy platforms.
* Familiarity with FedRAMP, HITRUST, or similar compliance frameworks.
* Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) for CI/CD runner infrastructure or application workloads.
* Exposure to DORA metrics and engineering-productivity measurement programs.
* Prior experience operating in a matrixed organization with distinct onshore/offshore reporting lines.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months**

* Offshore team capacity, ownership, and SPOF risks are documented and actively being mitigated through cross-training.
* Jenkins-to-GitHub Actions and AWS migration workstreams are progressing against a jointly owned, realistic timeline with clear blockers surfaced early.
* Security remediation items owned by DevOps show measurable burn-down, with clean ownership boundaries agreed upon with InfoSec and Release Management.
* The Director, DevOps and onshore leadership have consistent visibility into offshore delivery through structured, decision-focused reporting.

*HealthEdge Software, Inc. | Internal Job Description | Platform DevOps & Developer Experience*

description:

**General Summary:**

**JOB OVERVIEW**

This position is part of the Qualcomm Customer Engineering Group, which collaborates closely with automotive partners and customers — from concept through commercialization — across Qualcomm's broad Snapdragon Automotive platform portfolio. The team supports all aspects of embedded software including hardware and software architecture, feature bring-up, platform integration, software customization, system validation, and complex debugging efforts that are critical to product launch.

  

This is a Staff-level Software Applications Engineering position focused on Build & Integration (B&I) and Release Engineering for Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive platforms. The primary mission of this role is to own, drive, and continuously improve build systems, integration pipelines, and release processes that enable automotive software delivery across IVI, ADAS, and FLEX segments for global automotive customers. The role spans multiple OS environments including Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor) with multi-OS virtualized stacks.

  

The successful candidate will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Build & Integration engineering within the BDC CE team, driving cross-functional collaboration between Customer Engineering, Dev/Platform SW teams, and global automotive OEM/Tier-1 partners. As a Staff Engineer, this individual will provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, define build and release methodologies, and contribute to the continuous improvement of automation frameworks and engineering productivity tooling.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Build, Integration & Release Management**

* Own and manage end-to-end build, integration, and release activities for complex Snapdragon Automotive software products spanning multiple OS platforms.

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable and reliable build infrastructures and CI/CD pipelines tailored for embedded and HLOS automotive software stacks.

* Drive continuous improvement of build systems, toolchains, automation frameworks, and release processes across program milestones.

* Establish release governance, versioning, branching, tagging, and artifact management strategies for multi-OS automotive software deliveries.

* Monitor build health, integration quality, and release readiness across multiple product streams and chipset generations.

* Collaborate with development, quality engineering, and platform teams to ensure successful integration and deployment.

* Identify bottlenecks and implement measures to improve build performance, reliability, and delivery efficiency.

* Define and maintain build and release KPIs, dashboards, and operational metrics to track program health.

* Ensure compliance with software development standards, security policies, and release governance processes.

* Lead investigations and root-cause analysis for build failures, integration issues, and release blockers.
  

**Triage & Engineering Support**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for build and integration-related issues across the Customer Engineering (CE) team.

* Provide timely triage, troubleshooting, and resolution support for development, integration, and release issues.

* Analyze build logs, compiler errors, dependency conflicts, toolchain issues, and deployment failures.

* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring engineering issues; own Change Requests (CRs) end-to-end from triage through patch validation.

* Partner with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges.

* Develop self-service tools, documentation, and best practices to improve engineering productivity across the BDC CE team.

* Track and manage technical debt associated with build environments, toolchains, and integration workflows.
  

**Customer Engagement & Technical Support**

* Serve as a key technical interface for build and integration queries from automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers across regions.

* Support Automotive RFI (AutoRFI) assessments for B&I-related NRE scoping, communicating technical complexity and resource requirements.

* Engage with customers during bring-up, pre-CS, and post-CS phases to proactively identify and mitigate build and integration risks.

* Provide on-site customer support as required during critical program milestones.

* Collaborate with NA, EU, and India CE teams to ensure global follow-the-sun build and integration support.
  

**Automation, Tools & Engineering Productivity**

* Drive development and validation of build and release automation frameworks for multi-OS automotive software platforms.

* Design and maintain automated build health monitors, integration quality dashboards, and triage tooling to reduce mean time to resolution.

* Partner with platform and APT (Automated Platform Test) teams to define and integrate build qualification checks across CI/CD pipelines.

* Create and maintain build guides, integration runbooks, and reusable diagnostic artifacts for build and release issues across platforms.

Track and analyze build and integration trends across program stages (Bringup ES L0–L4 FC

* CS) and communicate risk to program and customer teams.

* Contribute to secure software supply chain and DevSecOps practices within the automotive software delivery pipeline.
  

**Technical Leadership & Mentorship**

* Serve as the B&I SME for the BDC CE team, providing architectural guidance on build system design, integration strategy, and release engineering.

* Lead cross-functional B&I reviews with Dev, QA, DevOps, and CE teams; drive root-cause analysis delivery to enable process improvements.

* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on build system concepts, CI/CD best practices, scripting, and customer engagement.

* Influence feature design and architecture decisions to proactively prevent build and integration failures in future Snapdragon Automotive SPs.

* Scale technical knowledge through reusable documentation, training materials, and knowledge-base contributions.
  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Experience**

* One of the following:

* B.E. / B.Tech in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or related field with 8+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related experience.

* M.Tech / M.S. in relevant field with 6+ years of experience.

* Ph.D. in relevant field with 4+ years of experience.
  

**Required Technical Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in build, integration, and release engineering for large-scale software products.

* Strong expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, implementation, and optimization.

* Hands-on experience with build automation systems (Make, CMake, Bazel, Ninja, Gradle, or similar).

* Proficiency in scripting languages: Python, Shell/Bash for build and automation workflows.

* Strong expertise in source control management and branching strategies (GitFlow, Trunk-Based Development).

* Experience with artifact repository management and release artifact governance.

* Experience with Linux/Unix build environments and containerized build infrastructure.

* 3+ years of customer-facing or cross-functional technical support experience.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to document RCAs and communicate technical findings to cross-functional teams.
  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Staff-level experience owning build and integration engineering for production automotive programs (IVI / ADAS / FLEX) from bringup through SOP.

* Experience with multi-OS build environments spanning Linux, Android, QNX (HQX), and HGY (Gunyah Hypervisor).

* Familiarity with Qualcomm Snapdragon Automotive chipsets across Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen4.5 / Gen5 software delivery pipelines.

* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software supply chain management.

* Knowledge of containerization (Docker) and cloud-native build pipelines for embedded software.

* Familiarity with ASPICE process compliance, ASIL functional safety considerations, and automotive program delivery cycles.

* Experience with AutoRFI processes, NRE scoping, and CDEV (Chipset Development) activities within CE programs.

* Knowledge of build and release KPI frameworks, dashboards, and workload-based productivity trend analysis.

* Proven experience collaborating with global automotive OEM and Tier-1 customers on build, integration, and release escalations.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience.

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

  
A day in the life  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.  
  
Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.  
  
Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times  
  
About the team  
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Knowledge of at least one modern programming language such as C, C++, Java, or Perl
* Experience with automation, testing, or monitoring framework development
* 1+ years of DevOps or SysOps in a large-scale software development environment experience
* Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Knowledge of and proficiency in the use of Python scripting language
* Experience on highly concurrent, high throughput systems and knowledge of complex distributed systems
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
* Experience with software development lifecycle, or experience in software development
