title: Track Manager - Mainframe Automation Tools
description:
Track Manager - Mainframe Automation Tools

Noida, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Java Platform Engineer is responsible for owning, maintaining, enhancing, and governing common Java libraries, utilities, frameworks, and shared components developed as part of Mainframe Modernization . These reusable assets serve as foundational building blocks for multiple modernized applications and are distributed through the enterprise artifact repository.

The role focuses on ensuring shared Java components are reliable, maintainable, secure, versioned appropriately, and consumable by application teams. The engineer will work closely with application development teams, platform engineering, architecture, testing teams, and business SMEs to support the long-term operational ownership of common code ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Strong hands-on Java development experience, including design, development, troubleshooting, refactoring, and production support.

* Experience maintaining enterprise Java frameworks, reusable libraries, and shared platform components.

* Strong understanding of Maven, Gradle, dependency management, and artifact lifecycle management.

* Experience with Artifactory or similar enterprise artifact repositories.

* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality controls, and release management.

* Experience with GitHub, source control management, branching strategies, and pull request processes.

* Familiarity with legacy modernization, mainframe-to-Java migration, code conversion, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL; DB2 LUW experience preferred.

* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

* Ability to work across multiple application teams and manage shared-code dependencies.

* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

* Own the lifecycle of common Java libraries, utilities, frameworks, and reusable services.

* Maintain and enhance shared components while ensuring backward compatibility and minimal disruption to consuming applications.

* Establish and enforce standards for reusable code, library design, packaging, and consumption.

Artifact Repository Management

* Build, package, version, and publish approved Java artifacts to Artifactory.

* Manage artifact versioning, release governance, dependency tracking, and deprecation strategies.

* Ensure shared artifacts are properly documented and available for enterprise consumption.

Development & Support

* Review, maintain, and enhance converted Java utilities, common-code components, and shared services delivered through Mainframe modernization.

* Analyze code for maintainability, performance, reliability, operational supportability, and security.

* Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, remediation planning, and validation activities involving shared platform components.

Consumer Team Enablement

* Partner with application teams consuming shared libraries and common services.

* Provide guidance on library adoption, upgrade planning, dependency management, and integration best practices.

* Support onboarding of new application teams to common components.

Build, Release & Quality Engineering

* Maintain build pipelines and automated validation processes for shared components.

* Implement and support automated testing, code quality analysis, and security scanning.

* Ensure artifacts meet enterprise quality, security, and compliance standards before publication.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* + Mainframe modernization and legacy application transformation initiatives.

  + Shared services or platform engineering organizations.

  + Enterprise artifact repositories such as Artifactory.

  + Maven Central style dependency management and semantic versioning.

  + CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar.

  + Enterprise-scale Java application support.

  + Cloud-hosted Java workloads and distributed application architectures.

  Success Measures

  + Stability and reliability of shared Java components.

  + Successful adoption of common libraries across applications.

  + Reduction of duplicate code and implementation inconsistencies.

  + Effective version governance and dependency management.

  + High-quality documentation and support readiness.

  + Timely resolution of defects impacting consuming applications.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Company Overview
  

Jetbro is a technology consulting and systems integration firm that builds reliable, scalable digital systems for organizations where technology is central to everyday operations. We work across infrastructure, enterprise software, and product development, focusing on systems that are stable, predictable, and built to operate under real-world pressure.

This role is part of Jetbro’s engagement with Safal, where we are building and evolving an enterprise SaaS platform used to manage procurement workflows, approvals, and business operations.

Quality assurance at Safal is not about simply running test cases. It is about deeply understanding business workflows, ensuring system reliability, and building automated testing systems that help the product evolve safely and confidently.

About the Role
  

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer with 3–5 years of experience who can combine structured manual testing with strong automation capabilities.

The Safal platform includes multi-role procurement workflows, approval chains, and enterprise-level system logic. The QA engineer must be able to understand these workflows deeply and validate that the system behaves correctly across multiple roles, conditions, and edge cases.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working with developers, writing structured documentation, and gradually automating QA processes.

We are particularly looking for candidates who actively use modern automation tools and AI-assisted workflows to improve QA productivity, automate documentation, generate test cases, and build strong test coverage systems.

Key Responsibilities
  

* Write structured test cases for product features and workflows
* Build and maintain automation test suites using Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks
* Perform exploratory testing to identify edge cases and unexpected behavior
* Conduct regression testing across product releases
* Test APIs and backend services using tools such as Postman
* Validate multi-role workflows, permissions, and approval logic
* Ensure data integrity across workflows and system actions
* Collaborate with developers during issue identification and resolution
* Contribute to maintaining test automation pipelines alongside engineering teams
* Generate structured test documentation including test cases, test plans, and coverage reports
* Use automation and AI tools to accelerate QA workflows and documentation
* Ensure releases meet quality standards before deployment

Requirements
  
  
Mandatory Requirements
  

* 3–5 years of experience in software quality assurance
* Strong experience in test automation using Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools
* Experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman
* Experience writing structured test cases and test documentation
* Strong understanding of regression testing and exploratory testing
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and validate system behavior
* Experience validating role-based systems and workflow logic
* Ability to generate structured test coverage reports
* Experience working closely with engineering teams during development cycles
* Familiarity with modern AI tools for improving QA productivity and documentation

Good to Have
  

* Experience with Python-based automation frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated testing environments
* Experience validating database consistency and backend workflows
* Familiarity with procurement or workflow-driven enterprise applications

What we care about
  

* Deep workflow understanding over superficial testing
* Automation mindset over repetitive manual execution
* Clear documentation over informal test notes
* Curiosity and investigation over checklist testing
* Continuous improvement of QA systems using automation and AI

This role is suited for someone who sees QA not as the final step in development, but as a core part of building reliable enterprise systems.

Benefits
  
  
What we Offer
  

* A chance to work on a greenfield project and influence architectural decisions.
* Competitive salary and benefits.
* Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing SaaS company.
* A collaborative and innovative team culture.

description:

* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM-related matters.

* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.

* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi-factor authentication).

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders

**Education:**

**Work Requirements:**

* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

title: Application Architect
description:
Avanade is the world’s leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7,000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft’s Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results.
  
  
Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60,000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165,000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Applications & Engineering practice is looking for an Application Architect to own the architecture of the custom applications we build for clients. This is a hands-on architect role — the person in it sets the target architecture, proves it in code, and stays close enough to the build to be accountable for whether it works.
  
  
You will architect microservices and cloud-native applications on Azure, lead modernisation of monolithic and legacy .NET estates, and set the engineering and DevOps standards the delivery teams work to. You will also lead a team directly — guiding engineers and technical leads through build and release — and act as the design authority with client architects and review boards. We expect fluency with LLM-based development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and a clear view of how to use them well on client code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the application architecture on client engagements — target-state architecture, service boundaries, integration patterns, non-functional requirements and architecture decision records.
* Architect microservices-based applications: domain-driven service decomposition, API design and versioning, synchronous and asynchronous communication, messaging and events, resilience, idempotency and distributed data patterns.
* Lead monolith-to-microservices modernisation — assessing the existing estate, identifying seams and bounded contexts, sequencing the decomposition (strangler-fig and similar patterns), and managing data separation and cutover without breaking the business.
* Design cloud-native applications on Azure — containers and AKS, App Service, Azure Functions and serverless, API Management, Service Bus and Event Grid, caching, storage, scalability, observability and cost-aware design.
* Lead migration of .NET Framework applications to .NET Core / modern .NET — assessment, dependency analysis, refactoring approach, phased cutover and regression strategy.
* Stay hands-on: build reference implementations, prototypes and the hard parts of the codebase in C# and .NET, and review the team’s code.
* Lead a team of engineers and technical leads through delivery — technical direction, work allocation, code and design review, and accountability for technical quality.
* Define and enforce engineering standards: branching and code review discipline, test strategy and coverage, static analysis, secure coding and performance benchmarks.
* Own the CI/CD and DevOps approach with the delivery team — multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps, environments, approval gates, release automation, infrastructure as code and continuous delivery.
* Set the standard for LLM-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or equivalent) — where it is used, how output is reviewed, and the guardrails that apply on client code — and use it hands-on to accelerate design, refactoring, test generation and legacy code comprehension.
* Design application security into the solution — authentication and authorisation (Entra ID, OAuth/OIDC), secrets management, data protection and secure integration — working with security teams on review and sign-off.
* Design for operability — monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, SLOs, DR and production support handover.
* Act as design authority — chairing design reviews, resolving architecture escalations and defending decisions with client architects and architecture review boards.
* Plan and estimate technical work with project managers, assess technical risk and dependencies, and keep delivery honest about trade-offs.
* Mentor technical leads and engineers, and drive skilling on .NET, cloud-native engineering and AI-assisted development.
* Support presales as the applications SME — solution architecture, modernisation approach, estimation, proposals and client technical workshops.
* Contribute reference architectures, reusable frameworks, pipeline templates and accelerators to the practice IP library.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10–15 years of overall experience in application development and architecture, with a substantial recent focus on Microsoft .NET.
* Deep hands-on expertise in C#, .NET Framework and .NET Core / modern .NET — ASP.NET Core, Web API, asynchronous programming and design patterns — and the ability to still write production-quality code.

Euphoric Thought Technologies is a technology-driven organization focused on building scalable, high-performance data ecosystems that power modern digital enterprises. Operating at the intersection of big data and cloud infrastructure, the company provides robust platforms that enable businesses to process complex information in real-time. With a culture rooted in engineering excellence and technical innovation, Euphoric Thought Technologies supports a diverse portfolio of clients, ensuring their data architecture remains resilient, secure, and highly available as they scale globally.

As a Senior Database Architect, you will serve as the primary technical authority for the design, implementation, and optimization of our core data platforms. description:

Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. We work as one global team, combining deep product expertise, implementation excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement to help customers realize value faster. Our environment is collaborative, customer-obsessed, and innovation-driven, centered on Guidewire InsuranceSuite and the Guidewire Cloud Platform.
  
  
As a Guidewire Architect focused on PolicyCenter, you will define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for complex, often greenfield implementations across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead critical design decisions, and ensure solutions meet demanding performance, scalability, and security needs.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers’ path to value while contributing to Professional Services’ mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Define and own the technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire PolicyCenter across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid deployments, aligning with customer enterprise architectures and Guidewire best practices.
* Lead end-to-end PolicyCenter configuration and customization, including Gosu development, PCF/UI design, data model extensions, underwriting rules, workflows, and plugins, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to business needs.
* Architect and oversee complex integrations between PolicyCenter and enterprise systems (billing, CRM, data warehouses, external partners, document management, and third-party services) using APIs, web services, and messaging patterns.
* Provide day-to-day technical leadership for cross-functional delivery teams, performing architecture and code reviews, mentoring senior developers and integrators, and driving engineering excellence and high test coverage (including GUnit).
* Collaborate closely with business analysts and customer stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable architectures and non-functional designs covering performance, availability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Champion Professional Services priorities by leveraging AI and automation to reduce implementation effort and time, support cloud migration and adoption, and help industrialize repeatable, high-quality delivery patterns across projects.
* Contribute to organizational assets such as accelerators, reference architectures, and technical white papers, and lead knowledge-sharing to uplift Guidewire and partner teams globally.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

**Required**

* 10–18 years of hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, including at least two greenfield PolicyCenter implementations.
* Guidewire Certified ACE for PolicyCenter Configuration, with deep knowledge of PolicyCenter UI, data model, Studio, and out-of-the-box features and accelerators.
* Strong experience with Gosu, PCF, entities, typelists, rules, workflows, plugins, and configuration for new personal and commercial lines of business.
* Proven track record architecting and delivering complex integrations using RESTful APIs, web services, messaging, and related technologies (e.g., Apache Camel, Bitbucket, IntelliJ).
* Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, performance optimization, security best practices, and non-functional requirements design for mission-critical systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to work in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Flexibility to collaborate across time zones and shifts when needed to support customers and global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience with Guidewire Cloud (PolicyCenter on Guidewire Cloud Platform), including cloud-native patterns, observability, and CI/CD practices.
* Background leading architecture on multiple PolicyCenter cloud or upgrade programs, especially those leveraging AI-enabled tools or automation to reduce implementation effort.
* Familiarity with other Guidewire products (ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Analytics, or Data Platform) and with modern microservices or event-driven architectures.
* BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Your Impact**

As a Security Consultant within EY’s internal Global Information Security team, the individual will be a trusted security advisor to the Client Technology Platforms Delivery organization within IT Services. The Client Technology Platforms delivery organization is responsible for end-to-end delivery of technology programs and projects supporting EY’s Client Techmology service lines including delivery of a global managed services platform, big data and analytics solutions as well as individual line of business solutions and services. This role will directly engage in supporting a team of architects, engineers, and product managers for delivery on programs and projects, defining security risks and control, providing security guidance, identifying and prioritizing security-related requirements, promoting secure-by-default designs and facilitating delivery of information security services throughout the system development life cycle (SDLC). The role will also develop and directly communicate appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security vulnerabilities translated vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for communication to business stakeholders.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Support a technical team with a focus on the following responsibilities:
* Provide security architectures and provide pragmatic security guidance that balance business benefit and risks.
* Engage IT project teams throughout the SDLC to identify and prioritize applicable security controls and provide guidance on how to implement these controls
* Perform threat modeling and risk assessments of information systems, applications and infrastructure
* Maintain and enhance the Information Security risk assessment and certification methodologies
* Define security configuration standards for shared and multi-tenant platforms and technologies
* Develop appropriate risk treatment and mitigation options to address security risks identified during security review or audit
* Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk terminology for business units and recommend corrective actions to customers and project stakeholders
* Provide knowledge sharing and technical assistance to other team members
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) in responsible technologies and have deep technical understanding of responsible services and technology portfolios

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation, and operation of security controls in one of the following areas:

* **Cloud Security** – Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud-based solutions e.g., Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services or another cloud platform (GCP, AWS, IBM, AliCloud, etc.)
* **Infrastructure Security** – Experience with the integration of cloud native infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), Application and API Gateways, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions.
* **Application Security** - Experience with the design and testing of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture.
* **Identity and Access Management** – Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) based Identity and Access Management and Authorization design and integration with API, IDaaS, and Federation technologies.
* **Agile & DevSecOps Methodologies** – Experience promoting automated security features in pipelines and security testing as a central feature in Agile workflows as a contributing member within an Agile development or DevOps environment.

  

Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

* **Operational Security** – Experience with defining operational security models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls.
* **Information Security Standards** – Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, NIST CSF, PCI/DSS, FEDRAMP.
* **Product Management** – working with broader business and technology teams on aspects of security that affect all phases of PI Planning from concept to design to implementation and then operational support.

  

**To qualify for the role you must have:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* Candidates are preferred to hold or be actively pursuing related professional certifications within the GIAC family of certifications or CISSP, CISM or CISA or similar cloud-security oriented certifications.
* Five or more years of experience in the management of a significant Information Security risk management function
* Experience in managing the communication of security findings and recommendations to IT project teams, business leadership and technology management executives

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Exceptional judgment, tact, and decision-making ability
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
* Excellent , communication, organizational, and decision-making skills
* Strong English language skills are required

  

**What working at EY offers**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Associate - Digital Delivery - T&I
description:
WSP are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead to drive digital transformation, BIM excellence, automation initiatives, and digital project delivery across our Transport & Infrastructure business.

The Infrastructure Digital Delivery Lead is the strategic technology architect responsible for the comprehensive digital lifecycle of our major infrastructure, utility corridors, bridges, and infrastructure master plans. Operating across the entire delivery continuum from conceptual design to asset handover this role unifies BIM, Geospatial Intelligence (GIS), Real-time Digital Twins, Legacy CAD standardizations, High-End 3D Visualizations, and AI-driven workflow automations.

You will not just manage models; you will design the overarching data infrastructure that connects engineering design to operational asset management, ensuring absolute data integrity, efficiency, and future-proof project delivery.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

**1. Digital Strategy, Frameworks & BIM Governance**

* Author, maintain, and enforce the overarching **Digital Delivery Execution Plan (DDEP)** and **BIM Execution Plans (BEP)** in strict compliance with **ISO 19650** standards.
* Establish, structure, and administer the **Common Data Environment (CDE)** using **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)** / BIM 360, setting up automated review workflows, ISO container compliance, and multi-firm security access permissions.
* Govern project coordinate systems, ensuring zero spatial or coordinate drift across linear highway alignments, utility networks, structural bridges, and global GIS maps.

**2. GIS & Digital Twin Integration**

* Architect the bidirectional data pipelines connecting **GIS platforms (Esri ArcGIS / QGIS)** with horizontal engineering design software (Civil 3D / OpenRoads).
* Build the schema maps and asset metadata frameworks required to translate 3D BIM data into operational **Digital Twin environments** (e.g., Autodesk Tandem, Bentley iTwin, or custom web-based twin environments).
* Define asset tracking protocols to integrate future **IoT sensor data metadata placeholders** within the smart-city asset master list during the design phase.

**3. CAD Legacy & Hybrid Workflows**

* Maintain strict quality control over traditional, two-dimensional deliverables by enforcing uniform CAD standards (layer structures, plot styles, sheet sets) alongside 3D environments.
* Manage hybrid workflows ensuring that legacy 2D drawings dynamically update from the core 3D federated model, minimizing manual drafting errors.

**4. 3D Visualization & Reality Capture**

* Manage large-scale visual aggregation models within **Autodesk InfraWorks** , Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine to produce high-end, real-time interactive models for public consultation and executive stakeholder reviews.
* Oversite the integration of **Reality Capture datasets** (UAV Photogrammetry, LiDAR point clouds, mobile scanning) into active design environments for real-time site verification.

**5. AI Tools, Scripting & Automations**

* Develop, scale, and deploy custom automations using **Dynamo for Civil 3D/Revit** , Python, or VBA to eliminate repetitive drafting tasks, automate grading calculations, and auto-populate asset metadata fields.
* Implement **AI-driven design tools** and generative design algorithms for optimizing massive earthworks volumes, alternative highway corridor alignments, and automated clash resolution pipelines.
* Utilize AI text and data analytics tools to run predictive automated audits on thousands of model parameters, catching quality drops instantly.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Information Management, Digital Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's Degree would be advantageous
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
* Proven experience leading digital delivery on large-scale transport and infrastructure projects.
* Strong background supporting the design and delivery of:

  + Roads & Highways
  + Rail & Transit
  + Bridges and Structures
  + Utilities
  + Aviation
  + Smart Infrastructure Projects
* Demonstrated success in implementing BIM and digital transformation strategies within engineering consultancies.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary digital delivery teams.
* Experience working in the UAE and/or wider Middle East strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 standards.

**Technical Proficiencies:**

* BIM / Civil Design: Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D (corridors, pipes, gradings), InfraWorks, and Revit (structures/bridges).
* Geospatial (GIS): Expert capability in Esri ArcGIS (Pro / Online) and its native integrations with the Autodesk ecosystem.
* Digital Twin & Visualization: Practical understanding of Digital Twin schemas (Asset Information Models) and real-time rendering environments (InfraWorks, Enscape, Twinmotion).
* Automation & Coding: Proficient with Dynamo, Python, or visual programming tools. Experience with AI prompt engineering or AI plugins for design optimization is highly valued.
* Collaboration & CAD: Mastery of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) alongside classic AutoCAD Architecture/Civil workflows.

**BGV:**

The AI Technical Lead owns the technical delivery of production-grade AI systems across enterprise digital, data, and analytics environments. This role sets engineering direction and provides strong hands-on leadership to design, build, deploy, and operate enterprise AI capabilities on a Microsoft-first stack, including agentic systems, generative AI applications, AI-enabled automation, and ML-powered platforms, ensuring consistent standards, quality, governance, security, and reliable global operations.Partners with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, legal, and central AI/data governance teams to enable delivery teams (internal and external partners) to build scalable, compliant, and auditable AI solutions across regions, cloud environments, and delivery models.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

* Accountable for all AI engineering activities with in the DADAI delivery factory.
* Lead the design, build, and operation of enterprise AI solutions on a Microsoft-first stack, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, and Azure services.
* Remain highly hands-on: review architecture and code, build proofs of concept, troubleshoot complex issues, and guide implementation teams through production hardening.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for AI delivery, including evaluation, monitoring, release controls, security, privacy, and Responsible AI practices in regulated environments.
* Work across architects, platform teams, security, and delivery stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are scalable, supportable, compliant, and aligned to business needs.

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* 7+ years of proven experience leading and developing large (20+) engineering teams, including direct people management responsibilities, coaching, performance management, career development, and hiring in a complex enterprise environment.
* 10+ years in software engineering, including senior hands-on design and delivery of applications and API in a modern Microsoft cloud environment.
* 2+ delivering complex enterprise production GenAI and agentic solutions on Microsoft technologies such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, RAG, and evaluation workflows.
* Strong Azure engineering background, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, API Management, Entra, CI/CD, monitoring, and production support.
* 10+ years Hands-on technical leadership with proven ability to build POCs, MVPs and production applications, review code and architecture, troubleshoot production issues, and lead implementation teams by example.
* 5+ years of experience working in enterprise or regulated environments with strong security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI controls.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across architecture, security, delivery, and business teams.
* BSc/BA in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience; relevant Azure or AI certifications are a plus.

**Key Skills**
--------------

* Hands-on builder and technical leader who can design, prototype, review, and unblock complex AI implementations.
* Strong problem-solving across prompts, models, retrieval, orchestration, runtime behavior, performance, and cost.
* Ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions, delivery plans, and engineering trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of AI SDLC, evaluation, monitoring, rollback, and operational readiness for production systems.
* Clear communication and strong collaboration in cross-functional, global delivery environments.

**Core Technology Stack**
-------------------------

* **AI platforms**: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow
* **Azure engineering**: Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, API Management, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus
* **Engineering and SDLC:** Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, Azure Machine Learning, CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, observability
* **Security and governance**: Microsoft Entra, Purview, Key Vault, Defender, Azure Policy
* **Data and analytics**: Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, SQL

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.

Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do
  
Analyze and Solve
  

* Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes
* Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities
* Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability
* Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions

  
Design and Integrate
  

* Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies
* Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation
* Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors
* Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity

  
Collaborate and Deliver
  

* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians
* Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines
* Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders
* Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results

  
Grow and Advance
  

* Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies
* Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects

* Strong hands-on experience in **Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI)** administration.
* Expertise in **Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix, VxRail, Hyper-V, VMware, and VMware ESXi** .
* Deep understanding of **Hyperconvergence Architecture** , Hypervisor administration, and cluster operations.
* Experience with **Nutanix Administration** and **Nutanix Architecture** .
* Knowledge of patch management tools such as **SCCM** , **WSUS** , and related enterprise patching solutions.
* Strong understanding of security vulnerability management and compliance requirements.
* Experience coordinating maintenance windows, change management, and outage communications.
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure, virtualization, and patch-related issues.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Data & AI Architect
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Data & AI Architect to define and govern the target architecture for Advanced Analytics, AI, and Data Products across SVD TEC. As the Data & AI Architect, you will ensure that analytics and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, secure, reusable, and governed foundation rather than isolated project-specific solutions.

You will define architecture standards, integration patterns, data contracts, AI deployment approaches, and governance models that enable teams to consistently deliver analytics and AI capabilities across products such as EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, condition monitoring, and predictive maintenance. You will act as the technical authority connecting business needs, product strategy, data platforms, AI services, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and product teams.

* Establish standards for data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, AI, and interoperability.
* Design reusable architecture building blocks and reference patterns.

title: Platform Architect
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Platform Architect** to define and drive the architecture of a modern, cloud-native platform supporting scalable, secure, and resilient applications.

The role requires strong expertise in **containerization, microservices, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Redis, multi-tenant architecture, and cross-region deployment**. Microsoft Azure experience is preferred.

The Platform Architect will work closely with engineering, DevOps/SRE, security, and product teams to establish platform standards, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture and technical direction for the platform.
* Design scalable and resilient **microservices-based architectures**.
* Establish standards for containerized workloads and Kubernetes deployments.
* Define cloud architecture using Azure services and cloud-native design principles.
* Design secure and scalable **multi-tenant architectures**, including tenant isolation and resource segregation.
* Define **multi-region deployment**, failover, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies.
* Design caching and distributed state-management solutions using **Redis**.
* Establish standards for service communication, API design, asynchronous messaging, retries, resiliency, and fault handling.
* Define platform security patterns including identity, access control, secrets management, and workload isolation.
* Define observability standards for logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health.
* Guide Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automated platform deployment practices.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and drive resolution of architectural risks and technical debt.
* Create and maintain reference architectures, design documentation, and architecture decisions.
* Mentor engineering teams on cloud-native and distributed-system design practices.

**Core Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

**Containerization**

* Strong experience with Docker/OCI containers.
* Understanding of container lifecycle, security, networking, and image optimization.

**Kubernetes**

* Strong hands-on architectural knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Experience with:
* Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and Ingress
* ConfigMaps and Secrets
* Autoscaling and resource management
* Persistent storage
* RBAC and network policies
* Cluster and workload high availability
* Experience with **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)** preferred.

**Microservices & Distributed Systems**

* Strong understanding of:
* REST APIs and service-to-service communication
* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures
* API gateways
* Service decomposition
* Resiliency patterns
* Distributed transactions
* Eventual consistency
* Idempotency
* Fault tolerance and graceful degradation

**Cloud Architecture**

* Strong cloud architecture experience, preferably with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Familiarity with relevant Azure services such as:
* AKS
* Azure Container Registry
* Azure Front Door / Application Gateway
* Virtual Networks and Private Link
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Managed Identities
* Key Vault
* Azure Monitor / Application Insights
* Azure Storage
* Azure SQL or equivalent databases
* Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs
* Azure Managed Redis

**Redis**

* Experience designing Redis for:
* Distributed caching
* Session or transient state
* High availability
* Replication and clustering
* Cache invalidation
* Performance optimization

**Multi-Tenant Architecture**

* Experience designing SaaS or shared platforms with:
* Tenant isolation
* Identity and authorization boundaries
* Data and resource segregation
* Tenant provisioning
* Noisy-neighbor mitigation
* Tenant-level monitoring and configuration

**Multi-Region Architecture**

* Experience designing:
* Regional deployment patterns
* Active-active and active-passive architectures
* Traffic routing
* Disaster recovery
* Regional failover
* Data replication
* RTO/RPO strategies

**Preferred Skills**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Helm and GitOps
* Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs
* OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana
* API Management and service mesh
* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Zero-trust and cloud security
* SRE and reliability engineering practices

**Experience**

* Typically **10+ years of software or platform engineering experience**.
* At least **4–6 years of experience in cloud-native and distributed-system architecture**.
* Proven experience architecting production platforms using Kubernetes and microservices.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient systems.

**Key Architecture Competencies**

The candidate should be able to evaluate architectural trade-offs such as:

* Shared vs dedicated tenant infrastructure
* Shared Kubernetes clusters vs tenant-specific clusters
* Database-per-tenant vs shared database models
* Stateless vs stateful services
* Synchronous APIs vs asynchronous messaging
* Active-active vs active-passive regional deployments
* Managed cloud services vs self-managed components
* Security and isolation vs infrastructure cost

title: Sr. Security Specialist
description:
### **About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?

### 

### **About the role**

As a **Senior Associate – Security Architecture, Design & Proof of Value**, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be part of the Cybersecurity Architecture & Risk organization, supporting the architecture, design, assessment, and validation of security technology solutions.

You will combine security architecture consulting with hands-on participation in Proof of Concept (POC) and Proof of Value (POV) activities. Working with Senior Managers, security architects, enterprise architects, engineering teams, and technology vendors, you will translate security requirements into practical designs, validate security controls, assess emerging technologies, and develop evidence-based recommendations.

### 

### **In this role, you will:**

* Support security architecture and solution-design reviews across cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, identity, network, and AI domains. Translate business and technology requirements into security requirements, architecture patterns, control recommendations, and practical solution designs.
* Participate in architecture assurance, threat modelling, and design reviews to identify security gaps, dependencies, risks, potential attack paths, and recommended remediation. Assess controls covering IAM, privileged access, workload/service identities, segmentation, encryption, secrets, logging, monitoring, and data protection.
* Plan and execute cybersecurity POCs/POVs by defining use cases, scope, success criteria, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, required integrations, data flows, identities, connectivity, and security controls.
* Perform hands-on configuration, integration, and testing of security technologies in approved POC/POV environments. Validate vendor capabilities against requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, collect objective evidence, and document gaps, limitations, dependencies, risks, and recommendations.
* Develop architecture and data-flow diagrams, security-control mappings, test cases, technical assessments, reusable security architecture patterns, assessment checklists, and POC/POV documentation. Contribute to final reports and leadership presentations and provide status updates on technical issues, dependencies, actions, and risks.

Embrace Cognizant’s culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build relationships.

### 

### **What you must have to be considered**

* **6–9 years of experience in information/cybersecurity**, with practical exposure to security architecture, solution design, security engineering, or consulting.
* Hands-on experience participating in and delivering cybersecurity POCs/POVs, technology evaluations, or pilots.
* Good understanding of enterprise security architecture principles and secure-by-design practices.
* Practical knowledge across multiple security domains such as IAM, cloud security, network security, application/API security, data security, or security operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, data flows, APIs, and technology integration patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to technical detail.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical security concepts.
* A strong sense of ownership and commitment to creating meaningful outcomes, consistent with the corporate template’s required attributes.

### 

### **These will help you succeed**

* Experience supporting cloud and hybrid security assessments.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, privileged access, and workload/service identity security.
* Understanding of network security, segmentation, and Zero Trust principles.
* Knowledge of application/API security, data security, encryption, DLP, security monitoring, and logging.
* Experience with third-party technology and security assessments.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI security assessments, including identity, data protection, model/API security, agent/tool security, and governance controls.
* Experience with threat modelling, security-control validation, architecture assurance, and design reviews.
* Ability to develop clear technical assessments and evidence-based recommendations for senior stakeholders.

### 

### **Work model**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a **hybrid position open to qualified applicants anywhere in India**.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on the project as well as business and client requirements.

title: Products & Solutions Development Team Leader
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Engineering Manager – Digital Backbone**

**Role purpose:** Build the teams, engineering system, and leadership capability that turn Digital Backbone into the reusable, trusted foundation for Siemens Healthineers’ next generations of connected, cloud-ready, AI-enabled healthcare products. The role combines people leadership, product-minded engineering management, and cross-organization influence to convert platform strategy into measurable customer, business, and engineering outcomes.

**What Digital Backbone Is**

Digital Backbone is the common digital and engineering foundation that connects products, services, data, devices, and clinical workflows across Digital & Automation. It provides reusable platform capabilities for cloud, edge, and on-premises deployments so business lines can innovate faster without repeatedly rebuilding infrastructure, integration, deployment, data, fleet, licensing, observability, and workflow capabilities. Its value is not measured only by platform delivery, but by the speed, quality, reuse, interoperability, and new business outcomes it enables across the Siemens Healthineers ecosystem.

**What Digital Backbone Must Enable in the Coming Years**

* **One engineering foundation across deployment models:** enable containerized components and consistent development, integration, release, and operation across cloud, edge, and on-premises environments.
* **Reusable platform products at enterprise scale:** shift from local solutions to governed capabilities that multiple business lines can discover, adopt, integrate, and evolve.
* **Connected and interoperable healthcare ecosystems:** strengthen common services for clinical information exchange, workflow orchestration, fleet and device connectivity, deployment, data, analytics, licensing, and business operations.
* **AI-ready and AI-native healthcare engineering:** provide safe, auditable foundations for AI-enabled workflows while embedding responsible AI into the software lifecycle, engineering knowledge, quality, and productivity.
* **Faster customer value and new business models:** shorten time-to-market, decouple software development from delivery, expand fleet-wide services, and enable subscription, metering, marketplace, and data-driven offerings.
* **Operational trust at scale:** make reliability, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory evidence, observability, supportability, and lifecycle sustainability intrinsic platform qualities.
* **A product-oriented global operating model:** create clear end-to-end ownership, transparent priorities, strong domain leadership, and accountable collaboration across product, engineering, architecture, quality, and business stakeholders.

**Engineering Manager Mission**

Create an environment in which autonomous, inclusive, high-performing teams deliver dependable platform products and continuously increase their impact across Digital & Automation. The Engineering Manager owns the health and capability of the engineering organization: the right people, skills, ways of working, quality discipline, delivery system, and partnerships needed to scale Digital Backbone outcomes.

**Core Accountabilities**

* **Translate strategy into team outcomes:** connect Siemens Healthineers, Digital & Automation, BTT, platform, and product priorities to clear team objectives, roadmaps, technical investments, and measurable outcomes.
* **Own organizational capability:** build balanced teams, identify future skill needs, develop succession, grow technical and people leaders, and enable mobility across products, domains, and geographies.
* **Lead predictable value delivery:** establish outcome-based planning, dependency and risk management, transparent flow metrics, and effective collaboration across teams without reducing agility to ceremony compliance.
* **Drive engineering excellence:** improve architecture realization, software craftsmanship, automation, CI/CD, test strategy, cybersecurity, reliability, observability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost.
* **Scale platform adoption and reuse:** treat internal consumers as customers, reduce onboarding friction, actively manage feedback, avoid duplicate solutions, and make reusable capabilities the preferred path.
* **Lead responsible AI transformation:** model effective AI use, establish human validation and governance, develop AI-native skills, and convert successful experiments into reusable engineering practices and product value.
* **Manage end-to-end ownership:** ensure teams understand and own build, release, operation, support, quality, and improvement of their platform products throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape cross-functional decisions:** partner with Product Managers, Architects, System Engineers, Quality, Cybersecurity, Operations, and business lines to resolve trade-offs and align investment with enterprise value.
* **Build a trusted culture:** create psychological safety, high standards, inclusion, accountability, candid feedback, and space for experimentation and learning. Promote and protect Peakon participation and leverage it as strategic tool for employee engagement.
* **Represent engineering:** communicate progress, risks, options, and impact in business language; influence priorities and secure the decisions, funding, and staffing needed for sustainable outcomes.

**Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships**

The Engineering Manager is accountable for people, engineering capability, delivery health, and the environment in which technical decisions are executed. Product Managers own product value, priorities, and market outcomes; Architects own architectural direction and integrity; technical leaders guide implementation and engineering practices. The Engineering Manager connects these accountabilities, makes ownership explicit, removes systemic barriers, and ensures decisions become dependable outcomes rather than parallel plans.

**Measures of Success**

* **Accountability:** the degree to which the engineering manager can create accountability amongst developers and team leadership acting as the anchor for stability and transparency.
* **Customer and ecosystem impact:** adoption, active consumers, integration lead time, reuse, customer outcomes, and satisfaction of internal and external partners.
* **Delivery performance:** predictable commitments, shorter lead time, improved flow, controlled dependencies, and faster recovery from issues.
* **Engineering quality:** automation, defect escape rate, reliability, security posture, observability, maintainability, and reduced technical debt or lifecycle cost.
* **AI and modernization impact:** measured productivity and quality gains, reusable AI-enabled workflows, responsible adoption, and migration from legacy approaches.
* **People and capability:** critical-skill coverage, internal growth, leadership pipeline, engagement, inclusion, retention, and evidence-based development.
* **Business contribution:** avoided duplication, lower cost to serve, faster time-to-market, platform-enabled revenue opportunities, and progress against strategic targets.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

This is an opportunity to shape how future healthcare software is built and delivered—not only to manage an existing team. The Engineering Manager will help create the foundation on which connected devices, interoperable clinical workflows, AI-enabled solutions, fleet services, and future software-defined products can scale. The role offers influence across business lines and geographies, combines people leadership with technology transformation, and turns engineering excellence into visible customer and business impact.

 **Benefits**  

**Engineering Manager – Digital Backbone**

**Role purpose:** Build the teams, engineering system, and leadership capability that turn Digital Backbone into the reusable, trusted foundation for Siemens Healthineers’ next generations of connected, cloud-ready, AI-enabled healthcare products. The role combines people leadership, product-minded engineering management, and cross-organization influence to convert platform strategy into measurable customer, business, and engineering outcomes.

**What Digital Backbone Is**

Digital Backbone is the common digital and engineering foundation that connects products, services, data, devices, and clinical workflows across Digital & Automation. It provides reusable platform capabilities for cloud, edge, and on-premises deployments so business lines can innovate faster without repeatedly rebuilding infrastructure, integration, deployment, data, fleet, licensing, observability, and workflow capabilities. Its value is not measured only by platform delivery, but by the speed, quality, reuse, interoperability, and new business outcomes it enables across the Siemens Healthineers ecosystem.

**What Digital Backbone Must Enable in the Coming Years**

* **One engineering foundation across deployment models:** enable containerized components and consistent development, integration, release, and operation across cloud, edge, and on-premises environments.
* **Reusable platform products at enterprise scale:** shift from local solutions to governed capabilities that multiple business lines can discover, adopt, integrate, and evolve.
* **Connected and interoperable healthcare ecosystems:** strengthen common services for clinical information exchange, workflow orchestration, fleet and device connectivity, deployment, data, analytics, licensing, and business operations.
* **AI-ready and AI-native healthcare engineering:** provide safe, auditable foundations for AI-enabled workflows while embedding responsible AI into the software lifecycle, engineering knowledge, quality, and productivity.
* **Faster customer value and new business models:** shorten time-to-market, decouple software development from delivery, expand fleet-wide services, and enable subscription, metering, marketplace, and data-driven offerings.
* **Operational trust at scale:** make reliability, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory evidence, observability, supportability, and lifecycle sustainability intrinsic platform qualities.
* **A product-oriented global operating model:** create clear end-to-end ownership, transparent priorities, strong domain leadership, and accountable collaboration across product, engineering, architecture, quality, and business stakeholders.

**Engineering Manager Mission**

Create an environment in which autonomous, inclusive, high-performing teams deliver dependable platform products and continuously increase their impact across Digital & Automation. The Engineering Manager owns the health and capability of the engineering organization: the right people, skills, ways of working, quality discipline, delivery system, and partnerships needed to scale Digital Backbone outcomes.

**Core Accountabilities**

* **Translate strategy into team outcomes:** connect Siemens Healthineers, Digital & Automation, BTT, platform, and product priorities to clear team objectives, roadmaps, technical investments, and measurable outcomes.
* **Own organizational capability:** build balanced teams, identify future skill needs, develop succession, grow technical and people leaders, and enable mobility across products, domains, and geographies.
* **Lead predictable value delivery:** establish outcome-based planning, dependency and risk management, transparent flow metrics, and effective collaboration across teams without reducing agility to ceremony compliance.
* **Drive engineering excellence:** improve architecture realization, software craftsmanship, automation, CI/CD, test strategy, cybersecurity, reliability, observability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost.
* **Scale platform adoption and reuse:** treat internal consumers as customers, reduce onboarding friction, actively manage feedback, avoid duplicate solutions, and make reusable capabilities the preferred path.
* **Lead responsible AI transformation:** model effective AI use, establish human validation and governance, develop AI-native skills, and convert successful experiments into reusable engineering practices and product value.
* **Manage end-to-end ownership:** ensure teams understand and own build, release, operation, support, quality, and improvement of their platform products throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape cross-functional decisions:** partner with Product Managers, Architects, System Engineers, Quality, Cybersecurity, Operations, and business lines to resolve trade-offs and align investment with enterprise value.
* **Build a trusted culture:** create psychological safety, high standards, inclusion, accountability, candid feedback, and space for experimentation and learning. Promote and protect Peakon participation and leverage it as strategic tool for employee engagement.
* **Represent engineering:** communicate progress, risks, options, and impact in business language; influence priorities and secure the decisions, funding, and staffing needed for sustainable outcomes.

**Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships**

The Engineering Manager is accountable for people, engineering capability, delivery health, and the environment in which technical decisions are executed. Product Managers own product value, priorities, and market outcomes; Architects own architectural direction and integrity; technical leaders guide implementation and engineering practices. The Engineering Manager connects these accountabilities, makes ownership explicit, removes systemic barriers, and ensures decisions become dependable outcomes rather than parallel plans.

**Measures of Success**

* **Accountability:** the degree to which the engineering manager can create accountability amongst developers and team leadership acting as the anchor for stability and transparency.
* **Customer and ecosystem impact:** adoption, active consumers, integration lead time, reuse, customer outcomes, and satisfaction of internal and external partners.
* **Delivery performance:** predictable commitments, shorter lead time, improved flow, controlled dependencies, and faster recovery from issues.
* **Engineering quality:** automation, defect escape rate, reliability, security posture, observability, maintainability, and reduced technical debt or lifecycle cost.
* **AI and modernization impact:** measured productivity and quality gains, reusable AI-enabled workflows, responsible adoption, and migration from legacy approaches.
* **People and capability:** critical-skill coverage, internal growth, leadership pipeline, engagement, inclusion, retention, and evidence-based development.
* **Business contribution:** avoided duplication, lower cost to serve, faster time-to-market, platform-enabled revenue opportunities, and progress against strategic targets.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

This is an opportunity to shape how future healthcare software is built and delivered—not only to manage an existing team. The Engineering Manager will help create the foundation on which connected devices, interoperable clinical workflows, AI-enabled solutions, fleet services, and future software-defined products can scale. The role offers influence across business lines and geographies, combines people leadership with technology transformation, and turns engineering excellence into visible customer and business impact.
