* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.

title: Global Cybersecurity Senior Manager - Architecture
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As the Infrastructure Security Architect – Secure Data, you will serve as the dedicated security architecture partner for BCG’s Secure Data Engineering Squad, owning the cyber defense governance and technical protection requirements for data security architecture covering data loss prevention, classification enforcement, encryption, and secrets management.

The role operates under the shared accountability model between ISRM Security Architecture and Secure Infrastructure Engineering: ISRM defines how platforms are secured and governed through security standards and architecture strategy; Platform Engineering owns the physical and logical implementation, delivery, and operation of those platforms.

You will ensure the Secure Data portfolio aligns with BCG’s Global Information Security Policy (GISP), the Cybersecurity Control Framework (CSF-10 (Data Protection)), the Security Architecture Reference Model, and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model (Data pillar), embedding security from design through delivery while preserving control integrity and audit defensibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain data security architecture: data loss prevention (DLP), data classification and tagging enforcement, encryption, and data privacy governance interfaces.
* Own architectural requirements for Microsoft Purview enforcement: sensitivity labeling, auto-labeling policy design, DLP policy architecture across endpoints, email, and cloud services.
* Define data classification enforcement architecture in alignment with the Global Data Classification Policy and Global Data Protection Policy, ensuring controls scale with data sensitivity.
* Own encryption and key management architecture requirements for infrastructure-managed data, including interfaces to secrets management and enterprise key management platforms including crypto-agility and post-quantum cryptography (PQC) migration readiness for infrastructure-managed data and key material.
* Define secure data access patterns for infrastructure-managed data stores and application interfaces, preventing unauthorized access, exposure, or tampering.
* Architect DLP coverage for emerging data egress channels, including AI-enabled tooling and agentic workflows, in coordination with Enterprise Security Architecture.
* Author and maintain the security standards, reference architectures, and control requirements that govern the Secure Data domain, mapped to CSF-10 (Data Protection) and ZTMM maturity targets.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for secure data initiatives; issue dispositions, conditions, and architectural decision records traceable to ISRM governance.
* Contribute domain expertise to ZTMM maturity assessments, control gap analyses, and the security architecture roadmap.
* Serve as the dedicated architecture counterpart to the Secure Data Engineering Squad, validating feasibility and effectiveness of security controls through implementation without assuming delivery ownership.
* Define logging, telemetry, and monitoring requirements (CSF-12) for secure data services in partnership with Security Operations, which owns SIEM, detection engineering, and continuous monitoring

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

* 6–10 years in security architecture, security engineering, or infrastructure security with demonstrated architecture responsibility.

* Experience operating in large, audit-sensitive, or regulated enterprise environments with formal governance and exception processes.

* Strong understanding of zero trust architecture (NIST SP 800-207, CISA ZTMM), enterprise control frameworks, and hybrid cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

* Deep hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Purview (Information Protection, DLP), enterprise data classification programs, and encryption architecture.

* Working knowledge of key management and secrets management platforms (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, cloud-native KMS/HSM), BYOK patterns, and cryptographic standards lifecycle.

* Familiarity with insider risk, data egress monitoring, and DLP enforcement across endpoint, network, and SaaS channels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certifications such as CISSP, SABSA, or relevant cloud security certifications.

Who You'll Work With

You will join the Infrastructure Security Architecture team within Information Security Risk Management (ISRM), serving as the dedicated security architecture partner for BCG’s Secure Data Engineering Squad. In this role, you will own the governance and technical architecture requirements that protect data across loss prevention, classification enforcement, encryption, and secrets management.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, cloud, identity, infrastructure, and security teams across BCG’s global technology organization to ensure data security controls are consistently designed, implemented, and governed. You will also partner with Security Operations, Risk Management, and architecture peers to advance Zero Trust Data pillar maturity and support enterprise-wide cybersecurity initiatives.

Working within a highly collaborative, matrixed environment, you will influence technical direction, build alignment on architectural decisions, and help teams deliver secure, scalable solutions that balance business objectives, operational effectiveness, and risk management.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

**You’re Good At**

* Translating enterprise security standards into practical, implementable engineering requirements.

* Holding architecture authority constructively: enabling delivery teams rather than blocking them, while keeping governance boundaries intact.

* Communicating precisely across engineering squads, architecture peers, and senior security leadership.

Regular, Full-Time (local employment terms apply)

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: 4614-Intern- Event Marketing
description:
**Go to Market at Innovaccer**

Our GTM team is passionate about healthcare and wants to leave a positive impact in the ecosystem. We are the tip of the spear that leads the organization externally. We care deeply about our customers and want to resolve their challenges with our solutions. If this excites you, let's chat about how you can help us tell our special story.

**Your Role**

We are looking for a persistent and motivated individual who will be working as an architect for creating and executing various marketing campaigns, strategies, and initiatives to attract potential prospects at our conferences and events (virtual and in-person). You will be working as the point of contact for driving programs, processes, and systems with the Events Marketing vertical. The candidate should have a strong set of verbal and written communication skills to develop relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external. You’d also be responsible for establishing and nurturing relationships with various healthcare professionals and prospects spread across the globe. With a flair for strategizing and executing highly-dynamic processes, you will be extensively working on transforming collective ideas into highly successful outcomes through powerful event management strategies.

**A Day in the Life**

* Work closely with Marketing & Sales teams, digital marketing, procurement, and finance teams to execute events marketing avenues.
* Conduct extensive market research, planning, documentation, and reach outs.
* Utilize a blend of strong soft and interpersonal skills to interact with external vendors and then transform collective ideas into creative event marketing campaigns
* Own up multiple processes and initiatives through high-impact project management techniques
* Learn and build workflows to monitor progress over weeks
* Own the complete vendor management process from scouting to negotiations and tracking them through the entire event marketing cycle
* Should be comfortable working in the US shift timings of 5:30 PM to 2 AM.

  
  
**Requirements**  

* + Graduation/ post graduation from a recognized university
  + Persistence and diligence to 'go the extra mile’
  + Basic understanding of events management is an advantage
  + Flair for written and spoken English with an impeccable command over grammar
  + Proactive, decisive, independent thinker and should be good at industry research.

Preferred Skills

* Event Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Vendor Management
* Project Management
* Market Research
* Written and spoken communication skills

 **Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.  
  
**Here’s What We Offer**

* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* Care Program: Whether it’s a celebration or a time of need, we’ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we’re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

Disclaimer:

Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

**About Innovaccer**

Innovaccer activates the flow of healthcare data, empowering providers, payers, and government organizations to deliver intelligent and connected experiences that advance health outcomes. The Healthcare Intelligence Cloud equips every stakeholder in the patient journey to turn fragmented data into proactive, coordinated actions that elevate the quality of care and drive operational performance. Leading healthcare organizations like CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health trust Innovaccer to integrate a system of intelligence into their existing infrastructure, extending the human touch in healthcare. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com.

title: Tech S and T-Resilience and Reliability Engineer-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)**
**Description**
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability & reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
  
  
A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
  
  
An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability & automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
* Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
* Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
* Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
* Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra & Operations - FinOps
* Critical Situation management
* SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
* Data Analytics & System trend analysis

**Typical Skills And Background**

* 7+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
* Hands-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
* Hands-on experience in at least one CI-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
* Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
* Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
* Experience in Observability - APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
* Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
* Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
* Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
* Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot & Cloud native architectures
* Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
* Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis
* Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs & models
* Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
* Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
* AI/ML & Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

Overlap with international clients' working hours

Key Responsibilities

**1. Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Design end-to-end AI automation solutions, including workflows, APIs, data flow, AI models, and human approval processes.
* Select the right tools, platforms, and infrastructure based on project requirements, cost, reliability, and security.

------------------------------

Grant Thornton INDUS is the global capability center for Grant Thornton US, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd., a leading global network of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms. Founded in Chicago in 1924, Grant Thornton US is one of the leading accounting and advisory firms in the U.S., bringing together $4B+ in revenue, 56 U.S. offices, and a multi-national platform spanning 20 countries with 25,000 people. title: Principal AI Architect for Enterprise AI Platform
description:
An enterprise AI platform is scaling quickly. It is running more customer pilots and taking on heavier platform demands, and it needs a senior architect to set its technical direction. You will own the architecture of its retrieval and knowledge layer: how enterprise data is structured, connected through knowledge graphs, and retrieved for LLMs and AI agents. You will also act as the senior technical voice for a growing engineering team. The work balances hands-on design with technical leadership. You’ll fix current problems with performance, accuracy, and scalability, and you’ll shape the approach for the customer-specific projects coming next.

**What You’ll Do**

* Provide senior architectural leadership across the AI platform, with clear technical direction for Generative AI, retrieval, and data design.
* Design, evaluate, and improve RAG and GraphRAG architectures for enterprise AI applications.
* Build and optimize knowledge graph and retrieval architectures, including ontology and semantic data modeling.
* Diagnose and resolve challenges in retrieval accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Improve how enterprise data is structured, indexed, and retrieved by AI agents.
* Work hands-on with Neo4j, Weaviate, and LangChain, or with equivalent graph, vector, and orchestration tools.
* Support the development of AI agents and their integration with enterprise data and workflows.
* Define technical approaches and reference architectures for upcoming customer-specific pilots.
* Mentor junior AI engineers through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
* Partner with engineering leadership and technical stakeholders so the architecture stays scalable and maintainable as the customer base grows.

**What You Bring**

* Senior- or principal-level experience in Generative AI and AI architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and shipping RAG and/or GraphRAG systems in production.
* Deep understanding of knowledge graphs, ontologies, and semantic data modeling.
* Experience with Neo4j or a comparable graph database (e.g., Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, Stardog).
* Experience with Weaviate or a comparable vector database (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Strong experience with LangChain or a comparable LLM orchestration framework (e.g., LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel).
* A track record of designing production-grade AI systems, with a strong grasp of LLM-based retrieval and data architecture.
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers within a collaborative team.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain architectural trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms or agentic AI systems.
* Background in AI governance, security, or data access controls (e.g., permission-aware retrieval).
* Experience optimizing AI systems for accuracy, performance, and cost, including evaluation frameworks.
* Experience delivering customer-specific AI implementations or pilots.
* Experience in a fast-growing startup environment.
* Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern AI/ML development frameworks.

title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer
description:
2Base Technologies is a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience. We work as an enterprise solutions partner for clients in the United Kingdom, the United States, India and other markets, building web and mobile applications and end-to-end digital solutions across industries.

We are adding a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to our DevSecOps team. You will strengthen our security posture, mature our pipelines and automation, and help the team build secure-by-design practice across everything we deliver. Depending on experience, this role can step into the lead position for the team or grow into it.

Key Responsibilities

Define, implement, and enforce security standards, policies, and best practices across cloud and on-prem environments.

Conduct security risk assessments, perform vulnerability scans, coordinate penetration testing activities, and execute mitigation plans.

Architect, maintain, and enhance secure CI/CD pipelines with automated compliance and governance checkpoints.

Promote and uphold a strong “Security First” culture across engineering, ensuring secure design and development practices.

Continuously monitor, detect, investigate, and respond to security threats, incidents, breaches, and anomalies.

Develop, own, and mature automation practices: infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and configuration management using Ansible, alongside other automation frameworks.

Design and maintain secure cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, or GCP to support scalable and compliant deployments.

Build, operate, and secure containerized environments using Docker, with enforced security baselines. Kubernetes where applicable to the project.

Implement and maintain secure monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for infrastructure and application layers, extending to SIEM as the practice develops.

Improve and optimize system reliability, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance across all critical workloads.

Mentor, guide, and upskill DevOps engineers in secure development, automation, and operational excellence.

Lead technical strategy, decision-making, tool selection, process improvements, and DevSecOps roadmap execution.

Work closely with PMO and engineering teams so that security, performance and delivery objectives stay aligned.

Operational Ownership

Backup and disaster recovery: Backup policies, regular tested restoration, and disaster recovery plans with agreed recovery time and data loss targets, with restoration tested rather than assumed.

Release management: Deployments across development, staging and production, including approvals, rollback procedures, and troubleshooting failed releases.

Access and secrets management: Access reviews, joiner and leaver access, service accounts, credentials, secrets rotation, and encryption keys.

Pipeline security: Code, dependency, container image, secrets and Infrastructure-as-Code scanning built into CI/CD, with clear ownership of who fixes what and by when.

Incident management: Leading production incident response, coordinating updates to the people who need them, running root cause reviews, and tracking corrective actions to closure.

Cloud cost management: Monitoring cloud spend, investigating unexpected cost, and improving resource sizing and utilisation without affecting reliability.

Documentation: Infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment guides, operational runbooks and recovery procedures, maintained as the environment changes.

Reliability measurement: Defining and tracking service availability, deployment failure rate, recovery time, and how long vulnerabilities take to close.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

6–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure engineering, including at least 4 years hands-on in DevOps, with strong security exposure.

Strong hands-on expertise in AWS, with a focus on secure architecture.

Deep experience with at least one CI/CD platform, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines. Breadth across several is useful; depth in one is required.

Experience securing and running Docker containers in production.

Experience independently owning production infrastructure, releases and incident resolution, demonstrated through the work you have led.

Strong understanding of networking technologies: LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPN, load balancers.

Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (OWASP, NIST, CIS Benchmarks).

Working depth in at least one monitoring and logging stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, or CloudWatch.

Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Shell).

Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence engineering teams.

Tools and Technology

These are the areas you will be working in. Core areas are assessed during the interview process. Additional areas strengthen an application, and support is available to develop them in the role.

AWS: Hands-on work across compute, storage, networking, access management and cost, based on environments you have configured.

CI/CD: Building and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines, including the security checks within them. Depth in one platform is sufficient.

Git: Version control in practice: branching strategy, merge and release flow, repository access control, and keeping credentials out of version history.

Cloud server administration: Provisioning, sizing, lifecycle and cost of the servers behind the applications, in the cloud and on-premise where it applies.

Ubuntu: Ubuntu Server administration at an operational standard: packages, services, storage, networking, DNS, TLS and permissions.

Monitoring tools: Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, CloudWatch or an equivalent, implemented by you, with judgement about alert severity. Depth in one stack is sufficient.

Server security: Hardening, patching, firewall and SSH configuration, least-privilege access, and closing known vulnerabilities to an agreed timeline.

Terraform: Infrastructure provisioning as code.

Ansible: Configuration management and automation.

Azure: Working depth in the equivalent services, and judgement about what belongs where when a client runs more than one platform.

GCP: Relevant where a client workload sits there.

Kubernetes: Running and securing orchestrated containers in production, where a project uses them.

SIEM and SOAR: Security event collection and response tooling. Prior experience is welcome; where you do not have it, this capability is developed in the role with support.

Education

A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is considered on the same terms.

Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.

* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.

* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.

* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

description:

Worksent is seeking an experienced
**System Engineer – L2**
to provide on-site IT support for our

Act as the primary on-site IT point of contact, handling desk-side and remote support requests within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Escalate complex issues with detailed troubleshooting notes and clear handover documentation.

Maintain IT documentation and adhere to established support processes and security standards.

Minimum
**4 years of IT support experience**
, including hands-on Level 2 support.

Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, and Windows 10/11.

Experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.

Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, switching, Wi-Fi, and VPN.

Hands-on experience with structured cabling, including Cat6 cable installation, RJ45/keystone termination, testing, and rack patching.

Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with non-technical users and overseas stakeholders.

Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and customer service skills.

Professional and calm communication, with a customer-focused approach.

Good organisational skills, accountability, and attention to detail in ticket management and documentation.

**Preferred Skills**

Experience with any of the following will be an added advantage:

Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments.

Supporting international clients or distributed teams.

NinjaOne, ThreatLocker, Hudu, or UniFi networking solutions.

**Apply Now**

If you have the required technical expertise and are interested in supporting our Australia-based client from Bengaluru, we encourage you to apply.

title: Linux Engineer- Linux Fleet Management
description:
**INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEERING**

Infrastructure Engineer III - Linux Fleet Management

**Job Profile Summary**

Design, engineer, and continuously improve scalable Linux fleet management, automation, configuration management, patching, and lifecycle capabilities. Serve as a technical leader and escalation point for complex infrastructure issues while driving automation, reliability, standardization, and operational maturity across the managed fleet.

**Career Level Summary**

* Requires in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge of infrastructure engineering and related disciplines.
* Solves complex and cross-platform technical problems with minimal guidance.
* Leads technical projects or significant workstreams and is accountable for technical outcomes.
* Designs and implements scalable infrastructure automation, configuration management, and fleet-management solutions.
* Defines and improves engineering standards and operational practices.
* Serves as a senior technical resource and escalation point for less-experienced engineers.
* Mentors Engineers I and II and contributes to long-term fleet strategy and modernization.

**Critical Competencies**

* **Excellence:**
  Demonstrates accountability, discipline, and consistent execution while maintaining reliable and supportable infrastructure.
* **Customer-driven:**
  Understands the needs of technology teams and delivers infrastructure services that support reliable business operations.
* **Expertise:**
  Builds and applies technical knowledge in Linux systems, fleet management, automation, and configuration management.
* **Agility:**
  Adapts to changing infrastructure requirements, technologies, and operational priorities.
* **Compassion:**
  Collaborates effectively, shares knowledge, and contributes to a positive and supportive engineering environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design scalable Linux fleet management, automated patching, and configuration-management solutions.
* Define and improve automated patching architectures, workflows, and operational controls.
* Design Puppet, Ansible, Jenkins, or equivalent automation patterns and reusable engineering frameworks.
* Develop advanced Python, Bash, or comparable automation for complex infrastructure use cases.
* Establish configuration-as-code, source-control, testing, and deployment practices for infrastructure automation.
* Define technical standards for Linux fleet configuration, patching, lifecycle management, and operational readiness.
* Lead complex end-of-life, modernization, and technical-debt remediation initiatives.
* Diagnose complex, systemic, and cross-platform infrastructure failures and drive root-cause remediation.
* Analyze fleet-wide operational metrics to identify systemic reliability and efficiency improvements.
* Lead technical projects from design through implementation and operationalization.
* Evaluate infrastructure automation and configuration-management technologies and recommend adoption approaches.
* Partner with architecture, cloud, application, security, and infrastructure teams on complex technical initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and serve as a senior escalation point for production infrastructure issues.

**Knowledge**

* Linux system administration and operating system concepts.
* Linux package management, patching, and operating system lifecycle management.
* Infrastructure automation and configuration management principles.
* Desired-state configuration, configuration drift, standardized deployment, and configuration-as-code practices.
* Server infrastructure, virtualization, and cloud computing concepts.
* Infrastructure vulnerability remediation and system hardening concepts.
* Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Deep knowledge of monitoring, availability, capacity, backup, recovery, and resiliency practices.
* Infrastructure architecture and engineering standards.
* Operational risk, lifecycle strategy, and technical-debt management.
* Advanced source-control, testing, and software engineering practices for infrastructure automation.

**Skills**

* Advanced Linux Systems Administration
* Operating System Patching
* Infrastructure Automation
* Configuration Management
* Deep knowledge of Ansible
* Bash / Shell Scripting
* Configuration-as-Code
* Git / Source Control
* Infrastructure Architecture
* Cloud Computing
* Virtualization
* Network/Systems Skills
* Vulnerability Remediation
* Infrastructure Monitoring
* Operational Metrics
* Project Management
* Technical Leadership
* Mentoring
* Process Improvement
* Knowledge of Linux Fleet Management, Python, Jenkins, Puppet are added advantage.

**Education**

* High School Diploma or regional equivalent required.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline preferred; relevant professional experience may substitute at the manager's discretion.

**Certifications**

Relevant industry certifications preferred. Examples include Linux, Red Hat, Ansible/Red Hat Automation, cloud, or infrastructure-related certifications. Equivalent technical experience may substitute for certifications.

**Experience**

3-6 years of relevant experience in Linux systems administration, infrastructure engineering, fleet management, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related technical role.

title: System Administrator
description:
**About OrbitAID**

OrbitAID Aerospace is an on-orbit servicing and refueling startup building the infrastructure to extend satellite life, enable in-space logistics, and support a growing commercial and defense space ecosystem. As we scale our engineering, business development, and policy operations, we're looking for a System Administrator to build and maintain the IT backbone that keeps the company running securely and reliably.

**Role Summary**

The System Administrator will be responsible for managing OrbitAID's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, endpoints, cloud environments, and internal systems. This role is critical to ensuring operational continuity across engineering, BD, policy, and PR teams, while maintaining the security posture expected of a company operating in aerospace and defense-adjacent domains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Software Administration Across Engineering Teams**
  — Deploy, license, and manage engineering software and company-wide systems (Google Workspace/Microsoft 365, CRM, PM tools); coordinate with team leads on tooling needs and licensing.
* **Infrastructure (Server, Cloud & Network)**
  — Build and maintain servers, virtualization, and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), plus LAN/WAN, VLANs, firewalls, and VPNs, including segmented networks for sensitive systems.
* **System Maintenance & Reliability**
  — Manage patching, OS hardening, backups, and disaster recovery; maintain uptime via proactive monitoring and alerting.
* **Cybersecurity**
  — Implement endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and IAM (AD/Entra ID/Okta) with least-privilege segregation across Commercial, Defense, Policy, and PR functions; ensure export-control-sensitive compliance.
* **IT Lifecycle & Documentation**
  — Manage onboarding/offboarding, endpoint provisioning, and access audits; maintain runbooks/SOPs and provide escalation-level technical support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 3+ years of system/network administration experience, with strong Windows Server and Linux proficiency
* Practical experience with virtualization and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls) and IAM systems (AD/Entra ID/Okta)
* Scripting/automation skills (Bash, PowerShell, or Python) and strong cross-stack troubleshooting ability

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with export control frameworks (ITAR-adjacent or Indian defense procurement compliance)
* Experience supporting engineering-heavy environments
* Relevant certifications (CCNA, Network+/Security+, Azure/AWS Administrator, or RHCSA)

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build foundational IT infrastructure for a fast-growing space-tech company
* Cross-functional exposure to commercial, defense, and policy operations in the space sector
* Collaborative, mission-driven work environment
* Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. In addition, Eurofins is one of the leading global emerging players in specialty clinical diagnostic testing.
  
  
In 2018, Eurofins generated 4.2 billion Euro proforma turnover in 800 laboratories across 47 countries, employing about 45.000 staff.
  
  
Tecna, as a part of Eurofins Technologies multi-national network, has the goal of developing and validating reliable industrial solutions for food safety assessment. It has been producing several immunoassays based on different technologies since 25 years, and keeps growing its catalogue portfolio with novel assays and applications to cover the food industry necessities of analysing chemical contaminants in ingredients and finished products. Applications need to be fast, easy, reliable and possibly safe for the personnel involved in routine implementation of analysis. In other words, the sample preparation and contaminants extraction from food matrices must be arranged through robust, simple and quick procedures, being ideally able to extract multiple contaminants in one single preparation, and being solvent – free or at least non-toxic.
  
  
**Job Description**
**OVERALL OBJECTIVES:**
As part of the IT Infrastructure Support Team for Eurofins Environment Testing Europe, you will join a growing international team to work on maintenance of newly deployed segregated IT User Zones and Application Availability Groups Cloud infrastructure. Your role will be to support daily Cloud operations tasks and to design & implement new infrastructure or migrate the existing components to Azure cloud. You will collaborate with number of different IT Support and Delivery Teams on daily basis. It will require strong Azure virtualization, O365, AD, Identity & Access, Security and Networking skills. Open mind and ability to cooperate with multiple individuals in a multicultural environment is essential.
  
  
You will get an opportunity to drive Eurofins major IT Infrastructure transition and transformation across Environment Testing Europe Businesses.
  
  
**Specific Assignments**

* Manage day-to-day operations of Azure based cloud infrastructure ensuring optimal performance and uptime
* Manage and administer Azure Active Directory (AAD) environments, including user and group management, access policies, and conditional access
* Support and optimize Office 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and related collaboration tools
* Develop, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools to automate cloud resource provisioning
* Monitor cloud infrastructure health, troubleshoot incidents, and drive root cause analysis to improve reliability
* Collaborate with compute and network teams, as well as application owners at the international corporate level to support compute capacity planning and optimization and best meet business requirements in terms of security, cost, and effectiveness
* Collaborate with security teams to enforce identity and access management (IAM) best practices and compliance policies
* Implement automation scripts using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or other scripting languages to streamline cloud operations
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the cloud operations team
* Maintain detailed documentation of cloud configurations, workflows, and operational runbooks
* Stay current with Azure platform updates, emerging technologies, and industry best practices

**Required Skills**
An ideal candidate should have strong experience in all of the below:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s preferred)
* 7–10+ years of IT infrastructure or operations experience, with at least 3–5 years in a senior cloud operations or cloud engineering leadership role
* Proven experience managing infrastructure in Azure at scale
* Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)
* Strong experience with MS Active Directory administration (GPO, gMSA, SPN, KRBTGT, tiering model)
* Sound knowledge of Azure Virtual Machines, Subscriptions, Resource Groups, Storage Accounts, Azure AD Connect, Azure Policies, Conditional Policies, Azure Virtual Desktop
* Good experience with O365 & Exchange Online (Licensing, Administration, Exchange management)
* Proven Azure Networking & Security knowledge: VNETs, Subnets, Peering, Network Security Groups)
* Deep knowledge of Azure Active Directory (AAD) and IAM concepts
* Expertise in automation, configuration management, and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps
* Demonstrated ability to manage cloud security and compliance programs
* Excellent communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to read, understand and create technical documentation
* Very good command of English written and spoken
* Ability to present technical projects on meetings
* Accustomed to using ITSM tools (e.g. BMC Helix)

**Preferred Skils**

* Experience with Azure AD Connect, Azure Identity Protection, and Privileged Access Management (PAM)
* Familiarity with cloud cost management and optimization strategies
* Bastion understanding
* Other cloud vendors experience (AWS, GCP etc.)
* Microsoft certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Security Engineer, or Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert

description:
**Salesforce Billing Administrator**

**Location:** Bangalore (Hybrid)  
**Working hours:** 2:00pm to 11:00pm with occasional night shifts (during revenue close periods)

**Why YOU want this position**  
  
At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.  
  
We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.  
  
The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.  
  
Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

**About the Role**  
As a Salesforce Billing Administrator, you will support and maintain the day-to-day operations of our Revenue Cloud environment, working closely with Salesforce Billing consultants and the Global Revenue Team. You will investigate and resolve billing cases, manage configurations, and ensure data accuracy across billing processes. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on CPQ and Billing experience who enjoys troubleshooting complex issues, improving system reliability, and partnering with global teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Performance Objectives**

* Hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Billing, including Contract Renewal, amendments, Subscriptions, Billing Rules, Tax rules, invoice scheduler and Payment.
* Work alongside Salesforce Billing consultants to understand the existing implementation, recurring issues, and system architecture — then take progressive ownership of day-to-day support.
* Investigate and resolve Salesforce Billing cases; identify root causes of recurring issues and apply permanent fixes.
* Manage Revenue Cloud configurations — billing rules, invoice schedules, and product setup.
* Build and maintain custom reports and dashboards for the Global Revenue Team.
* Set up and maintain invoice templates using Conga.
* Perform database maintenance — diagnostic testing, duplicate cleansing, and data quality governance.
* Resolve Sales Tax issues and maintain compliance with billing records.
* Provide end-user training and support for billing processes and new releases.
* Hands-on experience in flows.
* Experience across the SDLC, including Agile methodologies, sandbox-based development, and deployment best practices.
* This role requires flexibility to support night shifts during revenue close periods or when global team coverage is needed.
* Attend team meetings via video call with camera on.

**Competitive Candidate Profile**

* 2–4 years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience in Billing
* Thorough understanding of Quote to cash process.
* Understanding of Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote).
* Hands-on experience with declarative Salesforce tools (Flows, validation rules, reports & dashboards).
* Good communication skills; comfortable working with global teams over video calls.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator — required.
* Additional certifications (Platform App Builder, Billing Specialist, CPQ Specialist) are a plus.

title: Database Administrator (Contract) - Bangalore
description:
**Function/Group:**

CIS

**Experience:**

3-5 Years

**Location:**

India

**About Tally**

The pioneers of software product industry in India, we are a technology and innovation led company simplifying the lives of small and medium businesses over the last three decades. With our cutting-edge technology, we have had the privilege to reach over 2.5 million business globally and cater to more than 7 million users in over 100 countries. We are passionate about the SMEs’ growth and aim to deliver the best for their business through our product innovation and excellence. Our teams develop some of the most ingenious solutions that suit the unique requirements of millions of businesses across the globe. With a market share of 75% in India, we have a strong foothold in the Middle East and are also serving customers in SAARC & APAC, Africa, and North America. Our robust network of 28000+ partners help us deliver unmatched customer experience in sales, support, and services globally.
  
With a sole purpose of Making Everyone Who Touches Tally, Happier, we aim to be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world, by 2030.

**Culture & Values**

Over the years, we have nurtured a value-based culture that let individuals follow their lead and support them in their growth journey with us. We value honesty and integrity, prioritize a people-first culture, pursue excellence, and drive impactful innovation with simplicity.
  
Our vision at Tally is to ensure that all employees get access to equal opportunities, with decisions grounded on performance, merit, competence, and potential. We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in our policies. By fostering diversity and equality, we strive to eliminate all forms of discrimination. We are committed to an inclusive leadership where our leaders ensure that our people are empowered to be at their best, professionally, and personally. We take great pride in our work culture which has helped become a proud member of the elite Kincentric Best Employers Club!

**CIS**

Corporate Information Systems (CIS) is a dynamic and forward-thinking function within Tally Solutions, dedicated to providing innovative solutions for our internal support systems. We cater to the needs of our customers, partners, employees, by leveraging cutting-edge technologies.

### **We believe in**

* **Build:** Future-ready internal systems that power productivity.
* **Enable:** Seamless experiences for employees, partners, and customers through smart tech solutions.
* **Empower:** Data-driven decision making to accelerate business outcomes

**What You Will Own**

In this role, you will administer, secure, and optimize Tally’s production and non-production databases across MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL/distributed platforms such as MongoDB, Aerospike, and ClickHouse. You will be responsible for availability, performance, backup and recovery, replication, and security, while working closely with application, engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams.

**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future**

* 3–5 years of hands-on DBA experience in production environments, with strong command of MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL (SQL, indexing, transactions, locking/concurrency, execution plans).
* Hands-on experience in performance tuning, backup/recovery, replication/HA, and database security.
* Practical experience with at least one NoSQL/distributed database such as MongoDB, Aerospike, ClickHouse, Redis, or equivalent Strong Linux/Unix fundamentals and shell scripting, with an automation mindset.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and RCA skills.
* Comfort working across multiple database technologies and supporting production systems, including on-call as required
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline preferred

**The Scope of Your Influence**

**Database Administration & Maintenance:**

* Administer production and non-production databases, including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, and ongoing maintenance.
* Manage database environments across MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL/distributed platforms such as MongoDB, Aerospike, and ClickHouse.
* Execute database upgrades, patching, and migration projects in coordination with dependent application teams.

**Monitoring & Troubleshooting:**

* Monitor availability, health, capacity, performance, replication, and resource utilization to maintain uptime and reliability.
* Troubleshoot production issues, providing root cause analysis (RCA) and implementing fixes in a timely manner.
* Participate in on-call support as required and in post-incident reviews.

**Performance Tuning & Optimization:**

* Perform SQL/query tuning, execution-plan analysis, indexing, and configuration optimization.
* Troubleshoot locks, blocking, deadlocks, and resource bottlenecks.
* Identify opportunities to improve database efficiency through benchmarking and capacity analysis.

**Backup, Recovery & High Availability:**

* Implement and maintain backup, restore, and recovery processes for business-critical databases.
* Set up and manage high-availability and replication architectures.
* Implement disaster-recovery processes and participate in DR testing and RCA

**Security & Access Management:**

* Manage database users, roles, privileges, and access controls.
* Implement auditing and database security best practices.
* Review access and audit trails regularly to keep database environments aligned with security best practices.

**Collaboration & Delivery:**

* Work with application, engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams on database design, schema changes, deployments, and migrations.
* Support incident response with cross-team partners to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence.
* Learn and adopt new database technologies as platform and business needs evolve.

**Automation, Documentation & Continuous Improvement:**

* Automate DBA activities using Linux/Unix shell scripting; Python or similar scripting is a plus.
* Maintain database documentation, monitoring and alerting, operational procedures, and change records.
* Explore cloud database services and infrastructure automation to streamline database operations

title: Billing Executive
description:
**Job Title:** Admissions and Billing Executive

**Department:** Admissions and Billing

**Industry:** Healthcare / Hospital

**Reporting To:** Admissions and Billing In-Charge / Department Head

**Location:** Manipal Hospitals, Whitefield.

**Job Summary**

Responsible for managing patient admission, registration, billing, and discharge-related activities while ensuring accuracy of patient records, timely processing of transactions, and a smooth patient experience in accordance with hospital policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Patient Registration and Admission:** Register patients, verify identification and relevant documents, create patient records, and complete admission formalities.
* **Billing and Payments:** Prepare accurate patient bills, process payments, generate invoices, and handle refunds and billing corrections as per hospital policy.
* **Insurance and TPA Coordination:** Coordinate with insurance companies and Third-Party Administrators (TPAs) for cashless approvals, documentation, and billing-related queries.
* **Discharge Processing:** Coordinate with clinical departments, pharmacy, and other concerned teams to facilitate timely bill clearance and patient discharge.
* **Patient Assistance:** Address patient and attendant queries regarding admission procedures, billing, deposits, and payment options professionally.
* **Documentation and Records:** Maintain accurate billing records, admission documents, payment receipts, and supporting paperwork.
* **Coordination:** Liaise with nursing, doctors, insurance, pharmacy, and other hospital departments to resolve admission and billing issues.
* **Compliance:** Follow hospital policies, financial procedures, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* **Daily Reconciliation:** Verify billing transactions, cash collections, payment records, and pending dues, and report discrepancies to the reporting manager.
* **Customer Service:** Ensure a positive patient experience through clear communication, timely assistance, and efficient handling of concerns.

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in hospital admissions, patient billing, front office, or healthcare operations preferred.
* Freshers with relevant qualifications and good communication skills may also be considered.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of hospital billing and admission procedures.
* Basic understanding of insurance and TPA processes.
* Proficiency in MS Office and hospital information systems (HIS).
* Good numerical, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Strong communication and patient-handling abilities.
* Attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to work in shifts.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of billing and patient documentation.
* Timeliness of admissions and discharge processing.
* Billing error and discrepancy rates.
* Timely completion of insurance and TPA documentation.
* Patient satisfaction and query resolution.
* Accuracy of daily cash and billing reconciliation.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Slurm Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute infrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You'll own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.
* Administer, configure and tune Slurm clusters - partitions, QOS, accounting, limits, node states and topology - and operate them alongside an existing LSF estate.
* Automate scheduler operations: node onboarding and draining, configuration management, health checks and routine maintenance.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for job throughput, queue wait times and SLA attainment.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will be in the cluster and the scripts yourself, supporting design engineers during local business hours, and day-to-day operations - queue health and job triage - are a core part of the job rather than a side activity.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years in compute infrastructure, with hands-on responsibility for batch scheduling.
* Strong practical Slurm experience: configuration, partitions and QOS, accounting via slurmdbd, node management, and troubleshooting real job failures in production.
* Exposure to a second scheduler, LSF preferred, or a clear appetite to pick one up quickly.
* Solid Linux systems administration - filesystems, NFS, networking, process and resource management.
* Working automation skills in Python and shell, and experience with monitoring and dashboarding tools.
* Comfortable carrying a real operational load - you treat production support and escalations as part of the engineering job. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Senior SQL Database Administrator
description:
**Why Verifone**
----------------

For more than 30 years, Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone is one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and among the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.  
  
Verifone has a diverse, dynamic, and fast-paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in working with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payment solutions around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness.  
  
Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it's developing the next generation of secure payment systems or finding new ways to bring electronic payments to emerging markets, the Verifone team is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners, and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives every Verifone employee toward personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.

**What's exciting about the role**
----------------------------------

Verifone's databases power payments worldwide, so they need to be fast, secure, and always on. You'll own the performance, availability, and security of our relational fleet across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MySQL, and you'll get hands-on ownership of our active on-prem-to-AWS migration, moving workloads from on-prem and EC2 to RDS/Aurora. You'll join a senior team of database engineers, with principal and staff engineers setting architecture direction, and you'll act as a technical lead and coach for junior and mid-level colleagues.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Deploy, manage, and tune production databases across on-prem, AWS EC2, and RDS/Aurora.
* Plan and execute cloud migrations and minimal-downtime version upgrades.
* Build and run HA/DR (Always On, clustering, streaming replication) against defined RPO/RTO targets.
* Own backup, recovery, monitoring, and alerting, with automation wherever possible.
* Partner with developers and architects on query tuning, schema/index changes, access requests, and capacity planning.
* Follow ITIL change/incident practices and support PCI compliance.
* Share the on-call rotation across all four platforms.
* Review work and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5-7 years of production database administration experience.
* **Deep expertise in any two** of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL, including HA, upgrades, and performance tuning.
* **Working knowledge of the other two**, enough for BAU and on-call tasks like health checks, backups/restores, access management, and basic troubleshooting.
* Hands-on AWS RDS/Aurora experience, ideally with on-prem-to-cloud migrations.
* Solid Windows and/or Linux fundamentals.
* Real automation skills in Python, Ansible, PowerShell, or Shell.
* Experience with a monitoring tool (New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, SolarWinds, or similar).

**Nice to have**
----------------

* PCI or ITIL exposure, Terraform/Ansible and CI/CD, schema design, and familiarity with MongoDB, Kafka, Redis, Snowflake, or AWS data services (e.g., Redshift).

**Why Join us**
---------------

* Real cloud engineering ownership, not just maintenance.
* A multi-platform environment that broadens your skills.
* A senior team and architecture leaders to learn from.

**Our commitment**
------------------

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

You will troubleshoot complex cloud environments, advocate for customer needs, write documentation, and automate routine operational tasks.

* Scripting & Automation: Intermediate experience with Ansible and Python scripting, alongside shell tools (Bash).
