title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: ServiceNow Lead Developer
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe is seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Implementation Lead** to design, develop, and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This hands-on role will focus on developing enterprise applications, automating business processes, integrating external systems, and delivering high-quality solutions that enable clients to maximize the value of the Now Platform. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with consulting skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through innovative platform development.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform using platform development best practices.
* Develop custom applications, workflows, integrations, and reusable components leveraging JavaScript, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and other platform capabilities.
* Configure and extend ServiceNow applications, including but not limited to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, and custom applications based on client requirements.
* Develop and maintain REST and SOAP integrations with internal and third-party enterprise systems.
* Design and optimize Service Catalog offerings, workflows, record producers, and self-service experiences using Employee Center, Service Portal, and UI Builder.
* Build and support Workspace experiences, Next Experience components, and mobile capabilities.
* Design and maintain data models, CMDB structures, and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) relationships where applicable.
* Implement platform security using ACLs, application scoping, roles, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with solution architects and technical leads to develop scalable, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans using Agile methodologies.
* Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, optimize performance, and support testing and deployment activities.
* Utilize source control, update set management, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices to support application lifecycle management.
* Lead technical discussions, client workshops, and design sessions while providing guidance on ServiceNow platform capabilities and best practices.
* Produce clear technical documentation, development standards, and implementation artifacts.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software development or platform engineering experience, hands-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform capabilities, and application development best practices.
* Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree
* Certification in ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong JavaScript development skills and proficiency with ServiceNow scripting APIs and development frameworks.
* Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspace development.
* Certifications in any of the following:
  + ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  + One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications (ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, or other product areas)
  + ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience building and supporting REST/SOAP integrations and API-based solutions.
* Knowledge of platform security, application scoping, ACLs, and governance best practices.
* Experience with CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, or Service Mapping is preferred.
* Familiarity with source control, Git, update sets, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of ITIL concepts and enterprise service management processes.
* Experience developing across multiple ServiceNow product areas is highly desirable.
* Ability to lead technical solution design while mentoring other developers.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6000+ employees and 34000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection*.*

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

***Recruitment Scam Notice:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “**name@cvent.com**” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* *If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at* *recruitingindia@cvent.com**.* *For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

**About the Role:**

You will work primarily as a System Administrator and a dedicated Cvent Support POC for clients. You’ll be required to take care of any changes, modifications and maintenance services that need to be carried out on the accounts per clients’ request. In addition to this, you’ll also be required to troubleshoot on various account-specific issues on clients’ behalf and provide an RCA on the incident and next steps along with action items.

In This Role, You Will::

* Act as Client's primary contact/ advisor regarding Cvent technology solutions, features, and functionality
* Consult on business processes and best practices as it relates to enterprise meeting management technology
* Handle support queue calls until assigned to an account or engagement. Continue supporting the business through queue coverage whenever capacity is available, even after account assignment.
* Create and analyze cross-meeting reporting to provide recommendations for changes that can be made to support client objectives
* Design, coordinate, and conduct user training on client's meetings and events program
* Act as Client's advocate within Cvent's management and technology groups by managing activities and liaising between the client and the various Cvent departments
* Monitor user adoption and system usage, recommend strategies to increase usage/adoption, and maintain client's account configuration as part of overall system administrator duties
* Cultivate new business opportunities by asking questions, mining opportunities presented and sharing findings with sales partners
* Consultation for industry best practices and drive efficiencies using the platform
* Maintain and ensure compliance guidelines, privacy policies and branding guidelines are met
* Administration of user groups and user access
* Onboarding new users
* Ongoing platform support enquiries and track escalations
* Data steward for product data ensuring relevance, accuracy, and harmonization across the platforms
* Provide regular product updates/ issues to the customer
* Track tasks and progress with the customer
* Maintain documentation related to customers business process
* Cadence calls with Internal stakeholders to share updates and insights

  
Here's What You Need::

* Quick learner, with a positive attitude and ability to work well within a team
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Exposure to Cvent platform is a plus
* Experience that involves working on Custom tasks, Customer Success & Projects preferably in software and technical background
* Strong business acumen, ethics and high integrity
* Candidates must rank within the top 20% of their present team
* Candidates should be ready to work 24x7, shift depending on client's requirement
* Knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel will be a plus
* Must be articulate, organized, detail-oriented and can multi-task
* Should have 5 - 6 years of experience in customer success role supporting US, UK or Australia clients

title: Lead / Senior Systems Engineer - HPC Administrator
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. **About Clovity**

Clovity is a global digital transformation and product engineering company delivering solutions across Atlassian, Cloud, AI, IoT and Enterprise Applications. As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner, we help organizations modernize ITSM, project management, knowledge management, Agile delivery and digital transformation.

We are looking for an experienced

to manage, optimize and support enterprise Atlassian environments. The ideal candidate has
**5 to 7 years of professional experience**
, strong hands-on experience with Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM) and Confluence, plus automation, platform optimization, Atlassian migrations, Marketplace applications and enterprise integrations. * Test and validate new Atlassian versions, patches and plugins before deployment.

* Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, IT, vendors and business stakeholders, including global teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5 to 7 years of overall IT experience, with significant hands-on experience in Atlassian administration.
* Strong experience with Jira, JSM and Confluence.
* Experience supporting Data Center to Cloud migration initiatives.
* Strong Jira administration and configuration experience.
* Experience with JSM configuration and ITSM processes.
* Experience with workflow automation, JQL, dashboards and reporting.
* Experience with Marketplace apps and plugin administration.
* Knowledge of Atlassian migration tools such as JCMA and/or CCMA.
* Experience supporting Atlassian integrations with enterprise or DevOps tools.
* Knowledge of Agile methodologies and ITIL practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Atlassian certifications such as ACP-120 (Jira Administration for Cloud) or equivalent.
* Experience with Cloud-to-Cloud migrations.
* Experience with Marketplace app migrations and compatibility assessments.
* Experience with tools such as Bitbucket, Bamboo, Jira Align, eazyBI, Structure or Zephyr.
* Experience with Atlassian Crowd or centralized user and access management.
* Experience working with an Atlassian Solution Partner, MSP or global IT consulting organization.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise Atlassian environments.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and distributed teams.

**Why Join Clovity?**

- Work with one of the leading Atlassian Platinum Solution Partners.

- Work on enterprise-scale Atlassian environments and cloud transformation initiatives.

- Gain exposure to complex migration, automation, integration and platform optimization projects.

- Collaborate with experienced Atlassian SMEs, Solution Architects and technical teams.

- Work with global enterprise clients.

- Join a fast-growing digital solutions company with a strong partner ecosystem.

- Competitive compensation and accelerated career growth in a performance-driven culture.

Share your resume at
**hiring@clovity.com**

title: Network Access Control - Technical Solns.Arch. Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:**
340592
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Network Access Control - Technical Solns.Arch. Specialist Advisor to join our team in noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
In this role, Candidate is expected with an experience in core areas such as Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting, NAC (Network Access Control), and troubleshooting. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the administration, upkeep, and upgrade of Cisco ISE solutions and deep understanding of network security concepts, Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols, endpoint profiling, posture assessments, BYOD, Guest, pxGrid, DNAC integration with ISE and network access control (NAC) technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and Implementation: Collaborate with infra and security teams to design, implement and customize Cisco ISE solutions, integrate third party solutions to bolster the security posture of the organization and to meet, security business and regulatory requirements.
* AAA Configuration: Review and configure Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting protocols such as RADIUS and TACACS+ on Cisco ISE for secure network access. Ensure to leverage industry best practices to reduce the attack surface areas.
* Endpoint Profiling: Understand, develop, and maintain endpoint profiling policies to classify and manage devices accessing the network based on their characteristics.
* Network Access Control (NAC): Deploy and manage NAC solutions using Cisco ISE to enforce security policies, monitor network access, and ensure compliance.
* Policy Management: Define and manage access control policies, posture assessments, and identity-based access controls within Cisco ISE.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network, security, and IT teams to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions (SIEM and log management), identity providers, and network infrastructure components.
* Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to Cisco ISE configurations, authentication failures, load balancer, licensing, and network access problems.
* Documentation and Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation of Cisco ISE configurations, policies, and procedures. Develop method and procedures in alignment with Change management best practices and provide training and knowledge transfer to varied team members.
* Upgrade and Patch Management: Plan and execute upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities for Cisco ISE deployments to ensure system stability and security. Escalate and troubleshoot along with Cisco TAC for identified bugs and potential work arounds.
* Integration and Collaboration: Collaborate with network engineers, security teams, and IT stakeholders to integrate Cisco ISE with other security solutions, applications, and network infrastructure components.

**Preferences:**

* Development experience with Java, J2EE, JSP, XPRESS, XML
* +8 years Experience with other Identity and Access Management technologies

Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you.
**#UatInsurity**
**What’s In It For U**

* Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative
* Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it.
* Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
* More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
* Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year.
* Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average.
* Mentorship Program: We support a champion culture and growth mindset by pairing you with experienced, talented leaders to help you grow personally and professionally.
* Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.
* Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
* Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.

**Insurity’s Next**
**Senior Support Engineer**
Insurity’s next Senior Support Engineer will be a hands-on, customer-focused technical support professional who owns and coordinates the investigation and resolution of medium- to high-complexity production issues across assigned Insurity products.
  
  
This role combines advanced ticket ownership and escalation judgment with product configuration, component and integration knowledge, technical troubleshooting, and functional and technical root-cause analysis. The ideal candidate communicates clearly, documents work accurately, mentors other support engineers and performs effective handoffs to help customers and internal teams reach timely resolutions.
  
  
This role is expected to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and support customer-facing production issues across applicable time zones when required
  
  
**What Our Senior Support Engineer**
**Will Do**

* Lead triage of incoming tickets, determine priority and ownership, identify billable work, and act as an escalation point for higher-priority or complex support issues.
* Own medium- to high-complexity customer issues and requests through investigation, coordination, communication, resolution, and documented closure.
* Use SQL or similar query tools, application and platform logs, troubleshooting tools, debugging utilities, and other diagnostic methods to investigate reported issues and validate findings.
* Use Kubernetes and GitOps workflows to monitor deployments, review operational behavior, and support investigation of production issues.
* Apply advanced product configuration knowledge to troubleshoot core components, workflows, business rules, transaction processing, and integrations.
* Use programming logic, such as PHP, C#, PowerBuilder, Angular, TypeScript, etc. knowledge to investigate defects, gather relevant evidence, and communicate findings for further resolution.
* Perform functional and technical root-cause analysis for complex incidents and present findings, impact, contributing factors, and recommended actions clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Perform technical troubleshooting across connected systems and identify whether an issue is caused by a defect, configuration gap, integration behavior, data condition, or support process.
* Execute or coordinate approved data-maintenance scripts, quality audits, and other support-related technical work with the appropriate teams.
* Escalate issues through established procedures, provide complete technical context, and maintain follow-up through resolution or transition to the appropriate owner.
* Maintain accurate ticket information, workflow systems, customer-facing tools, case records, resolution notes, impact assessments, and knowledge-based content with limited oversight.
* Support customer-facing production issues through clear written and verbal communication, coordination across multiple time zones, and effective handoffs that protect business continuity.
* Support new customer go-lives by following established readiness processes, completing assigned tasks, and coordinating risks or dependencies with the appropriate teams.
* Communicate with Product Management, Software Engineering, Professional Services, other internal teams, and third-party software suppliers or partners as needed.
* Provide self-service tool support and ad hoc training for customers, internal users, new employees, and other support team members.
* Mentor Support Engineers and provide practical guidance on troubleshooting, ticket ownership, documentation, escalation judgment, and customer communication.
* Support continuous-improvement initiatives that reduce low-value support demand, improve service quality, strengthen knowledge transfer, and increase customer self-service.
* Contribute to and improve knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, standard procedures, and other documentation used for training and operational consistency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate and consistent with company requirements, to support troubleshooting, research, analysis, and documentation.
* Stay current on industry and job-related trends, support best practices, Insurity product changes, and new products offered.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in a support, development, or consulting environment, including at least 3 years supporting or developing assigned products.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.
* Experience owning complex customer issues, leading escalations, performing functional and technical root-cause analysis, and coordinating work across technical teams.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.
* Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, creative problem solving, and strong technical judgment.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings accurately, manage expectations, document work, and perform effective handoffs.
* Strong time-management, planning, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing customer needs.
* Ability to collaborate effectively while also working independently and taking ownership of assigned work.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to customer and team support needs.
* Strong business and technical acumen, including software development acumen and programming logic.
* Advanced technical troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, data, and integrations.
* Ability to configure the product and understand component and integration interactions.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools, SQL or similar query tools, XML/JSON or similar data formats, databases, version-control systems, case-management or CRM systems, debug utilities, application logs, and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Jira, Kubernetes, GitOps workflows, web-based troubleshooting tools, and PHP-based defect investigation is preferred.
* Working knowledge of insurance workflows, supported business scenarios, customer variations, and Insurity products is preferred.
* Within the first three months, complete required Insurity Academy courses and product-specific training covering company learning requirements, insurance and domain concepts, product functions, workflow and process training, transaction workflows, and technical processing.
* Ability to travel approximately 0–10% as needed.

ServiceNow ITAM,HAM,SAM ExpertiseTechnical Design & DeliveryCustomer & Team Leadership
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead design: Translate requirements into solution design documents, user stories, and build specifications for HAM/SAM; own and defend design decisions in front of customer architects.
* Workshops: Support and co-facilitate requirement and design workshops alongside the onsite counterpart; independently run technical deep-dive sessions where required.
* Lead delivery: Drive the build across sprints — configuration, scripting, flows, integrations, and unit/system testing; manage update set / application repository migration and release hygiene.
* Customer engagement: Lead design walkthroughs, sprint playbacks, defect triage, and technical status discussions with customer stakeholders; provide estimates, flag risks early, and manage dependencies.
* HAM scope: Full asset lifecycle (request → receive → deploy → maintain → retire/dispose), stockroom and inventory management, transfer orders, procurement integration, asset–CI reconciliation, refresh and audit processes, Asset Workspace and mobile capabilities.
* SAM scope: Software discovery and normalization, entitlement/license import, reconciliation and compliance positions, publisher packs (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe), software model management, and remediation workflows.
* Build on the existing footprint: Leverage the customer's live CMDB/ITOM investment — Discovery data quality, CSDM alignment, Identification & Reconciliation (IRE), and integration with endpoint/discovery sources (e.g., SCCM/MECM, Intune, JAMF) — without degrading existing data quality.
* Team leadership: Set development standards, review the work of supporting developers, and coordinate across onsite/offshore team members.REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS
* 8+ years of hands-on ServiceNow platform experience, with 3+ years focused on ITAM (HAM/SAM). Minimum two full-cycle HAM and/or SAM Pro implementations delivered end-to-end (design through hypercare). Candidates must be able to walk through these engagements in detail — scope, architecture, key design decisions, integration landscape, and lessons learned.

* CMDB/ITOM working knowledge: CSDM, Discovery data flows, and reconciliation — able to design HAM/SAM on top of a mature, live CMDB.

* Required: ServiceNow CSA; CIS–HAM and CIS–SAM (at least one; both strongly preferred).
* Preferred: CAD (Certified Application Developer), CIS–Discovery or CIS–ITSM; certifications current on recent platform releases.

NICE TO HAVE
  
  

* Experience delivering ITAM in financial services or public sector environments (audit/regulatory-driven SAM, vendor audits, true-ups).
* Exposure to SaaS License Management / license optimization initiatives.
* Familiarity with procurement/ERP integration patterns for asset intake.
* App Engine / custom scoped application delivery experience.

CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT
  
  
Shortlisted candidates will undergo a scenario-based technical assessment and should expect to:
  
  

* Present a prior HAM/SAM implementation — architecture, design decisions, integration landscape, and outcomes.
* Respond to live design scenarios — e.g., asset–CI reconciliation conflicts, license position discrepancies, normalization gaps.

The ideal candidate communicates clearly, documents work accurately and performs effective handoffs to help customers and internal teams reach timely resolutions. This role is expected to work during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours.

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. Professional Services Consultant
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As our Cybersecurity Professional Services Consultant you will be responsible for deploying and implementing our data Security and protection solutions in customer enterprise environments. In this position, the consultant has a central role in the organisation, generating revenue in coordination with sales, interfacing with the customer, and coordinating with R&D and product management to enhance and optimise the solution to meet customer’s needs.
  
  

* Client Engagement & Implementation:
* In this role, you will be a trusted advisor, delivering high-quality consulting services and technical implementations that protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with security standards.

+ Lead technical implementations of Thales data security products and services (e.g., CipherTrust Data Security Platform, CipherTrust Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Imperva Data Security Fabric, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Data Protection on Demand (DPoD), etc.)

* Conduct security assessments and data protection workshops with clients.
* Customize and configure data security solutions to meet client-specific requirements.
* Integrate security solutions with clients’ existing infrastructure (cloud, hybrid, on-prem).

* Design scalable and secure architectures for data security solutions.
* Collaborate with pre-sales teams to understand customer needs and define technical scopes.
* Translate business and compliance requirements into technical controls and processes
* Delivery of customer engagements in the area of HSM, CipherTrust Data Security Platform, CipherTrust DSPM, SafeNet Trusted Access, and/or PKI
* Design – Role, Policies and Procedures
* Documentation and hands on deployment including hardware security modules
* Training & Support:
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to client security and IT teams.
* Offer post-deployment support and troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Serve as a liaison between clients and product engineering teams for escalations and feedback.
* Documentation & Reporting:


+ Create detailed implementation documentation, security plans, and user guides.
+ Deliver executive-level and technical reports outlining project outcomes and recommendations.

**Your Experience**
This is a highly hands-on and technical role with extensive customer-facing responsibilities. You will work with cross-functional teams at customer sites, focusing mainly on IT security, data security, and data encryption and key management, to install and configure Thales data security products. To be successful in this role you will bring the following:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, professional services, or technical consulting
* Hands-on experience implementing Thales CipherTrust, HSM, or equivalent enterprise data security and encryption products
* Strong understanding of network and endpoint security fundamentals
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS security models

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong client relationship and communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Passion for continuous learning in cybersecurity.

**Preferred:**

* Cloud Certifications (Architect ) (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Proficiency in scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. ****Transportation will be given by company****
The Sr. Associate – Implementation Specialist provides technical leadership and hands-on expertise across client implementations of apex portal™ and smartVM™. The role owns the technical success of an implementation end to end — from requirement discovery and solution design through ERP integration, data mapping, testing and go-live.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong technical depth in SaaS platforms, APIs, ETL and databases with the consulting presence to build trusted client relationships. Practical, hands-on experience applying AI tools within a delivery or implementation environment is mandatory for this role. This is also a mentoring role: you will guide junior team members and act as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation & Delivery****
▪ Identify critical implementation requirements and build an implementation plan that delivers project milestones on time and to scope.
  
  
▪ Present technical overviews of apexportal and associated technical requirements to clients during implementation and upgrade planning.
  
  
▪ Manage the setup and configuration of the technical environment for hosted clients.
  
  
▪ Take end-to-end ownership of release and delivery activities, including cutover and post go-live stabilization.
  
  
****Solution Design & Integration****
▪ Design and develop workflows for apexportal functionality and present them to key stakeholders for sign-off.
  
  
▪ Assist clients in designing and building interfaces between their ERP systems and apexportal, and lead the testing of those integrations, including data reconciliation between the client ERP and apexportal.
  
  
▪ Develop and unit test baseline modules of the apexportal Solutions product.
  
  
▪ Apply AI tools and automation to accelerate delivery tasks such as data mapping, configuration, testing, documentation and issue diagnosis.
  
  
****Technical Leadership & Support****
▪ Serve as Subject Matter Expert and technical lead for client configurations and installations of apexportal and smartVM.
  
  
▪ Act as the escalation point for internal and external deployments, troubleshooting and diagnosing the root cause of software issues.
  
  
▪ Provide guidance, training and knowledge transfer to junior team members across both products.
  
  
▪ Partner with the Client Value and Audit teams to resolve client issues and support ongoing accounts.
  
  
****Process Improvement & Reporting****
▪ Design, implement and enhance high-impact business process improvement initiatives for client software implementations.
  
  
▪ Create and maintain mockups, BRDs, FRDs and wireframes using tools such as Visio, Excel, Microsoft Project, Adobe and Snagit.
  
  
▪ Provide recommendations to leadership on a regular and ad-hoc basis and prepare periodic status reporting for management.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
**Candidates must demonstrate all of the following:**
▪
****AI experience —****
hands-on experience applying AI tools and technologies (for example AI-assisted development, automation, document or data extraction, or AI-supported analysis) to real delivery work. Candidates should be able to describe specific use cases and the outcome achieved.
  
  
▪
****Implementation / ERP background —****
4+ years in an implementation, technical consulting or professional services role, including exposure to ERP systems and their data structures.
  
  
▪
****SaaS product understanding —****
solid understanding of SaaS architecture, multi-tenant delivery models, configuration-led implementations and the release cycles they operate on.
  
  
▪
****APIs, ETL & data warehousing —****
working knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, ETL mapping and table design, and core data warehouse concepts.
  
  
▪
****Database skills —****
hands-on experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL or an equivalent relational database, including the ability to write and troubleshoot complex queries, stored procedures, views, indexes and jobs (2+ years).
  
  
▪
****Communication —****
excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present technical concepts to non-technical client stakeholders and executives.
  
  
▪
****Delivery methodology —****
4+ years delivering within Agile / Scrum SDLC environments.
  
  
**Additional Technical Skills**
▪ Experience with Supply Chain or Procure-to-Pay technology implementations.
  
  
▪ Working knowledge of integration technologies including SSO, SAML, SSL, web services, REST and SOAP; ServiceNow integration experience is an advantage.
  
  
▪ Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, CVS or TFS.
  
  
▪ Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView or SSRS.
  
  
▪ Comfortable working with the command line and standard system commands.
  
  
**Preferred / Good To Have**
▪ Hands-on experience with Workday or Oracle.
  
  
▪ Consulting experience across multiple ERPs — specifically MDM, Vendor Master and P2P (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft and similar).
  
  
▪ Exposure to Accounts Payable modules within ERP systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle or J.D. Edwards.
  
  
▪ Knowledge of report migration, subscriptions and data extraction from ERP systems.
  
  
▪ Experience defining application and system configuration standards with cross-functional teams and business units.
  
  
****CORE COMPETENCIES****
▪ Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms.
  
  
▪ Client-service mindset, with the ability to translate client requirements into automated, scalable solutions.
  
  
▪ Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to multi-task with limited supervision and meet changing deadlines under pressure.
  
  
▪ Takes initiative and accepts accountability for outcomes.
  
  
▪ Collaborative and willing to share knowledge across the team.
  
  
**About Apexanalytix**
apexanalytix is a cloud-based software and services company that works with over 200 of the Global Fortune 1000 to recover lost profits, protect against procurement fraud, and manage supplier onboarding, compliance and payment profit optimization. Each year we receive approximately 9 million supplier records and $4.6 trillion in invoices and payments from our clients. We work with organizations including the world's largest retailer, electronics company, entertainment company, financial institutions, pharmaceutical and automotive manufacturers, and services companies, with shared services locations in the US, UK and Hong Kong.
  
  
Delivering our solutions to the world’s largest companies has enabled us to build what a leading IT industry analyst describes as possibly the only trusted source for accurate, high-value supplier information. We are making this data available to solution developers, enterprises and other organizations through an on-demand API business model. Our API service to the validated and enhanced smartVM data source is supplemented by over 400 real-time data sources through direct integration, subscription and robotics — giving clients the trusted data they need to ensure compliance, manage risk, improve B2B transaction processing, enable strategic initiatives, predict outcomes and prescribe action.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Security Operations Analyst will support build out of our internal capability and partner closely with our outsourced SOC provider. This role focuses on incident response coordination, security monitoring, vulnerability management and remediation oversight, helping to strengthen our overall security posture through effective operational processes and active stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
You’ll play a vital role in ensuring we meet both our internal security obligations and the high expectations of our financial services clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the in-house lead for escalations from our third-party MDR/SOC, supporting triage, investigation of alerts from the SIEM, EDR and cloud security tooling (Rapid7 InsightIDR, AWS GuardDuty/CloudTrail), and coordination of incident response
* Investigate security alerts across endpoint, identity, network and cloud environments, correlating available evidence to determine severity, business impact and appropriate response actions.
* Analyse Windows and identity-related security events, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos and NTLM authentication activity, and coordinate investigation and remediation with relevant technical teams.
* Review network security events involving TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common enterprise protocols, identifying suspicious behaviour and recommending appropriate follow-up actions.
* Escalate confirmed or complex incidents to the Senior SOC Analyst and the Rapid7 SOC. Support containment and recovery activities
* Document incidents from detection to closure in the ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow)
* Follow established SOC runbooks and playbooks while contributing to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of incident response runbooks, playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Support the vulnerability management programme such as scan scheduling, triage, risk prioritisation, and remediation tracking
* Monitor the threat landscape to inform detection and response activities
* Support audits and client due diligence processes where required

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 3–5 years’ experience in a security operation, incident response, or SOC analyst role (in-house or MSSP/MDR)
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise SIEM. Rapid7 InsightIDR / InsightVM preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar or equivalent accepted)
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common protocols.
* Practical experience investigating security events in Microsoft Windows environments, with working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos, NTLM and common authentication flows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear incident summaries, document evidence, and coordinate actions with infrastructure, application, engineering, and third-party SOC teams.
* Solid understanding of vulnerability management tools and risk-based remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and client security expectations in financial services or highly regulated environments
* Knowledge of attack techniques and incident response frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK)
* Beneficial:

+ scripting/automation, cloud security experience (AWS/Azure).
+ experience using approved AI-assisted security tools for alert triage, investigation, SIEM query development and reporting, with the ability to validate AI-generated outputs and handle sensitive security data appropriately.
+ Industry security certifications are a bonus.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.
  
  
Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.
  
  
All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Edge [T500-27945]
description:
**About REA Group:**

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way the world experiences property?”

Could we? Yes. Are we done? Never.

Fast forward 30 years, REA Group is a market leader in online real estate in three continents and continuing to grow rapidly across the globe. The secret to our growth is staying true to that ‘day one’ mindset; the hunger to innovate, the ambition to change the world, and the curiosity to reimagine the future.

Our new Tech Center in Cyber City is dedicated to accelerating REA Group’s global technology delivery through relentless innovation. We’re looking for the best technologists, inventors and leaders in India to join us on this exciting new journey.

If you’re excited by the prospect of creating something magical from scratch, then read on.

**What the role is all about:**

We’re seeking a Staff Engineer - EDGE Platform who will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling REA’s edge security and content delivery capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, cloud, networking and security, with a strong focus on building resilient, reusable and well-governed edge platform capabilities for teams across REA.

You’ll help define and evolve our EDGE platform strategy across CDN, WAF, bot management, DNS and traffic management, while applying platform thinking to create paved-road solutions that are secure, scalable and simple for product and engineering teams to adopt. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with operational discipline, leveraging automation, observability and incident response practices to improve reliability and customer outcomes.

This is your chance to work on impactful projects that directly influence availability, performance and security for customer-facing experiences at scale. You’ll work with modern tooling and collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, security and product teams in a large, complex technology environment.

**While no two days are likely to be the same, your typical responsibilities will include:**

* Set technical direction for the EDGE platform across CDN, WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, DNS and traffic management, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to business priorities.
* Lead the design and evolution of platform capabilities using Akamai and Kasada, making sound architectural decisions that balance security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Define and drive reusable platform patterns using Terraform, with strong platform thinking that enables self-service, consistency, governance and safe adoption across engineering teams.
* Work across AWS, networking, CDN and edge security domains to solve complex end-to-end problems and raise the technical maturity of internet-facing systems.
* Partner closely with product, platform, security and development teams to influence roadmaps, shape designs early and ensure edge capabilities are built as strategic platform services rather than one-off solutions.
* Improve operational excellence through PagerDuty, incident leadership, runbooks, on-call practices, service readiness reviews and clear ownership models.
* Define technical standards, guardrails and engineering best practices for the EDGE domain, and ensure they are adopted effectively across teams.
* Own and drive meaningful technology outcomes through OKRs, architecture direction and measurable improvements in security, reliability, performance and platform adoption.
* Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries and help grow a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, ownership and continuous improvement.

**Who we’re looking for:**

* 9+ years’ experience in cloud platform, SRE, network and edge engineering roles, including strong hands-on delivery and technical leadership in production environments.
* Deep expertise in CDN and edge technologies, ideally including Akamai for CDN, WAF and DDoS protection, with the ability to make sound architectural and operational trade-offs.
* Strong experience with bot management platforms such as Kasada, or similar capabilities used to detect and mitigate automated abuse at scale.
* Strong depth in AWS and a broad understanding of networking, DNS, TLS, traffic routing and internet-facing architectures, with the ability to reason across the full request path.
* Advanced proficiency in Terraform and infrastructure as code, including designing reusable modules, standards, abstractions and governance mechanisms for wider engineering adoption.
* Strong software engineering skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building internal tooling, automation and platform integrations used by multiple teams.
* Proven ability to solve ambiguous, high-impact technical problems across distributed systems and drive outcomes that improve security, reliability, performance and developer experience.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, product, security and leadership stakeholders with varying technical backgrounds.
* A high degree of accountability and ownership, including experience shaping or owning OKRs, driving execution and being responsible for measurable platform outcomes.

**Bonus Points for:**

* Experience designing internal platform capabilities that improve developer experience and adoption through self-service patterns.
* Exposure to edge security policy management, rate limiting, API protection or zero trust patterns.
* Experience in high-scale internet platforms where performance, availability and abuse prevention are critical.
* Familiarity with compliance, governance or risk controls in cloud and edge environments.

**What we offer:**

* A hybrid and flexible approach to working.
* Transport options to help you get to and from work, including home pick-up and drop-off.
* Meals provided on site in our office.
* Flexible leave options including parental leave, family care leave and celebration leave.
* Insurances for you and your immediate family members.
* Programs to support mental, emotional, financial and physical health & wellbeing.
* Continuous learning and development opportunities to further your technical expertise.

**The values we live by:**

Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:**

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more effective and fuel disruptive thinking - be it cultural and ethnic backgrounds, gender identity, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other identity or lived experience. We know diverse teams are critical to maintaining our success and driving new business opportunities. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

title: L2 IT Infrastructure Management Engineer – Remote Data Center Operations

**Level 2 IT Infrastructure Management Professional**

The engineer should have broad hands-on knowledge across
**Windows/Linux servers, virtualization, storage, backup, network, Active Directory, cloud connectivity, monitoring, security, and ITSM processes**
, with the ability to remotely diagnose infrastructure issues and coordinate resolution across different technical teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide
  **L2 operational support**
  for remote data center infrastructure across multiple technology towers.
* Monitor server, network, storage, backup, virtualization, and infrastructure health using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Handle incidents, service requests, alerts, and operational tasks within agreed SLA timelines.
* Perform troubleshooting for:
* Windows and Linux server issues
* CPU, memory, disk and service-related problems
* VM availability and virtualization issues
* Network connectivity and DNS/DHCP issues
* Storage capacity and access issues
* Backup failures and restore requests
* Active Directory and access-related incidents
* Support remote administration of physical and virtual servers.
* Coordinate with L3 teams, OEM vendors, application teams, cloud teams, SOC/NOC teams, and data center teams for complex issues.
* Perform routine health checks and operational checks across all infrastructure towers.
* Review monitoring alerts, identify recurring issues, and initiate problem management where required.
* Support server provisioning, decommissioning, patching, reboot coordination, and configuration changes.
* Monitor backup jobs and coordinate restore validation.
* Support Active Directory administration, including:
* User and group management
* Server/computer account management
* Group Policy troubleshooting

title: Saviynt Technical Architect
description:
**The Opportunity**
Implements strategic cybersecurity initiatives, driving the development and enforcement of security policies, risk management processes, and incident response protocols. Leads security projects and operational processes that enhance organizational resilience against cyber threats. Directs security activities within projects, overseeing teams responsible for risk assessments, threat mitigation, compliance, and infrastructure protection. Works on complex security challenges, requiring an in-depth evaluation of emerging threats, regulatory requirements, and business impact, often adapting traditional security models to develop innovative defensive strategies. Communicates with and influences management, offering insightful cybersecurity recommendations, strategic guidance, and risk mitigation plans. Strengthens relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join our forward-thinking team as a SAVIYNT Architect responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using the Saviynt Security Manager (SSM) platform. This role requires a blend of SAVIYNT and SAP Security skillset. The architect will collaborate with security, IT, compliance, and business teams to deliver end-to-end identity lifecycle management, access governance and application onboarding.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* Architecture & Design
* Develop and maintain the overall Saviynt solution architecture aligned with enterprise IAM strategy.
* Design end-to-end workflows for identity lifecycle management, provisioning, access requests, and certifications.
* Architect integrations between Saviynt and HRMS, Active Directory, Azure AD, SAP, cloud systems, and custom applications.
* Implementation & Configuration
* Lead Saviynt configuration includes workflows, rules, roles, analytics, dashboards, connectors, and access policies.
* Design and build custom Saviynt connectors using REST APIs, JDBC, and SCIM where needed.
* Configure SoD (Segregation of Duties) controls, risk models, and automated remediation rules.
* Governance & Compliance
* Ensure Saviynt meets regulatory standards such as SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and internal controls.
* Implement and optimize access governance, certification campaigns, and risk scoring models.
* Establish and enforce IAM standards, policies, and best practices.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration
* Work closely with security teams, application owners, and infrastructure teams to onboard new applications and improve IAM posture.
* Provide deep technical guidance to developers, analysts, and support personnel.
* Lead troubleshooting efforts for complex Saviynt issues and performance concerns.

**SAP Security Administration Responsibilities**
**User & Role Administration**

* Create and maintain SAP users (SU01, SU10).
* Build and modify single, composite, and derived roles in PFCG.
* Assign roles based on functional team requirements and access principles.

**Authorization Troubleshooting**

* Investigate and resolve authorization issues using SU53, SUIM, ST01, and STAUTHTRACE.
* Validate authorization objects, field values, and Associated access logic.

**SAP Risk & GRC Management**

* Perform SOD analysis in SAP GRC or Saviynt.
* Maintain firefighter/EM access and review logs.
* Support periodic access review cycles and audit requests.

**CERTIFICATIONS:**
Saviynt Certifications (e.g., Saviynt IGA Professional, Saviynt Cloud PAM).
  
  
**EXPERIENCE:**
8+ years of IAM experience with at least 4+ years hands-on Saviynt experience.
  
  
**Those Necessary To Perform The Job Competently**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* Proficiency with:

+ Directory services (AD, Azure AD)
+ Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
+ REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JavaScript, JSON

* Experience implementing IGA, PAM, and access governance capabilities.
* Deep understanding of identity lifecycle management, RBAC/ABAC, SoD, and compliance frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience with SailPoint, Okta, or other IAM tools.
  
  
**How You Will Thrive And Create An Impact**
In the Saviynt Architect role, you can deliver impact by designing secure, scalable IAM architectures, streamlining identity lifecycle processes through automation, and strengthening governance with effective SOD controls and risk‑based policies. I will ensure seamless integration across enterprise systems, enhance user experience through optimized workflows, and collaborate closely with security, IT, and compliance teams to align Saviynt capabilities with organizational needs. You can focus on continuous improvement and operational efficiency which would support a stronger, more compliant identity ecosystem.

****Job Description****
**Position Summary**
The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex manufacturing environment.
  
  
This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and legacy business systems while ensuring their stability, performance, security, and long-term supportability.
  
  
Working as part of the Enterprise Applications team, this role collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist with expertise across enterprise applications, Microsoft SQL Server technologies, and supporting infrastructure platforms. The ability to independently learn unfamiliar systems and assume operational ownership of business-critical applications is essential.
  
  
This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Administer, support, monitor, and troubleshoot business-critical enterprise applications, including ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and other operational systems.
* Develop technical expertise and operational ownership of assigned applications and services.
* Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Contribute to projects and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing technical debt, improving system stability, and modernizing legacy technologies.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, operating system, infrastructure, authentication, and integration layers.
* Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including clustered installations, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) platforms, and related technologies such as SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Collaborate with Development, Data, BI, and DBA teams to identify and resolve database and application performance issues.
* Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Support Active Directory administration, authentication services, and Kerberos-related troubleshooting.
* Support and maintain virtualized environments primarily based on Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Support Azure-hosted business applications, databases, and analytical solutions.
* Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live.
* Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable.
* Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and business-critical incidents.
* Collect and analyze diagnostic information using tools such as PerfMon, Windows Event Viewer, SQL Server tools, Dynatrace, Spotlight, and application logs.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

****The Following Certifications Are Considered An Asset:****

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, SQL Server, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications
* Citrix certifications

****Experience & Qualifications****

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise applications and systems technologies in a complex, global environment.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Experience supporting ERP and business-critical enterprise applications.
* Experience supporting ERP solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics AX.
* Experience supporting Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environments and Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Experience troubleshooting SQL Server performance issues and supporting clustered SQL Server environments.
* Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and supporting Microsoft Hyper-V environments.
* Experience working within ITIL-based support processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar business systems and technologies.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, warehouse management, and other business-critical enterprise applications. Experience with Teamcenter, NX, CAD/PDM/PLM platforms, WMS, OFS, TDM, or comparable business systems is considered an asset.
* Experience with Azure, Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions.
* Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

**Key Competencies**

* Self-motivated and highly independent.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Continuous learning mindset.

title: Snowflake Admin
description:
**What you will do**

**Platform administration**

* **Accounts and environments**
  Manage separate Snowflake accounts for development, testing and production, and keep their setup consistent.
* **Access and security**
  Build and maintain role-based access (RBAC). Manage single sign-on and user provisioning with the corporate identity provider (SAML/OIDC and SCIM). Set up key-pair authentication for service accounts and network policies.
* **Data protection**
  Apply Snowflake Horizon governance features: object tagging, masking policies and row access policies for sensitive data.
* **Cost and performance**
  Size and tune warehouses, set resource monitors and budgets, and report on credit usage. Find and fix slow or costly queries.
* **Infrastructure as code**
  Manage Snowflake objects through version-controlled scripts (for example Terraform or schemachange), not by hand.
* **Monitoring and support**
  Set up alerts, track failed jobs and logins, handle incidents, and write runbooks so others can follow the same steps.
* **Data sharing**
  Configure secure data sharing between accounts so non-production environments can use production data safely.

**Data engineering**

* **Source onboarding**
  Onboard enterprise business data sources (for example ERP, commerce, marketing, supply chain and SaaS applications) using Fivetran and Snowflake Openflow.
* **Ingestion operations**
  Configure and run connectors, and handle schema changes, re-syncs, failures and freshness targets.
* **Custom and streaming feeds**
  Build Openflow flows for sources without a ready-made connector, including files, APIs, databases and event streams.
* **Pipelines and orchestration**
  Build and schedule pipelines using Snowflake Tasks, Streams, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe and dbt Projects on Snowflake.
* **Data quality at landing**
  Add row-count, freshness and completeness checks so problems are caught before data reaches users.
* **CI/CD**
  Build deployment pipelines that promote code from development to test to production safely.

**Must have**

* 4+ years of hands-on Snowflake administration: RBAC design, warehouses, resource monitors, account parameters and user management.
* Had worked on enterprise companies who has implemented Snowflake as DATA Hub.
* Hands-on experience with Fivetran or a similar managed ingestion tool, including troubleshooting sync failures.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake Openflow or Apache NiFi, building and running data flows.
* SnowPro Core certification.
* Strong SQL and working Python.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data platforms.
* Working knowledge of AWS as it relates to Snowflake: S3, IAM roles and storage integrations.
* Clear written English and the discipline to document what you build.

**Nice to have**

* SnowPro Advanced: Administrator or Architect certification.
* Terraform, schemachange or similar tools for managing Snowflake objects.
* Snowpipe Streaming, Kafka or other streaming ingestion.
* Experience with a secrets manager for service credentials.

description:
