The Deepwatch Security Operations Center is a unique approach to how we support our customers and ultimately provide an experience not found anywhere else. You’ll be an integral part of supporting our customers by understanding their bespoke environment, needs and challenges. You will be playing a key role in supporting some of the top organizations in the world, and have the opportunity to develop your skills by working with the best responders in the industry, your team and your shift!

**This is a remote position based in Bangalore, requiring alignment with US business hours (11:30 PM to 7:30 AM IST). Candidates should be located in or near Bangalore, with the flexibility to work from our local office for team collaboration, meetings, and company events as needed.**

**In this role, you’ll get to:**

* Act as an escalation point  for alert triage processes across security technologies and multiple platforms including Windows, Linux and macOS
* Provide in depth analysis from escalated requests originating from any team member who needs support
* Validate suspicious events by performing investigations using SIEM and SOAR technologies
* Leverage Deepwatch proprietary tooling, OSINT, TTPs and IOCs
* Act as a key resource for Management, providing opportunities for improvement and actionable recommendations on creating efficiencies
* Identify gaps in customer environments, data ingested or configuration errors which reduce telemetry quality
* Collaborate directly with leadership and customers to highlight and resolve security  concerns
* Provide investigative support to analysts and train others on a regular basis
* Produce high-quality written and verbal communications, recommendations, and findings to customer management in a timely manner
* Further hone your skills and capabilities through hands-on experience and the Deepwatch learning & development program.
* Engage in peer review sessions to evolve and enhance analysis quality.

**To be successful in this role, you’ll need to:**

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity or SOC environment
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with SIEM platforms, Splunk required (Google SecOps & Microsoft Sentinel preferred) with the ability to perform queries and leverage various log sources to perform investigations
* Proven ability to collaborate with global teams across time zones and partner with U.S.-based leadership to ensure continuous security operations.
* Proven experience in incident response and threat hunting
* Possess strong understanding of cyber security principles, concepts and practices which includes the ability to perform a complete and thorough incident investigation and triage as the final point of escalation
* Possess comprehensive knowledge of Splunk SIEM, alongside the capability to utilize alternative platforms like Google SecOps or Microsoft Sentinel, ensuring smooth console navigation, optimized query execution for streamlined investigations, and precise alert evaluations.
* Have working knowledge of modern EDR tools like CrowdStrike & SentinelOne, email security, and cloud identity platforms.
* Have confidence to autonomously resolve complex investigations
* Effectively meet client expectations ensuring action items are tracked to completion while maintaining transparent communication with peers and leadership.
* Have advanced knowledge of Adversary Tactics, Techniques, & Procedures (TTP), Event Logging, and Event Triage
* Demonstrate the ability to pivot to other log sources, cloud systems or consoles to perform a comprehensive analysis from multiple data sources.
* A desire to support others and uplift the program and team through updating training materials and SOPs
* Hands-on experience utilizing enterprise ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar case management tools.
* Demonstrate the ability to write well-written reports and analysis that’s thorough, accurate and complete
* Monitor and manage incoming security alerts against strict operational SLAs
* Preferred Certifications: Security X,  CySA+,  GCSA, GCIH.
* Experience in an MDR or MSSP environment is highly desirable.
* The working hours for this role are from 11:30 PM to 7:30 AM IST.

**Why Deepwatch?**

* Mission-driven company focused on protecting customers from threats 24/7
* **Hybrid work model in India**
  , with access to collaborative office space in Bangalore
* High-impact leadership role with strong visibility across Product & Engineering
* Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits
* A company recognized as a
  **Great Place to Work® for five consecutive years**
* Opportunity to shape the future of cybersecurity and AI-driven platforms

**Life at Deepwatch:**

For employees, Deepwatch fosters a unique, flexible work environment designed with collaboration in mind. The company emphasizes personal and professional
  
growth, offering benefits such as professional development programs, comprehensive health coverage, and generous parental leave. Deepwatch is also committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, aiming to empower underrepresented groups in tech by connecting them with meaningful opportunities, mentors, and sponsors.

In recognition of its supportive workplace culture, Deepwatch earned the Great Place To Work Certification/(TM) in 2025, underscoring its dedication to creating a positive and inclusive work environment. Deepwatch is a global cybersecurity company with offices in San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Tampa, Florida; and Bengaluru, India.

title: Senior Technical Risk Analyst
description:
Senior Technical Risk Analyst

**Global Enterprise Security**

Role Overview

The Senior Technical Risk Analyst will support the operation and continued evolution of the organization's Cyber and IT Risk Management capabilities within Global Enterprise Security (GES), including alignment with broader business and Enterprise Risk Management processes.

This is a hands-on technical risk role requiring strong analytical judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to independently investigate and challenge risk assertions. The analyst will work directly with security, technology, engineering, architecture, and business teams to understand technical conditions, determine their actual risk significance, and translate validated exposure into actionable risk information.

The role goes beyond traditional GRC administration. Analysts are expected to examine the technology, controls, threat context, and supporting data behind identified concerns - not simply document the presence of a finding or deviation.

What You'll Do

Technical Risk Analysis

* Conduct technical risk assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, platforms, and technology services.
* Evaluate technical risk using evidence and context to determine exposure and business impact.
* Apply technical judgment to distinguish findings, issues, exceptions, and material risks, challenging unsupported risk assertions.
* Develop risk scenarios and recommendations that connect technical conditions, credible threats, controls, and business impact.

Risk Intelligence & Decision Support

* Identify and analyze security, technology, operational, and business data needed to support objective risk decisions.
* Correlate technical signals to identify trends, concentrations, systemic conditions, and emerging risks.
* Develop data-driven risk indicators and identify opportunities to automate risk monitoring and reporting.
* Translate technical exposure into actionable insights for technology and business leaders.

Program Evolution

* Support the evolution of Cyber Risk Management into broader IT Risk Management and alignment with Enterprise Risk Management.
* Strengthen relationships across technical findings, issues, exceptions, controls, systems, business services, and risks.
* Support consistent approaches to risk prioritization, ownership, treatment, aggregation, and escalation.
* Advance risk methodologies and technologies toward more dynamic, data-driven risk management.

What You'll Bring

* **At least 10+ years of general IT and Technology experience, with at least 6+ year of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or a related technical discipline, with a strong understanding of enterprise technology environments and cybersecurity controls.**
* Demonstrated ability to investigate technical security concerns, interpret technical evidence, and determine their actual risk significance.
* Ability to challenge unsupported assumptions regarding severity, likelihood, impact, or risk.
* Experience translating complex technical conditions into clear business-relevant risk scenarios.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity and risk frameworks, including NIST and ISO.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, architects, security practitioners, and business leaders.
* An undergraduate degree in Business, Information Technology, or related disciplines (or additional years of equivalent experience).

Preferred:

* Experience with data-driven risk analysis, cloud and hybrid technology environments, scenario-based or quantitative risk methodologies, continuous risk monitoring, or the modernization of Cyber or IT Risk Management programs.
* Applicable industry recognized certifications: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, etc.

What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means bringing technical depth, evidence, and sound judgment to risk management.

The Senior Technical Risk Analyst will help ensure that identified risks accurately represent meaningful technology exposure - not simply the presence of a finding or deviation. They will investigate what is behind a risk assertion, identify the data needed to validate it, understand the effectiveness of existing controls, and appropriately scope and prioritize the resulting exposure.

Ultimately, this role will help strengthen the connection between technical evidence, issues, controls, system-level risk, business impact, and enterprise risk, enabling more objective and data-driven risk decisions across the organization.

The technology and solution stack spansall internet facing web applications of the Institutional Security and Wealth Management Businesses. It consists ofhome-grown software, 3rd party software, open-source products, appliances, and auxiliary services and solutions. An Akamai Resident Engineer will be responsible for onboarding applications to Akamai, tuning and operating WAFprotections, troubleshooting production issues, reviewing security events, supporting AI/API security initiatives,coordinating quarterly security improvements, and acting as the technical bridge between Akamai and internalapplication teams.Morgan Stanley anticipates the need for one (1) Akamai Resident Engineer and one (1) backup resource, with amaximum of two resources proposed.Consultant’s responsibilities under this Task Order will include:1. WAF Onboarding and Application Migration Lead onboarding internet-facing applications to Akamai WAF. Work with applications, DNS, load balancer, proxy, firewall, and QA teams to migrate applications intomonitor/alert mode and ultimately deny mode. Coordinate testing, rollout plans, traffic cutovers, validation, and rollback procedures.2. WAF Policy Tuning and False Positive Analysis Analyze production traffic and WAF events to identify false positives. Tune security policies to reduce business impact while maintaining strong protection. Review blocked requests, investigate application behavior, and create narrowly scoped exceptions whenjustified.3. AI, LLM, and API Security Support Troubleshoot AI- and LLM-related traffic that triggers WAF protections such as SQL injection controls. Work with application teams and vendors to design compensating controls, header-based attestationmechanisms, and API-specific protections. Evaluate emerging Akamai AI security capabilities such as AI-powered detections, Firewall for AI, botidentification, and agentic AI protections.4. Security Event Monitoring and Threat Analysis Review WAF, Bot Manager, DDoS, Client Reputation, and API Security events. Analyze attack patterns and determine whether activity is malicious or legitimate. Recommend policy improvements and mitigations based on observed threats.5. Quarterly Security Reviews and Platform Upgrades Conduct structured reviews of applications protected by Akamai. Evaluate opportunities to move applications from monitoring to mitigation mode. Perform quarterly WAF upgrades, policy reviews, and security-control tuning to keep protections alignedwith current threat intelligence.6. Incident Response and Troubleshooting Assist with production incidents where application behavior changes after WAF enablement. Investigate latency issues, traffic-routing problems, load-balancer interactions, client IP handling, surgequeue events, and application outages. Coordinate with Akamai engineering resources and internal teams to identify root causes and correctiveactions7. Security Architecture and Design Consulting Advise application teams on secure web architectures, OWASP protections, API security, bot mitigation,client reputation controls, and DDoS protection. Provide guidance on best practices for onboarding, secure application design, and remediation of webvulnerabilities8. Program Management and Stakeholder Engagement Partner with application owners, infrastructure teams, auditors, risk managers, and security leadership. Track onboarding progress, risks, dependencies, and remediation activities through program governanceand ticketing systems. Present status updates, metrics, risks, and remediation plans to senior management9. Operational Metrics and Reporting Produce dashboards and reporting covering WAF adoption, deny-mode coverage, bot mitigationeffectiveness, API discovery, security exceptions, and attack activity. Measure onboarding progress, control effectiveness, and risk reduction across the organization.10. Vendor Liaison and Technology Roadmap Guidance Act as the primary interface between the enterprise and Akamai. Engage Akamai product teams on product defects, enhancement requests, AI roadmap discussions, policyrecommendations, and complex troubleshooting. Evaluate new Akamai capabilities and coordinate pilot deployments where appropriate.Mandatory Experience 5+ years of Akamai experience Akamai Kona Site Defender Akamai Bot Manager Akamai API Security OWASP Top 10 Incident response experiencePreferred Experience AI/LLM security Akamai Firewall for AI Enterprise-scale migration experience Financial services experience

title: Senior Engineer, Cybersecurity,
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
**Your Role at Baxter**
As part, a member of a Research & Development team, the Product Security Engineer works in close collaboration with the project & cybersecurity lead on assigned tasks and provides inputs to the design and testing of the new product/project. The engineer also provides guidance to software developers on their security issues, engages in design reviews, and helps resolve security issues.

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech or an equivalent engineering degree

* Proficient problem-solving skills
* Strong Interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with others in a team environment

title: Information Security Consultant (6 months)
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

**Experience:**
1–2 years

**Type:**
Full-time Consultant (6 months)

**Department:**
Information Security

**About Us**

Qure.ai is a global healthtech company using artificial intelligence to improve disease detection and patient outcomes at scale. Our solutions are deployed across hospitals, diagnostic networks, and public health programs worldwide.

Today, our technology has impacted
**40M+ lives**
across
**105+ countries**
, deployed across
**5,200+ sites**
, and powered by one of the world’s largest real-world medical imaging datasets. With
**26 FDA-cleared indications**
, we are helping shape the future of AI-driven healthcare.

**The Opportunity**

As a healthtech company working with hospitals and public health programs across 105+ countries, earning and keeping customer trust in how we protect data is central to everything we do. Our ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II report are how we prove it.

We are looking for an Information Security Consultant to own and mature our information security and compliance program. You will run our ISO 27001 ISMS and SOC 2 Type II audits, keep our controls healthy year-round, and be a trusted partner to engineering, IT and customer-facing teams.

**What You’ll Own & Drive**

* **ISO 27001 ISMS:**
  Maintain Qure’s ISMS end to end, including scope, Statement of Applicability, risk register, risk treatment plans and the full set of Annex A controls.
* **SOC 2 Type II:**
  Run the annual audit cycle, from control mapping and continuous evidence collection through auditor walkthroughs, sample requests and closure of exceptions.
* **Audits:**
  Plan and run internal audits, coordinate surveillance and recertification audits with external auditors, and drive corrective actions to closure on time.
* **Policies & procedures:**
  Own, review and update information security policies, standards and SOPs at least annually, and get them approved and acknowledged across teams.
* **Risk management:**
  Run periodic information security risk assessments, track risks with clear owners and due dates, and report status to leadership.
* **Vendor security:**
  Assess third-party and sub-processor risk through questionnaires, report reviews (SOC 2 / ISO certificates) and contract security clauses.
* **Customer trust:**
  Answer security questionnaires, RFP security sections and customer audit requests from hospitals, health systems and partners worldwide.
* **Access & asset hygiene:**
  Run quarterly user access reviews, maintain the asset inventory and track joiner–mover–leaver controls with IT and HR.
* **Vulnerability management:**
  Own the vulnerability management process end to end. Coordinate regular scans and annual third-party penetration tests, triage findings by severity, track remediation with Engineering and IT against agreed SLAs, and report on open and overdue vulnerabilities.
* **Security awareness:**
  Run onboarding and annual security and privacy training, phishing simulations and track completion across the company.
* **Incident & continuity:**
  Maintain the incident response, business continuity and disaster recovery plans, run tabletop exercises and support incident handling.
* **Cross-functional partnership:**
  Act as the security point of contact for IT, Engineering, DevOps, Product, HR and Legal. Help teams build controls into their daily work, review security impact of new features and tools, and make sure each control owner knows what is expected and when.
* **Sprinto (compliance platform):**
  Own and manage Sprinto as the system of record for ISO 27001 and SOC 2. Keep integrations, control mappings, policies and evidence up to date, assign and follow up on control tasks with owners, and use it to stay audit-ready year-round.
* **Metrics & reporting:**
  Track and report compliance health, open findings, risk posture and training completion to leadership and the security steering committee.

**What Success Looks Like**

In the first 6–12 months, you will:

* Take full ownership of the ISMS and SOC 2 control set, with a clear view of every control, its owner and its evidence.
* Lead Qure through at least one ISO 27001 surveillance or recertification audit with no major non-conformities.
* Complete a SOC 2 Type II audit window with a clean opinion and exceptions (if any) closed with documented remediation.
* Refresh the risk register and complete at least one full risk assessment cycle with leadership sign-off.
* Move evidence collection to a continuous, mostly automated process so audit preparation no longer depends on last-minute effort.
* Cut turnaround time on customer security questionnaires through a maintained answer library and trust documentation.
* Achieve full completion of annual security awareness training and quarterly access reviews.

**Core Skills Required**

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience in information security, GRC or compliance.
* Direct experience implementing or maintaining an ISO 27001:2022 ISMS, including risk assessment, SoA and internal audits.
* Hands-on involvement in at least one SOC 2 Type II audit, ideally from readiness through report issuance.
* Working knowledge of security fundamentals, including access management, logging and monitoring, encryption, vulnerability management, change management and backup.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure or GCP) and how common controls are evidenced there.
* Strong written communication; you can write a clear policy, a crisp audit response and a customer-ready security answer.
* Organised and detail-oriented, able to run many parallel workstreams and follow up with control owners across teams.
* Good to have: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, CompTIA Security+ or similar certification.
* Good to have: exposure to healthcare and privacy frameworks such as HIPAA, GDPR, India’s DPDP Act or ISO 27701, and compliance automation tools (e.g. Vanta, Drata, Sprinto).

**Life at Qure**

**Flexibility & Ownership**

o Hybrid work culture

o Relocation support (where applicable)

o Opportunity to work on global markets

**Growth & Learning**

o Learning and development allowance

o High ownership and accelerated career growth

**Wellbeing**

o Comprehensive health insurance

o Free online doctor consultations

o Unlimited therapy sessions

o Fitness & wellness allowance

**Culture & Community**

o Annual and team offsites

o Complimentary meals at the office

o Gaming zone (yes - including a PS5)

**Our Values**

·
**Humble:**
Curious, open to feedback, and focused on team success over individual credit.

·
**Hungry:**
High ownership, relentless drive, and a constant push for better outcomes.

·
**Smart:**
Structured thinking with empathy, solving complex problems with clarity and strong collaboration.

**Our inclusive workspace || Applicant Privacy Policy**

LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

LinkedIn's members entrust us with their information every day and we take their security seriously. Our core value of putting our members first powers all the decisions we make, including how we manage and protect the data of our members and customers. Information Security at LinkedIn is dedicated to protecting and securing business-critical member data and company assets. Our core mission is to empower LinkedIn to create a secure and thriving platform for every member of the global workforce.

The product and platform security team is responsible for securing all of LI’s services be it on-prem or cloud. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will oversee the creation of features and systems designed to enhance platform integrity and user confidence. In this capacity, you are accountable for the secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) and the security of CI/CD pipelines for both member-facing and internal products.

You will own and evolve the secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) by integrating leading security practices into every phase, from planning and architecture reviews to continuous testing and maintenance. In this capacity, you will oversee developer guardrails—including secure coding criteria, architectural designs, and code reviews—while driving the adoption of paved paths within the CI/CD pipeline. By automating scanning, testing, and compliance checks at every stage, you will ensure software supply chain security and code integrity from development through production, reducing systemic risk and driving high-value security outcomes. Act as a force multiplier by championing AI-assisted security workflows and utilizing AI-native systems that offer deep architectural reasoning. By integrating these advanced guardrails, you will eliminate classes of vulnerabilities ranging from traditional risks like the OWASP Top 10 to emerging, sophisticated threats like prompt injections targeting agentic applications.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications

* BA/BS Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline, or related practical experience.
* 4+ years experience programming experience in Python or Go.

Preferred Qualifications

* 6+ years of relevant work experience.
* Expert knowledge of computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
* Experience with object-oriented design, coding, testing patterns, and programming languages (Java, C++).
* Proven coding skills in a high level language with interest and ability to learn other coding languages as needed.
* Experience building web applications and services with IDEs and general development practices.

**Additional Information**

Suggested Skills

* Data Structures & Algorithms
* Software Design
* Python

title: Network Administrator - Cisco Meraki [T500-30102]
description:
**About Ferguson:**

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

**Skills Required:**

* Network Administration, Routing, Switching, Routers, Switches, Troubleshooting, Incident Response, Cisco Meraki, Meraki, HPE Aruba Networking Edge Connect, Orchestrator, HPE SSE, SASE, SD-WAN, NGFW, ZBF, IDS/IPS, VRRP, IPsec, GRE, SWG, SSL/TLS inspection, Zero Trust, ZTNA, VRF, 802.1X, RADIUS, REST API, Syslog, SNMP, NetFlow/IPFIX, SIEM, SOAR, Splunk, ServiceNow

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Rogue Device Enforcement:**

* Own the intake, investigation, and resolution of rogue devices
* Enforce defined network access and security policies, including device isolation and remediation actions
* Partner with Network Security to refine response procedures, thresholds, and enforcement standards

**NOC Operations & Network Support:**

* Support NOC incident response for network-related issues, including break/fix and service restoration
* Manage Layer 2 network devices and coordinate RMAs for faulty hardware
* Perform APC UPS and battery replacements to maintain infrastructure resilience
* Monitor network health using Meraki Dashboard and escalating issues as needed

**Incident & Service Management:**

* Leverage ServiceNow for incident, request, and problem tracking
* Provide timely communication and updates to global teams and US-based stakeholders
* Support ISP management activities including DIA circuits, modems, and provider coordination.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* 1-3 years of enterprise/branch network voice/data communications experience preferred.
* Proficient computer skills; must be comfortable in MS Office and related applications.
* Proficient network skills and experience; CCNA, CCNP, and additional certification relevant to the position is preferred but not required.
* Proficient troubleshooting experience and certification in wireless networking is preferred.
* Experience in an enterprise network operations environment, including large-scale deployments and refresh of multiple technical theaters.
* Experience with SD-WAN infrastructure and security protocols
* Experience within cloud management and technology
* Effective verbal and written communication skills
* Strong understanding of network fundamentals (Ethernet, Wireless, VLANs, ARP, STP, DNS, DHCP)
* Hands-on experience with Meraki wireless and switching environments preferred
* Familiarity with rogue device detection and network security best practices
* Experience with ITSM tools, preferably ServiceNow
* Understanding of hardware RMA processes
* Ability to operate in a 24x7 support environment
* Strong communication skills for global and US-based stakeholder interaction
* Self-directed, ownership-driven mindset with sound judgment under pressure
* Secure SD-WAN and SASE:
  Working knowledge of secure, cloud-ready network architectures that combine branch SD-WAN with cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) controls.
* Next-Generation Firewall:
  Experience with stateful and zone-based firewalling, application-aware policy enforcement, IDS/IPS, DoS/DDoS protection, anti-spoofing, and security event logging.
* High Availability and Resilience:
  Ability to support stateful high-availability designs, VRRP-based gateway redundancy, pre-established SD-WAN/VPN tunnels, path monitoring, and failover troubleshooting.
* SSL/TLS Inspection and Secure Web Gateway: Understanding of outbound SSL/TLS decryption, secure web gateway controls, URL categorization, content inspection, threat scanning, and policy-based cloud security steering.
* Centralized Orchestration and Automation:
  Experience centrally creating, deploying, and auditing network and security policies; familiarity with zero-touch provisioning, role-based access control, REST APIs, webhooks, and automated tunnel provisioning.
* Segmentation and Identity-Aware Policy:
  Strong understanding of security zones, VRFs, inter-zone policy, role-based segmentation, 802.1X, RADIUS, MAC authentication, and controlled traffic between Guest, IoT/OT, Corporate, and other network segments.
* Threat Intelligence and SIEM Integration: Familiarity with custom IDS/IPS signatures, URL/IP allow and block lists, reputation services, external threat intelligence, syslog export, and integration with SIEM, SOAR, or threat-intelligence platforms.
* HPE Aruba Networking Edge Connect:
  Hands-on exposure to HPE Aruba Networking Edge Connect SD-WAN and Orchestrator, or comparable enterprise SD-WAN and centralized policy platforms.

**Preferred / Nice to Have:**

* CCNA or equivalent networking training
* Experience with APC UPS systems and Structurer
* Prior NOC or Network Operations experience
* Exposure to security policy enforcement or SOC/NOC collaboration models
* API-Driven Operations:
  Experience using REST APIs for configuration management, firewall policy updates, and extraction of logs, metrics, alarms, and audit data.
* Monitoring and Telemetry:
  Familiarity with WebSocket alarms, SNMP polling and traps, Syslog, NetFlow/IPFIX, Splunk dashboards, and centralized security log analysis.
* Advanced Threat Detection:
  Awareness of cloud sandboxing, file detonation, zero-day analysis, multi-engine malware inspection, and endpoint quarantine workflows through NAC integrations.
* Offline Security Enforcement:
  Understanding of how branch appliances retain local policies, IDS/IPS signatures, URL categorization, and IP reputation data so enforcement can continue during temporary cloud-controller or WAN outages.
* Security Ecosystem Integration:
  Exposure to Aruba CX, ClearPass, HPE SSE, Splunk, MISP, ThreatConnect, Anomalies, BrightCloud/OpenText, Virus Total, ClamAV, or comparable technologies.

title: Microsoft Security Solutions_Senior Security Architect
description:

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Microsoft Security Solutions
  
  

* Architect and guide implementation of Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Office 365, and Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Design Microsoft Sentinel SIEM and SOAR solutions, including data onboarding, analytics, automation, workbooks, threat hunting, and incident workflows.
* Design identity security using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, Privileged Identity Management, and identity governance capabilities.
* Design data security and compliance solutions using Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, and compliance capabilities.
* Design endpoint and device security capabilities using Microsoft Intune and associated security baselines.
* Define integrations across Microsoft security services, Azure, on-premises platforms, third-party security technologies, and IT service management platforms.

Security Architecture and Consulting
  
  

* Lead cybersecurity architecture assessments, advisory engagements, and transformation programs.
* Design enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles and customer business objectives.
* Develop high-level designs, low-level designs, reference architectures, security roadmaps, and implementation patterns.
* Assess customer security posture and translate security gaps into clear business and technology risks.
* Design identity, endpoint, cloud, network, data protection, and security operations capabilities.
* Advise technical and executive stakeholders on cyber strategy, governance, risk, and compliance.
* Align recommendations with relevant frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and customer regulatory obligations.

Pre-Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support account and sales teams in customer pursuits and strategic opportunities.
* Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture reviews, and solution demonstrations.
* Develop Statements of Work, proposals, solution designs, assumptions, dependencies, effort estimates, and delivery approaches.
* Present proposed architectures and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.
* Identify opportunities for advisory, implementation, optimization, and recurring managed security services.

Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Provide architectural leadership from discovery through design, implementation, transition, and operational acceptance.
* Govern solution quality and confirm that delivery remains aligned with approved architecture and customer requirements.
* Manage technical risks, architectural decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and design exceptions.
* Review customer implementations and recommend improvements that increase security value and reduce risk.
* Mentor consultants, engineers, and junior architects, and contribute to practice capability development.

Service Innovation and Thought Leadership
  
  

* Create reusable reference architectures, delivery accelerators, templates, workshops, and technical enablement materials.
* Contribute field insight to Fujitsu cybersecurity service development and continuous improvement.
* Produce whitepapers, blogs, webinars, executive briefings, and other thought-leadership content.
* Stay current with Microsoft security, cloud infrastructure, AI security, regulatory developments, and industry good practice.

**Required Skills And Experience**
Technical Expertise
  
  
**Identity and Access Management:**
Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection, PIM/PAM, identity governance, SSO, and federation.
  
  
**Security Operations:**
Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, SOAR, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, security monitoring, and analytics.
  
  
**Microsoft Defender Suite:**
Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Office 365, and vulnerability management.
  
  
**Cloud and Platform Security:**
Microsoft Azure security, CSPM, workload protection, hybrid security architecture, and integration with third-party platforms.
  
  
**Data Security and Compliance:**
Microsoft Purview, Information Protection, DLP, data governance, and compliance management.
  
  
**Architecture and Risk:**
Security principles, enterprise architecture, threat modelling, risk management, control design, and security governance.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
Mandatory
  
  

* 10+ years of cybersecurity experience.
* 5+ years of Microsoft security architecture or engineering experience.
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise security architectures and leading customer-facing consulting engagements.
* Experience developing SOWs, proposals, solution designs, delivery estimates, and technical presentations.
* Ability to communicate security gaps and associated business risks to executives.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, lead multidisciplinary teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes on time and within agreed scope.
* Flexibility to support customers remotely and on-site; travel may be required based on engagement needs.

**Preferred**

* Experience in MSSP, MDR, SOC transformation, security advisory, cloud transformation, or global delivery environments.
* Exposure to OT/IoT security, AI security, enterprise architecture, and security service development.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Google Cloud, VMware, and hybrid infrastructure security.
* Experience collaborating with Microsoft sellers, partner teams, and customer technical stakeholders.

Certifications
  
  
Required or Expected
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), or willingness to achieve an agreed Microsoft security certification within six months of joining.
* One or more role-aligned Microsoft certifications such as SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, or equivalent.

**Preferred**

* CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC, SABSA, TOGAF, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Postgraduate qualification in cybersecurity, technology, or business is advantageous.

Success Measures
  
  

* Customer satisfaction and demonstrable security outcomes.
* Quality, practicality, and governance of security architectures and designs.
* Successful delivery of Microsoft security transformation engagements.
* Contribution to pipeline, proposals, and recurring security services.
* Creation and adoption of reusable intellectual property and delivery accelerators.
* Mentoring, knowledge sharing, and growth of Fujitsu security capability.

title: GMS-Senior-SAP Security IAM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Security, GRC Access Control and Identity Management Specialist**
**Professional Job Description For Modern SAP Landscapes**
Scope: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BW and integrated SAP platforms
  
  
**Role Type**
: SAP Security, GRC, IDM and Access Governance
  
  
**Seniority**
: Senior Analyst / Consultant / Specialist / Lead, depending on experience
  
  
**Primary Focus**
: User access management, role lifecycle, GRC operations, IDM provisioning, risk ruleset management, audits and access reviews
  
  
**Landscape**
: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.
  
  
**Key Accountability Areas**
**Area - Expected Ownership**

* SAP User Access Management : Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.
* SAP Role Management : Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.
* SAP GRC Access Control : Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.
* SAP GRC Process Control : Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.
* SAP IDM : Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.
* Access Reviews and Audits : Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.
* Risk Ruleset Management : Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.
* SAP Native Security : Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* SAP User Access Management

+ Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
+ Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
+ Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
+ Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
+ Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.

* SAP Role Management

+ Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
+ Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
+ Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
+ Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
+ Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.

* SAP GRC Access Control Management

+ Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
+ Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
+ Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
+ Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
+ Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.

* SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management

+ Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
+ Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
+ Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
+ Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
+ Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.

* SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management

+ Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
+ Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
+ Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
+ Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
+ Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.

* SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews

+ Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
+ Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
+ Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
+ Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
+ Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.

* SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates

+ Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
+ Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
+ Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
+ Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
+ Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.

* SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management

+ Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
+ Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
+ Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
+ Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
+ Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.

* Country Rollouts and Release Support

+ Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
+ Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
+ Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
+ Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
+ Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.

* SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support

+ Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
+ Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
+ Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
+ Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
+ Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

**SAP Application Scope**

* SAP S/4HANA on RISE / Private Cloud Edition
* SAP GRC Access Control
* SAP GRC Process Control
* SAP IDM
* SAP BTP
* SAP Ariba
* SAP SuccessFactors
* SAP BW / BW4HANA
* SAP Fiori Launchpad
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS / IPS, where applicable
* Integrated non-SAP systems connected to SAP access governance

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC Access Control and SAP user administration.
* Experience in SAP role design, role build, UAT support, transport movement and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of SAP GRC ARA, EAM, ARM and risk ruleset management.
* Experience with SAP Firefighter ID management, log review and emergency access governance.
* Experience implementing and operating SAP user access reviews and quarterly access certification processes.
* Experience with SAP IDM provisioning, workflows, connectors and identity lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA security, Fiori security, authorization objects and business role concepts.
* Understanding of SAP GRC Process Control and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Experience supporting SAP internal audits, external audits, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, evidence management and issue resolution skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA on RISE or hybrid SAP cloud landscapes.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security, role collections, identity provider integration and cloud authorization concepts.
* Experience with SAP Ariba and SAP SuccessFactors access governance.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services, IAS, IPS, SAP IAG or Microsoft Entra ID integration.
* Awareness of cross-application SoD risks across SAP and cloud applications.
* Experience in global SAP template rollouts and country-specific security deployments.
* Knowledge of SOX, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001 or internal control frameworks.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**About The Role**

You will combine security architecture consulting with hands-on participation in Proof of Concept (POC) and Proof of Value (POV) activities. Working with Senior Managers, security architects, enterprise architects, engineering teams, and technology vendors, you will translate security requirements into practical designs, validate security controls, assess emerging technologies, and develop evidence-based recommendations.

* Support security architecture and solution-design reviews across cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, identity, network, and AI domains. Translate business and technology requirements into security requirements, architecture patterns, control recommendations, and practical solution designs.

Assess controls covering IAM, privileged access, workload/service identities, segmentation, encryption, secrets, logging, monitoring, and data protection.
* Plan and execute cybersecurity POCs/POVs by defining use cases, scope, success criteria, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, required integrations, data flows, identities, connectivity, and security controls.

Validate vendor capabilities against requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, collect objective evidence, and document gaps, limitations, dependencies, risks, and recommendations.
* Develop architecture and data-flow diagrams, security-control mappings, test cases, technical assessments, reusable security architecture patterns, assessment checklists, and POC/POV documentation. Contribute to final reports and leadership presentations and provide status updates on technical issues, dependencies, actions, and risks.

Embrace Cognizant’s culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build relationships.
  
  
What you must have to be considered
  
  

* 6–9 years of experience in information/cybersecurity, with practical exposure to security architecture, solution design, security engineering, or consulting.
* Hands-on experience participating in and delivering cybersecurity POCs/POVs, technology evaluations, or pilots.
* Good understanding of enterprise security architecture principles and secure-by-design practices.
* Practical knowledge across multiple security domains such as IAM, cloud security, network security, application/API security, data security, or security operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, data flows, APIs, and technology integration patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to technical detail.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical security concepts.
* A strong sense of ownership and commitment to creating meaningful outcomes, consistent with the corporate template’s required attributes.

These will help you succeed
  
  

* Experience supporting cloud and hybrid security assessments.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, privileged access, and workload/service identity security.
* Understanding of network security, segmentation, and Zero Trust principles.
* Knowledge of application/API security, data security, encryption, DLP, security monitoring, and logging.
* Experience with third-party technology and security assessments.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI security assessments, including identity, data protection, model/API security, agent/tool security, and governance controls.
* Experience with threat modelling, security-control validation, architecture assurance, and design reviews.
* Ability to develop clear technical assessments and evidence-based recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Work model
  
  
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a
**hybrid position open to qualified applicants anywhere in India**
.
  
  
Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on the project as well as business and client requirements.

title: Lead, Penetration Testing
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking talented and motivated individuals for the role of Senior Manager / Lead Penetration Testing. Provide deep, hands-on penetration testing expertise for Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), blockchain, smart contract and API-based solutions. The role independently identifies exploitable security weaknesses, translates technical findings into business risk, and works closely with developers, architects, platform teams and security stakeholders to remediate issues. The role also brings current cyber-security and blockchain industry insight, uses AI-assisted security testing responsibly, applies extensive Java engineering skills to build security and QA automation frameworks, helps QA teams accelerate maintainable test automation, and includes the wider team in technical decisions through evidence-based recommendations and recognised best practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Technical Leadership**

* Act as a senior individual contributor and subject-matter expert for penetration testing across smart contracts, APIs, web applications, blockchain platforms and supporting infrastructure.
* Define risk-based penetration-test approaches covering black-box, grey-box and authenticated testing, aligned to system criticality, threat models and regulatory expectations.
* Maintain deep awareness of emerging cyber threats, blockchain vulnerabilities, attack techniques, defensive controls and relevant industry developments.
* Assess new tools and testing techniques, including AI-assisted approaches, and recommend adoption based on effectiveness, safety, explainability and control requirements.
* Bring engineers, security specialists and relevant team members into technical decisions, clearly presenting options, evidence, trade-offs and recommended practices.

**Security Testing and Assurance**

* Plan and execute end-to-end penetration testing of smart contracts, REST and event-driven APIs, web services, microservices, blockchain nodes, wallets, key-management integrations and supporting cloud or container platforms.
* Conduct manual and automated smart contract security testing, including source-code review, static and dynamic analysis, fuzzing, invariant testing and, where appropriate, formal-verification techniques.
* Use smart contract security tools hands-on, including Slither for static analysis, Mythril and Manticore for symbolic execution, Foundry and Echidna for fuzzing and invariant testing, and Certora for formal verification, selecting tools according to the assurance objective and validating all outputs manually.
* Create and maintain custom Slither detectors, Foundry test suites, Echidna properties and reusable smart contract security test harnesses where standard rules are insufficient.
* Test for blockchain-specific weaknesses such as reentrancy, access-control failures, oracle manipulation, front-running or MEV exposure, flash-loan abuse, unchecked external calls, upgradeability weaknesses, denial of service and cross-chain trust failures.
* Perform API testing covering authentication and authorisation, object-level and function-level access controls, token and session handling, input validation, injection, rate limiting, business-logic abuse, sensitive-data exposure and service-to-service trust.
* Assess common application, network and platform weaknesses using manual exploitation and appropriate tooling, while ensuring testing is authorised, controlled and non-disruptive.
* Validate identified weaknesses, establish realistic attack paths and distinguish exploitable risk from tool-generated noise or false positives. ge and efficiency without weakening professional judgement or accountability.

**AI-assisted Penetration Testing**

* Use approved AI-enabled security tools to accelerate attack-surface discovery, test-case generation, code and smart-contract review, payload variation, evidence analysis and report preparation.
* Apply human validation to all AI-generated findings and recommendations; protect confidential information and ensure use remains within authorised testing scope and organisational policy.
* Explore how adversaries may use AI to find, chain or exploit weaknesses, and incorporate relevant scenarios into controlled security assessments.
* Develop repeatable automation and AI-assisted workflows that improve coverage and efficiency without weakening professional judgement or accountability.

**Java Engineering and Automation Development**

* Demonstrate extensive hands-on coding experience in Java, including strong knowledge of object-oriented design, collections, concurrency, exception handling, secure coding, dependency management, unit testing and reusable framework design.
* Design and develop maintainable Java-based penetration-testing and QA automation utilities, libraries and frameworks for API, integration, regression and security testing.
* Build API automation using Java with REST Assured or equivalent frameworks, including authentication, request construction, schema and payload validation, negative testing, response assertions and test-data management.
* Develop UI automation using Java with Selenium or equivalent approved frameworks, applying Page Object Model, reusable components, robust waits, stable locators and parallel execution patterns.
* Use Java testing ecosystems such as JUnit or TestNG, Maven or Gradle, Cucumber, mock frameworks and reporting libraries, and integrate automated suites with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Review Java automation code for security, maintainability, test reliability, performance and reuse; coach QA engineers on coding practices, debugging and framework extension.

**Responsibilities**
**AI-enabled QA Automation and Enablement**

* Demonstrate extensive practical experience using approved generative-AI and coding-assistant tools to accelerate the design, creation, review and maintenance of automated test cases.
* Partner with QA engineers to identify automation opportunities and convert requirements, acceptance criteria, user journeys and API specifications into reusable positive, negative, boundary, regression and security test scenarios.
* Help QA teams select and apply fit-for-purpose tools, patterns and frameworks for UI, API, contract, integration and regression automation, while avoiding unnecessary tool proliferation.
* Create reference implementations, reusable prompts, templates, utilities and coding standards that enable QA engineers to develop automation faster and consistently.
* Provide hands-on guidance using enterprise-approved AI coding assistants with frameworks such as Playwright or Selenium for UI testing; Postman/Newman, REST Assured or Karate for API automation; and Cucumber for behaviour-driven test design.
* Use AI to assist with test-case generation, test-data creation, script scaffolding, locator and assertion recommendations, failure analysis, defect summaries and maintenance suggestions, subject to human review and validation.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, define quality gates and reporting, and ensure generated tests are traceable to requirements, deterministic, maintainable and suitable for regulated environments.
* Coach QA and development teams on responsible AI usage, including data confidentiality, prompt hygiene, secure coding, intellectual-property considerations and verification of generated outputs.

Remediation and Engineering Partnership
  
  

* Work directly with developers, DevSecOps, architects, product owners and platform teams to explain root cause, exploitation paths, business impact and practical remediation options.
* Provide secure design and coding recommendations for Solidity, APIs, identity, cryptography, secrets, wallets, blockchain integrations and distributed-system trust boundaries.
* Retest fixes, verify closure and identify residual risk, compensating controls or remediation dependencies.
* Contribute security test cases and controls to CI/CD pipelines and support shift-left security through threat modelling, design review and developer enablement.
* Produce concise, threat-based reports for technical and senior audiences, with reproducible evidence, severity rationale, remediation ownership and prioritisation.

**Skills And Experience**
Extensive hands-on black-box, grey-box and authenticated penetration testing across applications, APIs, networks and cloud-native platforms; ability to validate exploitability, attack paths and business impact.
  
  
Hands-on audits of Solidity/EVM smart contracts; identify reentrancy, access-control, oracle, front-running/MEV, flash-loan, upgradeability, cross-chain and business-logic weaknesses.
  
  
Extensive Java coding for reusable security and QA automation frameworks. Working proficiency in Python and JavaScript for tooling, test automation and blockchain/API testing.
  
  
Design, develop, review and maintain reliable automated test suites; reusable framework design; positive, negative, boundary, regression and security cases; debugging and code review.
  
  
Strong RESTful API testing methodology; authentication/authorisation, schema/payload validation, negative testing, business logic, rate limits and service-to-service trust.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Extensive use of approved AI coding assistants to accelerate test design, script generation, test data, assertions and failure analysis; validate outputs with human oversight and protect confidential data.
  
  
Validate transaction processing, consensus/finality assumptions, node behaviour, wallet functionality, cryptographic protocols, smart-contract invariants and deterministic behaviour where AI components interact with DLT.
  
  
Strong manual-testing methods; create comprehensive, traceable test strategies, plans, scenarios, cases and evidence; apply risk-based and exploratory testing.
  
  
Integrate security and functional automation into pipelines; define quality gates, execution reporting, deterministic runs and defect traceability.
  
  
Strong SQL, complex query development and database testing across transactional and integration flows.
  
  
Apply threat modelling and current application, API and smart-contract security standards; remain current on cyber, blockchain and DLT threats.
  
  
Work directly with developers, QA, DevSecOps and architects to explain root cause, recommend fixes, retest closure and communicate residual risk to technical and senior audiences.
  
  
Relevant hands-on blockchain/DLT or digital-assets industry experience; senior individual contributor who includes the team in decisions and provides evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
  
  
Design and execute load, stress and endurance tests; analyse results and isolate application, database, infrastructure or integration bottlenecks.
  
  
Practical familiarity with blockchain development, testing libraries, local networks, oracle integration and blockchain APIs.
  
  
Develop custom Slither detectors, fuzz properties, invariant suites and formal specifications for critical controls and accounting logic.
  
  
Use platform and observability tools to investigate failures, validate runtime behaviour and support DevSecOps testing.
  
  
Test model-output quality, consistency, safety and real-time behaviour in decentralised workflows; assess how non-deterministic AI outputs are controlled before deterministic smart-contract execution.
  
  
Understanding of permissioned and public DLT, DeFi, tokenisation, Layer 2, cross-chain architectures, DAOs and NFTs.
  
  
Practical offensive-security or application-security certification, supplemented by demonstrable hands-on capability.
  
  
Ability to learn new languages, tools and frameworks, share knowledge and support multi-skilling within an agile scrum team.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Do you want to build secure, scalable cloud controls that protect a large Azure-managed environment while enabling customer-facing teams to move quickly?
  
  
The Azure Managed Environment team provides governed Azure tenants and subscriptions for customer demonstrations, proofs of concept, support engineering, and other non-production scenarios. The service applies centralized policy, monitoring, automated remediation, lifecycle governance, and cost controls to reduce production-tenant exposure, limit shadow IT, and preserve delivery agility.
  
  
We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, build, and operate automated control solutions that enforce security and governance requirements across this environment. You will translate SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and business requirements into scalable policies, automations, telemetry, and remediation workflows.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role that combines software engineering, cloud security, operational judgment, and cross-functional leadership. You will partner with security architects, service owners, support teams, and business stakeholders to improve control effectiveness, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the resilience of the managed environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Engineer cloud controls: Design and develop reusable Azure Policy definitions, policy initiatives, automation, and remediation workflows that enforce security and governance requirements across managed tenants and subscriptions.
* Lead control implementation: Assess new SFI, Azure Tenant Baseline, Entra, privacy, and internal control requirements; determine affected resources and control gaps; and lead architecture, implementation, validation, and rollout.
* Build compliance by design: Embed secure defaults, configuration standards, monitoring, and automated remediation into provisioning and lifecycle processes so compliance is consistent and scalable.
* Own engineering quality: Establish design standards, code-review practices, testing, release controls, documentation, and operational readiness for cloud-control solutions.
* Improve detection and remediation: Use telemetry, execution logs, and control-effectiveness measures to identify failures, tune enforcement, reduce false positives, and accelerate risk reduction.
* Advance lifecycle and cost governance: Engineer solutions for tenant and subscription provisioning, renewal, decommissioning, ownership hygiene, resource governance, allowance management, and cost optimization.
* Automate repeatable operations: Replace manual processes and one-off scripts with durable services, APIs, pipelines, and AI-enabled engineering approaches where appropriate.
* Support operational resilience: Provide engineering leadership during complex incidents and escalations, perform root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Partner across functions: Work with service owners, security and privacy teams, platform engineering, finance, support, and business stakeholders to align requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers, communicate design and risk tradeoffs clearly, and influence decisions without relying on direct authority.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience using one or more general-purpose languages, scripting languages, or infrastructure-as-code technologies; OR a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and 1+ years of relevant experience; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience leading AI-powered transformation initiatives, including the implementation of agentic workflows, automation, and data-driven solutions at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with AI governance, risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value.
* Experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production-quality cloud services, automation, or platform engineering solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Policy, Azure Resource Manager, identity and access management, monitoring, or subscription and tenant governance.
* Understanding of secure software development, cloud security controls, least privilege, configuration management, and automated compliance.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues, use telemetry to drive decisions, and lead remediation across multiple teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and risk tradeoffs to engineering and business audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C#, Python, PowerShell, TypeScript, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps or GitHub pipelines, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience building Azure Policy definitions and initiatives, policy-as-code solutions, automated remediation, compliance dashboards, or control-evidence pipelines.
* Knowledge of Azure landing zones, management groups, subscriptions, Entra ID, role-based access control, resource lifecycle management, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience operating services at enterprise scale, including incident response, root-cause analysis, health service monitoring, and reliability improvement.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to engineering productivity, operations, detection, or remediation.
* Relevant Azure, security, DevOps, or cloud architecture certification.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
