title: Senior Software Engineer (Security Domain)
description:
**Job Summary**
Join the Security Engineering team as Senior Software Engineer and help secure NetApp's flagship storage operating system, ONTAP. As a Cybersecurity Development Engineer, you will design, develop, and enhance security capabilities that protect critical customer data across enterprise, cloud, and AI environments.
  
  
You will work on technologies spanning authentication, authorization, encryption, key management, secure communications, vulnerability mitigation, and security hardening. You will collaborate closely with kernel, networking, cloud, storage, and product security teams to build secure-by-design solutions while helping ONTAP meet evolving regulatory and customer security requirements.
  
  
This role combines deep systems software engineering with modern cybersecurity practices, including vulnerability discovery, threat modeling, secure development, incident response support, and AI-assisted security analysis.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
**Design And Develop Security Features Including**

* Authentication and authorization
* RBAC and privilege management
* TLS/mTLS and secure communications
* IPsec and secure networking
* PKI and certificate management
* Encryption and key management
* Data-at-rest and data-in-transit protection
* Cryptographic services
* Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, and attack-tree analysis for administrative operations, credential paths, and role boundaries.
* Translate security findings and threat models into product requirements, actionable test plans, and automated security tests.
* Investigate vulnerabilities affecting ONTAP and third-party components; assess exploitability and customer impact; and drive remediation, validation, release readiness, and regression test coverage.
* Develop AI-assisted security automation for vulnerability discovery, triage, detection, validation, remediation, suspicious-behavior investigation, and security response.
* Partner with Product Security and PSIRT teams to improve security assessment workflows and respond to customer-reported vulnerabilities, security disclosures, emerging threats, and technical escalations.
* Support compliance and certification programs including FIPS 140-3, Common Criteria, NIST security standards, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
* Translate regulatory and security requirements into product capabilities, engineering controls, security evidence, and release criteria.
* Participate in customer security reviews and incident response activities.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python.
* Solid knowledge of:

+ Operating systems
+ Computer architecture
+ Data structures and algorithms
+ Networking fundamentals
+ Concurrency and multithreaded programming

* Experience with security assessment methodologies and tools, including static and dynamic analysis, fuzzing, dependency analysis, and CVE triage.
* Experience conducting red-team, offensive security, vulnerability research, or security assessment activities on systems or products, including documenting findings, evaluating risk, and providing actionable remediation guidance.
* Proven experience building security automation, vulnerability assessment workflows, or automated security test frameworks.
* Strong debugging skills using tools such as GDB, DTrace, packet analyzers, and Linux/Unix development tools.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas:

+ Authentication and identity management, including Kerberos
+ TLS/mTLS and IPsec
+ PKI, cryptography, and key management
+ OpenSSL, OpenSSH, and StrongSwan
+ FIPS 140-3 and Common Criteria
+ Post-Quantum Cryptography
+ OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, and STRIDE
+ Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDL)
+ Storage, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure
+ Ability to solve complex technical problems independently.

* Proven ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines, including systems, networking, storage, cloud, and product security teams.

**Ideal Candidate**

* Security-focused systems engineer passionate about protecting customer data.
* Comfortable working across storage, networking, operating systems, distributed systems, and cybersecurity domains.
* Self-motivated, curious, and driven to solve complex technical challenges.
* Excited to shape the future of ONTAP Security through innovation, automation, and secure-by-design principles.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field and 5+ years of relevant experience; or
* Master's degree and 8+ years of relevant experience; or
* Equivalent combination of education and industry experience.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst
description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**

**Senior Information Security Analyst – Service Delivery Management**  
  
**REPORTING TO: IT Security Coordinator**  
**REPORTING LOCATION: Bangalore**  
**WORKING LOCATION: Bangalore**  
**SHIFT TIMINGS: 12PM - 9PM IST**  
**MODE OF WORK: Hybrid**

**SUMMARY OF ROLE AND OBJECTIVES:**

The Service Delivery Management, Metrics & Onboardings crew actively participates in managing the delivery of the Security Services to internal service consumers.

The Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management, Metrics & Onboardings) is responsible for service management activities for assigned service consumer base, acting as the SPOC (Single Point of Contact) between the service consumers and the Eurofins Group Security, resulting in positive customer satisfaction.

From operational perspective, the Information Security Analyst is responsible for the health of security services for internal service consumers.

**ROLE & OBJECTIVES**:

**Specific Assignments:**

The main responsibilities of an Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management, Metrics & Onboardings)

Role responsibilities:

* Run all Service Delivery processes and ITSM processes in Security Operations as defined by the Group.
* Manage and/or oversee the overall Security Services onboarding program for Zones and non-integrated ELEs, including but not limited to set deployment expectations, build project timeline, Onboarding resources management, stream communication across different stakeholders, monitor and report progress, and propose roadblock removal strategies so a compliance metric for a minimum of 95% of all Security Toolset coverage is achieved for all technologies in scope (100% for SIEM).
* Ensure Security Services are fit for purpose, carrying out relevant reviews/propose modifications as necessary.
* Conduct Security Service Review sessions with service consumers and stakeholders with special attention to Onboarding, Security Toolset compliance and Security Service Dashboards.
* Cooperate with internal Security teams and other Security actors to further develop Security Operations.
* Report SLA, KPI and performance metrics of Security Services, steer activities as per metrics defined in the Service card.
* Make sure definition of improvement plans to meet SLA and KPI are in place.
* Assess and report the level of compliance for each ELE/ZONE; and ensure there is a defined plan to reach the target as defined in the TSFs.
* Coordinate the work provided and service delivered by the security partners.
* Prepare and publish the report to stakeholders including Local IT Management and Information Security Management.
* Ensure that all Security documentation for Internal/External service consumers are available and updated.
* Help in the development of processes and procedures required for the delivery of the Security Services.
* Provide a clear and regular update to service consumers on action items, including proposed actions and dates to closure.
* Receive and coordinate reporting requests, assisting with high level design of reports where required.
* Provide Security Services expectations to align the stakeholders and service consumers.

Other Assignments:

* Overall accountability for transition success building best practices for the service management community.
* Build, manage and maintain a trusted relationship with all Security actors and service consumers both internally and externally.
* Organizing and Leading Service Delivery sessions including incident review, problem resolution, etc.
* Leverage the most effective and efficient service from the delivery teams for each assigned service consumer.
* Receive and coordinate consumer reported bugs/issues with internal Security Team.
* Maintain/track service consumers contact and organization details.
* Produce consistent, high quality service reviews on a monthly basis that demonstrate quality and continuous improvement.
* Escalation point for internal teams for unresponsive service consumers.
* Provide feedback to the Service Owner
* Supports the Lead Information Security Consultant and the associate Director in day-to-day activities.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**

Education and Certifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field. **(required)**
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Security +, CISM, or similar credentials are preferred.

Professional Experience:

* Minimum of 3+ years of experience in IT service delivery.
* Demonstrated experience working in a security-focused organization or environment.
* Proven track record in managing and improving service delivery processes, ensuring alignment with SLAs and business objectives.

Technical Skills:

* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network security, and cybersecurity principles.
* Proficiency in security frameworks such as ISO 27001, GPDR, HIPPA and other information security standards.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their associated security services.

Communication:

* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships across teams and regions.
* Strong conflict resolution ability.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey complex security concepts to non-technical audiences.

Problem-Solving and Strategic Thinking:

* Expertise in identifying, analyzing, and resolving complex service delivery issues in a timely manner.
* Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities with the ability to plan and execute long-term strategies.

Other Requirements:

* Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Willingness to travel and support global teams when necessary.
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on evolving security threats and technologies.
* Languages: fluent English.

  
**Qualifications**

DLP Triage & Processing · Own the end-to-end triage lifecycle for DLP alerts across endpoints, cloud environments (M365, Google Workspace, AWS), and email — from initial alert review through disposition and escalation. · Classify and prioritize incidents by sensitivity, intent, and potential business impact; apply consistent triage frameworks to ensure efficient and defensible case handling. · Identify policy gaps, false-positive patterns, and emerging exfiltration vectors; recommend DLP policy refinements to reduce risk while minimizing friction for legitimate business activities. · Maintain accurate, timely case records in the case management system, ensuring chain-of-custody integrity for all evidence. Investigations · Lead and conduct end-to-end investigations of potential insider risk incidents — including IP theft, data exfiltration, policy violations, sabotage, and pre-departure data staging. · Collect, preserve, and analyze digital evidence from endpoint forensics, cloud storage, communication platforms, and HR systems in accordance with legal and evidentiary standards. · Produce comprehensive, well-structured investigation reports documenting findings, timelines, impact assessments, and recommended actions suitable for legal, HR, and executive audiences. · Manage multiple concurrent active investigations with rigor, discretion, and appropriate urgency. Subject Interviews · Plan and conduct structured subject interviews in coordination with Legal, HR, and business leadership — applying established interview methodologies tailored to insider risk contexts (e.g., cognitive interviewing, motivational interviewing). · Conduct witness interviews to gather corroborating information and context; document findings with accuracy and impartiality. · Maintain composure and objectivity in sensitive, adversarial, or emotionally charged interview settings; protect subject dignity while gathering actionable intelligence. Legal Collaboration & Case Adjudication · Partner closely with Legal and Employment Law to ensure investigations comply with applicable labor laws, privacy regulations, and evidentiary standards across all operating jurisdictions (U.S., India, Israel, EU, and Asia-Pacific). · Present investigation findings, evidence packages, and risk assessments to Legal and HR for case adjudication — including decisions on disciplinary action, civil litigation, criminal referral, or administrative closure. · Support the preparation of materials for regulatory inquiries, litigation holds, and law enforcement cooperation when required. · Track and document case dispositions and lessons learned to continuously improve program policy and legal defensibility. Threat Intelligence & Risk Program Development · Develop and maintain an insider threat intelligence capability — tracking threat actor TTPs relevant to the semiconductor industry, including economic espionage, nation-state recruitment, and supply chain manipulation. · Produce threat intelligence products (briefings, advisories, risk reports) for security leadership, HR, and business unit heads to inform enterprise risk decisions. · Monitor the external threat landscape, including geopolitical developments, export control changes, and industry-specific threat reporting from CISA, FBI, and

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Skill Requirement :** Required · 7+ years of progressive experience in insider threat, corporate investigations, counterintelligence, digital forensics, or a closely related security discipline. · Demonstrated expertise with DLP platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Symantec DLP, Forcepoint, Zscaler) including policy tuning, triage workflows, and incident adjudication. · Proficiency with SIEM platforms (XSIAM, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or equivalent) and UEBA/UAM tools for behavioral analysis and anomaly detection. · Hands-on experience conducting complex civil or corporate investigations — from initial tip through evidence collection, interviews, reporting, and legal referral. · Experience conducting structured subject interviews and witness interviews in a corporate or law enforcement context. · Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Legal, HR, IT, and senior leadership in a highly confidential environment. · Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical audiences. · Demonstrated knowledge of applicable privacy and employment laws across multiple jurisdictions (particularly U.S., EU GDPR, and Asia-Pacific regimes). · Hands-on experience operating AI-powered insider risk or UEBA platforms — including use case configuration, cohort/module development, and risk score tuning — with a clear understanding of how AI-assisted detection outputs translate into investigation workflows. Preferred · Prior experience in the semiconductor, defense technology, or critical technology sectors with heightened awareness of IP protection. · Experience in or with federal law enforcement, intelligence community, or military counterintelligence. · Background in threat intelligence production (STIX/TAXII, indicator management, adversary TTP analysis). · Familiarity with digital forensic tools (EnCase, FTK, Cellebrite, or equivalent) and e-discovery platforms. · Experience with SOAR platforms and automation of investigation workflows. · Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK; for Enterprise and Insider Threat frameworks. · Experience using generative AI / LLM tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate investigative analysis, summarize case evidence, draft reports, or build detection logic. · Familiarity with the ethical, legal, and governance considerations of deploying AI in a workforce monitoring context, including explainability requirements and bias mitigation. Education & Certifications · Bachelor\'s degree in Cybersecurity, Criminal Justice, Intelligence Studies, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree a plus. · Relevant professional certifications valued: CISSP, CISM, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CFCE, EnCE, CCITP (CERT Insider Threat Professional), or equivalent.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Other Requirement :** You think like an investigator AND a data analyst — equally comfortable in a boardroom briefing and deep in SIEM query language. You harness AI as a force multiplier — you know how to configure detection use cases, build meaningful cohorts, and tune behavioral modules without losing sight of the human judgment that makes investigations defensible. You operate with impeccable judgment and discretion — you understand that access to sensitive data and AI-assisted monitoring is a privilege with strict ethical obligations. You are proactive, not reactive — you identify and reduce risk before incidents occur. You build trust across organizational boundaries — Legal trusts your evidence, HR trusts your process, and business leaders trust your judgment. You thrive in ambiguity and complexity — insider risk rarely comes neatly packaged, and you know how to structure uncertainty into defensible conclusions.

title: Guidewire Architect
description:

Professional Services at Guidewire partners with P&C insurers worldwide to implement, modernize, and optimize their core platforms, with a strong focus on cloud adoption and AI-enabled delivery. As a Guidewire Architect focused on PolicyCenter, you will define and own the end-to-end technical architecture for complex, often greenfield implementations across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead critical design decisions, and ensure solutions meet demanding performance, scalability, and security needs.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on expert who enjoys solving complex business problems, shaping implementation strategy, and accelerating our customers’ path to value while contributing to Professional Services’ mission to cut implementation effort and time through AI and automation.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Define and own the technical architecture, design standards, and implementation roadmap for Guidewire PolicyCenter across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid deployments, aligning with customer enterprise architectures and Guidewire best practices.
* Lead end-to-end PolicyCenter configuration and customization, including Gosu development, PCF/UI design, data model extensions, underwriting rules, workflows, and plugins, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to business needs.
* Architect and oversee complex integrations between PolicyCenter and enterprise systems (billing, CRM, data warehouses, external partners, document management, and third-party services) using APIs, web services, and messaging patterns.

* Collaborate closely with business analysts and customer stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable architectures and non-functional designs covering performance, availability, security, and disaster recovery.
* Champion Professional Services priorities by leveraging AI and automation to reduce implementation effort and time, support cloud migration and adoption, and help industrialize repeatable, high-quality delivery patterns across projects.
* Contribute to organizational assets such as accelerators, reference architectures, and technical white papers, and lead knowledge-sharing to uplift Guidewire and partner teams globally.
* At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI—empowering our teams to continuously leverage emerging technologies and data-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

**Required**

* 10–18 years of hands-on experience with Guidewire PolicyCenter, including at least two greenfield PolicyCenter implementations.
* Guidewire Certified ACE for PolicyCenter Configuration, with deep knowledge of PolicyCenter UI, data model, Studio, and out-of-the-box features and accelerators.
* Strong experience with Gosu, PCF, entities, typelists, rules, workflows, plugins, and configuration for new personal and commercial lines of business.
* Proven track record architecting and delivering complex integrations using RESTful APIs, web services, messaging, and related technologies (e.g., Apache Camel, Bitbucket, IntelliJ).
* Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, performance optimization, security best practices, and non-functional requirements design for mission-critical systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and to work in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Flexibility to collaborate across time zones and shifts when needed to support customers and global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your current role as well as data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.
  

  

**Preferred**

* Experience with Guidewire Cloud (PolicyCenter on Guidewire Cloud Platform), including cloud-native patterns, observability, and CI/CD practices.
* Background leading architecture on multiple PolicyCenter cloud or upgrade programs, especially those leveraging AI-enabled tools or automation to reduce implementation effort.
* Familiarity with other Guidewire products (ClaimCenter, BillingCenter, Analytics, or Data Platform) and with modern microservices or event-driven architectures.
* BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Your Impact**
---------------

We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first six months, you will take architectural ownership of one or more complex PolicyCenter implementations, aligning solution designs with customer business objectives while embedding Professional Services’ priorities around AI-enabled, faster, and more predictable delivery.

  
  

You will define technical roadmaps, guide teams through critical design and integration decisions, and put in place patterns and assets that measurably reduce implementation effort and time for future projects. As your influence grows, you will help customers fully leverage Guidewire’s cloud and AI platform, directly supporting our wider mission to transform how the world’s P&C insurers do business and advancing Guidewire’s ambition to deliver secure, scalable, and innovative solutions globally.

  
  

**What’s in it for you**
  
The people we employ give their all, and in return, we offer flexibility wherever we can, such as:
  
Flexible work environment.
  
Health and wellness benefits.
  
Paid time off programs including volunteer time off.
  
Market‑competitive pay and incentive programs.
  
Continual development and internal career growth opportunities.
  
  
All roles at Guidewire include an in‑person interview experience, and we provide an in‑person orientation for all new hires to help you build relationships and understand how your work contributes to our customers and mission.

Interested in this position?

  

**About Guidewire**

  
  

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

title: Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations
description:
Join our Global Workforce Systems team as an Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations and quickly expand your Workday knowledge through hands-on experience. You will manage JIRA tickets, process routine Workday transactions, maintain accurate employee data, and support process documentation. We are looking for someone with one to two years of Workday experience who is curious, careful, and committed to delivering accurate results.  
  
This is a regular, full-time position based in Bangalore, India and requires a work schedule that provides coverage during core U.S. business hours.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first level of review and support for HRIS and Workday requests submitted through JIRA, ensuring requests are acknowledged, assessed, and appropriately routed.
* Support the day-to-day management of the JIRA ticket queue by reviewing new tickets, prioritizing routine requests according to established guidelines, monitoring aging items, updating statuses, and following up as needed.
* Evaluate incoming tickets for completeness, urgency, business impact, dependencies, and appropriate next steps.
* Resolve routine Workday questions, requests, transactions, and data issues using established procedures and documented solutions.
* Proactively request missing information or clarification when a ticket does not contain sufficient details to investigate or complete the request accurately.
* Escalate complex, high-risk, time-sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate HRIS team member with clear documentation of the issue, troubleshooting performed, supporting information, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain complete and timely JIRA documentation, including the original request, investigation performed, actions taken, stakeholder communication, decisions, and final resolution.
* Monitor open tickets and dependencies and proactively follow up when information, approvals, testing, or action is outstanding.
* Identify tickets at risk of missing established service expectations or deadlines and escalate appropriately.
* Complete assigned routine Workday transactions and employee data updates across the employee lifecycle, according to established procedures, approval requirements, and role-based access.
* Review source documentation and validate key information, including employee names, dates, organizations, positions, statuses, and other relevant data, before completing Workday transactions.
* Perform post-transaction quality checks and follow documented validation steps to confirm that changes were processed accurately, escalating unexpected results or potential downstream impacts.
* Research employee and HRIS data discrepancies, reconcile information between source documentation and Workday, resolve routine issues, and escalate exceptions when necessary.
* Support Workday testing for system updates, enhancements, fixes, and configuration changes, including executing test scripts, validating expected results, documenting defects, and tracking issues through resolution.
* Assist with documenting and maintaining HRIS workflows and process maps, including process steps, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process guides, job aids, user instructions, FAQs, and HRIS knowledge articles to improve consistency and reduce repeat questions.
* Review existing workflows and documentation periodically to ensure they remain accurate and aligned with current Workday functionality and business processes.
* Identify recurring tickets, data issues, bottlenecks, or manual processes and share observations and potential improvement opportunities with the HRIS team.
* Support routine data audits, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain HRIS data integrity.
* Prepare, send, track, and validate manual HR notifications, ensuring communications are accurate, timely, and sent to the appropriate recipients.
* Partner collaboratively with Talent & Culture (HR), Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, IT, and other stakeholders as necessary to investigate and resolve HRIS requests.
* Handle employee and organizational data in accordance with established privacy, confidentiality, and information-security requirements.

**What You Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience supporting Workday within HR, HRIS, People Operations, Shared Services, or a similar environment.
* Hands-on experience reviewing or processing employee data and transactions in Workday.
* Experience using JIRA or a comparable ticket/case-management platform, including reviewing, assigning, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, escalating, and resolving support requests.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a ticket queue independently, balance competing priorities, and follow requests through to resolution.
* Experience creating or maintaining workflows, process documentation, SOPs, job aids, or knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information.
* A proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify outstanding actions, anticipate potential issues, and follow up without waiting for direction.
* Strong problem-solving and investigative skills with the judgment to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
* Ability to follow detailed procedures while recognizing opportunities to improve existing processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tickets, recurring responsibilities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical or process-related information in a way that is understandable to different audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams, locations, and time zones.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting Workday Core HCM and one or more related areas such as Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Talent, Absence, or other employee lifecycle functionality.
* Experience with JIRA-based HRIS support operations, including queue management, ticket prioritization, escalation, and reporting.
* Experience creating process maps and end-to-end workflow documentation.
* Experience conducting employee data audits, reconciliations, or validation activities.
* Familiarity with system-testing practices, including executing Workday test scripts, validating results, documenting defects, and supporting issue resolution.

**SAP Security, GRC Access Control and Identity Management Specialist**

Professional Job Description for Modern SAP Landscapes

Scope: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BW and integrated SAP platforms

**Role Type** : SAP Security, GRC, IDM and Access Governance

**Seniority** : Senior Analyst / Consultant / Specialist / Lead, depending on experience

**Primary Focus** : User access management, role lifecycle, GRC operations, IDM provisioning, risk ruleset management, audits and access reviews

**Landscape** : SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations

  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.

The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.

  

**Key Accountability Areas**

**Area - Expected Ownership**

* **SAP User Access Management** : Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.
* **SAP Role Management** : Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.
* **SAP GRC Access Control** : Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.
* **SAP GRC Process Control** : Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.
* **SAP IDM** : Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.
* **Access Reviews and Audits** : Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.
* **Risk Ruleset Management** : Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.
* **SAP Native Security** : Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

  

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* **SAP User Access Management**
  + Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
  + Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
  + Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
  + Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
  + Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.
* **SAP Role Management**
  + Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
  + Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
  + Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
  + Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
  + Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.
* **SAP GRC Access Control Management**
  + Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
  + Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
  + Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
  + Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
  + Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.
* **SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management**
  + Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
  + Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
  + Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
  + Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
  + Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.
* **SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management**
  + Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
  + Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
  + Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
  + Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
  + Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.
* **SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews**
  + Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
  + Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
  + Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
  + Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
  + Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.
* **SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates**
  + Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
  + Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
  + Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
  + Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
  + Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.
* **SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management**
  + Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
  + Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
  + Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
  + Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
  + Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.
* **Country Rollouts and Release Support**
  + Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
  + Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
  + Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
  + Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
  + Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.
* **SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support**
  + Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
  + Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
  + Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
  + Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
  + Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

**SAP Application Scope**

* SAP S/4HANA on RISE / Private Cloud Edition
* SAP GRC Access Control
* SAP GRC Process Control
* SAP IDM
* SAP BTP
* SAP Ariba
* SAP SuccessFactors
* SAP BW / BW4HANA
* SAP Fiori Launchpad
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS / IPS, where applicable
* Integrated non-SAP systems connected to SAP access governance

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC Access Control and SAP user administration.
* Experience in SAP role design, role build, UAT support, transport movement and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of SAP GRC ARA, EAM, ARM and risk ruleset management.
* Experience with SAP Firefighter ID management, log review and emergency access governance.
* Experience implementing and operating SAP user access reviews and quarterly access certification processes.
* Experience with SAP IDM provisioning, workflows, connectors and identity lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA security, Fiori security, authorization objects and business role concepts.
* Understanding of SAP GRC Process Control and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Experience supporting SAP internal audits, external audits, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, evidence management and issue resolution skills.

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA on RISE or hybrid SAP cloud landscapes.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security, role collections, identity provider integration and cloud authorization concepts.
* Experience with SAP Ariba and SAP SuccessFactors access governance.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services, IAS, IPS, SAP IAG or Microsoft Entra ID integration.
* Awareness of cross-application SoD risks across SAP and cloud applications.
* Experience in global SAP template rollouts and country-specific security deployments.
* Knowledge of SOX, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001 or internal control frameworks.

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst — Semiconductor IP
description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
Dover is a diversified global manufacturer with annual revenue of $8 billion. We deliver innovative equipment and components, specialty systems, consumable supplies, software and digital solutions, and support services through five operating segments: Engineered Products, Clean Energy & Fueling, Imaging & Identification, Pumps & Process Solutions and Climate & Sustainable Technologies. Dover combines global scale with operational agility to lead the markets we serve. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 60 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at dovercorporation.com.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Control & Evidence Management. Execute assigned IT compliance control activities in accordance with established methodologies and timelines. Maintain accurate control records, including test procedures, results, and evidence. Prepare clear, complete workpapers supporting conclusions, exceptions, and recommendations. Ensure traceability between controls, systems, applications, and compliance requirements. Proactively engage leadership to clarify exceptions and improve control quality. Compliance Monitoring & Issue Management, Identify control exceptions and evaluate them using defined criteria, including root cause analysis. Log and track control deficiencies and remediation actions through closure. Monitor remediation progress and follow up with control owners. Validate remediation evidence prior to issue closure. Audit & Review Support, Support audit readiness by ensuring documentation is current, complete, and aligned with expectations. Respond to audit inquiries and assist with evidence collection and clarification. Reporting & Data Quality • Support preparation of compliance reports and dashboards by ensuring data accuracy and completeness. Assist with testing GRC workflow updates related to usability, process effectiveness, and data integrity.
* 2+ years of experience working within a large audit (Big 4) or professional services company. Experience supporting IT audit, IT compliance, technology risk, or related operational roles. Direct exposure to internal or external audit processes. Bachelor’s degree in information systems, cyber security, or related field or equivalent experience. Familiarity with industry frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls). Understanding of common IT control domains (e.g, access management, change management, IT operations, etc.). • Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and organizational discipline. • Ability to follow structured documents and maintain audit-ready documentation. Experience with GRC platforms or similar compliance tracking tools preferred.
Strong execution discipline, clear documentation skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with control owners, business stakeholders, and auditors to ensure consistent / audit-ready compliance outcomes.  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

Job Title: Senior Security Engineer

Shift Timings: General Shift Role

  

Summary:

The Senior Security Engineer will lead application security engineering across the software development lifecycle. Strong hands-on SAST and DAST scanning experience is required, with primary ownership of DAST operations, SAST engineering, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation and DevSecOps enablement. The role will embed security into design and development, integrate security testing into Secure by Design (SBD), GitHub, Azure and CI/CD workflows, and work closely with development, QA, DevOps, cloud, and product teams to ensure security controls are implemented before production release.

  

Key Responsibilities:

Application Security & Secure by Design

* Embed security requirements, threat considerations, secure coding practices, and control validation across design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.
* Work directly with development teams to identify security gaps early and provide practical remediation guidance while applications are being built.
* Define and maintain security gates, minimum control requirements, exception handling, and evidence expectations for application releases. SAST, DAST & Penetration Testing - Technical Responsibilities
* Own the implementation, configuration, administration, tuning and continuous improvement of enterprise SAST and DAST capabilities.
* Configure, operate and optimize Invicti for authenticated and unauthenticated DAST scans, including scan profiles, authentication, scheduling, coverage, validation, reporting, retesting and troubleshooting.
* Perform SAST scan onboarding and configuration, validate code-level findings, analyze data flows and sources/sinks, tune rules, suppress verified false positives with evidence and provide developer-ready remediation guidance.
* Plan and execute web application, API and network-focused penetration tests using approved methodologies and tools; document reproducible evidence, risk ratings, business impact and corrective actions.
* Triage and correlate SAST, DAST and penetration-testing findings; validate exploitability, remove duplicate or false-positive results, prioritize risk and confirm closure through rescans and retesting.
* Monitor technical scan performance, including scan completion, coverage, authentication success, scan failures, false-positive rates, recurring findings, test effectiveness and remediation trends. DevSecOps, CI/CD, Azure & GitHub Security
* Integrate approved SAST and DAST controls into Secure by Design processes, GitHub repositories, pull requests, build workflows, CI/CD pipelines and release gates.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement automated security scans, quality gates, severity thresholds, break-build criteria, and risk-based exception workflows.
* Administer and monitor security controls across GitHub and Azure development environments, including code scanning, secret scanning, dependency alerts, repository security settings, pipeline findings and cloud security configurations.
* Enforce branch protection, mandatory reviews, least-privilege access, environment separation, secure secrets handling and controlled promotion to production.
* Investigate scan and integration failures and retain security evidence for release governance and audit requirements. Vulnerability Management & Remediation
* Manage the end-to-end application vulnerability lifecycle: identification, validation, prioritization, assignment, remediation tracking, retesting, closure and reporting.
* Drive SLA-based remediation with development owners, escalate overdue risks, support documented risk acceptance where justified and verify fixes through rescans or retesting.
* Maintain dashboards and metrics covering vulnerability aging, severity, closure performance, recurrence, scan coverage and application risk posture. Collaboration, Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Act as the application security partner for developers, architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product owners, cloud teams and infrastructure teams.
* Deliver secure coding guidance, developer awareness sessions, tool onboarding and knowledge-sharing based on observed vulnerability patterns.
* Contribute to application security standards, procedures, checklists, playbooks, audit evidence and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging AppSec and DevSecOps capabilities and recommend improvements that increase coverage, automation, accuracy and remediation speed.

  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum 5–8 years of hands-on cyber security experience, with strong focus on application security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management or penetration testing.

  

Required:

Strong hands-on experience implementing, configuring, operating, tuning and troubleshooting both SAST and DAST solutions in enterprise software development environments.

Hands-on experience with Invicti or a comparable enterprise DAST platform, including authenticated scanning, scan configuration, validation, tuning, reporting, troubleshooting and retesting.

* Hands-on experience integrating security scanning into GitHub pull-request workflows, Azure or equivalent cloud development environments, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Azure security concepts, GitHub security capabilities, source control governance, secrets management, and secure deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, common web and API vulnerabilities, risk methodologies. rating, remediation techniques and penetration-testing
* Ability to interpret code-level findings and collaborate with developers on remediation across at least one common language or framework.
* Experience managing remediation SLAs, exceptions, evidence, dashboards, metrics, and stakeholder reporting.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and corrective actions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Skills and Certifications
* Experience with additional SAST, SCA, container, API or cloud-native security tools.
* Exposure to tools and platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent technologies.
* Familiarity with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, software supply-chain security, SBOM practices, and compliance frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, , CEH, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent AppSec / penetration-testing credentials.

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Experience building or scaling a product function — hiring and mentoring product managers, delivery leads, or program managers.
* Familiarity with modern detection engineering concepts (behavioral analytics, ML-based detection, identity threat detection) sufficient to evaluate technical proposals critically.

title: Process Re-engineering - Payments
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Process Re-engineering - Payments.**

**In this role, you will:**

* International Organization for Standardization 20022 is a market driven mandatory, global payments directive which will migrate all payment messages from existing MT (Message Type) format into the new MX (SWIFT Message Type defined in ISO 20022) format. Additionally, as part of SWIFT International Organization for Standardization 20022 MX (SWIFT - Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication Message Type defined in ISO 20022) migration, party and agent name and address information must comply to structured format by November 2026. Payment messages that do not comply to structured format will be rejected. The scale of the programme covers over 50 sites in which Markets and Securities Services Operations have a presence and over 40 unique systems which generate payments.
* We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join the International Organization for Standardization Data workstream in delivering Structured Name and Address mandate by November 2026. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working on large-scale projects within the payments or settlements domain. This role involves extensive data analysis, requirements gathering and validation, coordinate and facilitate discussions with diverse teams across multiple geographical locations, as well as supporting testing for global rollouts.

* Perform data analysis related to payments, settlement instructions, accounts, and static data. Identify SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) / static data issue, provide remediation recommendations and/or analysis that helps to identify solutions.
* Gather, validate and document business requirements. Facilitate discussions with relevant teams across multiple geographical locations (e.g. Markets and Securities Services Technology, Markets and Securities Services Operations, Static & Reference Data teams, etc) where necessary and ensure requirements are clearly understood by delivery teams.
* Contribute to project planning and execution and ensure alignment with overall programme plan and objectives. Work with the Test Manager and Subject Matter Experts to co-ordinate the preparation of SIT (Systems Integration Testing) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) test cases.
* Work with Markets and Securities Services technology and Markets and Securities Services Operations to ensure complete and robust testing and go-live approach is supported.
* Work the International Organization for Standardization regional leads and / or Markets and Securities Services Operations to ensure business readiness is complete before go-live.
* Responsible for highlighting risks, issues and impact to project timelines to Workstream Lead / International Organization for Standardization Programme.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred.
* 8+ Years of experience in business analysis and Payments.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst in the payments or settlements domain, preferably within a large-scale project environment.
* Strong capability in handling and analyzing large datasets with attention to detail. Familiar with Business Analysis & Concepts, Process Related documentation and User Testing.
* Expertise in payments with MT (Message Type) and MX (SWIFT Message Type defined in ISO 20022) International Organization for Standardization 20022 format.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Organized individual who can manage multiple priorities with tight timelines. Excellent written communication skills to clearly and concisely present requirements in a manner appropriate to the audience.
* Proactive and self-starting and able to work autonomously on projects. Strong communicator and excellent at building relationships with peers, stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Experience and knowledge of the trade and payment lifecycle is ideal. Understanding of the Markets and Securities Services business. Understanding of the regulatory and market landscape
