Division
  
  
LCD comprises of Legal, Compliance, Global Financial Crimes and Regulatory Relations.
  
  
The Legal Department provides guidance, requirements and procedures for understanding and complying with the laws, regulations and Firm policies that apply to our businesses.
  
  
The Global Compliance Department identifies applicable Compliance Obligations and maintains a Firmwide Compliance Risk management program, including Compliance Risks that transcend business lines, legal entities and jurisdictions of operation.
  
  
Global Financial Crimes is responsible for the development and governance of the Firm's financial crime prevention efforts across all regions and business units. Global Financial Crimes is comprised of the Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Anti-boycott, Anti-Corruption (ACG) and Government and Political Activities Compliance (GPAC) programs.
  
  
The Global Regulatory Relations Group (GRRG) is responsible for strategic and centralized management of the supervisory activities of Morgan Stanley's regulators and related developments globally, with a focus on regulatory reviews and examinations and continuous monitoring activities. GRRG serves as the central point of contact for the regulatory staff responsible for supervisory activities at Morgan Stanley entities and for timely reporting to Firm management and other governance or management bodies, as appropriate, on those relationships and supervisory processes, including areas of significant regulatory focus or concern.
  
  
India LCD GC - Mumbai (India LCD GC) is a part of Morgan Stanley's Global In-house Center, which provides global support to LCD and is an integral part of Firm and LCD strategy.
  
  
Team: Surveillance
  
  
The Surveillance team performs an independent monitoring/oversight of Compliance reports that look for breaches to internal policies and/or regulatory requirements by Firm Traders/ Institutional Clients.
  
  
The team works closely with global colleagues and stakeholders across the Firm (including staff in Legal and Compliance, Business Control Unit, Risk Management, Operations and Technology) to promote the ongoing development and effectiveness of the surveillance program.

Insider Trading
  
Ramping
  
Front Running etc. Primary Responsibilities (Day Job)

Review and analyze trade surveillance reports across asset classes like equities, derivatives, fixed income and commodities to escalate any regulatory and policy breach identified as part of the review.

Support regulatory inquiries, regulatory inspections, internal audits by providing requested data / addressing respective queries
  
  
Interaction with IT/ QDA
  
Work with IT and / or vendors in enhancing/ developing new tools;
  
Participate in testing/ requirement drafting of new models/reports; and
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Experience
  
  
4 -6 years of relevant working experience in the financial services industry in Compliance or internal audit or with a securities exchange or securities regulator;
  
Preference will be given to candidates with relevant experience in Trade Surveillance
  
  
Knowledge
  
  
Possess excellent knowledge of financial instruments and co-relation of these instruments to being able to assess cross- product risks/ manipulations.
  
Knowledge of global markets / market regulations.
  
Understanding and knowledge of trading mechanisms across different financial instruments/ markets.
  
Should possess knowledge of trade booking and settlements.

Knowledge of global markets / market regulations
  
Knowledge of trading strategies, algorithms and trading terminologies
  
Knowledge of market data vendors (e.g. Bloomberg, Reuters Eikon)
  
Excellent communication skills: able to communicate complex scenarios and concepts clearly, concisely and effectively, both verbally and in writing, to stakeholders across all levels.
  
Strong analytical skills; experience of handling, analyzing and presenting large data sets to identify exceptions or anomalies
  
Ability to work with cross-functional and cross-regional teams spanning Compliance, and Technology
  
Strong Analytical Skills and attention to detail
  
Knowledge / Use of analytical tools like Tableau/SQL to query large data sets.
  
Understanding of new technologies like Machine Learning, AI, etc.

**About The Adviser Support Hub (TASH) and associated companies**

The Adviser Support Hub Ltd (TASH) is a subsidiary of the On-Line Partnership Group Limited (OPGL), who are owned by Russell Investments Services Limited.

**Job description**

The Adviser Support Hub Ltd is a UK based financial services business providing a range of outsourced administration support services to the UK Independent Financial Adviser market. TASH’s primary service is Paraplanning support (collation of financial product data to enable the research of financial products, investment fund strategies, and preparation of financial suitability reports) to clients of Independent Financial Advisers across the UK.

As a Mumbai based **Paraplanning Assistant** you will be focused on supporting the UK based Paraplanning team in the following areas of their work:

* UK Pensions (PPPs, SIPPs, GPPs, EPPs, Occupational).
* UK Investments (ISAs, Bonds, Collectives, VCT, EIS).
* UK Protection products (LTA, PHI, GLA, PMI).
* UK Taxation (IHT, Corporate, Personal).

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably have 1-2 years’ experience of the UK financial services market to include UK pensions, investments and protection products
* I.T. literate and ideally have some working knowledge of one or more of the following research software systems: Selectapension, Synaptics, Defaqto, FE Analytics and Morningstar Workstation (although training will be provided)
* Preferably have paraplanning experience within the UK market
* Are motivated for a career within the financial services industry
* Are a strong organiser with the ability to prioritise and have a positive self-motivated attitude
* Have a keen eye for detail and a solid grasp of UK grammar
* Can speak clear and fluent English
* Enjoy working within a team or at times as an individual whilst managing your own workflow and tasks independently and efficiently
* Are willing to keep up to date with UK based technical, taxation, legislation, product and provider changes

**Responsibilities**

The UK based Paraplanning team will assign work to the Mumbai based Paraplanning Assistant, who’s specific daily duties will include:

* Collation (via email/telephone) of UK pension and investment product data for analysis
* Preparation of product research to support financial recommendations
* Compile client facing research summary document to include the accurate presentation of data
* New business document preparation
* Financial report preparation
* Business submission via online portals
* Updating workflow management systems
* Other duties as assigned

title: Research - Vice President, Research Technology Management (Lead Prompt Engineer) (Mumbai)
description:
**Vice President, AI Enablement Lead**

**Research Technology Management | Global Research | Morgan Stanley**

**Position Overview**

Morgan Stanley Global Research is seeking a Vice President to serve as **AI Enablement Lead** within the Research Technology Management (RTM) Asia-Pacific The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for driving the practical adoption, development, governance, and optimization of generative AI and related AI capabilities across Global Research ’s Asia-Pacific and Japan division.

The role will operate at the intersection of Research, technology, data, AI/modeling, product management, training, and governance.

The AI Enablement Lead will be responsible for translating the needs of Asia Pacific and Japan Research analysts and teams into scalable, compliant, high-value AI solutions. The role will oversee the complete enablement lifecycle—from identifying and prioritizing use cases through requirements definition, solution development, evaluation, deployment, adoption, measurement, and ongoing support.

The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial services and investment research workflows with hands-on AI and technical capabilities, product and project management skills . The individual must be comfortable operating both strategically and tactically: establishing an AI enablement framework and roadmap for the department while also contributing directly to solution design, prompt development, testing, evaluation, and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development and Lifecycle Management**

Oversee the development of regional department-wide, sector/industry-specific, asset-class-specific, and team- or analyst-specific solutions across supported AI tools and platforms.

Responsibilities will span the complete solution lifecycle, including:

* Identify, solicit, collect, and document business problems, ideas, and AI use cases.

* Translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements.

* Assess feasibility, value, risk, scalability, and appropriate implementation approaches.

* Design and develop AI-enabled solutions, workflows, prompts, and prototypes.

* Develop and refine prompts and prompting strategies for centrally developed and deployed AI products.

* Design and execute appropriate testing and evaluation methodologies.

* Validate solutions for quality, reliability, usability, and compliance with applicable requirements.

* Coordinate deployment and implementation.

* Provide or coordinate ongoing production support, maintenance, enhancement, and optimization.

* Comply with appropriate lifecycle management for AI assets, including ownership, documentation, versioning, monitoring, review, and retirement where applicable.

* Promote reusable and scalable solutions where common needs exist, reducing unnecessary duplication of AI assets across Research teams.

**AI Use-Case Intake, Prioritization and Roadmap**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with Asia Pacific and Japan Research coverage teams to understand their workflows, priorities, challenges, and AI opportunities.

* Establish a sustainable process for soliciting, documenting, retaining, assessing, and prioritizing AI requirements and use cases surfaced by Research teams globally.

* Develop and maintain a transparent regional department-wide roadmap for AI enablement initiatives.

* Execute against the agreed roadmap and communicate priorities, dependencies, progress, and changes to stakeholders.

* Develop a consistent prioritization framework incorporating expected business value, user reach, implementation effort, technical feasibility, risk, strategic alignment, and potential for reuse.

**Governance, Risk and Compliance**

* Comply with legal , compliance, risk, information-security, and AI governance processes required to introduce new AI assets and capabilities into Global Research.

* Partner with firmwide modeling, governance, and control teams to ensure compliance with applicable firmwide generative AI, model, data, and technology requirements.

* Ensure that required evaluations, approvals, controls, and documentation are completed and maintained.

* Ensure relevant requirements and restrictions are clearly communicated to Research users and stakeholders.

* Embed governance, control, data-handling, entitlements, and appropriate human-review considerations into the design of AI solutions from inception rather than treating governance as a post-development activity.

* Maintain appropriate documentation and auditability of AI enablement activities, decisions, evaluations, and approvals.

**Technology, Data and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Coordinate closely with firmwide technology teams responsible for AI platforms, infrastructure, and tool rollouts.

* Partner with technology development leads on the design and development of technology-built and supported AI assets.

* Work with technology teams to develop tools, utilities, software, and infrastructure required to support the AI Enablement team's activities.

* Collaborate with development teams, data teams, modeling teams, technology support teams, analytics/reporting teams, and other groups engaged in related AI initiatives.

* Coordinate with similar AI and enablement teams across Morgan Stanley's Institutional Technology organization to share knowledge, standards, solutions, and best practices.

* Act as a bridge between Research users and technical teams, translating investment-research requirements into actionable technology requirements and technical capabilities into practical Research applications.

* Identify opportunities to reuse firmwide technology and AI capabilities before initiating duplicative development.

**Measurement, Analytics and Value Realization**

* Collect, analyze, and report usage data for AI Enablement-supported tools, features, solutions, and initiatives.

* Monitor adoption patterns and identify opportunities to improve utilization and user experience.

* Use data and user feedback to inform roadmap priorities, training needs, solution enhancements, and tool-selection strategies

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* At least 5 **years of relevant professional experience** , preferably within financial services, including investment banking, investment research, asset management, financial technology, financial-data providers/aggregators, or related organizations.

* Strong understanding of financial markets, financial analysis, and investment research workflows.

* Academic background in finance, economics, business, computer science, engineering, or a related discipline; demonstrated finance expertise is required.

* Strong hands-on Python capabilities.

* Minimum **2–3 years of practical experience with generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, or related AI technologies** .

* Demonstrated ability to design, develop, test, and improve prompts and AI-enabled workflows.

* Understanding of AI/LLM evaluation methodologies and the ability to translate evaluation concepts into practical testing frameworks z

* Demonstrated project and/or product management experience.

* Experience with data, data analytics, and usage/performance reporting.

* Ability to translate business requirements into functional and technical requirements.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical audiences.

* Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building capabilities.

* Ability to operate effectively and independently in the business environment.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives in a complex, global organization.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Citi is looking for a KYC Operations Analyst to play a key role in strengthening its Anti-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring, governance, and regulatory reporting activities within the Compliance and Control team. title: Cybersecurity Presales Consultant
description:
**Experience:**
10–12 Years

**Locations:**
Delhi & Mumbai

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Presales Consultant with 10–12 years of expertise in designing, positioning, and presenting enterprise cybersecurity solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on and consultative experience across Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), and Security Configuration Management (SCM). This role requires close collaboration with sales, delivery, product, and customer teams to translate business and security requirements into scalable, compliant, and commercially viable security solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end cybersecurity presales engagements, including requirement gathering, discovery workshops, solution design, technical presentations, product demonstrations, proof of concepts, and proposal support.
* Design and position solutions across PAM, IAM, EPM, and SCM aligned to customer security posture, compliance requirements, and business objectives.
* Prepare high-quality technical proposals, solution architecture documents, bill of materials, statements of work, RFP/RFI responses, compliance matrices, and commercial inputs.
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, IT heads, risk teams, compliance teams, and infrastructure stakeholders to understand pain points and map them to relevant cybersecurity solutions.
* Collaborate with sales teams to build account strategy, qualify opportunities, influence deal progression, and support revenue growth.
* Work closely with OEMs and technology partners for solution validation, pricing, licensing, sizing, and competitive positioning.
* Conduct customer workshops and deep-dive sessions on privileged access, identity governance, least privilege, endpoint privilege control, secure configuration, and Zero Trust principles.
* Support smooth handover from presales to delivery teams, ensuring scope, assumptions, dependencies, and success criteria are clearly documented.
* Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, regulatory requirements, threat landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to identity, privilege, endpoint, and configuration security.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 10–12 years of overall experience in cybersecurity, information security, solution consulting, presales, or technical architecture roles.
* Strong understanding of PAM concepts including privileged account discovery, credential vaulting, session management, password rotation, just-in-time access, break-glass access, and least privilege models.
* Experience with PAM platforms such as CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea/Thycotic, Arcon or similar solutions.
* Good knowledge of IAM concepts such as identity lifecycle management, access governance, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, role-based access control, federation, SAML, OAuth, LDAP, and Active Directory integration.
* Experience in Endpoint Privilege Management, including application control, privilege elevation, local admin rights management, endpoint hardening, and policy-based access control.
* Understanding of Security Configuration Management, secure baseline configuration, compliance checks, vulnerability remediation support, policy enforcement, and configuration drift management.
* Ability to map customer requirements to cybersecurity frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, RBI guidelines, CERT-In directions, GDPR, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Strong documentation, presentation, stakeholder management, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage complex enterprise opportunities and influence technical as well as business decision makers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, Microsoft Security, or other IAM/PAM certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Consultative selling and solution-oriented mindset.
* Strong customer-facing communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex cybersecurity concepts for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, collaboration, and problem-solving abilities.

description:

WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
  
  
Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
We are seeking a motivated and skilled Technical Analyst - SaaS Applications to join our team. This role focuses on administering, supporting, enhancing, and continuously improving enterprise SaaS applications. The successful candidate will ensure that business applications remain secure, reliable, and aligned with organisational objectives while supporting digital transformation initiatives and the adoption of new technologies
  
  
**What You'll Do**




+ SaaS Application Administration and Management

You will support the implementation, administration, and ongoing management of enterprise SaaS applications, ensuring seamless integration with existing business systems. You will contribute to product roadmaps, platform enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining high levels of system performance and user satisfaction.
  
  

* User Access and Configuration Management

You will manage users, roles, permissions, workflows, business rules, and platform configurations, ensuring secure and efficient operation of business applications. You will administer access controls in line with company policies and compliance requirements.
  
  

* Data Management and Integrations

You will perform data uploads, extracts, validation, reconciliation, and support integrations between SaaS applications and enterprise platforms. You will ensure data accuracy, consistency, and seamless information flow across systems.
  
  

* Production Support and Issue Resolution

You will provide L2/L3 production support, troubleshooting application, workflow, data, integration, and access-related issues while ensuring incidents and service requests are resolved within agreed service levels.
  
  

* Testing, Releases and Deployments

You will support SIT, UAT, regression testing, releases, patches, upgrades, and deployments across Development, Test, and Production environments. You will assist in delivering enhancements and business requirements while maintaining application stability and quality.
  
  

* Root Cause Analysis and Documentation

You will perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and maintain technical and functional documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
  
  

* Platform Governance and Continuous Improvement

You will monitor platform health, identify optimisation opportunities, and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, user experience, security, and operational effectiveness.
  
  

* Strategic Support and Execution

You will collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to support strategy development, identify process improvement opportunities, and help deliver initiatives that drive operational excellence and digital transformation.
  
  

* Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

You will act as a key point of contact for application-related initiatives, communicating progress, risks, and solutions to stakeholders. You will also support user training, adoption activities, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  

* Technical Expertise and Support

You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across SaaS platforms and interfaces, maintain application documentation, and support integrations and automation initiatives to improve interoperability between systems.
  
  

* Business Process Support

You will support business processes enabled through SaaS applications, ensuring systems remain aligned with operational requirements, regulatory obligations, and organisational objectives.
  
  

* Implementation of New Solutions and Digitalisation

You will participate in the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of new SaaS solutions and digital capabilities. You will work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment, change management, and continuous improvement.
  
  

* Usage Analytics and Reporting

You will analyse platform utilisation, user adoption, and consumption trends to identify optimisation opportunities. You will develop reports, dashboards, and recommendations that support informed business decisions and maximise value from SaaS investments.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology, Data Science, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 3 years' experience administering, supporting, or implementing enterprise SaaS applications.

* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, reporting, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with cloud-based integration technologies and enterprise application architecture.
* Experience supporting application releases, upgrades, testing cycles, and production environments.
* Knowledge of IT service management practices, incident management, problem management, and change management processes.

* Experience working within IT governance, security, audit, and compliance frameworks.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive issues to resolution.
* Excellent documentation, presentation, and knowledge-sharing skills.
* Experience supporting digital transformation initiatives and driving continuous improvement.

**Desirable**

* Exposure to automation, AI-enabled solutions, and data analytics platforms.

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test ) to provide end-to-end technical governance across all QA layers — frontend, middleware, and backend — for a complex, multi-layered onboarding platform. This role owns the architecture of API contract testing and the data modeling of complex entity relationships (e.g., hierarchical/parent-child style structures), while ensuring that quality assumptions made at one layer (such as client-side validation) are independently verified at every downstream layer rather than trusted at face value. The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership with the ability to set and enforce delivery governance across cross-functional teams.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Provide technical governance across frontend, middleware, and backend testing layers.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**
At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.
  
  
As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that support our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Security Operations Analyst will support build out of our internal capability and partner closely with our outsourced SOC provider. This role focuses on incident response coordination, security monitoring, vulnerability management and remediation oversight, helping to strengthen our overall security posture through effective operational processes and active stakeholder collaboration.
  
  
You’ll play a vital role in ensuring we meet both our internal security obligations and the high expectations of our financial services clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the in-house lead for escalations from our third-party MDR/SOC, supporting triage, investigation of alerts from the SIEM, EDR and cloud security tooling (Rapid7 InsightIDR, AWS GuardDuty/CloudTrail), and coordination of incident response
* Investigate security alerts across endpoint, identity, network and cloud environments, correlating available evidence to determine severity, business impact and appropriate response actions.
* Analyse Windows and identity-related security events, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos and NTLM authentication activity, and coordinate investigation and remediation with relevant technical teams.
* Review network security events involving TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common enterprise protocols, identifying suspicious behaviour and recommending appropriate follow-up actions.
* Escalate confirmed or complex incidents to the Senior SOC Analyst and the Rapid7 SOC. Support containment and recovery activities
* Document incidents from detection to closure in the ticketing system (Jira/ServiceNow)
* Follow established SOC runbooks and playbooks while contributing to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of incident response runbooks, playbooks and standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Support the vulnerability management programme such as scan scheduling, triage, risk prioritisation, and remediation tracking
* Monitor the threat landscape to inform detection and response activities
* Support audits and client due diligence processes where required

**Unleash your potential**
To be successful in this role, your background and experience will include:
  
  
  

* 3–5 years’ experience in a security operation, incident response, or SOC analyst role (in-house or MSSP/MDR)
* Hands-on experience with an enterprise SIEM. Rapid7 InsightIDR / InsightVM preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar or equivalent accepted)
* Working knowledge of network security fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, proxies, VPNs and common protocols.
* Practical experience investigating security events in Microsoft Windows environments, with working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Kerberos, NTLM and common authentication flows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear incident summaries, document evidence, and coordinate actions with infrastructure, application, engineering, and third-party SOC teams.
* Solid understanding of vulnerability management tools and risk-based remediation.
* Familiarity with regulatory and client security expectations in financial services or highly regulated environments
* Knowledge of attack techniques and incident response frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK)
* Beneficial:

+ scripting/automation, cloud security experience (AWS/Azure).
+ experience using approved AI-assisted security tools for alert triage, investigation, SIEM query development and reporting, with the ability to validate AI-generated outputs and handle sensitive security data appropriately.
+ Industry security certifications are a bonus.

**Working at Bravura**
Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.
  
  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* A cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.

**So, what’s next?**
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

* Strong experience managing technology vendors, contracts, licenses, and renewals
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks and solutions clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are seeking an AI/ML Security Data Scientist to develop, evaluate, govern, and operationalize machine-learning security controls that protect enterprise generative-AI applications and traditional machine-learning systems.
  
  
This position will own critical capabilities involving prompt-injection detection, LLM vulnerability assessment, audio redaction, adversarial-model testing, and secure-model-development practices. The successful candidate will combine strong applied data-science skills with an understanding of cybersecurity, model-risk governance, production ML operations, and regulatory documentation.
  
  
The role will work closely with AI Firewall engineering, AI Security Enablement, Model Risk Management, Technology Risk and Information Security, product owners, auditors, and external technology providers.
  
  
**AI Security Model Development And Evaluation**

* Develop, evaluate, and improve machine-learning controls for prompt-injection detection, LLM vulnerability detection, sensitive-data redaction, and related AI-security use cases. Benchmark open-source, internally developed, and third-party models using representative test datasets. Design training, validation, out-of-sample, and out-of-time evaluation datasets using sound sampling, labeling, and data-quality practices. Evaluate model performance using recall, precision, F1 score, Matthews correlation coefficient, accuracy, ROC-AUC, confusion matrices, and other appropriate measures.
* Recommend operating thresholds that balance detection effectiveness, false positives, operational impact, and business risk.
* Evaluate emerging audio, image, and video deepfake-detection technologies where relevant to the AI-security portfolio.

**Model-risk Management And Governance**

* Own and maintain model documentation for BERT-based prompt-injection detection, LLM vulnerability assessment, and other assigned AI-security models. Prepare model-validation submissions and coordinate responses to Model Risk Management Group requests. Document model purpose, methodology, datasets, assumptions, limitations, compensating controls, performance results, implementation testing, and ongoing monitoring.
* Define class-level performance monitoring and feature-, concept-, and probability-distribution-drift controls. Establish escalation, remediation, retraining, fallback, and model-deactivation criteria. Ensure documentation is internally consistent, technically defensible, traceable to evidence, and ready for independent review or audit. Audio redaction and sensitive-data protection
* Support the design and implementation of audio-redaction capabilities for enterprise AI applications. Assess centralized-service and embedded-SDK deployment approaches, including scalability, auditability, separation of duties, maintainability, language independence, and circumvention risk.
* Develop evaluation datasets and acceptance criteria for detecting and redacting sensitive data in voice and audio interactions. Partner with platform and application teams to integrate audio-redaction capabilities into production workflows. Secure model development lifecycle
* Conduct adversarial stress testing and robustness assessments for NLP, large-language, computer-vision, and tabular models. Identify model weaknesses, failure modes, integrity issues, and adversarial examples, and recommend remediation.
* Support model scanning, secure model hosting, protection from unsafe model artifacts, and controls addressing model-serialization and software-supply-chain risks. Help integrate model-security testing into APIs, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and application-development processes.
* Contribute reusable tools and processes that reduce the time required to securely evaluate and deploy models. Production enablement and operational support
* Partner with AI Firewall engineers to integrate approved models into production security controls. Support the rollout and monitoring of BERT-based prompt-injection detection across generative-AI and agentic use cases.
* Support upgrades or replacements for existing LLM vulnerability-assessment capabilities and the controlled retirement of legacy models.
* Investigate performance degradation, drift, unexpected model behavior, and production detection issues. Maintain reproducible code, datasets, model artifacts, test results, technical decisions, and transition documentation.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Translate technical model results into clear risk conclusions and recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Work with model owners, product teams, engineers, cybersecurity teams, governance functions, auditors, and vendors.
* Present findings, design decisions, limitations, and remediation plans to review committees and senior stakeholders.
* Provide evidence, demonstrations, and technical explanations for regulatory, risk, and audit reviews.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Five or more years of experience in data science, machine-learning engineering, cybersecurity analytics, or applied AI.
* Practical experience developing and evaluating classification or detection models. Strong Python skills and experience with common data-science and ML libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers.

**Strong Understanding Of**

* Training, validation, holdout, out-of-sample, and out-of-time testing,
* Sampling, labeling, data quality, class imbalance, and statistical evaluation,
* Classification metrics, model thresholds, drift detection, and ongoing monitoring,
* Model limitations, compensating controls, and production fallback strategies,
* Experience deploying or integrating ML models through APIs, containers, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines. Ability to produce rigorous technical and governance documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to respond to independent model reviewers and auditors.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

description:

Certifications - ISO 270001 LA/LI, CISA , ITIL V3/4

title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer
description:
**Job title: Senior Cloud Service Engineer**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for a motivated
**Cloud Service Engineer**
to join the Digital Workplace Services team and support the security, administration and governance of our cloud and SaaS environment. The role will work across platforms including
**Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Box**
and other enterprise SaaS applications, supporting operational security, access governance, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

  
  

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build hands-on experience across
**cloud security, identity, SaaS security, data protection and AI security**
within a large enterprise environment, working closely with senior engineers, security teams, platform owners, application teams and vendors.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* **SaaS & Cloud Security:**
  Support administration, security governance, onboarding, configuration, lifecycle management and periodic reviews for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet and other enterprise SaaS platforms.
  
  
* **Identity & Access Management:**
  Support Microsoft Entra ID and Google Cloud Identity administration, including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access, MFA, authentication methods, guest access and privileged role governance.
  
  
* **Data Protection & Security Operations:**
  Assist with Microsoft Purview, Defender, DLP alert monitoring, external sharing reviews, security triage, remediation tracking and operational reporting.
  
  
* **AI & Emerging Technology Security:**
  Support governance and monitoring for enterprise AI services, Copilot, Copilot Studio, GenAI applications, agents, connectors and related data protection controls.
  
  
* **Security Monitoring & Investigation:**
  Monitor dashboards and alerts across SaaS and cloud platforms, perform initial investigation, use tools such as Defender, Purview, Sentinel and SaaS security platforms, and escalate complex issues where required.
  
  
* **Platform Operations & Troubleshooting:**
  Provide second-line support for authentication, provisioning, synchronization, SSO, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, API integrations, vendor issues, change implementation and validation.
  
  
* **Governance, Documentation & Improvement:**
  Maintain inventories, ownership records, runbooks, knowledge articles, configuration records and operational procedures while identifying automation and process improvement opportunities.
  

  

**Key Technologies**

  
  

The role will have exposure to the following technology areas:

  

  
* **Identity & Cloud:**
  Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure, Google Cloud Identity and Google Workspace.
  
  
* **Security:**
  Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud Apps, Conditional Access, DLP and SaaS security/application governance.
  
  
* **SaaS Platforms:**
  Box, Lucidchart, Smartsheet, Adobe Apps and other enterprise SaaS applications.
  
  
* **AI Security:**
  Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI / AI Foundry, AI governance and data protection controls.
  
  
* **Automation & Technical Tools:**
  PowerShell, KQL, Power Automate, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, SAML, SCIM and OAuth.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  

  
* 5+ years of experience in cloud administration, SaaS administration, IT security, identity management or a related technical role.
  
  
* Basic understanding of Microsoft 365 and/or Azure, identity and access management, SSO, MFA and authentication concepts.
  
  
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, least privilege, data protection and operational security monitoring.
  
  
* Good troubleshooting and analytical skills, including the ability to investigate issues using logs, dashboards and administrative portals.
  
  
* Basic PowerShell or scripting knowledge, with willingness to learn KQL and security monitoring tools.
  
  
* Good written and verbal communication skills, ability to work with technical teams and vendors, and strong attention to detail in documentation.
  

  

**Desirable Skills**

  

  
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Purview, Defender, Sentinel/KQL, Google Workspace Administration, Google Cloud Identity, Box administration/Box Shield, SaaS security or CASB.
  
  
* Experience with OAuth application governance, SAML, SCIM, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Power Automate, cloud security, DLP, AI security or AI governance.
  

  

Relevant Microsoft, Google, security or cloud certifications would be advantageous but are not mandatory.

  
  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

  
* Independently handle routine SaaS and cloud security operations.
  
  
* Identify and resolve common identity, access, platform configuration and security alert issues.
  
  
* Maintain accurate application, access, security governance and remediation records.
  
  
* Improve documentation, repeatable processes, automation and operational efficiency.
  
  
* Develop deeper expertise across Microsoft, Google, SaaS, cloud, data protection and AI security platforms.
  

  

**Working Relationships**

  
  

The role will work closely with Digital Workplace Services, Cyber Security/SOC, Identity & Access Management, Microsoft 365/Azure engineering teams, Google Cloud/Google Workspace teams, Data Protection/Privacy, Application and Enterprise Architecture teams, SaaS application owners and external technology vendors.

  
  

**Ideal Candidate**

  
  

We are looking for someone who is
**curious, technically hands-on, security-minded and willing to learn**
. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in IT, cloud or security and wants to develop into a broader SaaS, Cloud and AI Security Engineer.

  

  
* Enjoys troubleshooting complex technical problems and learning new platforms quickly.
  
  
* Takes ownership of issues while knowing when to seek guidance.
  
  
* Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Has strong attention to detail and follows through on operational tasks.
  
  
* Is interested in emerging technologies, particularly cloud and AI security.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or related areas
* Solid experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and large-scale data processing systems
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing frameworks
* Experience working with Kafka or other streaming technologies
* Experience with Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or similar cloud data platforms
* Solid knowledge of data warehousing and lakehouse architectures
* Solid understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data lineage concepts
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in SQL and Python
* Proven excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Proven solid communication and stakeholder management capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications:**

title: Sr Engineer II - SecOps Insider threat
description:
At Aristocrat, we are at the forefront of entertainment and technology, pushing boundaries to build world-leading gaming content. Our mission is to bring happiness to life through the power of play, and our culture is built on innovation, creativity, and integrity. As a Sr Security Analyst, you will play a crucial role in our Security Operations Center (SOC), ensuring the safety and integrity of our systems. This is an outstanding opportunity to join a dynamic team, collaborate globally, and drive impactful security initiatives. Your expertise will be instrumental in protecting our assets and supporting our mission to deliver world-class gaming experiences. Join us and be part of an ambitious team that values connection and strives for excellence!

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as the incident lead for handling and investigating high-severity and complex security incidents from beginning to end. Focus on defining the incident scope, containment, eradication, and recovery phases. Work closely with technical and business partners. Assume responsibility for the root-cause analysis.
* Lead complex, multi-stage investigations across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS telemetry, including advanced malware analysis, credential-compromise, and lateral-movement investigations.
* Define detection strategy aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and the organization’s threat model; identify and recommend new detection logic across SIEM, XDR, EDR, and SOAR.
* Conduct threat hunts guided by threat intelligence, emerging TTPs, and gaps in detection coverage; convert findings into new detections, playbooks, and control recommendations.
* Lead Tier 2 SOC operations, ensuring shift priorities, case load, and blocking issue flow meet SLAs and quality standards.
* Build and maintain SOC playbook, runbook, and knowledge-based library; ensure content stays current with tooling and threat changes.
* Identify, build, and recommend process improvements across the SOC, measuring and reporting their impact.
* Chip in to and help implement the multi-year security operations strategy, including detection coverage roadmap, telemetry strategy, automation targets, and capability maturity.
* Interpret security findings as risk-centered advice for security engineering, IT, and business collaborators.
* Mentor and develop Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts through structured mentoring, investigation walkthroughs, and technical training.
* Participate in cross-functional forums and collaborate with global security teams to ensure a cohesive, consistent approach to security operations.
* Provide senior on-call coverage for major incidents involving blocking issues.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or an equivalent blue-team role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Advanced certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, GCFA, GCDA, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, Microsoft SC-200 or equivalent are highly regarded.
* Expert knowledge of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and Entra ID charge techniques; able to reconstruct an intrusion from raw logs without a playbook.
* Strong experience in cloud security monitoring and response across at least one major provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Proficiency in Python or PowerShell for automation, data analysis, and tooling integration.
* Deep solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, the incident response lifecycle, malware analysis, and phishing investigation.
* Track record of defining standards, processes, and playbooks, and of improving them based on evidence.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor analysts and raise the technical bar of a team.
* Clear, structured technical writing, including incident reports, RCAs, and briefings for senior technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong influencing and teamwork skills; able to work with engineering, IT, and business groups locally and globally to promote change without direct authority.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

title: Fraud Control-Sr. Executive-Ahmedabad
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a
**Fraud Control Analyst**
to identify, investigate and prevent activities that could result in financial loss or a poor customer experience. Based in
**India or the EU**
and reporting to a Team Leader within Security Operations, you will monitor customer activity, analyse suspected fraud cases and take timely decisions to prevent fraudulent activity.
  
  
This opportunity is suited to candidates with
**3–5 years of experience in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or customer support**
, particularly where data analysis has been an important part of the role. The position operates in a
**24/7 environment**
.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Monitor customer accounts, services and transactions to identify potentially fraudulent or suspicious activity, including roaming, domestic, artificially inflated traffic and first-party fraud
* Conduct detailed investigations of identified fraud-risk cases and use available evidence to confirm or rule out fraudulent activity
* Monitor accounts with unusually high local or international voice, messaging or data usage and take appropriate preventive action in line with established procedures
* Identify emerging fraud patterns and recommend effective approaches for fraud prevention, detection and resolution
* Manage internal fraud-related requests and complaints received through phone and email while maintaining high customer service standards
* Make timely, evidence-based decisions to prevent fraudulent activity, including independently resolving complex cases within established processes
* Maintain accurate case handling and meet agreed productivity, quality, service-level and process-compliance requirements
* Contribute to performance reporting, including key performance indicators and service delivery standards
* Collaborate professionally with colleagues, Team Leaders and other stakeholders, and recommend opportunities to improve fraud-control processes
* Comply with applicable internal regulations, departmental procedures and the Code of Conduct

Success in the role will be measured primarily through the
**speed and effectiveness of fraud prevention, accuracy of decisions and adherence to required processes**
.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* You are a graduate from a recognised university with 3–5 years of relevant experience in analytics, banking, telecommunications, fraud control, revenue assurance or a customer support role involving data analysis
* You have strong analytical skills and knowledge of telecommunications or banking fraud-control practices, with the judgement to investigate complex information and make appropriate decisions
* You are comfortable using Microsoft Office and multiple systems or applications to analyse information and manage cases
* You have strong written and verbal English communication skills at approximately C1/C2 proficiency and can manage customer and internal interactions professionally, including challenging situations
* You are organised, customer-focused and results-oriented, can prioritise competing activities, proactively manage your performance and are willing to work in a 24/7 operational environment

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to build practical expertise in telecommunications fraud detection and prevention
* Exposure to customer and transaction monitoring across domestic and international telecommunications services
* Experience investigating complex fraud-risk cases where decisions directly contribute to reducing financial loss and protecting customer experience
* Opportunity to work collaboratively within Security Operations and contribute recommendations that improve fraud-control processes and service delivery
* A role offering meaningful decision-making responsibility and exposure to evolving fraud behaviours and prevention approaches

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced fraud-risk analysis and investigation techniques within a telecommunications environment
* Identification and interpretation of emerging fraud behaviours and suspicious usage patterns
* Evidence-based decision-making for fraud prevention and loss mitigation
* Monitoring and interpretation of operational performance measures, including quality, service standards and fraud-prevention effectiveness
* Cross-functional communication, customer issue resolution and continuous process improvement

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Define, implement, and enforce security standards, policies, and best practices across cloud and on-prem environments.

Conduct security risk assessments, perform vulnerability scans, coordinate penetration testing activities, and execute mitigation plans.

Architect, maintain, and enhance secure CI/CD pipelines with automated compliance and governance checkpoints.

Promote and uphold a strong “Security First” culture across engineering, ensuring secure design and development practices.

Continuously monitor, detect, investigate, and respond to security threats, incidents, breaches, and anomalies.

Develop, own, and mature automation practices: infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and configuration management using Ansible, alongside other automation frameworks.

Design and maintain secure cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, or GCP to support scalable and compliant deployments.

Build, operate, and secure containerized environments using Docker, with enforced security baselines. Kubernetes where applicable to the project.

Implement and maintain secure monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for infrastructure and application layers, extending to SIEM as the practice develops.

Improve and optimize system reliability, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance across all critical workloads.

Mentor, guide, and upskill DevOps engineers in secure development, automation, and operational excellence.

Lead technical strategy, decision-making, tool selection, process improvements, and DevSecOps roadmap execution.

Work closely with PMO and engineering teams so that security, performance and delivery objectives stay aligned.

Operational Ownership

Backup and disaster recovery: Backup policies, regular tested restoration, and disaster recovery plans with agreed recovery time and data loss targets, with restoration tested rather than assumed.

Release management: Deployments across development, staging and production, including approvals, rollback procedures, and troubleshooting failed releases.

Access and secrets management: Access reviews, joiner and leaver access, service accounts, credentials, secrets rotation, and encryption keys.

Pipeline security: Code, dependency, container image, secrets and Infrastructure-as-Code scanning built into CI/CD, with clear ownership of who fixes what and by when.

Incident management: Leading production incident response, coordinating updates to the people who need them, running root cause reviews, and tracking corrective actions to closure.

Cloud cost management: Monitoring cloud spend, investigating unexpected cost, and improving resource sizing and utilisation without affecting reliability.

Documentation: Infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment guides, operational runbooks and recovery procedures, maintained as the environment changes.

Reliability measurement: Defining and tracking service availability, deployment failure rate, recovery time, and how long vulnerabilities take to close.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

6–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure engineering, including at least 4 years hands-on in DevOps, with strong security exposure.

Strong hands-on expertise in AWS, with a focus on secure architecture.

Deep experience with at least one CI/CD platform, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines. Breadth across several is useful; depth in one is required.

Experience securing and running Docker containers in production.

Experience independently owning production infrastructure, releases and incident resolution, demonstrated through the work you have led.

Strong understanding of networking technologies: LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPN, load balancers.

Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (OWASP, NIST, CIS Benchmarks).

Working depth in at least one monitoring and logging stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, or CloudWatch.

Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Shell).

Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence engineering teams.

Tools and Technology

These are the areas you will be working in. Core areas are assessed during the interview process. Additional areas strengthen an application, and support is available to develop them in the role.

AWS: Hands-on work across compute, storage, networking, access management and cost, based on environments you have configured.

CI/CD: Building and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines, including the security checks within them. Depth in one platform is sufficient.

Git: Version control in practice: branching strategy, merge and release flow, repository access control, and keeping credentials out of version history.

Cloud server administration: Provisioning, sizing, lifecycle and cost of the servers behind the applications, in the cloud and on-premise where it applies.

Ubuntu: Ubuntu Server administration at an operational standard: packages, services, storage, networking, DNS, TLS and permissions.

Monitoring tools: Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, CloudWatch or an equivalent, implemented by you, with judgement about alert severity. Depth in one stack is sufficient.

Server security: Hardening, patching, firewall and SSH configuration, least-privilege access, and closing known vulnerabilities to an agreed timeline.

Terraform: Infrastructure provisioning as code.

Ansible: Configuration management and automation.

Azure: Working depth in the equivalent services, and judgement about what belongs where when a client runs more than one platform.

GCP: Relevant where a client workload sits there.

Kubernetes: Running and securing orchestrated containers in production, where a project uses them.

SIEM and SOAR: Security event collection and response tooling. Prior experience is welcome; where you do not have it, this capability is developed in the role with support.

Education

A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is considered on the same terms.

Job Description

title: Engineering Manager - Infrastructure Security
description:
**About the team**

The Platform & Infrastructure Engineering team owns the foundational estate that everything else runs on. The team designs, builds, automates, and operates scalable cloud-native systems across networks, security, data & storage, and compute. It carries significant regulatory and operational responsibility, with its platforms directly underpinning critical customer-facing systems such as payments and banking, so security and availability are not optional.

**About the role**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Infrastructure Security at slice. You will own charters like cloud security, network security, and software supply chain security and build a team that makes the secure path the default path for every engineer. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the architecture, hire and grow the team, and be accountable for measurable, auditable security outcomes across our cloud and hybrid estate.

**What You will do**

* Lead, hire and scale the Infrastructure Security team, setting goals, mentoring engineers, and developing technical leaders.
* Own the cloud and hybrid network security architecture and roadmap, balancing security, reliability, scalability, velocity and cost.
* Establish secure-by-design principles, guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts, organizations and future cloud regions.
* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform automation to ensure security controls are version-controlled, tested, repeatable and consistently enforced.
* Own IAM, SSO/Identity Center, PAM, least-privilege access, just-in-time access and secrets management.
* Enforce encryption, KMS/HSM key management, certificate lifecycle management and data protection standards.
* Secure Kubernetes (EKS), compute workloads and container images through hardening, runtime protection and automated patching.
* Design secure network architecture, including VPC segmentation, hybrid connectivity, egress controls, firewalls, DNS security, IDS/IPS, and zero-trust access.
* Protect internet-facing services and APIs using DDoS mitigation, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and API security controls.
* Harden CI/CD pipelines and implement DevSecOps practices, including short-lived credentials (OIDC), SCA, image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and provenance.
* Implement policy-as-code and admission controls to prevent misconfigured infrastructure and untrusted or vulnerable artifacts from reaching production.
* Govern open-source and third-party dependencies through vulnerability management, license compliance, and remediation of SLAs.
* Establish security metrics for control coverage, policy violations, exposure and remediation timelines; continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations and security drifts.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, AppSec, GRC and SOC teams to address security and compliance gaps and support audits.
* Lead infrastructure security incident responses, including DDoS attacks and cloud misconfigurations, and drive blameless post-incident reviews.
* Strengthen resilience through availability planning, disaster recovery, capacity management, incident readiness, and recovery exercises for critical infrastructure.

**What You will need**

* 9+ years in infrastructure, cloud or security engineering, including 2+ years managing and building high-performing teams.
* Deep hands-on expertise in AWS/GCP/Azure security (IAM, Organizations/SCPs, KMS, Security Hub, Guard Duty or equivalents) and cloud security architecture.
* Strong understanding of IAM, SSO, PAM, secrets management, encryption and key management.
* Deep expertise in cloud and data-center networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection and IDS/IPS.
* Practical experience with CI/CD hardening, SCA and image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and policy enforcement.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (e.g., Terraform) and experience building guardrails at scale.
* Solid grounding in observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.
* Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems.
* Experience designing infrastructure for high-scale, highly available environments.
* Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments.
* Experience with RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, CERT-In guidelines, PCI DSS or NPCI audits.
* Depth in admission controllers, policy engines and runtime security tools.
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CCSP, CISSP or CKS.
* Contributions to security tooling, open source or the wider security community.

**Life at slice**

Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:

* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”.

title: Senior Analyst – Threat & Vulnerability Management
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live.
