We offer a stimulating environment where you can grow your career, make a real impact, and be part of something truly meaningful.
  
Your Impact
  
The Cisco Product Operations team is looking for a visionary and experienced leader to scale and provide strategic oversight for our integrated product operations team. You will be responsible for influencing and driving organizational strategy, mentoring a high-performing team of engineers and program managers, and driving operational excellence across the full product lifecycle. This is a high-visibility role where you will influence cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Manufacturing, GSM, and Executive Leadership to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and cost-competitiveness.
  
High-Level Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for the product operations organization to support global scale and efficiency.
* Provide leadership and career mentorship to a diverse team of Electrical, Mechanical, and Test Development Engineers and Program Managers.
* Foster deep collaboration with Hardware Engineering and Supply Chain partners to ensure seamless transitions from NPI through End-of-Life.
* Oversee organizational quality benchmarks and drive proactive risk mitigation across the product portfolio.
* Champion value engineering and cost avoidance initiatives to maximize gross margins and operational profitability.
* Facilitate executive-level communications to provide status updates, performance insights, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead the development of processes and technology frameworks that enable our teams to innovate faster and solve complex technical challenges.
* Ensure adherence to rigorous operational standards and financial stewardship across all hardware programs.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in product operations, supply chain, or engineering leadership within the high-tech industry.
* Proven track record of building and leading high-performing, cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
* Expertise in full product lifecycle management (NPI to EOL) and deep understanding of manufacturing dynamics.
* Advanced ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive strategy without direct authority.
* Outstanding written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated success in managing complex budgets and operational performance metrics.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Master’s degree in Engineering or an MBA.
* Experience leading large-scale electronics manufacturing operations or hyper-scaler infrastructure programs.
* Certification in Project Management (PMP) or process improvement methodologies (Six Sigma).
* Deep familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and enterprise PLM systems.
* Experience scaling organizations through periods of significant growth or technical transformation.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Senior/Principal Application Engineer
description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The Senior/Principal Application Engineer will drive the development of reference designs and application boards with a strong focus on BMS, OBC, DCDC applications in light electric vehicles (LEV) that showcase Nexperia’s portfolio. The person will play a critical role in bridging product development and customer requirements by translating device capabilities into practical, production ready hardware solutions

This role is central to enabling customer adoption and accelerating time-to-market through high-quality design collaterals, hands-on validation and technical support

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, develop, and validate reference designs and application boards using Nexperia’s discrete, analog, and power IC solutions
* Create schematics, perform component selection, and collaborate on PCB layout to optimize performance, efficiency, cost, thermal behavior, and reliability
* Perform comprehensive electrical, thermal, and system-level validation, including efficiency analysis, switching characterization, transient response testing, thermal profiling, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance evaluation and troubleshooting
* Provide application-focused technical support to customers and sales teams by troubleshooting designs, supporting design-in activities, participating in customer engagements, and representing Nexperia at workshops, conferences, and exhibitions
* Create and maintain high-quality technical collateral such as application notes, design guides, simulation models, user manuals, and web-based application content
* Build deep application expertise and translate customer insights into future product opportunities by collaborating with marketing, R&D, and system architects to define requirements, identify use cases, and contribute to product roadmap development

**SKILLS /COMPETENCIES**

Hard Skills:

* Technical experience in PCB design and layout – Altium, KiCad
* Familiarity with simulation tools and industry standards - Matlab/Simulink, LT Spice, Plecs, Thermal analysis, EMC compatibility
* Switching behaviour, losses and efficiency optimization

Soft Skills:

* Strong analytical and system-level thinking
* Hands-on, problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
* Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams
* Customer focused approach with strong ownership
* Excellent presentation and technical writing skills
* English business fluent verbal and written

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS:**

* Education/ studies: BSEE. MSEE preferred
* 5-8 years of experience in application engineering, hardware design or power electronics
* Proven experience developing reference designs or evaluation boards
* Strong knowledge of BMS architectures with all safety measures is advantageous
* Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO26262, UL standards, and AIS is desirable

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do
  
Analyze and Solve
  

* Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes
* Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities
* Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability
* Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions

  
Design and Integrate
  

* Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies
* Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation
* Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors
* Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity

  
Collaborate and Deliver
  

* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians
* Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines
* Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders
* Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results

  
Grow and Advance
  

* Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies
* Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects
* Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

  

* Strong hands-on experience in **Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI)** administration.
* Expertise in **Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix, VxRail, Hyper-V, VMware, and VMware ESXi** .
* Deep understanding of **Hyperconvergence Architecture** , Hypervisor administration, and cluster operations.
* Experience with **Nutanix Administration** and **Nutanix Architecture** .
* Knowledge of patch management tools such as **SCCM** , **WSUS** , and related enterprise patching solutions.
* Strong understanding of security vulnerability management and compliance requirements.
* Experience coordinating maintenance windows, change management, and outage communications.
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure, virtualization, and patch-related issues.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

title: Technical Customer Service Representative
description:
**Technical Customer Service Representative**

**Location:** Hospet, Karnataka  
**Work Arrangement:** Onsite

**What we do at Weir**  
  
We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

**Make your impact**

You’ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

**What you’ll do**

* **Safety Management:** Follow and promote safety norms as per Weir Group EHS policy and WMI IMS Policy. Facilitate safety trainings, identify hazards, and actively participate in safety activities to ensure a zero-harm environment.
* **Operation & Maintenance Supervision:** Operate and monitor ore crushing, grinding, and size reduction equipment daily. Optimize parameters to achieve desired output and particle size distribution. Conduct process evaluations and troubleshoot operational issues to minimize downtime. Collaborate with metallurgists, plant engineers, and operators to improve throughput and recovery.
* **Performance Analysis:** Perform routine inspections and coordinate maintenance to ensure optimal equipment performance and material flow. Analyze performance data including efficiency, energy consumption, and product quality, preparing detailed technical reports. Implement process control strategies to enhance equipment utilization, productivity, and reduce operational costs.
* **Service Support:** Assist in service activities including maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting to maintain equipment reliability.
* **Management Information Systems (MIS):** Monitor and record process parameters and operational data on a daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly basis to support continuous improvement.
* **Customer & Site Management:** Manage customer relationships, establish process guarantee parameters as per agreements, ensure equipment availability, and meet customer satisfaction targets including Net Promoter Score (NPS) as per headquarters guidelines.
* **Travel Requirements:** Occasional travel may be required to customer sites or other operational locations to support commissioning, maintenance, or customer engagement activities.
* **Safety First:** Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must-haves:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in Mineral Processing, Mechanical, or Electrical disciplines.
* 5-7 years of hands-on experience with large mineral processing equipment such as ball mills, crushers, and HPGRs.
* Strong knowledge of hydraulics, electrical systems, and diagnostic/fault-finding tools.
* Proven skills in preventive and predictive maintenance, installation, and commissioning of large equipment.

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Excellent customer and supplier networking and relationship management skills.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with a solution-selling mindset.
* Behavioral competencies including customer focus, collaboration, developing people, performance mindset, building trust, effective communication, good decision-making, and delivering excellence through others.

**Why join Weir?**  
We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

**Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Career development and learning support
* Access to global inclusion networks
* Regional and team-specific benefits
* Sharebuilder scheme
* Wellness support for you and your family
* Collaboration with global teams
* Study support

Founded in 1871, Weir is a world leading engineering business with a purpose to make mining operations smarter, more efficient and sustainable. Thanks to Weir’s technology, our customers can produce essential metals and minerals using less energy, water and waste at lower cost. With the increasing need for metals and minerals for climate change solutions, Weir colleagues are playing their part in powering a low carbon future. We are a global family of 11,000 uniquely talented people in over 60 counties, inspiring each other to do the best work of our lives.

title: Manager - Projects & Qs
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: MANAGER – PROJECTS & QS**

**Position Vacant**

Manager – Projects & QS

**Organization Name**

Covestays Pvt Ltd (Cove Offices)

**Reports To**

Management

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech – Civil (preferred), Electrical or Mechanical.
* Diploma in Engineering with strong relevant execution and QS experience will also be considered.
* Certification in Quantity Surveying (RICS / IIQS), Project Management (PMP) or Construction Management (NICMAR) is a plus.

**Job Description / Responsibilities**

An engineer who started in site execution and has moved onto a project management track, with strong quantity surveying ability.

The role spans budgeting, planning, estimation, billing and quality across Cove’s fit-out and modification projects.

This is a hands-on role – the person must be able to produce a BOQ from a drawing, check a contractor’s bill and oversee execution of interior fit-out projects.

**Budgeting & Estimation**

* Prepare project budgets for new centres, client interior modifications and repair or upgrade works.
* Quantity take-off from architectural and MEP drawings; prepare detailed BOQs covering civil, interiors, electrical, HVAC, fire fighting, plumbing, IT and networking, and access control.
* Rate analysis and benchmarking against prevailing Chennai and Bangalore market rates; build and maintain an internal rate library.
* Develop cost per seat and cost per sq.ft. benchmarks by centre and by scope, and provide fit-out cost inputs for client proposals and landlord negotiations.

**Planning & Scheduling**

* Prepare project schedules identifying the critical path and the activities that must run in sequence versus in parallel.
* Prepare procurement and material delivery schedules aligned to the construction programme.
* Track actual progress against baseline, flag slippage early and prepare recovery plans.
* Maintain look-ahead plans and daily and weekly progress reporting.

**Tendering & Procurement**

* Prepare tender documents, float RFQs and RFIs, and run pre-bid clarifications.
* Prepare technical and commercial comparative statements and recommend award.
* Draft work orders with unambiguous scope, rates, measurement basis, payment terms and timelines.
* Identify and develop new vendors and contractors across civil, MEP and specialist trades.

**Measurement, Billing & Certification**

* Carry out joint measurement at site and record measurements in the measurement book.
* Verify contractor RA bills against the BOQ, work order rates and actual site measurement, and certify for payment.
* Maintain deviation and variation statements with rate justification for non-BOQ and extra items.
* Reconcile free-issue and client-supplied material.
* Track advances, retention, recoveries, debit notes, and final bill settlement and closure.
* Coordinate with finance for release of payments against certification.

**QA / QC**

* Prepare and enforce inspection and test plans, stage-wise quality checklists and the material approval process.
* Check executed work against drawings, specifications and approved samples at each stage.
* Conduct pre-handover testing – electrical load and earthing, HVAC balancing and airflow, fire system testing, plumbing pressure testing, network certification and access control commissioning.
* Prepare and close snag lists; complete handover documentation including as-builts, warranties, O&M manuals and asset registers.

**Cost Control & Reporting**

* Track estimated versus actual cost line by line; maintain a variation register and flag overruns before they are incurred.
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and quantify the saving and the trade-off.
* Prepare monthly MIS on cost, schedule and quality across all live projects.
* Prepare decision notes and options analyses for management on technical and commercial matters.

**Technical Support to Management**

* Act as the technical point of contact for management – site inspections, technical assessment of prospective buildings, and assessment of landlord fit-out obligations and base-build condition.
* Scope, cost and advise on chargeability of client fit-out and modification requests.
* Prepare technical inputs for client agreements, scope schedules, snag and handover documents.
* Represent Cove in meetings with landlords, architects, consultants and contractors.

**Desired profile of the candidate**

* An execution engineer on a project management track, with strong quantity surveying skills. This is not a supervisory-only profile – the person must personally build budgets, check measurements and certify bills.
* Experience with a PMC, design-build contractor, IPC, developer, or a retail / flex-space rollout operator, handling commercial interior fit-out projects.
* Comfortable working across civil, electrical and MEP scopes rather than a single trade.
* Strong numerical discipline and documentation habits.
* Willing to travel across Chennai and Bangalore. Primary place of posting – Chennai / Bangalore.

5 – 8 yrs, including at least 2 – 3 yrs of direct site execution.

title: Azure Architect
description:
**Experience:** 10 – 12 Years

**Required Skills**

Microsoft Fabric Architecture, One Lake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Direct Lake Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics Medallion Architecture and Data Governance Azure Cloud Architecture, Landing Zones and Networking Security: Entra ID, RBAC, Purview, Key Vault DevSecOps, CI/CD, Terraform/Bicep Enterprise Data Migration and Modernization Architecture Leadership, Pre-Sales and Stakeholder Mana

**Role summary**

The Azure Architect is the design authority for enterprise data and analytics platforms built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. You will define target-state architecture, landing zone and security guardrails, and the DevSecOps operating model that lets delivery teams ship Fabric workloads safely and repeatably. You will lead client-facing architecture, pre-sales solutioning and governance boards, and mentor senior engineers and specialists.

**Key responsibilities**

**Architecture and design authority**

* Define end-to-end target architecture for Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks/Spark, Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstream, Eventhouse/KQL), and Power BI semantic models using Direct Lake.
* Design medallion (bronze/silver/gold) and data-mesh patterns using Fabric domains, workspaces, OneLake shortcuts (ADLS Gen2, S3, GCS, Dataverse) and Mirroring (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Snowflake, Databricks catalogs).
* Own capacity strategy: F-SKU sizing, capacity separation (dev/test/prod, workload isolation), autoscale, smoothing and throttling behaviour, Capacity Metrics app monitoring and chargeback.
* Produce architecture decision records (ADRs), HLD/LLD, reference architectures and non-functional requirements (availability, RPO/RTO, performance, cost).
* Lead migration architecture from Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, SQL Server/SSIS, Power BI Premium (P-SKU) and on-premises warehouses to Fabric.
* Design Azure landing zones aligned to the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Well-Architected Framework: management group hierarchy, subscription vending, hub-spoke or Virtual WAN networking, Azure Firewall, Private DNS.
* Define network isolation for Fabric: Private Links (tenant and workspace level), Managed Private Endpoints, managed virtual networks, trusted workspace access, on-premises and VNet data gateways.
* Architect supporting services: ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Functions, AKS/Container Apps, Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry integration with Fabric data agents and Copilot.
* Define identity model with Microsoft Entra ID: security groups, workspace roles, item permissions, OneLake security (role-based data access), row/column/object-level security, service principals and workspace identities, PIM and Conditional Access.
* Integrate Microsoft Purview: data map and scanning, Unified Catalog, sensitivity labels and label inheritance in Fabric, DLP policies, lineage and audit.
* Set encryption and key management standards: customer-managed keys, Azure Key Vault, managed identities, secret rotation.
* Map controls to regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, DPDP Act, RBI/SEBI or industry equivalents) and lead security architecture reviews and threat modelling (STRIDE).
* Own Fabric tenant settings governance and admin-portal policy baseline.
* Define the secure SDLC for data workloads: branching strategy, Fabric Git integration (Azure DevOps Repos / GitHub), deployment pipelines (dev → test → prod), deployment rules and parameterisation.
* Standardise Infrastructure as Code with Terraform (azurerm, azapi and the Microsoft Fabric provider) and/or Bicep; define module registries, state management and policy-as-code (Azure Policy, OPA/Conftest, Sentinel).
* Define CI/CD reference pipelines on Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions using the Fabric REST APIs and the fabric-cicd Python library, with OIDC / workload identity federation (no long-lived secrets).
* Embed security gates: SAST (CodeQL, SonarQube), secret scanning (GitHub Advanced Security, Gitleaks), IaC scanning (Checkov, tfsec/Trivy), dependency/SCA scanning, container image scanning and SBOM generation.
* Define posture management with Microsoft Defender for Cloud (CSPM, DevOps security connectors), Microsoft Sentinel alerting and audit-log streaming.

**Azure platform and landing zone**

**Security, governance and compliance**

**DevSecOps and platform engineering**

title: Senior HPC Cloud Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You will be the primary architecture reviewer and performance champion for new data center clusters being built across multiple sites globally.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the build-out and day-to-day operation of NVIDIA's VLSI high-performance compute environments in the public cloud, and the repeatable patterns that let us stand up the next environment faster than the last.
* Bring up and operate large compute clusters on Google Cloud end to end - instance provisioning, machine images, OS pipelines, networking, identity and quota management.
* Build the automation that makes cluster bring-up reproducible: infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, image build pipelines, and host lifecycle automation including hostname and identity preservation across maintenance events.
* Extend the same patterns to new on-premises data centers so cloud and on-prem run on one toolchain rather than two, and work with networking and storage teams on cross-site connectivity, latency budgets, and what is cross-mounted versus kept site-local.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will debug at depth when clusters misbehave - image and boot issues, mount failures, scheduler-host interactions, capacity and quota problems - and partner with the scheduling and operations engineers so what you build is operable by the whole team, not only by you.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering, with substantial time running production compute at scale.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with a major public cloud, Google Cloud preferred - compute, networking, IAM, storage, quotas, and the operational realities of running thousands of instances rather than tens.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and configuration management skills (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent), plus experience with machine image build and OS lifecycle pipelines for large fleets.
* Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting: filesystems, NFS mounts and latency, networking, boot and image pipelines.
* Working understanding of data center and network fundamentals for compute-intensive workloads - topology, bandwidth and latency characterisation, and the practical limits of cross-site operation - along with familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and how compute nodes join, leave and are managed within them.
* Strong Python automation, experience bringing a new environment, cluster or data center online end to end, and the ability to work effectively across time zones. Semiconductor/EDA exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Engineer III - Communication
description:

You will design, build, and deploy secure, end-to-end connected device ecosystems—from microcontrollers and Linux gateways up to real-time telemetry analytics in the cloud.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Firmware & Embedded Software Development:** Write, test, and optimize production-grade firmware (C/C++, FreeRTOS, Embedded Linux) for edge microcontrollers, sensors, and gateway devices (e.g., ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi, custom SBCs).
* **Network & Connectivity Layer Integration:** Implement secure communication protocols (MQTT/TLS, CoAP, WebSockets, gRPC, TCP/IP) and interface with physical transport networks (Wi-Fi, Cellular/LTE, BLE, LoRaWAN, Ethernet).
* **Cloud Platform Integration:** Connect edge fleets to cloud IoT backends (AWS IoT Core, Azure IoT Hub, GCP IoT) and build pipeline logic for device provisioning, remote management, Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates, and time-series telemetry processing.

* **Security & Device Identity:** Implement hardware-root-of-trust security, X.509 certificate provisioning, end-to-end encryption, and secure boot across embedded devices and cloud API gateways.
* **DevOps, Automation & CI/CD:** Build containerized edge deployments (Docker, AWS Greengrass, Azure IoT Edge) and set up continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for firmware and cloud releases.
* **Field Testing & System Validation:** Lead integration testing on physical hardware setups, simulate adverse network conditions (latency, intermittent drops), and support operational detachments or field-site deployments for root-cause diagnosis.

* Escalate technical, legal, documentation, approval-related, or pricing queries to the appropriate internal team whenever necessary.
* Ensure all information shared with customers is accurate, transparent, and consistent with company-approved communication.
* Build customer trust through professional communication, timely responses, and consistent follow-ups.

**III. Lead Qualification, Follow-Up & Sales Pipeline Management**

* Qualify leads based on customer interest, budget suitability, preferred project location, purchase readiness, and willingness to attend a site visit.
* Identify genuine prospective plot buyers and distinguish them from general enquiries or prospects with no immediate purchase intent.
* Maintain a systematic follow-up schedule for interested customers and ensure that no qualified lead is missed due to delayed communication.
* Follow up with customers who require additional information, need time to discuss with family members, or are comparing different property options.
* Record customer objections, feedback, purchase timelines, and agreed next steps in the CRM.
* Re-engage older leads and prospects who previously showed interest but did not proceed with a site visit or booking.
* Share qualified leads and relevant customer information with the Field Sales Team to support effective customer engagement.
* Monitor the progress of leads from initial enquiry through qualification, site-visit scheduling, and subsequent sales follow-up.
* Maintain an updated pipeline of active prospects, follow-up cases, and potential sales opportunities.

**IV. Site-Visit Coordination & Conversion Support**

* Convert qualified customer enquiries into confirmed site visits for the company's plotted development projects.
* Explain the importance of visiting the project site to understand the actual location, layout, accessibility, surrounding development, and available plots.
* Schedule site visits based on customer availability and coordinate with the Sales Managers, Field Sales Executives, and Site Teams.
* Confirm scheduled visits with customers and provide reminders to improve attendance.
* Share customer requirements, budget details, preferred plot sizes, and previous discussion notes with the assigned Sales Executive before the site visit.
* Track scheduled, completed, rescheduled, and cancelled site visits in the CRM.
* Follow up with customers after their site visits to understand feedback, interest level, concerns, and further requirements.
* Coordinate with the Sales Team to identify prospects who require additional assistance before proceeding towards booking.
* Support the sales team in improving lead-to-site-visit and site-visit-to-booking conversion ratios.
* Maintain regular communication with the Sales Team regarding high-potential leads and immediate sales opportunities.

**V. Channel Partner Coordination (If Applicable)**

* Coordinate with the Channel Partner Team or designated reporting manager regarding enquiries received through channel partners and property brokers.
* Record and track customer leads referred by channel partners in the prescribed CRM system.
* Ensure that channel partner leads are assigned, updated, and followed up on according to company procedures.
* Coordinate with the concerned internal team to obtain approved information regarding project details, pricing, availability, and sales processes for channel partner enquiries.
* Follow up on referred leads and coordinate with the Sales Team regarding site visits and subsequent sales progress.
* Maintain proper records of channel partner enquiries, lead status, site visits, and booking updates.
* Escalate channel partner-related queries or issues to the authorised team for resolution.
* Follow company policies concerning lead ownership, customer allocation, channel partner communication, and commission-related information.

**VI. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery**

* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets assigned by the reporting manager.
* Meet prescribed outbound calling and customer enquiry-handling targets.
* Maintain expected productivity in terms of connected calls, meaningful customer conversations, and qualified leads.
* Generate and schedule qualified site visits based on customer interest and project requirements.
* Improve site-visit attendance through timely confirmation calls, reminders, and follow-ups.
* Contribute to sales and booking objectives by providing qualified prospects and consistent follow-up support to the Field Sales Team.
* Monitor individual performance against assigned targets and take corrective action when required.
* Participate in daily reviews, weekly performance meetings, and monthly target assessments.
* Maintain a balance between calling volume, lead quality, customer experience, and conversion performance.
* Work towards the performance benchmarks established by management based on lead availability, campaign volume, and project requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Number of outbound calls made.
* Number of inbound enquiries handled.
* Number of connected calls and meaningful conversations.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of site visits scheduled and completed.
* Site-visit attendance and conversion rates.
* Follow-up completion and lead reactivation.
* CRM data accuracy and timely MIS submission.
* Contribution to sales opportunities and bookings.

**VII. CRM, Documentation & MIS Reporting**

* Maintain complete and accurate customer records in the company's prescribed CRM or lead management system.
* Update call outcomes, customer requirements, lead classification, follow-up dates, site-visit schedules, and sales progress promptly.
* Ensure proper lead allocation, status updates, and follow-up tracking in accordance with company procedures.
* Prepare and submit daily call reports, follow-up reports, qualified-lead reports, and site-visit updates.
* Prepare weekly lead pipeline and site-visit status reports for management review.
* Support the preparation of monthly performance reports covering productivity, lead conversion, site visits, and sales contribution.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all CRM entries, reports, and customer-related documentation.
* Avoid duplicate records, incomplete entries, and unauthorised changes to lead information.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information, company databases, project pricing, and internal business information.
* Follow company guidelines for CRM usage, data security, and customer information handling.

**VIII. Coordination with Internal Teams**

* Coordinate with the Team Lead – Pre-Sales / Pre-Sales Manager for daily activities, target allocation, lead prioritisation, and performance reviews.
* Work closely with the Digital Marketing Team to understand lead sources, campaign details, and the quality of incoming enquiries.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Field Sales Executives to facilitate site visits and support sales conversion.
* Liaise with the CRM Team for clarification regarding customer documentation, registration processes, and post-booking procedures when required.
* Coordinate with the Liaison Team for authorised clarification regarding project approvals and documentation-related queries.
* Communicate recurring customer objections, feedback, pricing concerns, and market observations to the reporting manager.
* Participate in project briefings, product training, sales meetings, and internal performance reviews.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination across departments to ensure a smooth customer journey.

**IX. Professional Development**

* Develop a thorough understanding of the company's plotted development projects, including location, layout, plot sizes, amenities, pricing, and approved payment plans.
* Upgrade knowledge of CRM tools, lead management practices, customer engagement techniques, and sales reporting.
* Stay updated on real estate market trends, customer buying behaviour, competitor offerings, and local property demand.
* Improve telephone etiquette, persuasion, negotiation, objection handling, and customer relationship management skills.
* Participate in internal training programmes, project presentations, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Implement feedback received from the reporting manager to improve productivity and conversion performance.

**X. Behaviour, Teamwork & Workplace Conduct**

* Maintain professional conduct and a customer-focused approach in all interactions.
* Demonstrate discipline, ownership, accountability, and commitment to assigned targets.
* Work collaboratively with the Pre-Sales, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and other relevant teams.
* Maintain a positive attitude while handling customer objections, repeated follow-ups, and target-related pressure.
* Demonstrate patience, emotional intelligence, and effective communication when dealing with diverse customer requirements.
* Follow ethical sales practices and provide only accurate, company-approved information to customers.
* Adhere to company policies, attendance requirements, reporting procedures, and workplace guidelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer data and company information.
* Accept performance feedback positively and demonstrate continuous improvement in individual and team performance.

**Working Days & Week-Off Policy**

* Sunday working is mandatory due to peak customer enquiries and site-visit requirements.
* Weekly off will be provided on a weekday as per management allocation.
* Flexibility to work during marketing campaigns, festive periods, special sales drives, and other business requirements is expected.
* Working hours, attendance, leave, and other employment conditions will be governed by company policy.

**Key Working Relationships**

**Internal**

* Team Lead – Pre-Sales / Pre-Sales Manager
* Sales Managers and Field Sales Team
* Digital Marketing Team
* CRM Team / CRM Head
* Liaison Team, wherever required
* Other relevant departments as required for customer enquiry resolution

**External**

* Prospective Customers and Clients
* Channel Partners / Property Brokers, where applicable
* Other authorised external stakeholders, as required

**Qualification & Experience**

**Essential**

* Any graduate degree from a recognised university is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in real estate pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management, or target-based customer acquisition is preferred.
* Experience in residential plot sales, plotted developments, land sales, or other property-related businesses will be an added advantage.
* Good verbal communication skills in Tamil are essential for handling local customers.
* Basic to good English communication skills for professional interactions and reporting.
* Ability to work towards assigned performance targets and manage regular customer follow-ups.

**Desirable**

* Postgraduate qualification such as an MBA in Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Experience handling high-volume customer enquiries and digital marketing leads.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, lead management tools, and sales MIS reporting.
* Experience coordinating site visits and supporting real estate sales conversions.
* Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and a willingness to work in a target-driven environment may be considered based on business requirements.

**Functional Competencies**

* Lead Management and Qualification
* Customer Relationship Management
* Real Estate Project Knowledge
* Lead Conversion and Site-Visit Coordination
* Communication, Persuasion and Objection Handling
* CRM and Technology Utilisation
* Reporting and Performance Metrics
* Follow-Up and Sales Pipeline Management
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Target Achievement and Productivity Management

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Customer Focus
* Team Collaboration
* Emotional Intelligence
* Time Management and Prioritisation
* Adaptability and Initiative
* Accountability and Ownership
* Professionalism and Ethical Conduct
* Resilience and Target Orientation
* Attention to Detail
* Continuous Learning and Improvement

**Overall Role Objective**

The Pre-Sales Executive is responsible for serving as the first point of contact for prospective customers interested in the company's plotted development projects. The role focuses on effective lead management, customer engagement, project explanation, systematic follow-ups, and site-visit generation. Through disciplined CRM management and close coordination with the Field Sales Team, the position is expected to strengthen the sales pipeline and contribute to the company's overall sales and booking objectives.

description: Job title: Senior Project AssociateProject and job description:Applications are invited for the position of Senior Project Associate under ISRO RESPOND project titled “Large and small-scale ionospheric plasma irregularities using airglow imaging and GNSS TEC measurements“.This is a two-year project involving collaboration between Krea University and Physical Research Laboratory (PRL).The primary work location would be Krea University campus in Sri City.The aim of the project is to develop low-cost imagers to capable of observing ionospheric irregularity structures in the faint oxygen airglow lines emanating from the thermosphere-ionosphere region. title: SDET- API/Middleware
description:
**Job Overview**

Welo Global is hiring an **SDET** (Software Development Engineer in Test) to bring deep technical rigor to middleware-layer testing. This role requires strong technical expertise across gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, JSON-RPC/REST, proxy-based traffic inspection, and API scripting. The primary responsibility is to observe and reconstruct the network interactions generated by the onboarding UI, including request/response structures, schemas, headers, identifiers, Enums, and client-injected parameters. This is primarily an API/network analysis and evidence-generation role rather than a conventional UI automation or regression-testing role. The resource will produce sanitized network evidence and controlled, benign tracer replay scripts for downstream backend validation.  
  
**Project Details**  
  
**Title:** SDET - API/Middleware  
**Rate:** $9.50/hr  
**Start Date:** 19th October  
**Duration:** 5 Weeks  
**Commitment**: 35 Hours per Week  
**Location:** India (Remote)  
**Job Type:** Freelance

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain automated API test suites covering gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, and JSON-RPC/REST based services
* Export clean, sanitized HAR/network evidence while maintaining traceability between UI actions and corresponding network requests.
* Map relevant schemas, headers, identifiers, routing information, and client-injected parameters.
* Use proxy tools such as Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools to inspect, intercept, and validate network traffic between client and server
* Develop and maintain API automation scripts using Python, Postman, and cURL for functional and regression testing
* Analyze protocol-level request/response behavior to identify defects related to serialization, encoding, and transport
* Inspect and validate request payload structure, including system-level headers (e.g., auth tokens, routing identifiers) and internal/hidden parameters, ensuring correct handling under both valid and malformed conditions
* Collaborate with backend and middleware engineers to define testable contracts and edge-case scenarios
* Continuously improve test automation frameworks for reliability, speed, and maintainability
* Document technical findings, automation coverage, and known protocol-level limitations

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on expertise of **3-5+ years** with gRPC-Web, Proto3, HTTP/2, and JSON-RPC/REST protocols
* Proficiency with proxy/traffic inspection tools including Mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, and browser DevTools
* Solid scripting/programming skills in Python, with practical use of Postman and cURL for API automation
* Experience designing and maintaining automated test suites for middleware or API-layer services
* Working understanding of API request structure, including headers, auth tokens, and internal/system parameters, and how to test for their correct handling
* Understanding of software engineering practices as applied to test automation (version control, CI integration, code review)
* Strong debugging skills at the network/protocol level
* Experience analysing browser-generated network traffic and reconstructing API behaviour is strongly preferred.
* Experience with HAR analysis, API schema reconstruction, or controlled API replay is strongly preferred.
* Ability to work within approved staging/test environments and follow defined data-handling and test-authorization requirements is required.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our R&D Department. The candidate will be responsible for validating web-scraped data, reviewing sample files, testing API responses, verifying client-specific requirements, and ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards before submission.

The candidate will work closely with developers, Team Leads (TLs), and Assistant Team Leads (ATLs) to identify defects, maintain quality benchmarks, and prevent recurring data extraction issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Quality Assurance**

* + Validate scraped data against the source website and client requirements.
  + Verify field-level accuracy, completeness, consistency, and data types.
  + Identify missing fields, incorrect values, duplicate records, and formatting issues.
  + Validate product details, pricing, availability, URLs, identifiers, and other relevant attributes.

**2. Sample and Deliverable Validation**

* + Review sample files before they are marked as QA-passed or submitted to clients.
  + Ensure that the output structure, column names, file naming conventions, and data formats match the specified requirements.
  + Validate samples against the approved requirements and reference examples.
  + Maintain evidence of validation and document any defects identified.

**3. API Testing**

* + Validate API requests and responses, including HTTP status codes, response structures, required fields, and error handling.
  + Verify JSON, CSV, Excel, and other required output formats.
  + Test pagination, filtering, and relevant request parameters wherever applicable.
  + Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.

**4. Defect Management and RCA**

* + Report defects with clear descriptions, sample records, screenshots, and reproduction steps.
  + Coordinate with developers and TLs/ATLs for defect resolution and retesting.
  + Identify recurring quality issues and contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  + Maintain defect logs and track issues until closure.

**5. Quality Process Improvement**

* + Develop and maintain QA checklists for different projects and platforms.
  + Identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation tasks using Python.
  + Track quality metrics, including defect rates, first-pass acceptance, rework, and sample rejection trends.
  + Recommend improvements to reduce recurring errors and improve delivery reliability.

**Required Skills**

* + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  + Experience in manual testing, data validation, or software QA.
  + Basic to intermediate Python knowledge for data validation and automation.
  + Experience working with JSON, CSV, Excel, and structured datasets.
  + Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and response validation.
  + Familiarity with Postman, Excel, and basic SQL/MongoDB queries.
  + Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Experience in web scraping, crawling, e-commerce data, or data extraction projects.
  + Knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, XPath, and browser developer tools.
  + Experience with automated testing frameworks or data comparison scripts.
  + Familiarity with Git and issue-tracking systems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* + Accuracy and completeness of QA validation.
  + Number of defects identified before client submission.
  + Reduction in recurring defects and sample rejections.
  + Compliance with project-specific QA checklists.
  + Timely completion of QA reviews.
  + Quality and completeness of defect reports and RCAs.
  + Effectiveness of retesting and defect closure.

**Expected Outcome**

The QA Engineer will establish an independent quality checkpoint within the R&D workflow, ensuring that samples and deliverables are validated against client requirements before final approval and reducing avoidable rework and quality escalations.

From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

**Job Purpose**

The Consultant (Technical) is an experienced team member of the Professional Services (PS) business unit. They are responsible for planning and overseeing technical team activities to develop complex technical upgrades of customer solutions as well as install and deploy to customer environments. This role will require the individual to become an expert in Quorum’s enterprise software architecture and deployment processes, including maintenance of heavily customized code, databases, and installations, and to mentor other team members in these areas.

**What You Will Do:**

* Execute end-to-end technical upgrades to latest software versions across dozens of enterprise customers, from incremental monthly patches to major upgrades of versions 5+ years out of date
* Perform complex technical tasks independently, including database upgrade packaging, custom database object remediation, analysis of code customizations, development of outdated custom features in latest code version, deployment of Azure DevOps pipelines, and on-premise environment installations
* Perform assigned work with quality, timely delivery, and documentation. This includes proactively collaborating with team members to overcome any technical challenges and roadblocks.
* Balance workload priorities across multiple concurrent upgrades and deliverables for various customers
* Demonstrate mastery and drive improvements for technical skills required for successful deployments & upgrades, such as: SQL, NuGet, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and in-house Quorum tools.

* Participate in stand-ups and retrospectives to identify technical and process issues, discuss improvement ideas, and share knowledge
* Serve as a Quorum Subject Matter Expert (SME) in client conversations while representing Quorum positively
* Serve as a technical SME in several areas of our products and architecture
* Understand, follow, and broadcast process changes among team members
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 2+ years of experience in software deployments or development,
* Strong programming skills (C++/C# or similar) including developing enhancements, performing code reviews, and resolving bugs
* Strong database skills (SQL) including writing complex functions/procedures, converting and managing large sets of data, and troubleshooting issues
* Demonstrated ownership of own commitments to high-quality software deliverables and customer experience
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal

**Preferred Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, technology, or other analytical discipline
* Development or deployment experience working in an Agile environment
* Experience with cloud solutions and complex integrations

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with TFS – In case developer needs to look at code previously developed in older versions
* Ability to debug and troubleshoot application bugs in Visual Studio
* Exposure to Oil & Gas domain

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.
